tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 gsung 'bum/_'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma/(si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /)

tei:div.tei:p: ra / /mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rdo grub chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i gsung 'bum legs bshad nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

pod 1sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig gnas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen da sa shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang /das sgrig/ tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ spyi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang66gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung go'i 1

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu dbos ’zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par ba sprul/gong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/nga tshos rang skyong khul kyi don dngos dang zung 'brel byas te/ ched gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'then dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga tsho'i thog ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung / nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zin cing / dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dugade phyir thog ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng /1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshul du〈khra dge slong tshul 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 1ma khrims dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga gzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing ched rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung jengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lab star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spa ṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol snyud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lta dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub 3

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ston la brtsi srung sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel — dang / mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rig gnas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gcigs 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang spros ma dgos/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chags par byas te/ ma 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 1dngul gyi mthun rkyen cung 'byor ba'i gnas tshul 'og〈dpe tshogs〉de jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i ris gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing / mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de tsho'i rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i legs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog dang / phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du ‘mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams —nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi 5

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ra tshogs la thugs gzhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang / legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min ris gnas shig gi bdag por gyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dag dang de das gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 1 —— rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs ba yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus mtshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gcigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang66mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste sogs kyis — mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul gsum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni bslab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsung chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas tebu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dusaX7

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gyur mang po'i khrod du'ang srog dang bsdos nas srung skyob byas 'dug da lta bsam na 'di ni goms srol legs po tsam du ma zad snying stobs rigs shig gi mtshon byed du'ang rung bar snyam/de dag gi dbang gis sa gnas 'dir yang lo rgyus su mkhas pa mi nyung ba tsam byon cing / da lta'i bar 'tshol du yod pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos kyang mang tsam bzhugs la/ de tsho'i thun min rin thang gi cha nas bshad na'ang lo rgyus su mgo log 'di mdo khams 'brel mtshams su chags yod pas/ mdo khams rig gnas ma lag che ba gnyis ka gcig 'dres su song ba'i nyams shig snang la/ bod brgyud nang bstan grub mtha'i dbang du btang na'ang snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge lugs pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba/mnyam med bka' brgyud pa sogs grub mtha' che gras phal mo che zhig yun ring mnyam gnas su chags pas/ dmangs khrod rig gnas tshun gyi rig gnas kun la sa cha gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i sger khyad cig lhag ger snang bar bsten/ rig gnas shul bzhag 'di rigs myur skyob thub pa byung na/ bod spyi'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dar rgyun nam brgyud pa gyes 'phel 'gro tshul dang /sa gnas thun min rig gnas grub stangs sogs zhib 'jug byed par don snying dang rin thang shin tu che bar gdon mi za la/ tha na 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 1 bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang gses phyogs rer mtshon na de phyogs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra1 gang ltar da lha nga tshos((mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub ba ni tang gi mi rigs srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing / krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bsnyon du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs snon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing / dus mtshungs su〈dpe tshogs〉'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod gsar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor —

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yod/de sngon kyi srid jus legs po'i go skabs ma shor bar byas te/cha rkyen zhan cing dka' tshegs che ba la ma ltos par mthun rkyen gsar gtod sgos 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig myur skyob kyi las la rang rtogs ngang zhugs nas sa gnas rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du 'bad pa yun ring bsten pa'i ched las don gnyer mi sna dag gis don mthun gyi bya ba mang po bsgrubs song bas/ ngas 'dir khong tshor dka' las myang song zhes zhu zhing / kho bo rang ngos kyis bya ba de la rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen sbyor ba'ang ldog med kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis yod/'on kyang rang khul gyi gna' rtsom ma lus par yongs su myur skyob byed rgyu ni da dung dus yun ring zhing dka' khag che ba'i bya ba zhis yin pas/ grub 'bras kyi rmang gzhi'i steng myu 'thud nas rgyun 'khyongs lhod med kyi bya ba 'bor chen zhig bsgrub pa la rag las yod/mjug mthar mgo log gna' rtsom bya ba legs 'grub yong zhing / grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa'i smon 'dun zhu//zhes pad ma rnam rgyal nas2003 1 1la bris/10

pod 1rtsom pa po za sprod mdor bsdus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa rgos li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyur bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo gling lor(spyi lo1865)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 11

za da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhan phan 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag pa mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so//rdza stod du phebs nas 'jam dbyangs rur sprig 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas/lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs te dgongs pa ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgung lo brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'jug gi bka' khrid gnang dgos zhes phyogs kyi slob bu mang du bsdus tshe/nye gnas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong sku na chung drags pas re zhig 'khor de lta bu la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad par brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jug chen mo'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo zhing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal sprul rin po 12

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 1che'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byis pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung gi bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzogs sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla gter chen/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dbu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thig gong 'og sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ mdo smad rdi tsha dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig chas gtso byas ri bo dge ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med par thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher rgyas/3

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rab tshes lcags 'brug spyi lo1880lor mgo log pad ma 'bum dpon shog brgyad kyis ched du phul ba'i bzhus/sa gnas rdo yul khri zhes bya bar dgon gnas gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes bya ba gsar du bzhengs pa/ phyis ming zur shugs kyis 'gyur te gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling du grags/de tsam nas dgon pa de'i g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong mar thang stong rgyal po'i lha khang du grags pa'i dben khrod cig tu sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos khor yug dus kun 'gengs la/ lhag pa'i lha la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bgro gleng byed cing / ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus nas glegs bam skyel 'bul byed pa/ nyin lam du ma'i sar rab gnas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang brdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kho nar dgyes pas don gyi gsang ba sus kyang dpogs par dka'/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs su bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ bod kyi mkhas grub ris med kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam gsar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi phrin las kyang rgya cher spel/mthar rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad pa me stag gi lor(1929)14

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 1gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus so//lung gis zin pa'i thugs sras mgar ba mkhan po 'jigs med 'od zer dang / ser shul mkhan po/ klu shul mkhan po/ mkhan po dam chos bcas mkhan chen bzhis gtso'i rnyiḥphi dug tsha sogs yul gru kun nas slob ma mang du 'dus kyang / 'khor slob rgya cher bsdu ba sogs thun mong gi mnga' thang dang gzi byin gyi spros pa rtag tu bsgyungs te bzhugs/gsung rtsom la〈rgyud ma hā yo ga'i tan+t+ra gsang ba'i snying bo de kho na nyid rnam par nges pa la zur lugs ltar gyi dgongs 'grel spyi don rin chen mdzod kyi lde mig〉dang / 〈mdo las byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs kyi rgyan rnam par bshad pa rgyal yum lus bzang mdzes byed legs bshad phreng ba〉sogs mdo sngags gzhung 'grel gyi skor dang / sgrub thabs skyed rdzogs kyi skor/lo rgyus gtam tshogs kyi skor/ gsung mgur snyan ngag gi skor/ zhal gdams man ngag gi skor sogs gang la'ang thun mong min pa'i khyad chos rtsal du thon pa'i gsung chos pod chen bcu phrag lhag cig bzhugs pa las/gong smras〈gsang snying spyi don〉dang / 〈gzungs kyi rnam bshad〉〈gter gyi rnam bshad〉sogs la shes nas smra ba'i mkhas pa du mas bstod bsngags kyi me tog mang du 'thor/ gzungs kyi skor la rnam 15

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad 'di nyid kho na las gzhung logs su brtsams pa zhig bod na med par grags pas/ 〈gzungs rnam〉'di'i dpe zhig a mdo dge bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi phyag brgyud nas kun gzigs bcu gsum pa chen po'i spyan sngar phul bas dgyes gzigs dang bsngags brjod yang yang gnang bar gsung la/ rdo grub khong rang nas kyang〈gsang snying〉dang〈gzungs rnam〉gnyis ka snying dmar rjen du bstan pa yin ces lan du mar gsung bar grags/ 〈gzungs rnam〉dang〈gter rnam〉gnyis dbyin ji sogs kyi yi ger bsgyur yod pa'ang nye lam thos so/ /gzhan yang khong gi gsung chos gang la'ang rtsom nyams dang rtsom stangs kyi cha nas thun mong la rjes bzlos su ma song ba'i khyad chos shig yod la/ snyan rtsom la'ang 'gyur bag dang ro nyams gzhan dang gzhan la yong dka' ba'i cha bklags pa tsam gyis lhag ger myong thub pa zhig yod pas/gsung mgur dang / gtam tshogs khrod kyi sgrung thung dag la rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur dang rin thang ngo mtshar ba zhig yod par sngon dang da lta'i ngag rig smra ba kun zhal gcig tu gleng ngo / /zhes pa'ang lnga rig smra ba bde legs rab rgyas su 'bod pas khul gna' rtsom gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor zla tshes dge bar 'phral mar sbyar ba'o// //16

dkar chagasgyu sngon 'gro'i gtam/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (1)rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ ༷ ༷ ༷ (11)bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ ༷༷ ༷ (1)gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ ༷ ༷ (225)zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ (315)gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ (457)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ (1)

ngo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ — ྾༄/ /bstan pa'i bdag po zam 'dren bzhi ba'i rnam thar dran pa'i bstod pa mi'am ci rab dga'i glu phreng sogs bzhugs/chos nyid bzod pa'i snang ba che/ /shin tu yun ring brtan byas pas/ /zab mo'i chos rnams kun gyi gshis/ /ston pa zla med de la 'dud/ /srid na rnam par kun ba pa'i/ /grags pa tsam la ngal 'tsho ba/ /rnam dor la sogs ches mang yang / /nyes kun rtsa ba bzlog nus min/ /lo kyi srid pa'i rgud mang po/ /las kyi rgyu las gyur ba nas/ /'du byed rtsa ba ma ris/ pa/ /rmang nas 'don pa'i thabs 'di bstan/ /'di na 'jig rten rgyang 'phen sogs/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i nyes tshobs las/ /nges 'byung thabs la rnam rmongs shing / /srid pa'i snyoms 'jug tsam zhig 'dzin/ /lo kyis ma rig drungs 'byin pa/ /rten 'byung ston pa seng ge'i sgras/ /chos kyi rang bzhin ji lta ba/ /sems can khams la snang bar mdzad/ /srid rtsa las dang lus yin zhes/ /dka' thub dag gis gdungs byed pa/ /de dag btso blag mkhan bzhin du/ /khams gsum nyid las yongs 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mi 'da'/ /khyod kyis gdungs bas ma gzir bzhin/ /bdag med rtogs pa zab mo'i blo/ /'di nyid gcig pus khams gsum gyi/ /rgyu ba bde blag nyid du gcad/ /'dod nyon bral la thar ba zhes/ /bsam gtan tsam zhig bstan byed pa/ /de das sa bon ma spangs phyir/ /'dod nyon lag pa'i dreg ltar skye/ /khyod kyis nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bdag lta cha dang bcas ldog pa'i/ /lam 'di bstan nas kun nyon mongs/ /skye ba'i bzhi nyid zhi bar mdzad/ /mdor na spra ba zla med pa/ /khyod kyis sems can khams smin phyir/ /stong dang rten 'byung zung 'jug tu/ /bstan gang sto na pa gzhan la med/ /skye bo mdzangs pa min blo can/ /stong pas snang tsam nyid 'jig cing / /rten 'byung nyid phyir mi stong zhes/ /'gal bar 'khrul nas sgro skur 'dogs/ /khyod kyis ji snyed chos rnams kun/ /'gro dang 'ong med mtshan ma bral/ /rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes zhes/ /stong pa'i tshul 'di bstan nas slar/ /sgyu ma 'phrul 'dra'i chos 'ji dag /ma brtags nyams dga'i snang ba ste/ /rten nas 'byung ba nyid yin zhes/ /tha snyad gtam gyi rol mor 'doms/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung nyid log na/ /du ma'am gcig tu grub par 'gyur/ /du ma gcig nyid bsags pa ste/ /gcig bsabs min pa'i du ma med/ /gal te chos 'di gcig nyid na/ /min las log 3

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ba dang yin ma log /cha shas 'di dag mi 'grub ste/ /ngo bo nyid kyi gcig phyir ro/ /de slad khyod kyis shes bya kun/ /blo yis bzhag pa ma gtogs pa/ /'ga' yang yod pa ma yin zhes/ /smra ba skyon med 'di bstan gyur/ /brten nas btags la rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa nam yang ma mchis zhing / /stong bzhin snang ba 'di snang zhes/ /don 'di don gzis/sa mchog khyod gsungs/ /snang ba med cing sto nga ma mchis/ /rtag min chad pa ma yin pa'i/ /chos nyid 'di la khyod bzhugs nas/ /snang dang stong pa'i tha snyad 'dogs/ /khyod kyis ji snyed bstan pa'i chos/ /chos nyid gcig la 'bab cing gzhol/ /de phyir khyod kyis jeg pa gsum/ /bstan pa mthar thug don du gcig /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams la/ /stong nyid seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa/ /khams gsum rgyu ba zad phyir te/ /re zhig theg pa gnyis su bstan/ /blo mchog snying rje che ldan la/ /zab pa'i chos nyid gang bstan pa/ /byang chub mchog la 'jog phyir te/ /thabs kyis khyad par byas pa lags/ /ji ltar mgar ba dag gis gser/ /bzhu btul shugs drag shugs drag min/ /khyad par 'di las gser gyi mdangs/ /dag dang ma dag khyad par snang / /de bzhin slob ma bse ru'i lam/ /theg pa che dang mi mtshungs pa/ /pha rol phyin pa'i sgo mang po/ /rnam par bstan pas khyad par byas/ /de ltar khyod kyis sems 4

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1can khams/ /sna tshogs chos rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /gdul ba'i cho 'phrul 'dzad med kyang / /chos nyid 'khrugs par byas pa med/ /khyod kyis chos rnams ma bshigs shing / /khyod kyis khams rnams bskyed pa'ang med/ /de lta mod kyi chos nyid gshis/ /bri gang med 'di khyod kyis bstan/ /don zab seng ge'i sgra 'di yis/ /ma rig rgyu ba 'gog mdzad de/ /de bkag pas ni skye 'chi'i sgo/ /kun la'ang 'gog pa thob pa lags/ /chos kun rang bzhin zad bstan nas/ /'dzad med srid pa'i snang ba 'di//mi zad tshul gyis zad mdzad pa/ /ston mchog khyod kyi thabs mkhas sgo/ /skye nyid rga shir 'phos min zhing / /rga shi skye las ma byung min/ /skye shi rkyen nyid 'di ba zhes/ /skye shi'i rtsa ba 'gog phyir bstan/ /mdor na ston pa kun mkhyen zhabs//ston pa'i nang na zla med cing / /smra ba kun las khyu mchog tu/ /rigs pa mkhyen pa rnams la grub/ /de rjes 'brangs nas mi mkhas pa/ /bdag 'dra'ang mkhas pa ltar bcos te/ /bstod tshig me tog dog pa 'dis/ /'dren pa mchog la phu dud byas/ /dge tshogs yid bzhin sprin dkar las/ /dge legs char chen 'bum bsnyil nas/ /dge zhing dge ba'i bkra shis kyis/ /sa gsum rtag tu bdal gyur cig /ces pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med pas rang lo bcu dgu pa chu lug gi lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin gung skad cig 5

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yud tsam la spyo gtam byas pa dge bar gyur cig///rab/ /dpal shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grangs med bskal pa'i nor 'dzin yangs pa ru/ /dpag med tshogs gnyis sa bon legs btab pas/ /tshad med stobs bcu'i myu gu bskyed bsrings pa'i/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal mang gong nas mngon par sangs rgyas kyang / /ris bral 'gro la snying rjes rab bskul te/ /zhing 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa po/ /mgon po shākya'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam mang dga' ba'i 'byung gnas lha yul na/ /rgyal sras sa bcu'i sems dpa' phyin drug spyod/ /dam pa tog dkar zhes bya'i snyan pa'i rnga/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i thos 'dzin bcud du bsal/ /gang tshe sil snyan sgra yis bskrul ba'i mod/ /dkar gsal zla ba'i mdangs kyi rjes 'gro ba'i/ /glang po mchog tu dal ba'i ngang tshul gyis/ /sgyu 'phrul lhams su zhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbugs skyes bcu yi grangs su brgal ba'i tshe/ /sum rtsen gnas la 'gran pa'i dga' tshal du/ /glag sha'i shing drung ngo mtshar ltas dang bcas/ /mtshan dpe'i sku mchog bltams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu rtsal sa srung dbang por stegs bcas nas/ /shākya'i nu cor smra ba'i da nu'i bu'i/ /khengs dregs ru mtshon stobs chen sprin skyes kyis/ /gzhom bgyid don kun grub la 6

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs bzang chu gter las 'ongs lang tsho'i dal/ /mdzes sdug ri bong gzugs kyis 'khyud gyur pa'i/ /mig yangs gzhon nu'i dbang mo drug khri'i 'khor/ /sa bdag zhi ba'i rgyan gyur der phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i gnas ris dug can bu mo'i lto/ /sdug bsngal ba ra yis nyer bzung ba'i/ /ngang tshul shes nas rnam grol gling bzang du/ /tshul khrims 'gros kyis chas der phyas 'tshal lo/ /dal 'bab bdud rtsi'i klung gi nye drung na/ /tshangs spyod lnga sde'i 'khor dang chabs gcig tu/ /mkha' khyab ting nge 'dzin la rab zhugs nas/ /dka' spyad khur du bzung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de tshe phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad dang / /blo ldan mkhar nyal tshogs kyis bskul tshig gis/ /dka' thub kho nas grol ba med mkhyen nas/ /bcud ldan bsod par dgyes mdzad der phyag 'tshal/ /bag/ med rnam par spangs pa'i spyod lam dang / /zhi dul ngang tshul ldan pa'i slong tshig gis/ /bkra shis gzhon nu'i mchog las rtswa blangs te/ /gnas kyi gtso bor gshegs der phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang 'thung dbang po'i mchod rten ljon pa'i drung / /bdud 'dul ting 'dzin 'od stong bskrun pa'i mthus/ /yid bsrub dpung bcas mthu nus ku nu da/ /kun tu zum par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi ba'i ting 'dzin shel dkar khrir bzhugs te/ /rnam drug mngon par shes 7

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ 4྾pa'i go gyon nas/ /'dod nyon gzhan rgol sde tshogs gzhom mdzad pa'i/ /dpa' bo blo gros mchog la phyag 'tshal lo /dus kyi mchog gyur nyin mo'i sgo yi skabs/ /lo kyi byang chub chen po brnyes pa'i tshe /'od srung byin yang dga' bas gar bsgyur zhing / /'od snang stong du 'gyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug kun khebs khrod du zhugs gyur cing / /shes rab sgra 'dzin shin tu nyams gyur pa/ /'gro la lo kyi thugs ni dbyung gyur te/ /skyo ba'i ngang tshul ston der phyas/ 'tshal lo//'jig rten gsum na grags pa'i lha dbang zung / /grong khyer gsum na dkon pa'i skyes dang bcas/ /lan grangs gsum du bskul ba don yod phyir/ /chos gsung zhal gyis bzhes der phyag 'tshal lo /bsod nams bye ba'i 'byung gnas mtshan dpe'i sku/ dmar ser ngur smrig gsum gyis mdzes byas te/ /dge legs stong gis nyer bskrun grong khyer mchog /wa ra ṇa sir gsheb/sa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam gyis mi khyab tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan las//gdul bya'i skal bar 'tsham pa'i chos 'khor gsum/ /drang nges ldem dgongs tshul gyis legs bstan nas/ /'gro kun thar bar 'dren la phyag 'tshal lo//rtag 'dzin le lo'i lcags kyu'i dbang byas pa'i//skye bo'i tshogs la snying rjes ma bzod nas/ /sā la'i 'dab bskyod drung du gzugs snyu'i dpal/ /dbyengs su bsdu ba'i tshul ston la phyag 'tshal/ /stobs 8

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga bcu'i dbang phyug srid zhi'i mig gcig pu/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ris bral 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /ston mchob bu ram shing ba'i yon tan char/ /prod 'dir 'gran zlas dben la phyag 'tshal lo de ltar bstod dbyangs tshangs pa'i rgyud mangs ni/ /dad gsum sor mos bskyod pa las 'ongs pa'i/ /dge tshogs snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs ma lus pa/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob slad bsngo bar bgyi/ /bstan pa'i bdab po rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i rnam thar dran pa'i bstod pa mi'am ci rab dga'i glu phreng zhes bya ba 'jigs med rab rgyas kyis bris gzhi shog ldeb 'di'i grangs ldan byin nas der gang dran 'ib bris shig ces bskul ba ltar rmongs blo'i chu bur gyi spubs na shes gsum ri bong 'dzin mngon par gab pa'i byis pa/ 'jibs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i bla dwags 'chang bas so////

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ra / /'phags ba 'jam dpal la bstod pa/ ye shes sgyu ma 'bar ba'i phyag rgya che/ /rjes chags snying rje chen po'i snang ba can/ /dmar ser sku yi brda thabs 'dis mtshon te/ /snang ba gcig gis nam mkha'i khyon kun 'geng / /mkhyen gnyis ye shes shin tu rgya chen po/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su g.yung drung sgur bzhugs te/ /dwangs ma'i gzugs sku nges dang ma nges pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul rol mos srid pa kun tu khyab/ /bgres dang mi bgres mtshan ma btul zin kyang / /lhun grub ye shes rgyun chad med mtshon phyir/ /ga/zhon nu'i gzugs sbu rtag brtan 'gyur med ches/ /nam mkha' ji srid sgyu ma'i gar gyis rol/ /ye shes rdo rje sa/sang ba zab mo'i srog /'chi bdag bdud kyis rgol du ga la zhig /'chi med dbyings su ji ba'i chos nyid can/ /rtag chen sku ni 'gres rgud kun dang bral//sgrib med ye shes shin tu rgya chen po/ /zab mo'i dbyings su ro mnyam 'ubs chub cing / /rgya che'i chos la gzigs pa rnam dag pa/ /kun khyab sku ni chos kun rjes su 'gro/ /rtsol dang rtog pa'i 'ching ba nyer zhi yang / /gang 'dul bdul bya'i mos ngor 'tshams pa'i 0

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga nga gzugs/ /phyogs dang dus kyi rjes su song gyur pa/ /lhun grub sku ni dpag par dka' ba yin/ /srid dang zhi ba mi dmigs mnyam pa'i dbyings/ /mtha' bral klong du bzod pa'i mchog brnyes shing / /gzhom gzhig spangs pa'i khyad par mchog grub pa/ /ye shes sku ni rdo rje'i sku mchog yin/ /bsil gyur ye shes mi zad gangs chen mtsho/ /sgrib gsum nyes pa'i dra ba mthar mdzad de/ /dbang sngon ral gri'i dpa' rtags rjes 'dzin pa/ /gtsug tor chen po 'jam dpal smra ba'i lha/ /dngos snang shin tu zhi ba'i chos nyid du/ /sgra dang sgra min snang ba ma mchis mod/ /smra las don mang rtogs pa'i gdul bya'i ngor/ /sgra dbyangs stong gi rol mo rtag tu sbir/ /'bad rtsol ri mor bris pa ma yin kyang / /gsung gi che ba rnam pa thams cad pas/ /sna tshogs dbang por 'tshams pa'i sna tshogs don/ /rim dang rim min dus rnams kun tu ston/ /sdebs legs sgra la zhen pa'i tshur mthong ngor/ /byings rkyen rnam dbye'i sbyor bas dab byas pa'i/ /legs sbyar 'phags pa'i skad du chos ston te/ /'phags pa'i skad la rtog ges brdzi ba med/ /byings las bsgrub pa'i sgra skad 'ba' zhig pas/ /sems can khams mang 'dul ba'i yul min phyir/ /mchog dang mchog min rnam par ma phyes pa'i/ /sgra skad du mas chos phung rab 'byams ston/ /gsung gi gdangs gcig 'khor gyi dkyil 1

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾ — ྾—r+yā'akhor du/ /yan lag rgya mab dbyangs su snang ba'i 'phrul/ /ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs rmad byung ste/ /gsung gi che ba brtag par dka' ba lags/ /skad cig tsam zhis rna bar son pas kyang / /nyon mongs bag rdul phyis pa bzhin gyur te/ /blo gros snang ba snying la rgyas byed pa/ /gsung gi byin rlabs ngo mtshar phul byung yin/ /zlos dang ma 'brel sdeb sbyor nyams la sogs/ /ngag gi dri ma gzhar yang ma mchis te/ /tshis gi sbyor ba shin tu ma smad pa/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i dbyangs su rtag par sgrog /zab pa'i rang bzhin stong dang rten 'byung don/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar dge gyur ba/ /gsung sga don bzang bdud rtsi'i snang ba ste/ /gsung gsang bsam gyis mi khyab 'jam pa'i lha/ /mtha' brgyad spros pa bral ba'i gnas lugs su/ /srid dang srid min gdod nas mnyam gyur cing / /mnyam dang mi mnyam ngang gis nyer zhi ba'i/ /chos nyid klong du chos can 'dzin pa zad/ /mtha' grol gzhi las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /ji snyed snang ba sna tshogs shes bya'i khams/ /ba pa'i ye shes gcig gis nyer bcings te/ /gsung gi che bas shes bya rab 'byams ston/ /yid kyi nyes pa sgog bzhin 'ching byed pas/ /blo yi nus stobs bcings pa bzhin byas pa/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin ral gri yis/ /lhag mar bgyis des shes bya cis mi gzigs/ /'byin 'jug sems kyi ri mo 1 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1phyis bzhin du/ /ting 'dzin rnam par thar pa'i ye shes sgor/ /'jug pa'i spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /thos sgrog rang sangs rgyas kun zil gyis gnon/ /lam gyi mchog dang log par lhung ba'i lam/ /bde 'gror 'gro ba'i lam rnams kun gzigs te/ /lam dang lam min smra la ma bsnyengs ba/ /kun mkhyen thugs zhi sgobs pa'i phung po yin/ /dus bsum kun tu 'jug pa'i ye shes ni// chags dang thogs pa'i rdul gyis ma bzung ste/ /bsnyel ba med pa'i chos nyid mchog brnyes pa/ /kun mkhyen thugs ni dran pa'i gter chen yin/ /'gro 'ong med pa srid pa'i sgyu ma na/ /bde sdug snang ba chu zla bzhin spyod pa'i/ /sems can khams la dus kun dgongs mdzad pa/ /kun mkhyen thugs ni snying rje'i rang bzhin yin/ /yon tan rang bzhin rnam par grol ba'i chos/ /shin tu yongs rdzogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /yon tan mnga' ba'i rtse mor gshegs pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos 'jam dpal dpa' bo yin/ /grangs med zhing na rgyal dang de sras tshobs/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i yon tan bsngags mdzad kyang / /mdzad pa'i pha mtha' ༷ dmigs su yod min na/ /blun chen bdag 'dras brjod du ga la zhis /mos gus yid kyis bsngags brjod thung ngu zhig /bgyis pa'i legs byas ston zla ltar dkar bas/ /mtha' yas 'gro la phan dang 13

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstanas nyi'i gsung 'bum/bde ster zhing / /'jam mgon thugs kyi gsang ba mngon gyur cig /gus pa'i yid can sprang phrug spyon pa yang / /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i byin rlabs don gnyer zhing / /mkhyen pa'i lha de spyi bos rtag mchod pa'i/ /skal bzang snang ba mchog dang 'bral ma gyur/ /zhes pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med pas rang lo bco brgyad pa chu rta'i lo'i zla ba bdun pa'i dmar phyogs nyer gcig gi nyin bris shing gsol ba btabs pa dza gte////nga / /mig yor lta du'i gzugs kyis rnam rol phyogs dang dus kyi rjes su song / /bras cha lta bu'i gtam gyi rnga sgras 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor kun tu khyab/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes mchog sgas ji lta ji snyed chos kun gzigs/ /nam mkha' lta du'i spyod yul mchog brnyes 'jam dpal mgon la phyag bgyi'o/ /sems dang yid kyi rgyu ba nyer zhi rnam par shes las rab 'das pa'i/ /chos rnams rang bzhin shin tu brtag dka' spros bral zab mo de kho na/ /so so rang rig ye shes bcig sgas mtshan ma med pa'i tshul gzigs te/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa'i klong du mi mnyam snang ba ngang gis zhi/ /shes dang shes bya'i snang ba mtha' dag ma brtab tha snya da bden pa'i ngor//rten cing 'brel 'byung sna tshogs tshul can chu zla lta du'i rol mo ru//mkhyen pa'i ye shes skad cig gcig gis chags thobs med par 14

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga mngon gzigs te/ /mkha' dang lag mthil mnyam par brdzu ba'i 'phrul chen nam yang bsnyel ba med/ /bdag nyid gzhan bcas gnyis ka las min rgyu med snang ba ma yin pa'i/ /phyogs dang dus kyi shes bya rab 'byams rtog btags snang ba rdzun po cher/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig gis ma 'dres ji bzhin mngon gzigs te/ /rten 'byung zab mo'i gtam gye rol bas blo chen ldan rnams smin par mdzad/ /chos la chos su mngon rloms de dag sdang dang zhen pa'i pha mthar lhung / /gang la chos kyi rloms sems med rnams nam mkha' bzhin du chags pa med/ /chos dang chos min mtshan mar med gzigs de yi phyir na bdag nyid che/ /khyod dang khyod 'dra'i spyod yul mchog ni zag pa'i khams dang mdza' ba min/ /skye ba'i chos la skye ba med bzhin gzugs brnyan lta bu'i tshul skye zhing //skye med chos la ngo bo med bzhin mi dmigs tshul tu rab brtags pa'i/ /tshul gnyis chos la chos mig rdul bral phul byung bzod pa mchog brnyes te/ /chags med ye shes nam mkha' lta bus dus gsum kun tu gzigs pa 'jug /so so yang das rig pa rnam bzhi'i yon tan phung po 'dzad med cing / /kun rmongs nyes pa gzhar yang ma mchis mi 'jigs ye shes mchog mnga' bas/ /dag dang ma dag 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed bkod pa'i 6

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma ma dbus/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba'i chos tshul snang ba 'bum du 'jo/ /mtha' bral ston pa rdo rje'i dbyangs kyis 'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri bo snyil/ /bden don stong pa gdong lnga'i nga ros rgol ba ngan pa'i ri dwags 'joms/ /tshul gnyis don ston gtam gyi me lces dngos por smra ba'i tshang tshing sreg /smra ba'i dbang phyug smra ba zla med 'jam dpal mkhyen pa mchog brnyes rgyal/ /sde snod theg pa'i rnam grangs rgya cher dpag yas nam mkha'i mtha' 'dra ba/ /rim dang rim min gdul bya'i khams ltar tshangs dbyangs rnga sgras snang mdzad de/ /ji snyed theg pa'i chos tshul mtha' dag theg pa gcig tu gzhol ston pas/ /dpa' chen khyod kyi gsung gi gsang ba nam yang bsam par sla ba min/ /de slad khyod kyi ngo mtshar yon tan rmad byung ba/ /rjes dran yid kyis bsngags brjod me tog 'di byas te/ /gtam gyi rgyud 'dis yid can yid kyi mun bsal nas/ /rdul med byang chub zhi ba mchog la reg gyur cig /ces pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga lo ༄ / /'di na lang tshos rgyags pa 'bum phrag gi/ /srog shing lus kyi spubs su zhugs pa bzhin/ /gyur pa'i gzhon chung 'du ba brgya stong zhig /dar gyi lhab lhub mang pos g.yogs shing 'dug /16

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1khengs dregs rgyags pas bzang ba ma yin kyang / /mtshan dpe'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i ye shes sku/ /lha klu'i dregs pa khrag khrig zil gnon pa/ /gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa'i ngang tshul yin/ /skye gnas dur khrod 'dra ba'i 'dun sa nas/ /khrag gi thigs pa blangs pa'i sgyu lus kyis/ /yid la rgyags pa rgyas pa'i gzhon pa yang / /skye bo'i gral na zla ba bzhin du gsal/ /dag chen ye shes sgyu ma'i snang brnyan ni/ /yid can mos pa bzhin du rab 'jug ste/ /'di la'ang rloms sems mnga' bar mi mdzad pa/ /gzhon nu spra ba'i seng ge'i brtul zhugs yin/ /khrag chen tshon gyis pags pa dmar po ru/ /byas pa'i mkhur tshos gdong la 'chang ba yang / /gzhon nu'i rgyan du rlom pa'i mi lhod pa'i/ /mi la'ang sred ldan mang zhig ltad mor sems/ /snang dang stong pa mi phyed rdo rje'i skur/ /mtshams sprin snang ba 'bum gyis nyer byubs shing / /nor bu'i rgyan phreng yang dang yang ngoms pa de la ngo mtshar mi byed su zhig yod/ /rus pa'i tshal bu zhing lpags bgo ba can/ /phung por byas la gnyer ris nyung gyur pa/ /gang la'ang gzhon nu'i lus zhes grags pa'i rnga/ /dogs pa med par srid 'dir rtag tu rdung / /de yi spo na gzhan med ye shes che/ /mi shigs dwangs ma'i lang tshor snang ba'i gar/ /rga ba'i khur tshon nam yang mi 'dzin pa/ /de la snyan pa'i rdza rnga cis mi rdung / /mtshar sdug 17

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga nyams brgyar snang ba'i gzhon nu'i gzugs/ /ring ba min par rgud pas nyams 'gyur zhing / /nyams pa med kyang sgyu ma'i zhags pa yis/ /sdug pa med byas des kyang byis pa mgu/ /dag gsal mdzes pa'i sku mchog lhang nge ba/ /'khril ldem zhi ba'i nyams bzang mi zad pas/ /gtong ba'i go skabs dbye ba ma mchis pa/ /de la 'jig rten mtha' dag cis mi mgu/ /klad pa'i khang bzang thod rus sra ba'i khams/ /snum bag byug pas gos pa'i thi lo can/ /nye reg bya ba'i yul du 'di rung zhes/ /'jig rten skye bo'i mdun sar grags pa brtan/ /dkar po'i brtul zhugs snye ma smin pa'i zhal/ /mthon mthing ral pa'i 'bras bzang lnga 'chang ba/ /'phags chen gzhon nu'i 'jo sgeg 'di yang ste/ /lha chen dres/sa pa brgyas kyang gzung bar dka'/ /rngul chu'i thig pa lto bar sprum pa'i sha/ khrus kyi cho gas lan brgyar bkrus pa las/ /re zhig kun da lta bur snang la yang / /gzhon sha gsar pa gsar pa'i bla dwags ster/ /dri mas 'khyud pa ma yin gzhon nu'i sku/ /rdzing bur bkrus pa ma yin ngang sgas mdzes /tshon gyis byub pa ma yin dmar ser mdangs/ /mog mog kha dog ma yin lhan ner 'bar/ /lhod lhod 'gros kyis bskyod pa'i lhab lhub 'dab/ /g.yo zhing g.yo zhing ldem ldem 'gro ba la'ang / /dul ba'i lus zhes skye bo dga' byed na/ /'phags pa'i gzugs la ngo mtshar 18

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma cis mi skye/ /lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku/ /mthong na mi mthun ngang gis nyer zhi ba/ /bye ba khrag khrig 'od zer snang ba'i gzhi//'jam dpal gzhon nu'i sku ni de 'dra'o/ /bzod dka' 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad kyi mes/ /bud shing tha tshig mnos pa'i lus kyis kyang / /chags bral brkam pa 'phel ba'i grogs gyur na/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i gzugs sku cis mi mchod/ /gzhom gzhig mtshan ma zhi ba'i rtag chen sku/ /dran pas yid la dga' ba mchog stsol ba/ /dge ba'i mchod sdong mchog ni 'di yin zhes/ /'jigs med sprang po'i yid ni de ltar phyogs/ /zhes pa'ang sprang smyon 'jigs med pas so// //19

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/par /bstod tshig thol byung ma/bskal pa bye ba mang po nas/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs byas te/ /stobs bcu'i rgyal thabs mthon po la/ /rtag bzhugs 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal/ /zab mo chos rnams kun gyi gshis/ /mtha' brgyad spros bral chen po ru/ /gnyis snang mtshan ma nyer zhi ba/ /'jam dpal de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rtag chen nges pa lnga ldan sku/ /'og min chen por snang ba'i gar/ /rnam mang zhing na sgyur mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal dbyangs la rtag tu 'dud/ /gzhon nu'i gzubs dang rgan po'i gzugs/ /bde gshegs sku dang nyan rang gzugs/ /gzugs kyi rol pa mang po yis/ /srid pa skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyan par smra ba rab mang po/ /zab mo'i phyogs dang rgya che'i phyogs/ /legs 'doms tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs la/ /dbang mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i klong ltar bltar med cing / /shes dang shes bya nyer zhi ba'i/ /dbyings su mi rtog ye shes che/ /ro gcig gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rtsol zhing rtog med kyang / /dpag bsam shing las char 'bebs bzhin/ /rtag khyab lhun grub phrin 20

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1las che/ /kun tu 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grangs med tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i mthu/ /nam yang rgyun chad med ston phyir/ /gzugs sku bye ba rnam mang pos/ /gzhan phan spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas ji lta ji snyed chos/ /mtha' dag skad cig gcig gis kyang / /gzigs par mi thogs ye shes can/ /'jam dbyangs mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams rang bzhin med gzigs bzhin/ /rmi lam lta bu'i 'khor ba par/ /mi dmigs thugs rje rtag 'byung ba/ /'jam dbyangs de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal sras khrag khrig du ma'i dbus/ /smon lam chen po'i gzi brjid kyis/ /skar ma'i dbus na zla ba bzhin/ /brjid byas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan bdag nyid che rnams kyang / /sang zhabs phu dud yul nyid du/ /bsngags pa nam yang mi lhod pa/ /thod kyi thod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsngags 'os bsngags mdzad sras bcas kyi/ /'dren pa bgrang las 'das mod de//sprang thrun bdag gi ngag 'di yang / /bdag nyid chen po'i snyan du phul/ /ci sbad ce na thog med kyi/ /dus nas ngag gi nyes byas pa/ /de kun tshangs par bgyid slad du/ /gtam gyi rdza rnga 'di brdungs so/ /ces smyo gtam cal col ma 'di'ang yud tsam la'ang bsam gzhig ma btang bar/ 'jigs med pas bris pa'o// //21

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /'jam dbal gzhon nur gyur pa'i yon tan gyi che ba la bsngags pa'i rab byed ba shi ka'i me tog gi chun 'phyang zhes bya ba/tshogs gnyis phyogs kyi chu gter dwangs pa'i ngogs/ /mkhyen gnyis rje ra ba'i 'khri shing che/ /tshul gnyis btam gyi bsung zhim 'bum 'jo ba/ /'jam dpal ga/zhon nu'i rnam thar yang yang dran/ /gang la bdag nyid che zhes grags pa'i dri/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs 'dab brgyas nyer bzung zhing / /gzhan phan lang tsho'i 'jo sgeb ma smad pa'i/ /dbang phyug 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i mtsho skyes bzhad/ /smon lam 'khri shing dkar po'i dpung ba las/ /rjes chags rnam par rol pa'i 'dab ma khris/ /phyogs dang dus kyis tha gru zlum po ru//'ching mdzad 'phags pa'i me tog 'jam pa'i lha/ /phul byung thabs la mkhas pa'i me tog gis/ /yang dang yang du 'khyud mos nyer bcing ba'i/ /phan bzhed lhag pa'i thugs mchog skyed mo'i tshal /gang la mnga' mdzad mgon po ral gri can/ /'phags mchog me tog mdzum pa'i 'dun sa na/ /rten 'byung gtam gyi dri bsung mi 2 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1zad pas/ /blo gros chen po'i khyad par gsal byas pa'i/ /me tog zur phud lnga par grags de rmad/ /gzungs kyi ye shes rmad byung dza ti'i nags/ /spobs pa chen po'i sna ma'i me tob gdong / /'dzum bzhad lang tshos lan brgyar sgeg byas pa1 /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i rnam thar rgya chen yin/ /ye shes gzigs pa'i zla rgyas gcig gis kyang / /don zab legs par bshad pa'i pad dkar brgya/ /'byed pa'i tshul 'di 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i ste/ /lha dbang smin drug khris kyang bzung ma gyur/ /nor 'dod slong mo'i bung ba khrag khrig stong / /snyan grags dri bsung dngar pos nyer bkug ste/ /gtong ba dam pa'i sbrang rtsis sim mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo'i brtul zhugs me tog yin/ /nyes spyod sprin gyi rus pas ma reg cing / /bsdu bzhi'i 'dab ma ring pos 'jig rten khyen/ /khyab mdzad dge ba chos sdud me tog 'dis/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i spyod mchog mdzes par byas/ /phas rgol g.yul gyi char pa gang bab pa/ /bzod pa'i me tog 'dzum pa'i grogs gyur te/ /khro tshig gdung ba rtsub mo'i skabs med pas/ /'jam pa'i lha zhes grags pa lci bar byas/ /legs byas pad+ma'i rtsa ba rab brtan pa/ /brtson 'grus rlan gyi thigs pas bskyed bsrings te/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i ye shes pad+ma dkar/ /nam mkha' ji srid snang bar ma byas sam/ /ting 23

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dzin me tog dpal mo'i 'dzum dkar las/ /spyan dang mngon shes bsung ba rnam 'phro zhing / /snying la mi zad 'dod dgu'i bcud stsol ba/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i spyod yul rlabs chen yin/ /rdul med shes rab mang po bzhad pa'i tshor/ /dran dang rtogs pa'i chu rlabs rnam g.yo zhing / /bden don gtam gyi ngang mo 'bum rtse ba//gzhon nu smra ba'i seng ge'i blo gros yin/ /srid pa'i chu bter zab mo'i klong 'khor na/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i me tog stong ngom kyang / /sred dang len gyi 'dam gyis ma bzung ba'i/ /gnas 'di zab mo'i bzod pa'i lag rjes yin/ /lhag bsam mchog gi rtsa ba ma smad cing / /phul byung thabs kyi lo 'dab ma rnying ba'i/ /don dam gzigs pa'i ye shes dpag bsam shing / /de la stobs bcu'i me tog g.yur du za//shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtshor/ /rdzobs smin sbyang ba'i me tob rgyun chags pas/ /grags pa'i dri bsung ldang ba don yod du/ /byed po 'phags bzhi'i ded dpon 'jam pa'i lha/ /sku mchog mtshan dpe'i me tog bkrag tu brtas/ /tshangs dbyangs chos kyi me tog dar la rgyas/ /rigs pa chen po'i me tog mtshungs pa med//'phags mchog me tog khyu mchog ral gri can/ /mchod 'os mchod pa'i zhing mchog 'jam pa'i lhar/ /bsngags brjod me tog mchod sprin 'dis mchod kyis/ /dgyes sprin ye shes gzigs pas bzhes 24

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nas slar/ /byin rlabs snang ba yangs pos srid 'di skyongs/ /bdag kyang theg mchog bstan pa'i dga' tshal du/ /lung rigs me tog do shal nyer bzung nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyang gru len bzhin par/ /bzod pa chen po'i gar gyis rol par shog /gtam 'di thar pa don gnyer can/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes/ //gzhon pa rang lo bco brgyad pas/ /snyan ngag bzang po'i phreng bar spel/ /shu hūṃ/ma rtsa sarba rdza ga te// / /༄/ /me tog chun 'phyang 'dzin pa'i thor tshugs rtser/ /mthing mdog nor bus mdzes pa 'bum byin pas/ /ral pa'i phon po lhang nge lhan ba ba/ /lnga phrag spyi bor bcings de gang zhig yin/ /skra cog mthon mthing 'bar ba'i lang tsho zhig /mtho ris skabs gsum lhas kyang bzung gyur mod/ /snang stong ye shes sgyu ma'i 'jo sgeg can/ /gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa'i ngang tshul yin/ /'khril ldem nyams brgyas sgeg pa'i ye shes sku/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams gang du snang gyur pa/ /de na 'phags chen bye bas me tog char/ /nam mkha'i lam nas sprin phung bzhin du 'thor/ /srid na bsod nams bye ba'i gter mdzod du/ /grags pa rnga ltar ldir ba'i lha rnams kyang / /khyod kyi zur phud mchod pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /man+da ra ba'i 'khri shing gsar pa slong / /bye ba khrag khrig 'od zer snang ba dang / /lhan cig mtshan 26

pob 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpe'i zhal bzang rtag ngom pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje bde gshegs mi bskyod lha/ /khyod gtsug ral pa'i rgyan du snang zhes thos/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba rnams kyi ye shes che/ /rtag chen gzhon nu'i gzugs su ngom pa'i gar/ /de la mdzes pa'i skra cog 'di yod ces/ /gcig tu ngo mtshar bgyi ba ci zhig mchis/ /mthon mthing zur phud rnam lnga'i gzi byin ches/ /dge legs shis pa'i char bsil 'bebs nus na/ /de la nor bu'i ska rags ci slad 'chang / /khyod kyis 'di la dbos don gzigs zhes grags/ /phyogs dus mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni/ /do ker mchis su 'chad par ma gyur mod/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /mtshon pa'i rtags su zur phud lnga zhig snang / /bde bar gshegs pa'i byin rlabs bsam mi khyab/ /ye shes mchog gi 'phrul chen bsam mi khyab/ /de slad mkhyen gnyis mngon par rdzogs pa'i thugs/ /ral pa'i dog par 'char ba mi rigs med/ /de skad co le nyo le'i gtam/ /ci yin 'di yin med pa 'di/ /sbrang phrug ki bo zhes bya bas/ /a mtshar tho co'i tshig tu bris// // ra / /rgyal kun gsang ba zab mo'i ye shes ni/ /mtshan rdzogs sgyu ma'i lang tshor yongs bzhengs pa/ /khyab bdab mtsho skyes bla mar dbyer med pa'i/ /'jam mgon smra ba zla med rgyal gyur cig /bsam gyis mi khyab stong nyid dbu ma che/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis med tshul 26

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga nga gyis mnyam bzhag pas/ /mkha' dang lag mthil bskal ba skad cig tu/ /snang ba'i spyod yul chu zla bzhin du ston/ /'khor gsum rang bzhin med gzigs shes rab dang / /chabs gcig sbyin sogs rlabs chen spyod pa'i khur/ /mtha' klas yid can rgya mtshor smad slad du/ /'dzin mdzad tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs mkhyen pa'i gter/ /snying stobs go cha tshad med rab bgos te/ /thabs mkhas 'phrul dang 'grogs pa'i mdzad bzang ni/ /gang 'dul gdul bya'i mos ngor snang mdzad pas/ /phrin las rgyal ba kun dang thun mong gyur/ /dri med shes rab rang bzhin thugs rjes ni/ /phyogs dus khong na ci mchis lus can tshogs/ /kun la g.yo med gzigs pa'i mgon po gang / gzhan phan spyod la dus las yol ba med/ /ting 'dzin rnam thar bye ba'i gter gyur cing / gzungs sprin ye shes dpag med snying la 'khribs/ /blo gros mkha' ltar rnam dag ngag gi dbang / /mi zad spobs pa mchog la mnga' dbang 'byor/ /tshangs dang dbang phyug dpal gyis mtshon min pa'i/ /zag med rnam grol bde ba brgya phrag brgya/ /sbyin pa'i lha mchog rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /grags pas sangs rgyas zhing mang kun tu khyab/ /brjod med rang bzhin gnas lugs zab mo ni/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis gdul byar ston mdzad pas/ /'ching ba kun gyis bcing ba'i 27

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— sems can yang / /'ching bral zhi ba dam pa'i gnas la sbyor/ /ji lha ji ltar chos dbyings rgya che ba/ /de lta de ltar khyod kyi ye shes rgyas/ /ji lta ji ltar sems can tshad med pa/ /de lta de ltar khyod kyi snying rje rgyas/ /rgyal ba bye bas lan brgyar khyod bsngags shing / /rgyal sras 'bum gyi khyu mchog khyod lags na/ /lha klu mi'am ci yi thor tshuṭa su/ /khyod kyi zhabs pad bkod la ji ltar bsnyon/ /gang gis lan gcig dang ba'i yid kyis ni/ /'jam dpal dbyangs zhes mtshan tsam dran pas kyang / /mtha' yas bsod nams rlabs chen 'grub gsungs na/ /bstod cing sgom sgrub bgyid la lta ci smos/ /rtag tu 'gro khams rgya mtshor brtser dgongs shing / /'gog med phrin las snang ba 'jug lags na/ /ci slad bdag gis sa/dung bas gsol btab kyang / /byin rlabs snying la mi ster 'di ci zhig /'on te bdas nyid skal pa ches dman zhing / /sgrib pa'i mun rum stug por 'thum gyur pas/ /re zhig khyod zhal mthong ba'i mthu med grang / /nam zhig 'phags pa'i zhal bzang mthong bar shog /tshe rabs 'di dang skye ba'i phreng ba kun/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam chos mdzod 'dzin cing / /blo gros zab yangs nor bu'i lde mig gis/ /gzhung lugs sgo brgya 'byed pa'i mthu thob shog /ces pa'ang byis pa 'jigs med pas gsol ba btab pa ste de de bzhin du 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur 28

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1skyes bu dam pa khyod kyang mdzad par gsol lo//ma / /mchog gi ye shes chu gter ma dros pa/ /dge legs shis pa'i chu gter 'bum gyi gzhir/ /smon lam dam pas lhun gyis grub byas pa/ /'jam pa'i lha des bkra shis me tog gtor/ /brjed ngas 'dam gyi dri mas ma bzung zhing / /rnam g.yeng med pa'i byed las bsung zhim can/ /dran pa'i yid 'ong me tog man+da ras/ /bdag snying mdzes par mdzod cig 'jam pa'i lha/ /chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i 'dab ma rgyas/ /rmad byung legs par bshad pa'i dri bsung 'jo/ /thogs pa med pa blo gros pad ma'i char/ /snying la lan brgyar phobs shig 'jam pa'i lha/ /phul byung zab don bye ba'i ke sa ra/ /gtong ba ma yin yid la dam 'chang ba/ /rtogs pa'i gter chen dong ka'i me tog char/ /'dzad med snying la stol cig 'jam pa'i lha/ /gdams ngag sbrang rtsi'i ro bcud mi zad pa/ /skad cig rer yang 'gro blo 'dzin byed pa'i/ /gzungs kyi yon tan me tog rkon bu'i char/ /yid la 'chang ba bkram mdzod 'jam pa'i lha/ /zab mo'i 'bel gtam bsung ba khrag khrig gis/ /skal bzang bung ba'i dga' ston ster byed pa/ /mi 'jigs spobs pa'i me tog char pa stong / /'gog med yid la phobs shig 'jam pa'i lha/ /dpyad gsum rnam dag rgyal bstan snying po'i bcud/ /'chad rtsod rtsom 29

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i ze bar rtag 'chang ba/ /chos kyi gter chen 'dab stong bzhad pa'i char/ /bdag yid khyab par 'bebs mdzod 'jam pa'i lha/ /dge tshogs me tog 'dzum pa'i tshal chen por/ /ngo mtshar yon tan bye bas mngon 'phags pa/ /byang chub sems mchog u dud ra'i char/ /snying la 'jo bar mdzod cig 'jam pa'i lha/ /'khrul rtogs sad kyis gdung ba'i skabs med cing / /chos mig rdul bral lang tsho ma rnying ba/ /bzod pa chen po'i me tog 'bum phrag gsum/ /snying la bzhad par mdzod cig 'jam pa'i lha/ /dri ma med pa'i ye shes nam mkha'i lam/ /zhi bsil thugs rje'i sprin dkar g.yo ba las/ /phul byung shis pa'i char chen mi zad pas/ /srid khams dge legs mdzod cig 'jam pa'i lha//chos mchog snyan pa'i rnga sgra rtag tu sgrog /phan dang bde ba'i me tog char du 'bab/ /gzungs dang spobs pa'i snang ba cir yang rgyas/ /bkra shis de 'dras sa gsum khyab gyur cig /bkra shis ngo mtshar mchog gi tshigs bcad 'di/ /bkra shis me tog 'dzin pa'i lo 'dab ngos/ /bkra shis yid la bcags pa'i gzhon nu des/ /bkra shis zla ba nya ba'i tshes la bris// //༄ / /mtha' bzhi'i mtshan ma zhi ba'i chos dbyings su/ /mthar 'dzin lta ba'i nyes tshogs rab bsal te/ /mtha' bral lta ba'i ye shes mchog brnyes pa/ /mtha' yas rgyal kun spyi gzubs 'jam 30

stod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma pa'i lha/ /rnam mang rnam thar rgya mtsho'i gter gyur cing / /kun mkhyen kun tu bzang po'i phrin las can/ /gzhan phyir gzhan phan mdzad pa mchog brnyes pa'i/ /'phags chen 'phags pa'i gtso mchog 'jam pa'i lha/ /sgrib gsum nyes pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod yul kun la dbang / /dbang bcu'i yon tan che ba bsam mi khyab/ /khyab bdag rgyal ba kun dngos 'jam pa'i lha/ /ye shes mchog brnyes mchog gzigs blo gros mchog/sgobs pa rgya chen mthu chen bdag nyid che/ /mkhyen brtse'i dpal mnga' dpal ldan smra ba'i dpal/ /mgon po lha yi lhar gyur 'jam pa'i lha/ /gang 'dul thabs la mkhas pa bsam mi khyab/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin 'jug pa bsam mi khyab/ /mngon shes stobs kyi mthu nus bsam mi khyab/ /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab 'jam pa'i lha/ /zag bcas khams la chags pa ma mchis shing / /zas/ med chos la rlom sems mi mdzad de/ /zag dang ma zag rnam par rtog med pa'i/ /zag bral blo gros che ldan 'jam pa'i lha/ /yul dang yul can gnyis med spros bral klong / /ye shes mchog gi gzigs pas rtag rol zhing / /yid bzhin nor ltar 'bad rtsol kun bral ba'i/ /ya mtshan rnam thar che mnga' 'jam pa'i lha/ /'od stong ldan zhing zhing rnams snang bar mdzad/ /mtshan snyan rab grabs grags pa don 31

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang ldan/ /lha brgyas gus mchod mchod 'os yongs kyi btso/ /'phags chen chen po gsum ldan 'jam pa'i lha/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog log smra zil gyis gnon/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan tshangs pa kun las lhag /ngag gi dbang phyug ngag rnams kun gyi bdag /mkhyen ldan mkhyen rab mchog sprul 'jam pa'i lha/ /lam min lam du gol ba'i phyogs bcom ste/ /lam mchog tshul gnyis snang bas gsal mdzad cing / /lam kun theg chen ngang du tshul gcig pa'i/ /lam gyi bgrod pa kun dmigs 'jam pa'i lha/ /shing dbang drung sogs bde gshegs skur bzhugs shing / /gnas ris gzhan du nyan rang gzugs su'ang gnas/ /gzugs rnams kun tu 'char ba'i ye shes gzubs/ /lha mchog gzugs kyi bdag nyid 'jam pa'i lha/ /gtam gyi nyes pa kun spangs zab mo'i sa/tam/ /ngag gi dri ma kun zad rdo rje'i ngag /tshig gi 'khrul ba kun bral yang dag tshig /lha mchog gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i lha/ /rnam par mi rtog chos nyid gzibs pa'i thugs/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs// rnam gnyis zung 'jug sgrib med ye shes thubs/ /rnam dka thugs la mnga' brnyes 'jam pa'i lha/ /khyod la gus pa'i blo bzhag ste/ /khyod kyi yon tan bsngags pa'i gtam/ /khyod nyid dgyes slad 'di byas pas/ /khyod zhal mngon sum mthong bar shog /ces pa'ang 32

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gzhon nu 'jigs med pas tshig phreng byis pa'i rtsed mor spel ba dge/ maṅga lo// //༄ / /sor mo'i zhags pa nang du bsdus nas ni/ /brang rus yang dang yang du brdeg bzhin du/ /skal ngan bdag ni nyes pas bcom mo zhes/ /lag na ral gri'i spyan sngar rtag tu ngu/ /skye bo rgan rabs rnams kyi 'dun sar yang / /rmongs pas yang yang 'bod pa thos gyur tshe/ /btung ba'i chu rgyun ring por sbreng byed na/ /lag na ral gri'i dbang phyug lta ci smos/ /bdag ni de ltar yid la rab byas te/ /bkren chen de ring skyobs zhes stong bos kyang / /khyod kyi snyan lam grag par ma gyur bzhin/ /bzhugs pa'i tshul 'di ci las gyur pa lags/ /bdag ni nor gyi los spyod chen po min/ /nye du mdza' bshes mang pos srung ba'ang min/ /de lta mod kyi khyod thugs brtse ba ni/ /bsod nams can la phyogs lhung min zhes thos/ /'on te bdag ni khyod 'bangs zungs shig ces/ /gdung ba'i smre sngags rtag tu bton gyur kyang / /mtshan dpe'i 'dzum zhal gcig kyang ma bstan na/ /nyam thag 'gro la khyod thugs mi brtse 'am/ /gdong ba mchi mas g.yog pa'i dam 'gyur bcas/ /yus kyis brnang zhing brnang zhing khyod bos kyang / /bdag gtsug phyag bis lan gcig nyug pa'ang med/ /de sbad bdag ni skal pa ngan pa lags/ /ma 33

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bkur ma bsnyen par yang 'gro ba mang / /nyes spyod chen po'i zhugs las skyob mdzad mod/ /bdag ni khyod zhabs gus pas mchod bzhin du/ /khyod kyis slar la kho bo ci'i phyir btang / /'jigs pa chen po'i g.yang ni bdag gis thob/ /sdig ltung chen po'i thog ni bdas la babs/ /bdag 'dra khyod kyis thugs brtses ma bzung na/ /snying rje chen po'i yul de su zhig yin//ma bos bzhin du sems can khams mang po/ /srid pa ji srid gtong bar mi bgyi zhes/ /khyod kyi thugs bskyed dam bca' ma 'gongs na/ /kho bo sems can grangs su med dam ci/ /ci ste skal ba ngan pas nongs zhe na/ /skal ba mchog la khyod zhal ma bstan kyang / /rang gi yon tan nyin re bzhin du 'phel/ /de slad skal ngan bdag la skyob mdzad gsol/ /zhes 'jigs med pas so// //ra / /gang gi zhabs sen zla gzhon gsar pa'i dkyil 'khor che/ /blo chen mkhas dbang mig gsum 'bum gyi cod pan du/ /phu dud bya ba'i rnam 'gyur stong gis mchod gyur pa/ /lag na ral gri'i 'khri shing 'dzin des shis par mdzod/ /phul byung 'dzad med rnam dkar spyod pa'i chu gter che'i/ /snying por grub pa ye shes nyi ma 'bar ba'i sku/ /mi zad mtshan dpe'i snang ba khrag khrig 'jo ba'i dpyid/ /mig gi bdud rtsi dga' ston mtshungs med 'jam pa'i lha/ /3 4

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1sku yi cha shas ba spu'i ljon bzang re re yang / /legs byas bsod nams bye ba'i chu gter las 'ongs pa/ /de yi phyir ni lha khyod bsod nams phung po zhes/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba yongs kyi mdun sar grags min nam/ /ji snyed rgyal dang rgyal sras yongs kyi yon tan mi zad gangs chen mtsho/ /ngo mtshar mtshan gyi ri mo 'bum bkra rtag chen gzhon nu'i lang tsho ru/ /snang ba'i 'phrul chen bsam gyis mi khyab zung 'jug ye shes sgyu ma'i sbu/ /mkha' khyab rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing na cir yang snang mdzad 'jam pa'i lha/ /dri med tshangs dbyangs yan lag brgyad ldan gang gā'i klung / /bkra shis ngo mtshar bye ba'i rlabs phreng rnam g.yo ba/ /phul byung legs lam gdong ba bzhi pa'i zhabs bsil du/ /sbreng la mi bsnyeng blo gros chen po 'jam pa'i dpal/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan bzang me tog gsar pa'i phul/ /mgrin pa'i chos dung dri med me tog man+ta ra/ /zab cing rgya che'i legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i snying po can/ /skal bzang rigs gsum rkang pa drug pa'i gsos su che/ /rtsol rtog 'ching ba dbyings su btul yang rmad byung brtson pas gzhan phan mdzad/ /yi ge gcig tsam bstan pa med kyang tshig dang yi ge'i spros par snang / /sgra dang sgrar 'dzin mtshan ma med kyang yan lag drug cu'i rgyal rnga brdung / /khyod kyi yul 'di 'gal bar snang yang don la 36

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gal ba cha tsam med/ /tshig dang don zhes rang gi ngo bos ma grub kyang / /gnas lugs rang bzhin zab mo mtshon pa'i yi ge a/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yi ge sprin gyi rol mo ru/ /mngon par snang ba'i byed po mtshungs med 'jam pa'i lha/ /dpag par dka' ba'i ye shes mchog ni phyogs kyi chu gter zab mo bzhin/ /kun gzigs blo gros rgya chen mchog ni mtha' med lha yi jing ring bzhin/ /gzigs pa sgrib med mkhyen rab mchog ni sprin med ston ka'i zla rgyas bzhin/ /chags thogs bral ba'i sgobs pa mchog ni 'jigs byed ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor bzhin/ /spros pa kun bral chos nyid zhi ba'i nam mkha' la/ /stobs bcu'i ye shes phyogs kyi mu khyud rgyas pa'i dpal//rtag khyab lhun grub phrin las snang ba stong bdal ba/ /sa bcu'i ye shes gnya' shing 'dzin ri'i bla na mtho/ /khyod sku lan cig yid la byas pas blo gros snang ba stong du 'jo/ /khyod mtshan lan cig rna bar son pas ngan 'gror rgad la rnam par smod/ /khyod zhabs lan cig spyi bor bcings pas yid la ye shes mchog tu stsol/ /khyod kyi rmad byung mdzad pa'i rlabs chen phyogs dang dus kyi khongs su g.yo/ /rnam dkar mdzad bzang bcu gnyis bdun gyi ma dros klung / /lha yi lhar kyur stobs bcu'i dbang phyug dpag bsam shing / /grangs kyi yul du mdza' ba min pa'i 'byung gnas che/ /gang kha dbang bsgyur 36

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'phags pa'i ded dpon 'jam ba'i lha/ /khyod kyi yon tan rjes su dran zhing yang yang yid la rab byas te/ /dad pa'i chu gter snying la bskrun tshe mchi ma'i rba rlabs drag tu g.yo/ /mos blo'i zla gzhon gsar du shar tshe lag pa'i pad+mo kun nas zum/ /gus pa'i chu 'dzin yid mkhar 'khrigs tshe bsngags brjod me tog char du snyil/ /bslab gsum lus zungs rid cing skam pa'i nyam thag gzhon pa nags na 'bod/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje sprin gyi 'dzum dkar gang du mos pa'i gdong phyogs nas/ /gsol 'debs ngag gi rgyud mangs snyan pos phu dud ri mor rtag bgyid na/ /gzungs dang spobs pa'i char rgyun bsil bas bdag sogs kun nas ngoms par mdzod/ /dbyangs bdun 'gyur ba 'bum du sgrogs pa'i bstod tshig glu/ /mgrin pa'i lam nas lhod lhod 'jo ba'i legs byas 'dis/ /ji snyed 'gro ba'i yid kyi nun pa kun bsal te/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i rgyal thabs khri la dbang bsgyur shog /ces pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas gang dran lhug par sbya ra ba maṅga lo////ba / /zla bral bla ma khyab bdag 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dbang dang rnam thar mtha' yas rang dbang mdzad/ /rnam dag lam bzang bstan pas gzhan phan mdzad/ /tshangs dang lha dbang brgya 37

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/phrag gang la dad/ /mtha' bral lta bas mthar lta lhag mar byas/ /rab zab bdams ngag tshangs dbyangs rnga sgras 'chad/ /gang zhal dran pas gnas ngan g.yang las drang / /grags pa rab 'bar dpal mnga' rgyal sras dbang / /dpag bsam rgyas ltar gang bsam stsal bar mdzad/ /bsam gtan grangs mang mnga' mdzad 'gran zla bral/ /myang 'das rgyal thabs la dbang mtha' las 'das/ /rtas chad lta ngan mthar mdzad smra bsam dang / /rnam bral rnam grangs ma lags gsal bar mdzad/ /a nges pa'o/ /mi shigs zhi ba'i dbyings nyid ji bzhin gzigs/ /mi dmigs ting 'dzin nyi ma'i gzi brjid kyis/ /gnyis 'dzin sprin gyi 'khri shing 'jig bgyid cing / /mi 'jigs bzhi yis shis pa'i gzi byin sbyin/ /i nges pa'o/ /kun 'byung chu klung drungs phyungs bdud dpung 'dul/ /sku gsum kun 'dus rdzu 'phrul nus mthu grub/ /kun tu phul byung sku gsung thugs gsum grub/ /sgyu 'phrul 'bum 'byung gzhung kun thugs su chud/ /u nges pa'o/ /rten 'brel legs shes bden med nges mkhyen rje/ /theg chen spel byed brtse chen ye shes ster/ /dge legs me chen mched byed bde chen gter/ /sred len nyes bsregs nges legs ches cher brnyes/ /e nges pa'o/ /stobs sogs yongs rdzogs 'gro don yongs spyod mgon/ /sgro 'dogs yongs 38

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gcod log rtogs tshogs 'joms mchog /nyon mongs tshogs 'joms blo gros mchog sprul khyod/ /chos 'khor yongs bskor chos mchog don mthong sbyor/ /o nges pa'o/ /de skad tshig bzang legs skye mas/ /don bzang nam mkha'i snye ma tog /dge legs bye ba'i bsil grib can//'jam mgon dgyes pa'i dpyid du bsgrigs// //ma / /ji lta ji ltar gus pas rab mchod pa/ /de lta de ltar byams pa'i phyag skyong ba/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo lha yi lha mchog gis/ skyabs med bdag la skyob par mdzad du gsol/ /ji lta ji ltar srid pa'i grong gnas pa/ /de lta de ltar nyon mongs rnam 'phel ba'i/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i 'gro la brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji ltar bya ba'i lam gnas pa/ /de lta de ltar sdig ltung rnam 'phel ba'i/ /skal ngan bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji ltar tshe yi gzhug phyin pa//de lta de ltar rtag 'dzin rnam 'phel ba'i/ /blun chen bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji ltar mi yi rten rnyed kyang / /de lta de ltar chos min spyod 'phel ba'i/ /byur ngan bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam 39

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'khum/pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji ltar zab mo'i chos nyan pa/ /de lta de ltar chos las blo nyams pa'i/ /chos dred bdas la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ / skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ //ji lta ji ltar thos pa'i sgo bstan pa/ /de lta de lhar yid gnyis rnam 'phel pa'i/ /rmongs chen bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ ji lta ji lhar dge ba'i bshes mthong ba/ /de lta de ltar sdig grogs la dga' ba'i/ /phung 'dren bdas la thugs rjes brtser dbongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ ji lta ji ltar bdud las ring 'dod kyang / /de lta de ltar bdud kyis zil gnon pa'i/ /mthu med bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji ltar chags pa'i dgra byung ba/ /de lta de ltar gnyen po'i phyogs nyams pa'i/ /nus med bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji lhar khro ba'i dgra ldang ba/ /de lta de ltar bzod pa'i mtshon rul ba'i/ /skal dman bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji ltar kun rmongs mes gdungs pa/ /de lta de ltar shes rab mtsho skam pa'i/ /skyabs 40

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1med bdag la thugs rjes brtser dkongs te/ skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ ji lta ji ltar bag med mtshon ldang ba/ /de lta de ltar dge ba'i go ral ba'i/ /skal dman bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lha ji ltar theg chen gzhung bsam pa /de lta de ltar snying rje'i blo nyams pa'i/ /go log bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji ltar rgyal ba'i gzhung 'dris pa/ /de lha de ltar 'dren pa brjed nges pa'i/ /ma rabs bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji ltar chos lam slob 'dod pa/ /de lta de ltar chos kyi gegs ldang ba'i/ /las ngan bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji ltar nyes pa'i sgo byung yang / /de lta de ltar nyes la slar 'jug pa/ /khrel med bdag la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lha ji ltar sems 'dul thabs bsam yang / /de lta de ltar rang rgyud ches lhong ba'i/ /gzhung ngan bdag la thugs rjes brtser dkongs te/ /skyabs mdzod skyabs gsum kun 'dus 'jam pa'i lha/ /ji lta ji lhar dam pa'i sgyu11

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gral bzhag pa/ /de lha de ltar zog po'i gral rgyug pa'i/ /thur bltas ya bo brlag 'dre nga 'dra la/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig rje btsun thugs rje can/ /zhes pa'ang 'phung bshig gi sprang rgan 'jigs med pas mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la smre sngags kyis gsol 'debs grong tshig dum chod mar bris pa'o// //ra / /mkhyen gnyis ye shes dam pa'i zlos gar ni/ /thogs med gzugs brgya'i rol mor mngon snang yang / /dbang sngon ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor 'chang ba'i gar/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes grags pas mdzes der 'dud/ /dmar ser nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od dang / /'dzum sgeg gzhon nu'i rnam rol mi zad pa/ /zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul dru ba'i ye shes sku/ /sna tshogs dag chen sprul pa'i gar gyis rtsen/ /phul byung zhal gyi zla gzhon dang ba'i ngogs/ /yid 'ong mdzod spu'i zla rgyas 'di snang ste/ /zla zhun zla ba gnyis pa'i snying po can/ /dpa' chen khyod kyi legs byas dpung pas bzung / /do ker rtse mo lnga pa'i ri dbang la/ /rin chen me tog 'dzum pa'i ga shal brgya/ /'phyang 'phrul dra ba bstar ba'i 'jo sgeg 'dis/ /ngo mtshar zhal gyi grong khyer mdzes par byas/ /ldem ldem ral ba bskyod pa'i zur phud dang / /lam lam ral gri'i 'khri shing rnam g.yo bas/ /yang yang nam mkha'i lam 'di mdzes byas te/ /mang mang lha brgyas 4 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ba dkyil 'khor zil gyis gnon/ /mi 'jigs gdong ba lnga pa'i brtul zhub/sa kyis/ /mgrin pa chos kyi dung chen gzengs bstod cing / /'khril ldem sku yi 'gying tshugs ngom bzhin du/ /zab don gtam gyi sgra dbyangs 'bum du 'jo/ /gser bzang phreng ba dngar ba'i dog pa la/ /snang ba rnam sdud nor bu'i phra tshom can/ /rmad byung mgul ba'i rgyan du spud byas pas/ /lha dbang nor bu'i gtsug phud lan brgyar bskal/ /rkang gdub 'khyud mos bcings pa'i zhabs pad+mo/ /bkra shis rtsibs stong 'khyil ba'i 'od ris can/ /tshangs dbang zur phud 'dzum gyis bsu bzhin du/ /skra rgyan nor bu'i 'od kyis byi ba bzhin/ /de slad bdag kyang khyod zhal rjes dran te/ /mig gi khor yug g.yog pa'i chu rlabs dang / /sor mo'i yal 'dab zum pa'i snyim pa yis/ /'phags chen khyod kyi zhabs pad ri mor bgyi/ /mtho ba lhun po'i rtse 'dra'i phrag pa nas/ /gyes pa dpag bsam 'dab 'dra'i phyag brkyang ste/ /glog gi snang ba lta du'i sor mo yis/ /bdag gtsug lan brgyar nyug pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /sil khrol gdub 'khor 'chang ba'i yid 'ong zhabs/ /mnyen lcugs gnag bag med pa'i mtshar sdug bcas/ /dbang phyug ral ba'i bla na zla ba bzhin/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i spo 'dir rtag gzhes shig /ces pa'ang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la mi phyed dad pa'i shugs can sprang 43

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byon 'jigs med pas bris pa dge// //ma / /glog gi sgron ma 'bar ba'i 'od zer gzis/ /mtshungs zlar bsgrun pa min pa'i snang ba la/ /bgrang yas zhing khams rgya mtshos mig thug pa/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo mtshan rdzogs sku ru bzhugs/ /dkar dang leb rgan phyogs su ma lhung ba'i/ /'od zer rnam pa du ma'i kha dog can/ /yid can mos pa'i rjes su mthun 'jug pas//mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i zhing mang snang bar mdzad/ /dus kyis nges pas bcings pa ma yin zhing / /phyogs kyis gtug pa med pa'i 'od zer che/ /tshad kyis nges par brdzu ba'i sgyu thabs 'dis/ / gang 'dul gdul bya'i yid dbang mgron por 'gugs/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa'i sgra dbyangs brgya/ /'od kyi 'dzum rlabs gcig bis mngon bsgrags te/ /rgya mtsho'i chu rdul mnyam pa'i sems can khams/ /smin mdzad thabs mkhas spyod yul bsam mi khyab/ /'od kyis 'jig rten bsum du snang byed pa'i/ /tshangs chen nyi ma zla ba'i kha dog kyang / /'dzam bu'i gser bzang drung na sol phung bzhin/ /'phags chen gzhon nu'i mdun sar mdzes pa med/ /rnam mang sdugs bsngal phung pos gzir ba'i 'gror/ /dri med 'od kyi byus/sa pas reg ma thab /bde legs mchog gi dus ston rnam 'phel ba'i/ /tshul 'dis sems can khams mang rtag tu skyong / /gang na stobs kyi 44

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga rdzu 'phrul dbang btsan pa'i/ /lha chen nyi ma'i zer kyang ma zhugs pas/ /khor yug nun pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por yang / /snang ldan 'od zer bye bas lham mer mdzad/ /'od kyi drwa ba bkod pa'i rnam rol la/ /mtshan bzang snang ba 'bar ba'i bde gshegs sku/ /grangs med zhi ba'i gzugs kyis mngon bzhugs pas/ /'phrul chen 'dod dgu'i rol mo cir yang 'khrol/ /lang tshos rgyags pa rgyas pa'i yid can la/ /mdzes sdug gzugs sku'i rnam 'phrul snang mdzad de/ /'od zer mchog gi snang ba mi zad pas/ /lha dbang bzhin gyi mdangs yang zil gnon mdzad/ /bsod nams chen po'i mthu las nyer 'ongasaXshing / /ye shes rgya mtsho'i byin gyis rab sbyang ba/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i 'od zer gsang ba che/ /bskal bar brjod kyang thug pa ga la zhig /ces 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi 'od la ched du brjod pa co le nyo le ba 'di'ang sprang thrun 'jigs med pas so//nga / /skabs gsum gnas kyi lha mo legs skyes ma/ /phang bar 'khyud pa'i tshiṭa bzang mig stong pa/ /khyod nyid ma nu gzhon pa'i dpyid bcig pur/ /shes nas 'bras kyi snye mas mchod par spro/ /ci 'di nyin byed bye bas mtshon med pa'i/ /dmar ser snang ba 'bum gyis kun gsal lto/ /'gengs pa'i ngo mtshar rdzogs pa'i 'jo sgeg 'di/ /grong 'joms skal bas bzung ngam yid gnyis 'gyur/ /snang 46

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang stong pa dbyer med ye shes sku/ /rtag brtan gzhom gzhig bral ba'i lang tsho ni/ khyab bdag ye shes me long mtshan dpe'i skur/ /nges pa'i blo gros nyin mo bzhin du gsal/ /ma bris mtshan dpe'i ri mo 'bum bkra zhing / /ma bgos tshul khrims bsung zhim phyogs mthar brdal/ /ma bcos dul ba'i spyod lam ngang gis mdzes/ /ma 'bad gzhan phan mdzad pa lhun gyis grub/ /mdzes sku lta bas mi ngoms dpag bsam ljon/ /mtshan bzang gnyis skyes grangs ldan 'dab stong spubs/ /dpe byad 'bras bu'i khur mang g.yur za bas/ /kun nas sgeg byas phan bde'i 'du ba rgyas/ /kha dog med kyang kha dob/ gzugs su ston//rang bzhin med kyang sgyu ma'i rol mor snang //'gro 'ong med kyang zhing khams rgya mtshor 'gro/ /brjod med don yang brjod pa'i zol gyis ston/ /snang bar byas so rgya mtsho'i gos can ma/ /'od zer snang ba stong ldan zla bas te/ /yang dag chen po bdun ldan lam bzang yang / /khyod kyi legs par bshad pa'i 'od brgyas so/ /zhing gi rdul snyed sems dpa' grangs mang yang / /go cha bsam mi khyab ldan khyod zlas dben/ /lcugs phran rgyas pa'i rkang 'thung grangs mang yang / /ha ri tsirnyan ljon pa shin tu dkon/ /bgrang yas bde gshegs nyi ma'i mdun sa ru/ /zab mo'i gtam gyi 'od snang 'bum 'phro zhing / /rgyal sras rgyu skar phreng bas mdzes byas 16

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1pa/ /'phags mchog zla rgyas dbang po khyod gcig yin/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa zhi ba'i sku/ /phyogs kyi mu khyud rgyas pa'i dpal la bzhin/ /kun dga'i dpal ster mkha' gos skrod pa'i 'od/ /mtha' yas zhing khams rgya mtsho spro zhing sdud/ /gcod byed ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor 'bar ba'i gzi/ /srid na dpe zlas dben pa'i tshul mthong nas/ /bai zur rtsig pa 'dra ba'i mkha'i bzhin ras/ /skyeng ste chu 'dzin gsar bas 'geb la rings/ /mdzes mdzes sor mo'i lcug phran la gnas shing / /ldem ldem sdong du'i rtse mor bab chags pa'i/ /zlum zlum thig ler 'khyil ba'i 'dab ma brgya/ /cher cher bzhad pas gro la rnam par gsal/ /zhes so// //ra / /spros mtshon rtog pa'i dra ba mthar byas shing / /zab dang rgya che'i sku gnyis mngon mdzad kyang / /gzhon nu'i mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i lang tshor bcas/ /sems dpa'i gzugs su snang de 'jam dpal yin/ /byas pa ma yin chos rnams kun gyi gshis/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang ba ste/ /bden pa dbyer med gzhi yi dbu ma na/ /rtag dang mi rtag gar yang grub med kyang / /chos dbyings mi 'gyur bas na rtag pa ste/ /de nyid mi rtag yin zhes su zhig smra/ /rtag dang mi rtag las 'das phung sum chos/ /shes bya'i khong 'dir gzhar yang ma mchis so/ /gnyis yin zhes pa 17

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga bdag gis ma smras te/ /don dam klong na rtag dang mi rtag dang / /gnyis yin gnyis min mtha' dang bral bas na/ /'dus ma byas pa chen po yin zhes smra/ /de nyid legs gzigs 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ni/ /bden dang bden med 'dzin pa spangs pa ste/ /mtshan ma'i rtog pa kun las rnam grol bas/ /rnam par mi rtog zab mo'i ye shes yin/ /chos rnams rang bzhin bden pas stong pa la/ /bden med yin zhes brjod pa med gyur na/ /bden grub nyid du ldog las 'os med de/ /phung gsum gzhan du 'dzin tshul med phyir ro/ /skye ba med ces ji bzhin shes pa'i ngor/ /skye bar 'dzin las ldog 'dir bsnyon du ci/ /bden med nyid kyang rang bzhin med shes na/ /bden pa med ces su yis 'dzin par 'os/ /ji lhar zhi ba'i dbyings ni 'pho 'gyur med/ /ma byas rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyang / /'dus ma byas pa rtag pa'i rdo rje yin/ /'di ni tha snyad dpyod pa'i blo ngor te//don dam yang dag tshad mas brtag byas na/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes mchog gi chos nyid ni/ /'di zhes smra brjod yul du ga la rung / /mdor na bde bar gshegs pa'i gsang ba ni/ /yul dang yul can gnas su mi dmigs shing / /mtshan 'dzin dri ma'i spubs las rab grol ba/ /'di ni 'jam zhes mkhas pas rtogs par bya/ /gzung 48

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa mi mnga' bzhin/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kyi bye brag kun/ /ma 'dres sgrib med cig char nyid gzigs pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos sku zab mo yin/ /byis pas lan brgyar brtags kyang rtogs min pa'i/ /stong dang rten 'byung dbyer med chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam grangs min pa'i gnas lugs mtha' bral ba /ji bzhin gzigs pa'i chos sku zab mo yin/ /slob pa'i lam gyis bsdus pa'i mnyam bzhag ni/ /stong dang ye shes ro gcig 'dra na yang / /gnyis snang bag chags phra mos bslad pas na/ /zab mo 'di dang ldan par ma gyur to/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos sku zab mo ni/ /mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings dang ro gcig pas/ /mkha' dang lag mthil mnyam pa'i spyod yul dang / /gcig tu mdza' ba'i tha tshig rang gir mdzad/ /'od ldan ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bcig las du ma'i snang brnyan kun tu 'gyed/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes ni/ /gcig las gzugs sku'i snang brnyan du mar ston/ /tshad med thugs rjes 'gro la rab dgongs te/ /nam mkha' ji srid gzhan phan mdzad pa ni/ /dus las yol min phrin las rlabs chen po/ /ma lus yid can rgya mtshor sman par bgyid/ /phyogs re ma yin nam mkha'i khyod yangs por/ /bgrang yas zhing khams rgya mtshor snang gyur pa/ /de snyed rer yang yid can tshad med 49

za da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/de/ /de dag rnams la khyod kyi phrin las 'jug /'bad rtsol yod min rnam dkar mdzad pa ni/ /dkos 'dod kun ster nor du'i rgyal po bzhin/ /mos ldan 'gro la cig char snang mdzad pas/ /kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer khyod la mnga'/ /mdor na zab mo'i chos sku mngon byas shing / /shin tu rgya che gang 'dul gzugs kyi skus/ /skal bzang 'gro la rnam grol dpal ster ba'i/ /'di ni dpal zhes blo ldan rnams kyis 'tshal/ /nges pa'i don du khyab bdag 'jam pa'i dpal/ /mkha' khyab rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes las/ /tha dad ma yin mi shigs rdo rje sku/ /srid pa ji srid mtshan dpe'i lang tshor 'bar/ /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin srid pa'i grong khyer na/ /sgyu ma'i gar bzhin las nyon gom stabs bcas/ /gcig tu rgyu ba'i sems can sgyu ma rnams//byang chub sgyu ma'i sa la reg par mdzod/ /gzhom gzhig spangs pa mtshan rdzogs sku yi dpal/ /nyi ma lta bur brjid pa'i 'od zer bcas//'chi ba med par nam mkha' ji spid du/ /rtag chen gzhon nu'i gzugs kyis srid na snang / /rga dang na dang rgad pa rnams spangs pa'i/ /ngo mtshar bsod nams bye ba'i gter gyur pa/ /sna tshogs sku yi bkod pas srid gsum 'gro/ /phan dang bde ba'i gnas la sbyor bar mdzad/ /de skad 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i mtshan gyi don/ /cung zad gtam du byas pa'i legs byas la/ /60

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1brten nas rnam par grol ba'i byang chub mchog /ring min myur du thob pa'i dge legs shog /yod med yin min dmigs gtad sna tshogs kyi/ /spros pa'i drwa ba rtog pa'i zug rngu'i tshogs/ /rnam bral 'jam pa'i dbyings su mnyam bzhag pas/ /bdud kyi rgyu ba kun nas mthar byed shog /stong pa'i ngang nas 'gags med mkhyen pa'i gdangs/ /kun khyab snying rje chen po'i rol pa las/ /nam mkha' ji srid 'gro ba'i phan bde'i dpal/ /rtag khyab lhun gyis grub pa nyid gyur cig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sku/ /rdul bral mchog gi lang tshor shar ba'i dpyid/ /rtag brtan bgres rgad bral ba'i gzhon nu'i gzugs/ /'gro khams rgya mtshor yongs su snang grur cig /rang rig nges pa don gyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mngon sum nyid du ma gyur de srid du/ /blo gter ngag gi dbang phyug gang gi sku/ /rtag tu snying gi 'o mtshor gsal gyur cig /tshig don bzang po'i drang tshul la/ /rjes su yi rang bdag gis kyang / /tshigs bcad bzhi tsam zhabs 'degs su/ /bsnan pa zhabs phyir 'khrid par zhu/ /zhes pa rje mi pham rin po che'i gsung gzhir bzhag la zhabs 'degs kyi tshul du kha snon cung tsam bgyis pa'o// // ra / /gang du gnyis snang mtshan ma'i chos/ /spang ba min kyang rang ngo nas/ /grub pa med pa'i chos nyid la/ /'jam dpal 61
