pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbyangs zhes rab tu brjod/ /'di na tha snyad snang ba'i chos/ /sgyu ma bzhin du 'phrul pa'i gzhi/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings bsam bral la /gdags su rung ba ma yin nyid/ /gal te yod dang med pa dang / /gnyis min gnyis zhes byar yod na/ /de nyid gdags byar rung na yang / /de med phyir na brjod du med/ /ci ste bden med dam pa'i don/ /grub pa 'ga' zhig yod gyur na/ /de nyid dmigs su rung mod de/ /bden dngos med phyir de med nyid/ /bden grub yong ye ma mchis pas/ /bden med yod ces tha snyad brjod/ /gshis la de nyid yod gyur na/ /de rang nyid kyang bden grub 'gyur/ /yul dang yul can mi dmigs shing / /bsal dang bzhag pa ngang gis zhi/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa nyid/ /de phyir 'jam dpal stong zhes bya/ /don dam rigs pas dpyad bzod pa'i/ /ye shes dang ni de bzhin nyid/ /grub na shes byar brjod rung gi/ /ma grub de brjod ga la rung //gang zhig rtogs pas spang bya'i chos/ /zad byed med par mi 'gyur te/ /'di yis gzhi la gzung dang 'dzin/ /ma grub brjod las gzhan min phyir/ /ci ste gshis la skyon yod na/ /bdag med zab mo mngon rtogs kyang / /bdag 'dzin 'bral bar mi rigs te//de nyid bden grub yin phyir ro/ /yon tan ma thob bden grub na/ /sems can 'tshang rgyar rigs ma yin/ /yon tan thob pa grub na 6 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1yang / /yon tan mi ldan skabs mi srid/ /de bzhin zag bcas ji snyed dang / /dri med chos rnams gang yang rung / /gcig dang du mar grub pa'i chos/ /srid par rung ba ma yin no/ /gcig tu grub pa'i chos yod na/ /shes bya 'ga' yang snang mi 'byur/ /gcig cig rtsom gzhir ma byas pa'i/ /du ma srid pa ma yin nyid/ /'on kyang ji snyed snang ba 'di/ /med bzhin brten nas 'byung bar zad/ /stong las gzhan la rten 'brel ni/ /mkhas pas smra bar mi rigs so/ /'dis ni kun rdzob don dam du/ /thal ba khas blang ma yin kyang / /kun rdzob las gzhan stong bya'i chos/ /dmigs su med phyir tshul 'di bzhag /ming rkyang btags yod las 'das de/ /da dung yod pa bsgrub dgos na/ /de tshe mthar thug tshad ma yis/ /smra ba bgyid las 'os ci yod/ /gang phyir rtog btags ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos de ri bong rwa 'dra zhes/ /dge slong de nyid rig rnams kyis/ /gzhung lugs rab tu bsgrags pa yin/ /rten 'byung ngo bo nyid nas stong / /stong pa sgyu ma'i rol mor snang / /snang stong phyobs re ma lhung ba/ /de la 'jam dpal dbyangs zhes brjod/ /zab mo 'di yis chos — rnams la/ /khyab phyir sems can bde gshegs su/ /'gyur ba dka' ba med grub ste/ /sems can rang bzhin med phyir ro/ /rtog btags las gzhan ma mchis kyang / /tha snyad ngos nas don mthun 63

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dang / /log blo'i phyir na stong rtogs pas/ /bden 'dzin 'bral bar nus pa yin/ /de phyir bral 'bras ji snyed pa/ /chos nyid 'di la rag las shing / /rang bzhin rnam dag nyid kyi phyir/ /'jam pa zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /yon tan nor gyis phongs rnams la/ /rgyu rkyepomang zhig tshogs pa las/ /yon tan gang zhig thob gyur pa/ /de yang sngar gyi rnam dpyad bzhin/ /tha snyad gnas tshul las bsam kyang / /ma das mtshan ma gtan med par/ /dag chen sku dang ye shes su/ / gdod nas lhun rdzogs dpal zhes bya/ /gang la skye med don gyi dbyings/ /phra ba zhes byar mkhas rnams smra/ /rgyal bas dbyangs kyis bang bsnyad pa'i/ /don zab bla med kyang 'di nyid/ /shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs bzhin/ /'jam dpal zab mo rab bshad pas//srid rtsa nam yang ma mchis pa'i//srid zhi mnyam nyid la gnas shog /ces pa'ang 'jigs med pas sbyo gtam smras pa'o// //ra / /shes bya mkhyen la gegs byed pa'i/ /tha tshig ral bar mi byed pa/ /sgrib gnyis nyes pa'i nags klung che/ /ye shes me lces zos der 'dud/ /yang 'dir rigs pa 'di snang ste/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa dang / /rnal 'byor pa yi blo gros kyis/ /chos nyid mchog ni mnyam pa nyid/ /de dag dbyer med nyid kyang ste/ /de bzhin nyid las rab gzhal na/ /blo gros mchog dang mchog min gyi//64

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rnam bzhag stong nyid bcas pa med/ /rgyal dang sems can tha dad ltar/ /de bzhin nyid kyang de bzhin zhes/ /tha dad smra ba don dam gyi//tshad ma ji bzhin ma mthong yin/ /ci phyir zhe na don dam du'ang / /mchog dman so so bzung phyir te/ /bden pa gnyis char ma grub na//tha dad bya ba ci zhig mchis/ /de 'dra'i tshul la rab mkhas shing / /rten 'byung rmi lam lha bu ru/ /gzungs sbobs ma brtags nyams dga' bar/ /snang tsam rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes che/ /yi ge sprin gyi 'khor lo ru/ /drang nas snying la de sbas na/ /nges par phrog pa bzhin du 'gyur/ /bde gshegs gzhan du ma dmigs shing / /bdag nyid bdag tu ma grub par/ /don mthun tshad mas rtogs pa la/ /'di dag thams cad 'thad par shes/ /spobs pa'i gter brgyad 'di yin te/ /dran dang blo gros rtogs pa dang / /gzungs dang spobs pa chos kyi gter/ /byang chub sems dang sgrub pa'o/ /gang gis sngon byung chos rnams kyang / /brjed pa nam yang ma mchis par/ /dran pa 'di ni dran pa'i gter/ /sems byung yul nges lnga las yin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched chos/ /shes rab chen pos rnam 'byed par/ /gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa/ /blo gros dam pa'i gter chen yin/ /zab mo'i shes rab de yi mthus/ /phul byung mdo don rgyas pa rnams/ /sgro dang skur ba ma mchis par/ /66

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rtogs pa rtogs pa'i gter zhes bya/ /gang zhig thos pa'i ba/zhung lugs kun/ /myur du blo la 'dzin byed pa'i/ /dran dang shes rab rmad byung ba/ gzungs kyi gter du rig pa yin/ /rgol ba rnams la lan smra bar/ /rigs pa thag thogs med gyur bas/ /legs bshad smra la mi bsnyeng ba/ /spobs pa'i gter zhes bya ba yin/ /gzhung lugs 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yis/ /sde snod rin chen gsal byed pa'i/ /blo mchog rab tu grub pa ni/ /chos kyi gter du rnam par bzhag /'gro ba kun la snying brtse'i phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon 'dod pa/ /de ni dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung / /'tshob byed byang chub sems kyi gter/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes cher/ /mnga' dbang shin tu 'byor gyur pas/ /byang chub lung bstan brnyes pa'i blo/ /sgrub pa'i gter de phyi ma'o/ /srid pa sgrub pas ci zhig rung / /gzhan phyir mya ngan 'da' 'dod na/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /spobs pa'i sku mchog 'di bsgrub rigs/ /de skad rigs par smra ba'i gtam/ /'jam dpal rdo rje non po'i sngags/ /snying la bcings pa'i gzhon pa yis/ /snga thun gcig la myur du bris/ /zhes pa'ang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas sbyar ba'o////༄ / /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul las 'khrungs shing / /chos kyi 66

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bsnyen bkur kho nas mnyes bya dang / /mnyes pas chos kyi rgyal srid sbyin nus pa/ /'jam dbyangs zhabs kyi bkar yid btud de//smon tshig phreng ba brgyud 'dir rje btsun khyod/ /dag pa'i snyan dbang yud tsam mngon phyogs nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i thabs mkhas tshad med pas/ /bzang po'i smon lam rgya cher skong bar mdzod/ /khyod sku mtshan dpe'i rin chen me tog tshal/ /ngo mtshar bye ba brgya yi mdangs bkra bar/ /yid mig rol pa'i dga' ba de las bdag / byang chub snying po ji srid mi nyams shog /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal bas bstod dbyangs dang / /lhan cig shis pa'i me tob char 'bebs shing / /kun bzang mchod sprin nang na sprin dbus su/ /glog ltar mdzes pa'i dpal gyis yid 'phrog shog /shin tu zhi ba thog ma'i na tshod can/ /gsal zhing 'od 'bar phyi nang yongs dag pa/ /phul byung gzugs sku lan re mthong bas kyang / /dga' ba'i yid byed dus mang 'byung bar shog /'dzum bcas byams pas dgyes pa'i nyams chags shing / /gser bzang 'od kyis nam mkha' dgod pa bzhin/ /mkhas pa dga' ba'i legs bshad ring 'phro ba/ /kun dga'i zhal ras rgyun du rtog par shog /'dod pas rmongs byed las kyi sgyu ma min/ /mthong bas thog ma med pa'i gti nug mun/ /rab 'phrog ye shes lang tsho gsar ba'i gzi/ /g.yeng ba 67

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mtha' dag btang ste yid byed shog /rnam par bsgyings pa'i gzigs stangs khyu mchog 'gros/ /dbugs 'byin bdud rtsi'i phyag stabs mnyam med sogs/ /dran pas bde legs mchog sprul spyod lam gyis/ /sems kyi rnyog pa kun nas dwangs byed shog /dag cing sgrib med mkha' ltar rgya che ba/ /mthu stobs dpag yas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rgyan/ /blta bas mi ngoms 'od kyi lding khang du/ /dpag bsam nags kyi lha bzhin rtse bar shog /kun spyod thams cad mnyam bzhag rjes 'brang yang / /'jig rten bsam pa sna tshogs la gzib/sa shing / /mi mnyam mdzad spyod chos dbyings khyab ston par/ /shes nas ci mdzad legs dguraXmathong bar shog /rgyal mdzad 'khor lo'i rtags can zhabs mthil la/ /rgyal sras khyu mchog mang po'i cod pan rtse/ /legs gtugs bla na med pa'i bsod nams zhing / /mthong nas dngos po kun gyis mnyes byed shog /dag pa'i snod bcud rab yangs rdul snyed gzugs/ /mdzes snyug cha shas phra mor gsal rdzogs pa'i/ /sgyu ma'i rol rtsed mchog la yid zhugs nas/ /thun mong min pa'i ngo mtshar 'char bar shog /phyogs bcur dag pa'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs dang / /'khor dang zhing gi rgyan bkod 'byams klas pa/ /chos dkar bdud rtsis smin pa'i mngon sum yul/ /thob nas kun bzang spyod la mkhas par shog /mi phyed 68

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'khor ltar mthun pa'i gdu bu dang / /gtong dang tshul khrims bzod pas legs brgyan pa/ /dge ba'i bsung tshor pad+ma'i zhabs zung la/ /'jus nas smon lam rlabs chen sprub par shob /bden zhing phan pa'i don ldan sbyar legs tshig /phun tshogs bsod nams brgya pa'i zhal sgo las/ /tshangs ba'i dbyangs snyan rgyud la nyer drangs pas/ /gsung gi dbang por mi 'phrog nges rnyed shog /'jigs rung srid pa'i nyes dmigs bsam yas pa/ /bstan nas bag med yid ni skyo mdzad cing / /rten 'byung 'khor lo'i tshul la mi rmongs pa'i//yang dag blo gros snang ba sbyin par shog /de nas sems can thams cad yid 'ong du/ /sgrub byed rigs pa'i rnam grangs mang bstan nas/ /rgya chen snying rje'i ljon shing yal ga stug / lhag bsam 'bras bus brgyan pa 'byung bar shog /gzhan phyir rdzogs byang sgrub pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /tshul khrims phung po yongs su dag byed cing //skyo dub med pa'i brtson 'grus rgyun chags pas// khyod gsung gdams pa'i gter la 'jug par shog /de tshe tshigs bcad res kyang dpag dka'i don/ /du mar myur 'jug ring du mi brjed pa'i//blo mchog rnyed nas gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar /son pa'i go 'phang bde blag 'thob par shog /'chad thabs rgyan ldan bshad pa'i pha rol phyin/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin rtsod pa'i tsher ma 59

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbyung //'khrul ba bral ba'i dgongs 'grel gzhung byed la/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog chos smra'i dbang por shog /kun tu mi bzad yid kyi ba yo ba'i dug /'phrog byed bsam gtan sbyor ba'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /zad par zil gnon mngon shes la sogs pa/ /rnam mang yon tan phung por 'gyur bar shog /shes bya'i gsang ba gnyis med zhi ba'i sgo/ /mtha' bral stong pa rten 'byung don du ni/ /rnam dag rigs pa'i sgo mo brgyas mthong ste/ /yid ni lhag mthong zab mos ngos gang shog /mkha' ltar dang ba'i mnyam bzhag sgyu ma lta'i/ /rjes thob bsod nams tshogs dang zung 'brel du/ /sbyangs pas sems kyi rgyu ba las 'das nas/ /dmigs med stong pa'i dbyings su 'phyo bar shog /slar yang rgyal sras rnams kyi bla ma khyod/ /gzugs skus 'jig rten nyin mor mdzad mthong nas/ /de 'dra'i 'byor pa rgya chen sgrub slad du/ /rab yangs bsod nams tshogs mchog gsog par shog /'gran zla med par chos 'khor bskor ba'i gsung / /rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes nyag gcig gi /'phrul du mthong nas ngoms pa ma mchis par/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i ye shes tshogs gsog shog /mos spyod sa nas khyod gsung tshig 'bru dang / /don dang nges tshig spobs pa mtha' yas pas/ /legs bskrun so so yang dag rig bzhi yi/ /sa bon dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin 'phel bar 60

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1shog /de mthus sangs rgyas spyan sngar smra rnams kyi/ /thog ma'i skyes mchog khyod dang lhan gcig tu/ /theg mchog 'gro ba'i tshul la mi 'jigs pas/ /sems can rgya mtsho yongs su sgrol bar shog /'khor ba ji srid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /cho 'phrul gsum gyis mtha' las 'gro ba kun/ /gdul bas mi skyo rgyal kun yab gcig gi/ /rnam thar ma lus myur du rdzogs par shog /de ltar ye shes spyod yul mthar phyin te/ /skru dang zhing khams sku tshe yongs dag 'khor/ /snyan grags mdzad phrin chos dbyings snyom 'jug pa/ /kun gzigs dpa' bo mchog dang mnyam par shog /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gzhan don phun tshogs kyi sku la brten te rang gi don gnyis phun tshogs 'grub tshul dang sbyar ba'i bstod pa smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni rdo rong gi ban de bstan pa'i nyi mas sbyar ba tshe rabs kun tu bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nus yongs 'dzin mdzad pa'i rgyur gyur cig gu/mad lo// / /nga / /na mo ad+ma mañju shri ye/ /rab 'byams zhing sga mgon po sras bcas kyis/ /rgya chen bstod dbyangs me tog char phab pa/ /rgyal kun yab cig mkhyen rab lhag pa'i lha'i/ /zhabs rten rin chen pad+ma ra phyag bgyi'o/ /kun dga'i dpal ster dgyes 'dzum pad+ma'i zhal/ /shis pa'i bsung 'thul zung spyan a sprul mda'/ /dus 61

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dir bdag cag rnams la lhan cig tu/ /phyogs pa'i rjes brtse mdzad cing dgongs su gsol/ /bdag sogs skye zhing skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ /rlabs chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyod bsten nas/ /theg mchog gdams pa'i bdud rtsi 'thung ba yis/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen lang 'tsho blta bar shog /mthong bas yid nun sel mdzad mtshan dpe'i nyi/ /tshe 'dir dang ba'i mig mkhar mngon sum du/ /legs shar byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i 'od snang gi/ /dga' bas nyin mtshan kun tu 'da' bar shog /legs gsung 'dul mngon mdo sde'i gzhung lugs kun/ /dgongs 'grel shing rta chen po'i man ngag la/ /brten nas rgyal ba nyid kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ /rtogs pa'i blo mig khyod mthus rnyed par shog /drang don gsung rab kun gyi brjod bya'i gsang / /nges don 'khor lo bar pa'i zab gnad mchog /mtha' bral dbu ma'i chu gter 'jings rol ba'i/ /rnam dpyod gru skya rang dgar 'dzin par shog /shin tu rgya che rnam grangs 'byams klas pa'i/ /rgyal sras spyod tshul rgya mtsho'i de nyid la/ /mi rmongs chos rab rnam 'byed rtsal rdzogs nas/ /yum don mthong ba'i rab dgas myos par shog /theg mchog lam gyi khyad par mtha' dag la/ /shin tu phra ba'i rigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /yid ches rnyed nas gzhan gyis mi 'phrogs pa'i/ /zab bzang blo gros rtsa ba tshugs par 62

bstod tshogs phyogs ba bsdus/ pod 1shog /dgos 'grel med pa'i gsung rab yod min pas/ /lung don ma lus nyams len snying po ru/ /dril nas sgrub pa nan tan 'khor lo yis/ /yongs rdzogs bstan la bya ba byed par shog /tshe yi mtha' yang rnam grol bdud rtsi'i lha/ /dri med zla zhal mnga' ba khyod mthong ste/ /brgya phrag bsod nams las grub byams pa'i phyag /brkyangs te spyi bor 'jog cing rjes 'dzin shog /shi 'phos nas kyang rje btsun khyod kyi zhal/ /dran pa'i 'du byed skad cig mi 'gog cing / /gang dang gang du dpa' bo khyod bzhugs pa'i/ /phyogs der skye ba'i myu gu 'dzin par shog /nam yang mgon khyod mnyes par mi bgyid pa'i/ /rgyu mthun chos la sdang dang dam pa smod/ /gzhung lugs ngan dang sdig pa'i grogs bsten sogs/ /rmi lam du yang bgyid par ma gyur cig /bskal mang thos dka' thos nas shes dka' ba'i/ /chos tshul sgo mo brgya stong bye ba snyed/ /khyod las myur thos tshigs bcad re rer yang / /brten nas bde blag kho nar rtogs par shog /sgyu ma'i rnam thar mthar phyin mgon po khyod/ /sgyu 'phrul sprul pa lta bu'i skru lus kyi/ /rnam rol sna tshogs ston pa'i zhing de dag /mngon sum blta ba'i dbang 'byor thob par shog /bsam yas rgyal kun 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /kun tu bzang po'i rol rtsed brgya phrag gis/ /bzhud tshe khyod zhabs pad+ma'i sa 'dzin rdul/ /bsnyen pa'i zham ring 63

ngo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gtso bor bdag 'gyur shog /sangs rgyas thams cad bsnyen bkur sbyor ba dang / /dam chos nyan dang tshangs spyod bsten pa dang / /ye shes sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus tshad med pas/ /bde gshegs mthong ba'i mig ni rnam dag shog /rgyal rnams spyan sngar khyod dang lhan cig tu/ /theg mchog 'dri dang smra ba'i skal bzang la/ /dbang bsgyur rgyal sras mkhas pa nor bzang bzhin/ /gyur nas sems can mang la phan byed shog /skad cig tsam yang mgon po khyod zhabs dang / /mi 'bral sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba kun/ /mthong ba'i ngo mtshar dpal la rtag rol cing / /rnam pa kun tu de 'dra'i rjes slob shog /mdor na kun bzang spyod pa'i smon lam mdzod/ /rje btsun khyod kyi byin rlabs bzang po yi/ /drin las mig 'phrul lta bur rdzogs byas te/ /yon tan phung po khyod dang 'dra bar shog /'jam mgon zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di'ang bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs la mi 'phros pa'i yid ches cung zad thob pa'i rje 'jam dpal rig pa'i ral gris lcags yos chu stod can gyi rgyal ba thog ma la bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ //64

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ra / /rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa la bstod pa dge legs nyin byed 'dren pa'i thing rta sogs/oṃ swa ste/ /gang du 'khor lo'i mtshan mnga' zhabs skyes gzi/ /li khri'i rdul tshogs lhung ba'i 'bab stegs der/ /rab 'byams thub pa'i yid dang bkra shis bsung / /lhan cig ldang ba drang srong pad+ma'i zhal/ /de yi rjes phyogs dad pa'i rlung yab kyis/ /nye bar bos pa'i brjod 'dod rlung shugs ni/ /blo gros 'khri shing 'dab ma la phog pas/ /yid 'ong bstod pa'i me tog cung zad 'thor/ /snyan ngag nor gyis dbul ba bdag 'dra'i tshig /mkhas pa'i yi gar mchi snyam mi bgyid de/ /mgon khyod yon tan brjod pa'i dga' ba dang / /'grogs phyir me tog char ba'i dpes kyang bsnyad/ /shin tu g.yo ba sos ka'i dpal 'byor gyis/ /'khyud pa'i khu byug glus kyang dga' skyed na/ /kun tu bzang po'i phun chogs za ma tog /khyod kyi gtam la su zhig ngoms pa skye/ /khyod la lus can nyer 'tshor ma 66

—po da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ bstabs pa'i/ /phun tshogs bung ba'i rkang rdul tsam yod min/ /de phyir khyed ni ma lus 'jig rten gyi/ /bla na med pa'i phan 'dobs zhing du mthong / /gang phyir khyod kyis mtha' dag lus can la/ /rgud pa'i khur ni gang dang gang gzigs pa/ /de de nyid kyi nongs pa bzhin dgongs pa'i/ /thugs rje'i yum gyis dang por bskrun pa lags/ /de las bdag nyid phan bde mi zad pa'i/ /gter du mdzad nas skye dgu'i re ba kun/ /rdzogs par skong ba'i thubs bskyed rin po che/ /dbang phyug khyod kyi thog ma'i gdung ribs lags/ /khyod ni rlabs chen rigs kyi che ba'i mthus/ /thos sgrogs dpa' bo rnams kyang skrag 'gyur ba'i/ /brtul zhugs bya dka' kun la ma zhum par/ /gzhal med pas kyang gzhal med bskal bar spyad/ /lus can rgud pa'i rnam grangs ji snyed par/ /khyod kyis legs tshogs tshol ba lhur blangs te/ /rgyur bcas rgud pa de snyed rnams kyis kyang / /khyod kyi thabs mkhas tshad la thub ma gyur/ /de ltar 'jig rten kun dang mi mnyam pa'i/ /rgyu tshogs phul byung rnams la dbang mdzad phyir/ /dpe zla sa gsum 'gro nang rnyed min pa'i/ /yon tan phung po rgya chen brnyes pa lags//go 'phang srid zhi'i ba gam rtser 'dzegs kyang / /thugs rje'i spyan ras mgon med 'gror chags te/ /gzhan phan nyid kyi gtsug tor rgyan bzhes pa/ /66

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bar kye ma'o khyod kyi chos nyid ya mtshan lags/ /khyod ni myu gu'i dus su gzhan gyi phyir//skyo dub med par phun tshogs 'bras bu bsgrubs/ /de rnyed nas kyang bdag gi 'byor ba la/ /spyod pa'i slong ba tshol zhing rtag tu bzhugs/ /ma 'dris mdza' bshes 'brel ba med pa'i gnyen//phongs la ma bcol bzhin du mgon mdzad pa/ /byams dang sdang ba snyom pa'i dge sbyong gtso/ /khyod kyi gtam 'dra su yi rnar mi 'jug /gtam 'di pad+ma'i dpal ltar yid 'ong phyir/ /nam mkha' tshad kyis 'jal 'dra'i zhing kun tu/ /mkhas pa'i mgrin pa gcig nas gcig brgyud de/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba stong bis rtse zhing rgyu/ /dpag bsam nags ni bsung ngad mtshar sdug dang / /ro ldan shing tog rnams kyis nyams dga' ltar/ /khyod kyang grags pa'i dri dang mtshan dpe dang / /gsung gi dga' ba rnams kyis brgyan pas mdzes//khyod kyi sku ni nyi ma'i lang tsho bzhin/ /mchog tu 'bar yang skye bo'i gdungs byed min/ /rab gsal na tshod tshes pa'i zla 'dra yang / /mdzes dgu'i yon tan cha shas ma gang min/ /zhi ba'i mtshar sdug pad+ma la 'gran yang / /rtag tu mi zum dpe la des mi phod/ /yangs shing mtho ba lhun po'i ngos 'dra ste/ /gzi brjid ri rab lhas kyang bsnyen par dka'/ /drang zhing rgyas la chu zheng shin tu gab/ /'jam mnyen btso ma'i gser bzhin kha dog 'phags/ /ma rnyong dku 67

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/skabs phyed cing yan lag 'tshams/ /lan brgyar bltas kyang yid mig ngoms pa med/ /pad rag me long phyis 'drar gtsang ba'i zhal//dkyus ring zla ba tshes pa'i dbyibs mnga' zhing / /gnag snum be zur 'od chags smin ma'i dbus/ /dkar zhing g.yas 'khyel mdzod spu'i thig le 'tsher/ /gsal dag mchog tu bkra ba 'dab brgya'i spyan/ /rab zhi bsam gtan ro yis gang ba'i nyams/ /be+e ka'i gzigs stangs gang du babs pa yang / /dge legs nor bu'i char gyis dpal ldan mdzad/ /mdog legs rim par 'tshams shing mtho ba'i rgyud/ /rab gtsang dri yi longs spyod bzang po can/ /de 'dra'i shangs ni mkhur tshos zla ba dang / /so so'i mdzes sdug rigs kyis 'gran pa 'dra/ /dmar ba'i phun tshogs bim pa la 'phya zhing / /steng 'og legs par 'tshams pa'i zhal gyi sgros/ /mi g.yo yang dag 'jog bzhin gnas pa na/ /brtan pa'i brjid bag cis kyang 'phrog mi 'gyur/ /de ni chos ston dus su g.yo 'gyur te/ /tshems dkar chu shel 'od kyi 'char nub dang / /mnyen yangs ljags dmar 'gyu ba'i rol rtsed kyis/ /mdzes pa brgya 'gyur du ni gsal zhing 'bar//dwangs shing rgyas pa'i za 'gram ngos dag tu/ /rang 'od me tog phreng ba spel mkhas pa/ /mnyam zhing 'khyil legs ma nyams snyan gnyis ni/ /mkha' khyab sgra dbyangs mdzes mar rtag tu 'khyud/ /mthu chen 68

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dge ba'i gzi 'bar gnas gtsang lha'i/ /zur phud rin chen snye mar dbang bsgyur ba/ /khyod zhabs 'khor lo'i dpal gyis mi dbang gi/ /rin chen bdun gyi mthu dpal stong du pham/ /chos dbyings khyon na las dang ye shes kyi/ /sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul ji snyed 'char ba kun/ /khyod sku'i rdul cha re rer gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gsal rdzogs dbang 'byor pha mtha' su yis dpog /mthon mthing lcang lo'i rgyan gyur gtsug tor rtse/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi sgyu ma lta'i/ /ting 'dzin sprul pa'i me tog bsnyi bstang dang / /'grogs pa'i rtse dga' skad cig nyams pa med/ /khyod ni skyil krung gcig la ma bzhengs kyang / /sprul pa'i sprin dang 'od zer glog gi phreng / /mkha' las chos kyi 'brug sgra rang 'byung sogs/ /lhun grub rnam 'phrul phyogs bcu khyab par 'jug /chos dkar phyogs su 'bad pa brgya yis kyang / /bskyod par dka' ba nyes mang goms pa'i blo/ /khyod zhal mthong ba tsam nas byang chub cher/ /mi 'phrogs dga' ba'i gzhan dbang 'gyur ba lags/ /su zhig bzungs spobs ting 'dzin mngon shes sogs/ /gang gang mngon 'dod gtso bo khyod dran na/ /de de'i re ba'i 'bras bu de dang de/ /'od mdzad zhal bzang mthong ma thag tu 'thob/ /kun bzang spyod pa'i ngo mtshar 'byams klas pa/ /ma 'dres ri mor bris pa khyod kyi sku/ /'di ni 69

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang gi tshogs la drin gzo'i ched/ /lhar bcas mdun du zur gyis bstod pa 'dra/ /khyod ni chos sgrogs pa dang mi gsung la/ /dgyes pa gdul ba'i dus dang dus min gyi/ /mtshams las mi brgal ye shes rjes 'brang ste/ /de slad bshad pa 'bras bus lci ba las sa/ /khyod gsung ge sar nags las nyin re bzhin/ /mtho ris 'dod pa'i bung ba 'bum snyed dag /dkar po'i lta spyod bsam gtan sbrang rtsi'i phreng / /gus pa'i rgal pa la thob rab dga' sgrogs/ /re ba'i mig 'bur thar pa la gtod cing / /khyod gsung zil pa'i rdul chas ngoms rnams ni/ /mchog tu gya nom rdul bral yang dag mtha'i/ /lding khang mtho la ngal 'tsho rnam par sten/ /rigs dang dbang po yongs 'dzin rlabs che ba'i/ /brtan pa rnams kyis rmad byung spyod pa'i khur/ /dus mang khyer ba'ang mgon po khyod kyi bka'i/ /mchog gi rnam 'phrul rdzogs par blta slad lags/ /spros bral dbyings dang rten 'byung snang ba ni/ /ro gcig tshul 'di khyod gsung dgongs pa'i gting / /zab pa lags te de dang mtshungs sbyor ba'i//blo can rgyal las gnyis pa gzhan yod min/ /ma lus tha snyad spros pa'i tshon ris dang / /chos rgyal rnams kyi dbang phyug chen po'i sku/ /de 'drar rab yangs sa dang phar phyin gyi/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho'i snod kyang khyod kyi gsung //khyod ni khams dang mos dbang sna tshogs pa'i / /70

bstod tshogs phyog bsdus/ pod 1'khor mang nang du dbyangs gcig bsgrags pa las/ /so so'i skal ba ji bzhin legs 'tshams par/ /gdams pa'i ro ni du mar snang ba lags/ /khyod kyis chos bstan rab mtha' gang lags kyang / /'dul ba'i dgos pa la ltos tshang ba dang / /ma nor rim par 'os shing rgyas bsnyus 'tshams/ /zab mo'i gnas kyang sa ler ston pa lags/ /de bzhin khyod ni gang gang gtam mdzad pa/ /brjid cing rab snyan 'thad pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /mang yang mtha' dag bzang la bzang ba dang / /bsdus kyang don mang gsal ba kho na'ang lags//gnang bkag drang nges mi 'dra mang bstan kyang / /mi 'gal phan tshun grogs su 'gro ba ste/ /gting mtha' blo chen gyis kyang dpog dka' la/ /shes rab chung la'ang dga' ba mi skyed min/ /gdangs snyan rgyun chags zab cing brtan par grags/ /'khor gyi mu tshod cud zad mi 'da' zhing / /'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor gdugs bzhin bsil bar khebs/ /cho 'phrul rgya chen du mas brjid pa lags/ /'gro sems log pa'i yul la g.yo ba'i dug /drag po'i shugs kyis 'phyur zhing 'ong ba yang / /khyod gsung dri za'i rgyud mangs sgras bkug ste/ /rtse gcig chos ldan ltad mo la chags 'gyur/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten mya ngan 'das dbyings su/ /rgyu ba'i lam chad yun ring lon pa na/ /phan mdzad smra ba zla med khyod byung ste/ /lam 71

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba de 'ing rta chen po'i srol bzhin btod/ /slob ma'i tshogs stus bsam yas sras mnga' ba/ /khyod ni nam zhig zhi la mnal ba na'ang //gsung gi lha mo sgyu rtsal dpag med 'di/ /rjes dran sgo ni rab 'byams zhing du rtag /ston mtshan mkha' la gza' skar rgyu ba rnams/ /dang ba'i chu nang mig bkod shes pa bzhin/ /khyod kyi sgrib med mkhyen brtse thabs bcas pa/ /gsung gi 'byor pa 'di las nges pa lags/ /'od mdzad 'gro ba rjes 'dzin kun dga'i skur/ /dpag bsam 'byor pa'i sgo nas cha tsam zhig /bstod pa'i dge bas skye zhing skye ba kun/ /khyod bstod me tog phreng rgyud dbang por shog /tshe 'di kho nar sangs rgyas mi mthong ba'i/ /las kyi mtshan mo zad pa'i thun mtshams ni/ /drang srong 'dzum 'od 'char ka'i gzi dmar gyis/ /mdzes par 'ching ba'i go skabs mthong gyur cig /de mthus grangs med rgyal ba'i zhal gyi sgor/ —/mngon sum rna ba'i snyim pa legs btud de/ /nyin re theg mchog gdams pa'i btung ba ni/ /rgya mtshos chu klung sdud 'dra 'thung bar shog /legs bshad shing rgyal bsnyen bkur bya phyir ni/ /lus srog bdug spos bzhin du yal gyur kyang / /zhum pa spang ba'i shugs drag snying stobs kyis/ /bskal pa'i dkyil 'khor bgrang yas 'da' gyur cig /de las khyod kyis mchog tu phra ba'i sku/ /thun mong min pa'i longs spyod rol pa can/ /bde 72

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'byung mgo bor zla tshes zhin thob nas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab thos pa'i mdzod 'phel shog /slar yang gzhon nu'i sa la zhi mtha' las//brtse chen gdams pa'i phyag gis yongs bzung bas/ /thabs shes rtogs pa'i na tshod cher rdzogs nas/ /dbang bskur nor bu'i cod pan nod par shog/snying gi bum par cad gsung bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /bsam byung skya bas legs par bsrubs pa las/ /mtha' bral lta ba snying rje'i gser mdangs dang / /mi phyed bcud kyi gong bur 'dril bar shog /tshul de rgya chen spyod pa'i rgyan ldan par/ /brtson pa drag pos bar med bskyed bsrings bas/ /shin sbyangs dga' ba mi mnyam ster byed pa'i/ /sher phyin mdzes ma'i brang la sen 'debs shog /khyod kyis mos spyod yon tan sgrub pa'i sgo//rab mchog lags par gzigs pa'i thabs mkhas tshul/ /ma lus bde blag nyid du yongs grub nas//chos mchog zur phud spe la phyin par shog /de nas gnyis snang spros pa'i na dun rdul/ /gnas lubs nam mkhar dag pa'i rjes thog tu/ /zab cing rgya che'i snang ba mtha' yas kyis/ /chos dbyings ngos kun thig le 'god gyur cig /sa dang sa la rnam pa tha dad pa'i/ /tshogs kyi dga' ston gsar pa la rtse zhing / /rlob sems bral ba sgyu ma'i mi lha bus/ /rdzogs smin sbyang gsum pha mthar rgal bar shog /rtag tu mgon khyod bka' yi spring yig ni/ /brtse 73

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i lag rtser thogs nas yid can la/ /klog pa'i las kyis cung zad mi dub par//zhing khams rgya mtsho'i tha gru nyul bar shog/gsung rab ma lus gzhan dring mi 'jog par/ /drang srong dgongs pa'i theg lam nyag gcig nas//'grel byed ngag gi ba dan bye ba brgyas //rgyal bstan khang pa rnam par brgyan byed shog /sgrub dang sun 'byin sbyor ba rnon po yis/ /sa steng log par smra ba'i dug 'phrogs shing / /mi bzlog rigs pa'i gzi byin rgya che bas//mkhas pa'i yid la smin pa sbyin gyur cig/bdag gi snyan ngag sdeb legs phung po ni//grags pa'i pho nyas dus gsum mi ngal bar/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna lung la rgyud cing //thub rnams kha la rdzogs ldanaX'agugs gyur cig /sangs rgyas chos smra 'jig rten rgyan byed rnams/ /rtsod dus 'jigs pa brgya yis gtse ba na/ /mthu stobs rdo rje gdengs pa'i brjid zil gyis/ /srung ba'i dpa' bo mchog tu bdag 'gyur shog /mdor na srid zhi'i legs tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /rgyal ba'i chos tshul nyan dang sgrubs pa dang / ston pa'i smon lam yid bzhin rtsal rdzogs nas/ /chos kyi dbang phyug khyod bzhin 'gyur bar shog /rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa la bstod pa dge legs nyin byed 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba mdo smad rdo rol gyi phreng rgyud mkhan po nyi ma dpal gyis be dza ya zhes pa shing lug khrum zla'i dkar phyogs drang srong ri 74

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ka'i dkyil 'khor 'chi med kyi btung ba 'gyed pa'i dus su gser ljongs bzlo bkod pa'i spyil spugs su sbyar ba bsam don 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga lo// //ra / /bkra shis pad+ma rgyas pa'i yid 'ong zhal/ /tshangs dbyangs sbrang rtsi'i dog pa ring po can/ /thub rnams yid kyi bung ba chags byed pa'i/ /'od mdzad snang ba dpag med khyod phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyi rab dkar grags pa'i yi ge ni/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal bas lan mang du/ /mkhas pa'i tshogs su dbyangs kyis gsal mdzad pas//lha dang mi rnams nyin bzhin kha ton byed/ /de ltar rab mang 'gro ba'i thor cog rtse/ /gzi ldan mtshan gyi zhags pas nyer drangs te/ /rang gi zhabs rdul gur gum jig le yis/ /dpal 'bar bgyis pa'i zhing du rtse bar mdzad/ /khyod kyi mtshan tsam gus pas klog pa rnams/ /bsam yas yul gyis bskal pa'i phyogs gnas kyang / /mthu stobs thogs med 'od zer phreng tshogs kyis/ /pad+ma nyi shar bzhin du smin par 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthar son khyod la blta ba na/ /mdzes sdug 'jig rten gsum na dpe med dang / /shis dgu'i mchog ster mthu yi khyad par gyis/ /dang por mig dang yid la tshim pa skyed/ /de nas ye shes bcud kyis rgyas pa'i zhal/ /phan dang bden pa'i don ldan legs bshad dbyangs/ /sngon med cho 'phrul 76

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba brgya yi rgyan bcas te/ /spro bas yid dang rna ba cher sim mdzad/ /rmongs pa mtshan mo'i smag gis thog med nas/ /skal ngan bgyis pa'i yid kyang khyod gsung mthus/ /tshul bzhin sems pa'i 'od kyis skya gyur nas/ /ye shes li khri'i snang ba rim gyis rtsom/ /khyod kyi chos sku shin tu yongs dag pa/ /zab mo so so rang gis rig bya ba'ang 1 /tshul 'dis 'gro la lhang nger bstan mdzad phyir/ /gsung gi rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab pa lags/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'dab ma'i cha rdzogs pa/ /khyod gsung dpag bsam sdong po 'di skyes pas/ /ma lus chos dbyings mdzes ma ston dus kyi/ /zla zer spu long lta bu'i dga' ba 'dzin/ /de lta'i ya mtshan 'od kyi rtse das/ra bcas/ /tshogs gnyis rta mchog bdun pa'i shing rta yis/ /bskal mang gling gi 'khor lo 'jal byed phyir/ /khyod ni tshe dpag med kyi nyi ma lags/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa kun gyi de kho na/ /khyod la g.yogs pa kun dang bral ba'i phyir/ /mtha' dag shes bya'i nam mkha' skad cib/ rer/ /ye shes 'od kyis 'gengs pa'i dbang phyug mnga'/ /khyod kyi mkhyen pa gdul bya'i khams dbang dang / /'dul ba'i thabs dang dus la thogs med cing / /thugs rje chen pos rang gis phun tshogs kun/ /gzhan phyir bskal pa du mar byin brlabs pa/ /de phyir 'od bzang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni//gcig pus phyogs bzhi'i 76

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bar nam mkha' rgyan byed ltar/ /mdzad pa gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog par/ /gdul bya'i yul la mnyam par 'jug pa lags/ /de skad blo chung shing gi pi waṃ khog /rtse gcig dang ba'i rgyud can bskul ba'i sgras/ /khyod mchod bsod nams zla ba'i dum bu ltas/ /'gro kun tshe dpag med kyi gnas rnyed shog /bstan pa'i nyi mas gus pa chen pos phyag dang bcas te phul// //ma / /sangs rgyas mtshan thos tsam yang bskal mang du/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin dkon phyir/ /phul byung bsod nams zhing 'dir snyan dngags kyi/ /sa bon bag tsam 'debs la spro ba skyes/ /mthong bas dga' sbyin bum pa bzang po'i mchog /thos pas sdig 'phrog gdung sel ri bong can/ /yid la dran pa yis kyang legs dgu'i nor/ /sbyin mdzad chos kyi rgyal po 'od dpag med/ /khyed ni 'khor ba mi gtsang 'dam rdzab la/ /lhag par dmigs pa'i brtse chen sdong bu las/ /zab cing rgya che'i yon tan 'dab ma brgya/ /grol nas tshangs chen ral pa'i tog tu 'phags/ /khyod kyi zhal bzang pad+ma'i mchog ltar mdzes/ /ge sar spubs las chos sgra'i dri bsung 'phro/ /de ni mtshan dpe'i yal ga rab rdzogs pa'i/ /dpag bsam sku yi cha shas kho nar 'tshams/ /tshangs pa'i nga ro zhi ba'i don ston pa/ /cho 'phrul brgya dang lhan cig mthor sgrogs pas/ /77

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—gdul bya'i snying la ring nas 'dris pa'i nun/ /'dod lha'i dga' ba dag dang lhan cig 'phrog /mkhyen pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor dus gcig khyab/ /thugs rjes ma lus 'gro la gcig tu 'khyud/ /mkhyen dang brtse bas srid zhi'i rgad pa kun/ /cig char 'grog pa'i spyod yul khyed kyis brnyes/ /sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa ji snyed pa/ /sa/cig tu bzang ba dzasbu'i gser 'dra la/ /kun kyang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor rtag 'jug pa'i/ /skyabs 'os khyod la snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /deng nas skye ba kun tu khyod zhabs rdul/ /ral pa'i cod pan rtse mor mi 'bral zhing / /khyod gsung bdud rtsis yid kyi u sprul/ /dgod pa'i lang tsho mi rnying thob gyur cig /'od mdzad brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu'i gzis/ /brjid 'bar blo yi mig stong thig le can/ /khros pa'i brgal brtags rtse brgya'i mtshon 'phangs pas /phas rgol lta min rnam par 'thor byed shog /cher snyigs dus kyi rgya mtshor drang srong che'i/ /gsung rab rin chen 'dzin ma bying ba na/ /blo dang brtson pa'i shugs kyis 'degs bzod pa'i/ /pad dkar mig bzang 'jug par bdag 'gyur shog /khyod kyis legs gsungs rig sngags 'don byed cing / /de don tshang la ma nor sgrub pa yi/ /nan tan me tog nyin bzhin 'bul ba yis/ /rgyal rnams dgyes skyed drang srong gtso bor shog /de skad nags dang nags 78
sgyu phyogab྾༵'i sa

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄ / /'phags pa sprun ras gzigs kyi bstod pa byang ma'i chas sgogs sogs/khyab bdag 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi dbyings las sprul pa'i skur bzhengs te// sna tshogs zhing du gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin/ /rnam pa mang po'i mdzad pas rnam rol pa/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /kun rtog tshon brgyas bkra ba'i rang sems kyi/ /khang brtsegs yangs par bzlas brjod rol mo 'khrol/ /dad pa'i mchod yon sbreng zhing spyan 'dren na/ /thugs rje shing rta'i kha lo phyogs 'dir sgyur/ /ye shes tsam las rang shar sgyu 'dra'i gzugs/ /thugs bskyed tsam gyis gdul bya'i mdun na bzhugs/ /khyed kyi gshegs bzhud 'bad la ltos min pas/ /chu nang zla shar lta bur blta bar bgyi/ /sdig dang nyon mongs du ma'i phyags dar gyis/ /gang ba'i yid 'di mdzes par mi snang yang / /chags bral gtso bo khyed la srid zhi gnyis/ /mnyam pa lags kyis rang gi khab bzhin dbongs/ /khyod kyis dgongs na bdag 'dra'i shes rgyud kyang / /'og 80

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1min gtsang ma'i khyim ltar 'gyur du re/ /gang phyir mnar med me yi 'obs nang yang / /khyod zhabs reg pas me tog mtsho gling 'gyur/ /srid pa'i 'brog dgon nyam nga 'jigs rung du/ /sdig pa'i chang 'thung gom tshugs 'khyor ba bdag /da gdod 'phags pa'i mgron po khyod thos te/ /yig drug chos kyi bzhi mdor dus shig 'debs/ /dngos grub slong ba tshol ba'i mgon khyod dang / /sangs rgyas mthong la skom pa'i gus ldan bdag /rig sngags lam srang gcig tu 'dzom dus 'dir/ /mthong dka'i zhal bzang gsal bar bstan du gsol/ /gang tshe bdag cag rig sngags rgyal mo'i shing / /yi ge'i yal 'dab btud pa la 'ju tshe/ /'jig rten yab khyod thugs rje'i phyag rkyongs la/ /dngos grub 'bras bu'i khyad par bzang mang stsol/ /'khor ba rgya mtsho'i 'gram du rig sngags gru/ /sgyur legs bshams nas pha rol su 'gro zhes/ /dus drug sgrog khyod re ba'i yul byas te/ /grur zhugs bdag cag myur bar bsgral du gsol/ /dman dang phongs pa lhag par rjes 'dzin phyir/ /rgyal rnams khyod la snying rje'i gter du bsngags/ /bdas 'dra skal ba dman pas mi sgrol na/ /de ltar bsngags pa'i bden pa gang du song / /dam chos rin chen gling nas legs brtags te/ /rig sngags yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po blangs/ /ngal brgyas mchod kyang dgos pa ma grub na/ /don mthun 81

za da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4 ྾grogs mang nang du ngo yang tsha/ /'on te drang srong rnams kyang rgyal po'i srid/ /nyi za dka' thub dgos pa grub par sems sangs rgyas rgyal srid 'khor lo rin chen lta'i/ /rig sngags lag rtser 'ongs na smos ci 'tshal/ /bklag grub sngags 'di gzung sla yi ge nyung / /don tshul phye na chos dbyings po ltar yang / /lo dang grangs med rgyal ba'ang 'di na bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa'i sprin yang 'di las 'byung / /zab don ro brgya ldan pa'i la du 'di/ /shes rab so rtse rnon pos legs bldad de/ /ting 'dzin lce yis yang dang yang myang ba/ /de dag bdud rtsi'i bro ba rim gyis shes/ /lo las rig sngags bdud rtsi 'di bzhes te/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal rdzogs ga ka'i bye snyed kyang / /dkon mchog chos 'dir byas pa gzo slad du/ /su zhig zlos brtson de la mchog sbyin mdzad/ /gang la rgyal rnams ye shes rjes 'brang ba'i/ /thugs rje chen po ming gi rjes dran sgor/ /rnam par 'phrul 'di mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i sprin/ /dbang byed sil snyan yan lag brgya ba'ang yin/ /dka' spyad brgya yis mthong dka'i lha rnams kyang / /'di zlos mdun sar ma bos bzhin du 'du/ /sa bdag du mas ma thob glang po rnams/ /ma la ya yi nags su rang nyid 'ong / /rdul bral sgyu ma'i rnam thar khams las grub/ /sngags kyi rdzu 'phrul stug po'i rgyan bkod pa/ /yig drug 'phags pa'i zhing 82

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bzang nyams dga' bar/ /bzlas brjod rtsed 'jor rol nus skal ba bzang / /snying rje'i pad+ma phyin drug 'dab phreng can/ /chos dkar lang tsho rdzogs pa'i mdzes sdug gter/ /yi ge'i gzugs gyur sngags kyi me tog nang / /bsam gtan skyil krung 'cha' noms 'phags pa'i sras/ /'jigs brgya'i mtshon char 'babs pas phan bde'i srog /mthar byed lnga bdo'i g.yul chen nang 'dug kyang / /'di 'dra'i chos rdzong 'jigs med la brten te/ /nyin mtshan bde bas 'da' rnams skyid pa'i phul/ /ser sna'i las kyis mgul pa 'gags gyur cing / /rgya mtshor chu yis phongs pa'i yi dwags kyang / /gang mthus lha rdzas zas la ci bde bar/ /spyod nus sa gsum 'tsho ba'i bum bzang gcig /sna tshogs phyogs rum nas thon grangs mtha' yas/ /bar snang dkyil 'khor 'geb pa'i rdul tshub sprin/ /drag por rab 'khrugs dmar po'i gzugs can rnams/ /rlung gis bdas pas g.yul pham byer ba bzhin/ /las dang nyon mongs gtum po'i bka' lung gis/ /drag tu rbad pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad tshogs/ /thugs rje'i rig sngags gzi byin cha shas res/ /shi ro'i lhag ma'ang bltar mi mngon par 'gro/ /mgon po'i rnam thar sgrog pa'i spring yig gsar/ /mdzes sku blta ba'i mig dang gru 'dzin zhing / /bgrod pa'i rta mchog shul ring lam rgyags sogs/ /dgos 83

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'gum/nga dgu mtha' dag 'di yis byed par 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs mchog brtson rig sngags 'di zlos shing / /sngags 'di'i de nyid sgrub pa lhur blang na/ /'di gcig kho nas rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi/ /rgya mtsho brgal sbad chos kyi nying khur gsungs/ /sangs rgyas chos brtsegs sprin chen mtho las 'ongs/ /dman pa'i 'jig rten yul la lhag par 'bab/ /zhi bsil rang bzhin phan bde'i ro gcig pa//bdud rtsi'i char 'di brgya lam zhig na 'byung / /pad+ma'i mchog sogs de bzhin gshegs rnams dang / /sgrib sel la sogs rgyal sras mchog rnams kyis/ /dka' spyad du mas btsal zhing mchod mdzad pa//'di 'dra'i rin chen grangs med zhing na'ang dkon/ /de ni sna tshogs skye bo'i lag brgyud tshe/ kha cig gtsug rgyan bzhin du mgo la bkur//gzhan dag srang mdor bor ba'i rdo bzhin brnyas/ /la la tshong pa'i rdzas bzhin zong du 'tshong / /'on kyang bka' drin bzo dang log par sgrub/ /mtshungs par rjes brtse rgyas pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /gzigs shing chos mchog snying po'i skal pa'i shas/ /snyoms par sbyin mdzad de la su mi gus/ /mgon khyod tha mal gzugs kyis mdun byon nas/ /'di ltar yid bzhin nor bu'i gter kha bstan/ /gter 'di'i yon tan ji ltar rnam bsam pa/ /de ltar khyod dran phyir zhing mthong la 'dun/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 84

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'bar dri med zla ba'i zhal/ /blta nus rjes dran mig sman ma grub kyang / /bltar med rig sngags rgyal mo'i sgra dbyangs su/ /rtsen pa'i rnam 'phrul mjal la rab dga' skyes/ /ting 'dzin lus la sngags kyi sgro gshog rgyas/ /sa mchog spyod yul dag pa'i nam mkhar 'phur//mthu chen rgyal sras ngang pa'i tshogs dbus nas/ /'jig rten snying rjes blta bar nam zhig 'gyur/ /da ni zin med spun pa 'phyar ba lta 'i/ /don mang bya ba mang po rgyang bsrings te/ /dben pa'i nags rir nyin mtshan bar med du/ /yig drug rnal 'byor spyod par bdag gyur cig /zab dang rgya che'i gnad rnams kun bsdus pa'i/ /lam 'di skye ba kun tu mi brjed cing / /mang thos rgya mtshos zhib mor legs sbyangs te/ /rtse gcig sgrub pas mgon po mnyes byed shog /de tshe yig 'bru res kyang mtha' yas pa'i/ /chos sgo rnyed cing sangs rgyas grangs med mthong / /bsam yas rnam thar sgo mo rang bye ste/ /dngos grub mchog gi gnas la dbang sgyur shog /'phags pa'i don mthun zad pa'i dus ngan mthar/ /dge ba'i rgyags chad mgron po lam stor rnams/ /rnyed mang 'jug pa bde ba'i lam 'di nas/ /sangs rgyas zhabs drung nyin bzhin bgrod par shog /sgrib bral mkha' ltar yangs pa'i ye shes grub/ /sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul sprin gyis chos dbyings khyab/ /dam chos char gyis 'jig rten nyer 'tsho 86

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'gum/ba/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gtso bo'i gnas thob shog /'phags pa thugs rje chen po la yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa byang mas chas snyogs zhes bya ba bod kyi gna' mye'i lugs kyi rjes ma zin cing / da pyi'i lugs la ma dad pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba'i dā ri dras sbyar ba'o// //༄ / /rab gsal mkhyen pa'i spyan ras 'od kyis shes bya'i mkha' la gur gum lang tsho'i ri mo 'bri/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyi zla ba mthong bas lu4can mtha' dag phan bde bsil ba'i spu long g.yo/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten dkar po'i chos lam gsal por blta la spyan du gyur pa gcig pu nyid/ /grangs med zhing du spyan ras gzigs zhes yi ge'i rna rgyan g.yo ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu bezlurla mchog byi dor byas pa'i mthing kha'i phun tshogs zil gnon zhing / /sna tshogs rin chen gzi ldan rgya mtsho'i kha dog bkra ba'i dpal ni pham byed pa/ /khyod spyan ut+pal sngon po'i nags kyi lang tsho kun dga'i gter gyur bzhad pa las/ /dge legs 'bras bu'i tshogs mang shin tu rgyas ldan ston ka'i dus bzang 'ong bar shes/ /bsam gtan bde ba'i mig sman gyis sbyangs nag dkar yud tsam dmar ba'i kha dog rim pa gsum ltar rnam bkra ba/ /mtha' yas bskal pa'i 'byor rgad rgyur bcas zhib mo gzigs phyir mig 86

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rnams kun las 'jig rten shes pa'i thu bo dang / /gnyid logs sems can rjes su srung slad dus gsum mig skyo 'jig rten kun gyi mel tse byed pa zung gcig nyid/ /tshul de rig nas 'jig rten skyong rnams dregs pa'i ru mtshon rtse mo btab pa thor tshugs btud pa'i gzugs su sprul/ /sngon gyi rgyal rnams rin chen sgron me nyi zla'i gzi byin 'gog pa'i phreng bas mchod mdzad cing / /lus can phongs pa ut+pal mig gi sbyin pas bsdus sogs byang chub spyod pa gzhal mi lang / /de ltar khyod kyis 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i zhing mang 'bad pa brgya yis brten nas ni/ /bsod nams rin chen snye ma las thon srid zhi'i gzugs can snying po bsdus 'dra 'di dag brnyes/ /khyod thugs chos la mnyam par bzhag tshe 'di dag zhi ba'i lta stangs rtse gcig nyid 'gyur te/ /de tshe gang la mgon khyod gzigs pa'i spyod yul gnas de rnal 'byor pas kyang shes mi nus//snying rjes sna tshogs yul la bskyod tshe phyogs kun glog gi rtse dgas 'gengs pa bzhin byed de/ /de tshe ngan song 'gro ba rnams kyang cad kyi spyod yul rmad byung shes nas dga' bar 'gyur/ /chos dbyings mdzes ma'i rtse dga'i 'khri shing sor rtog ye shes dang ba'i gzugs kyi sgyu ma can/ /'di dag dman dang phongs pa'i yul la gzigs pa lhur len kye ma'o snying rje nus pa rdo/ /spid bde dbu ba'i 'dzum 87

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga ris mthong nas phal cher rang gi phyi ma'i rgad pa'ang brjed par 'gyur/ /dgra bcom sems la dbang thob rnams kyang zhi bde'i dbang song nye du'i gnas skabs lta ba spangs/ /'dzum zhing zhi la mchog tu mnyes gshin bzang po'i gzigs pa rjes brtse'i zil dngar spro ba bzhin/ /de la 'thung bas phyir zhing ngoms med lha brgya'i mig yangs ting 'dzin thob ste gnas pa ni/ /chu skyes nags su bung ba'i khyu tshogs ro bcud len la rtse gcig zhugs pa lta bu ste//gang phyir khyod kyi gzigs pa'i dpal ni gcig pu nyid kyis sa sa/sum 'gro 'di 'tsho bar nus/ /'jig rten mig ces grags pa gsal ldan nyin mo'i mgon po'ang lan 'ga' gza' yis long bar mthong / /rnam sad mig gi mdzes pa mtshon nus pad+ma gzhon nu'ang mtshan mo'i dbang gis gnyid log 'gyur/ /kun tu bzang po'i mig mchog grub khyod rgyud lnga'i 'gro la rnam par gzigs pa'i phrin las ni/ /skad cig char yang gzhan du mi 'gyur gang slad snying rje'i brtul zhugs nges pa'i 'bras bu lags/ /rang gi 'od zer tshon rtsi'i phreng bas nam mkha'i ngos kun zlos gar sa gzhir 'bri byas nas/ /smin ma'i rol sgeg g.yo ba dang bcas snying rje'i rtogs brjod gsal bar mtshon pa'i gar mdzad cing / /de yi rgyan byed dpe las 'das pa'i tshangs dbyangs rol mos mkhas rnams yid 88

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dbang 'dzin pa na/ /lha mang khyod las mchog don gnyer ba'i gsol 'debs glu yang zlos gar yan lag lhag ma 'dra/ /nyin mo'i dbang po shar ba nyid kyis sa steng pad+ma mtha' dag rjes su bzung ba ste/ /'dab brgya mig ni phye ba gcig pus bung ba'i don mthun tshogs la mdza' ba brjod pa nyid/ /gtso bo khyod spyan gzigs pa kho nas lus can dbugs rab 'byin pa'ang rnam pa de 'dra ste/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i chos nyid thob rnams gzhan phan las la bya dka' zhes bya 'ga' yod min/ /'gro mang rkud pa'i mtshon chas rab rmas spyod tshul bzang po'i khrag rgyun gzag nas 'gyel byed cing / /bde ba'i longs spyod gces dgu 'phrog brtson snyigs ma'i chom rkun brtse bral khro bo'i mig can rnams/ /khyod kyi ba mchob rdzi ma'i sgro ldan dkyus ring spyan mda' smin ma'i gzhu ris la sbyar nas/ / byams pa'i lta stangs 'bar bas 'phang tshe nam mkha' lding dbang mthong ba'i sprul ltaraXzhum par 'gyur/ /ring por gzigs pa'i rlung gi pho nyas rgyal dang rgyal sras lho yi tsan dan nags bskul te//de dag gzigs pa bsil ba'i spos ngad skyes su thogs nas srid pa'i mya ngam 'jug brtson phyir/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal tsha bas nyen tshe shes rab ldan rnams khyod la re bas mig gtod de/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes grags pa'i yi ge'ang kha ba'i tsan+dan lta bur bsam 89

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstad nyi'i ba gsung 'dum/nas 'dzin par byed/ /gang zhig byung na rdul snyed zhing gi nam mkha'i rmongs pa nges par 'phrogs nus shes rab mchog /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras 'khor rnams mngon dga' gsar pa'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas byed spring yig ste/ /skye dgu'i skal ngan mtshan mo zad pa'i dus dag 'ong ba nye bar ston byed skya rengs gzug/sa/ /ci tsam blta ba'i rkyal gyis bgrod kyang ngo mtshar brgal dka' khyod spyan 'od zer chu bo'i mdzod/ /brtse chen zur mig glog gi thag pas phyogs rnams bcings te nga ni 'jig rten sgrol ba'o zhes/ /'jigs med nga ro'i 'brug dbyangs snyan pa dal gyis dgod byed mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i gru char 'bebs/ /ma lus chos dbyings nam mkha'i rgyan gyur 'gro ba'i yum gcig bdud rtsi'i char sprin bzang mo ni/ /'phags ma sgrol ma'ang khyod spyan rgya mtsho thugs rjes bskul ba'i chu rlabs tshogs kyi rnam 'phrul lags/ /de ltar bstod las skye ba'i phreng bar 'phags mchog spyan ras pad+ma'i dpal gyis 'tsho bar shog /mgon po'i spyan sngar bstod tshig yid 'ong snyan ngas phreng ba bung ba'i rgyud mangs len par shog /dngos grub dga' ba shin tu mdangs legs ge sar rdul gyis yid la thig le 'bri bar shog /pad+mo'i dpe nyid rnal 'byor sbrang rtsis phyi mtha'i bar du lus can bung ba tshim byed shog /ngag gi gzhir gyur ti se'i 90

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'gram stegs nye bar bsten phyir 'dzin byed mtsho yi 'ching ldan skyong la ngal spong phyir/ /g.yo dang g.yo min glang po gzung phyir 'khyogs 'bar mig gis lus sbyangs g.yul du sprin dbyangs mthon po dgod pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i gos sngon dgra bos theg pa 'phya ba'i dpal 'dzin gad rgyangs drag po'i chu mthong snye ma gzengs ring gis/ /dpal stug rgyal ba rnam par ston cing gnas kyis 'phrog byed grags pa'i rabs la rgyas 'debs byed pa yang dag sprul/ /'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gyal gzhon nu lta bu'i spyan ras la bstod pa bung ba rol pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas bya mang gi nags tshal dga' ba can du sbyar ba rdzogs so////ra / /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang du lhar bcas 'jig rten 'di/ /'og nas 'og tu bying ba dang / chu srin 'dzin khris rab gtse zhing / /klong 'khor 'khrugs pa'i sgra khyab pa/ /mtho dman mang la 'chol bar g.yo/ /shin tu 'jigs rung gting mtha' med/ /de lta bu yi chu tshogs kyis/ /phyogs rnams mtha' dag nag por gnas/ /de yi dbus na rab mdzes pa/ /thun gsum smag gis bslad pa yi/ / mkha' la zla mdzes ci bzhin te//pad+ma(pad+ma'i rigs)dkar po'i tshal chen yod/ /de ni chu yis rgyas pa ste/ /chu yi nyes pas yong mi gos/ /91

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chu rnams dpal ni gcig pu zhes/ /grags pa'i rdzi ngad phyogs su 'gro/ /skye dgu chu bos khyer ba brgya/ /bde ba'i thang la sgrol mkhas pa'i/ /mnyan pa 'gro ba dbugs 'byin rnams/ /pad+ma'i nags mchog de las skyes/ /lhag par 'jig rten sgrol ba la/ /brtson 'grus gzugs can nyid gyur pa/ /rta mchog nyi ma'i shugs 'chang ni/ /de na thig le lta bur gyur/ /dul(ji ni ta)ba'i lus can mthu rtsal drag /'jam(byis pas kyang reg bzod pas)la gzi byin rab tu no//brtan yang yid ltar myur ba ste/ /dregs pa smad la snying stobs mtho/ /sna tshogs 'khor gyi nang dag na/ /sna tshogs 'dres pa'i spyod pa ni/ /rang gi kha dog 'dra ba yis/ /rnam pa sna tshogs don chen sgrub/ /gzhan dag ngal ba rjes bzung phyir/ /mgron po mang po'i rgyu phyogs gnas/ /bdag nyid mthu yis 'phags mthong bas/ /zhum med nga ros kunaXshes byed/ /de yi gzi brjid kyis skrag pas/ /chu gter khol ba'i sgra chen 'byin/ /rgod ma kha yi me lce yang / /ri mo'i me yi go 'phang thob/ /de ni rig dang rkang par ldan/ /sna tshogs 'gros kyi pha rol phyin/ /bde dang lang tsho dar la babs/ /bzod pa'i stobs ni rdo rje 'dra/ /sgrol ba'i dus dang dus min shes/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin dus mi 'da'/ /rnam pa de lha'i tshul gyis ni/ /sems can sgrol la dus kun gnas//gar stabs gcig gis yul kun gnon/ /92

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1 'od zer gcig gis phyogs rnams skul/ /gcig pus sa dang nam mkha' dang / /sa 'og 'jig rten yang dag khyab/ /rdzogs ldan sprin ltar mtho ba'i lus/ /steng phyogs nam mkha' rgyas par 'gebs/ /sa steng kun na gdugs gcig pa'i/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal bzhin mdzes/ /dbyangs de snyan la rgyun chags sgrog/gsal zhing zab la ma brtabs pa/ /bsgyur na bde zhing ring du 'gro//sgra mang nang na dpe yis dbul/ /skye dgu nun rum 'khyams pa rnams/ /gang thos dran pa rnyed byed pa'i/ /glu yi mtshan ma legs bzung nas//pad+mo snang ba'i dga' tshal 'jug /gcig pur rgyu zhing 'tshe ba mang /shul thag ring ba'i lus can la/ /'jigs med gnas su ngas 'khyer zhes/ /snying rje mngon sum bzhin du sgrog /srin mo glu yi mchil pa can/ /rgya mtsho'i don mthun za ba'i tshogs/ /sa gsum mngal rgya 'jig byed pa'i/ /'tsher skad kyis ni brgyal zhing gnon/ /nyams brgya'i gar ni rnam rtsen pas//ri gling rgya mtsho bcas pa skyod//bdud rnams rgyal srid gnas las lhung / /dmyal ba sprugs shing steng du 'phen/ /skyed tshal pad+ma rab dga' zhing / /bung ba'i dus ston 'phel ba rtsom/ /ji snyed sa steng pad+mo yi/ /sa bon tshogs ni dbugs 'byin byed/ /snying rjes yid ni ches gdung yang / /mchog tu dba' ba'i gzugs kyis rgyu//'jig rten glu gar gyis sdud kyang //93

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shin tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin/ /lha dang lha min dbang po'i g.yul/ /dpung tshogs srod mun bzhin gtibs pa/ /chu gter sa dang nam mkha' la/ /thogs med drag shul spyod pa rnams/ /sdug phongs rgyab tu bzung ba yi/ /rta mchog rgyal po nyer 'ong che/ /seng ge'i sgra thos glang po bzhin/ /ci la'ang ltos med ring du 'byer//de yi rmig pa skal bzang ldan/ /lam gyi nyes kun sel ba ste/ /gang gang dag nas de 'gro ba/ /de de phun tshogs rnyed pa'i sgo/ /dman rnams dbul ba 'dor byed cing / /che rnams rgyal ba 'thob pa'i gzhi/ /dgra sde dregs pa'i myos chu skrugs/ /kun gyi phun tshogs kho na'i rgyu/ /spyod yul mthun pa'i lha chen rnams/ /dka' spyad brgya yis mthong bar dka'/ /'di ni spyod yul ches bskal yang / /dran pa nyid kyis rjes 'dzin byed/ /g.yog pas chod dang gshed mas bkag/bgrod dka'i lam la zhugs rnams kyang / /'di ni skad cig rjes dran na/ /sgrol ba'i don slad mdun na gnas/ /dmyal ba'i sa gzhir rmig rjes kyi/ /me tog phreng ba yid 'ong byin/ /de na las kyis nyer brtsegs pa'i/ /rgud pa'i gos ni stug po phrog /btson chud re re'i don phyir yang / /khri nun rnams su lam chen btod/ /goms stabs gcig kyang grangs med pa'i/ /btson rnams thar pa'i 'bras bur bcas/ /grags pa dri med rab yangs pas/ /phyogs kyi tshad ni nyin 94

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bzhin mjal/ /de yis gzhal ba'i khong chud pa/ /ma lus snying rje'i rgya yis thebs/ /mchog gi gnas la dbang sgyur zhing / /dman pa'i yul la skyo ba spangs/ /ci la'ang rang nyid mi gnas te/ /sems can dbang bzhin 'jug pa nyid/ /skad cig skad cig zab mo dang / /gsal ba'i yul na mngon sum slebs/ /gar yang sgrim med ring 'gro ba/ /dbang 'byor rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i mthu/ /snying rje'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ /rin chen snying po 'di 'dra byung / /gang mthus ltas kyang ma thob pa'i/ /sems kyi rgyal srid bla med ster/ /sa steng snying rje ldan mang yang / /gang zhig mthong ba tsam nyid kyis/ /'jigs sgrol shugs ni myur rtogs phyir/ /sngags kyi ye shes de ltar sprul/ /'jig rten mthon po'i gnas la dga'/ /de lta'ang thur nas thur du gzhol/ /rang nyid bzlog ste 'gro bar dka'/ /tshul 'dis phongs pa mi bzad ldan/ /de slad sa mthor bkri ba yi/ /myur bde'i theg pa rin chen 'di/ /gzhan phan la dga' che rnams kyis/ /bsngags 'os mtshungs med ci ste min/ /rta zhon phyug po mang mchis kyang / /de 'dra yod pa 'ga' ma mthong / /'di lhar gtam du smra nus pa'ang / /rgyus shes rnams kyis bsnyad las byung / /sems can sgrol ba'i don slad du/ /rta mchog rgyal po legs bsngags pa'i/ /bsod nams de yis skye ba kun/ /bla med theg pas 'gro bar shog / 95

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga 'phags pa rta mgrin la thun mong gi rnam thar dang mthun par cha tsam bstod pa kun dga'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyims chu glang dbo zla'i dga' ba gsum pa la gus pas 'bad de bris pa gru 'dzin chos kyi mdun sar yan lag brgya pa'i sil snyan gyi sprin du 'byung bar gyur cig gu// //nga / /phun tshogs chos dbyings sgeg mo'i bzhin la so sor rtog pa'i ye shes spyan/ /rol pas dga' ldan 'jig rten gsum na snying rje'i gdugs dkar gcig 'dzin pa/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes grags pa'i ba dan phyogs kyi pho nyas bsgreng ba gang / /'ur 'ur gnas su gzugs brnyan zol gyis gzhan phan bdud rtsi spro la 'dud/ /khyod zhal mthong ba gcig pu yis/ /lus can dge ba rab rgyas byed/ /pad+ma dga' ba'i mig 'byed pa/ /nyin byed mthong ba gcig pos nus/ /bskal pa snyigs ma'i chu gter zab yangs sdug bsngal klong 'khor 'khrugs pa'i dbus/ /'gal me'i 'khor lo'i spun zlar rab g.yo lus can nyam thag brgya stong snyed/ /snyan grags thag pas ring nas nyer drangs zla zhal mthong bas mngon bskyed pa'i/ /dang sems dge ba'i zam pa la 'dzegs bde bar dbugs 'byin mdzad la 'dud/ /mtshan mo'i myos chu btung ba'i nam mkha' ni/ /bdud rtsi'i thig le gcig pus mgon dang bcas/ /96

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1snyogs brgya'i khur gyis ngal ba'i yul ljongs 'di/ /skal bzang bgyid pa'i mgon ni khyod gcig lags/ /de slad sa phyogs rdo rjer rab sgrub pad+ma'i zhabs zung brtan par bzhugs/ /phyogs rnams mtha' dag 'dzum zhal 'od kyis dkar por mdzod cig rgyal ba'i tshogs/ /rdo rje thal mo'i phyag rgyas nyer bskul phan bde'i rgyun bzang mi zad stsol/ /bdag kyang zla bas ku nu ta bzhin byin rlabs snang bas rjes 'dzin mdzod//phyogs 'di sdug bsngal chu yis khebs//gdul bya'i me tog rab tu mang / /brtse chen ngang pa'i rgyal po khyod/ /'di la gzigs shing brtan par bzhugs/ /khyod kyi smon lam rnga sgra gsal pos sbyin skyes rgyal mtshan bsnyil bar shog /'jig rten rmongs pa gnyid sad gyur cig dge ba'i dus ston cher rgyas shog /skye dgu yig drug rgyud mangs len gyur kun dga'i glu gar mang bar shog /gru 'dzin 'jig rten lam po cher gyur rgyal sras dkyil 'khor 'phel bar shog /dar dkar sprin mdzes byu ru'i glog dmar g.yo/ /zhu phrin dbyar rnga'i sgra yis brgyan pa 'dis/ /rjeXbatsun ti se'i ri dbang khyod mchod pas/ /phan bde'i chu bo rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /rdo stod kyi sa'i cha dpal brtsegs bde 'byung gi ri bo'i ngos nas/ 'phags mchog gang gi bka' drin kho na la re ltos 'cha' ba'i 'bangs kyi tha shal tsam du gtogs pa 'jigs med bstan 97

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i nyi mas phul ba dge/ //ba / /phun tshogs skye dgu'i legs byas ri bo'i zur phud rtse na mdzes pa'i tog /ston ka'i zla gzhon gang ba'i gzugs can pad+mo rgyas pa'i zhal mnga' ba/ /phan bde'i bdud rtsi zad med 'jo ba'i grags pa dkar po'i bsil 'od can/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sa gsum 'gro ba'i yid bzhin nor gcig khyod la 'dud/ /snying gi gdungs ba rnam par 'phrog nus dpag dka'i mdzes sdug chu yi tshogs kyis dkrigs gyur pa/ /ngo mtshar rlabs phreng 'khrugs pa'i chil sgras phyogs rnams 'geng bzhin dul ba'i dpal las mi g.yo ba'i/ /khyod sku yid bzhin rgya mtsho che la gang zhig dad sems ngur ba'i rkang pa 'god byed pa/ /de dab sa gsum 'jig rten nang na phul byung dga' ba'i khyad par dag gis rtsen par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'dzin ma'i gzhi la dam pa'i spyod tshul 'char ka'i 'od kyi mdangs ltar bzang ba byung dgu dang / /rlabs chen phan bde'i snang ba li khri'i mdog bzhin gsal bas srid 'di'i kha dog sgyur ba gang byung ba/ /de kun khyod mtshan yi ge seng ge'i spar mos bdud kyi glang chen mgo bo brdzis pa las byung khrag /phyogs kyi nags tshal phreng ba'i ral pa la chags skye bo'i mig sngar dga' ston dpal du gyur pa lags/ /khyod kyi 'od zer rab dkar dri med gting mtha' 98

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus pod 1 bral ba'i nang dag na/ /dga' bcas lha rnams 'o ma'i rgya mtshor rkyal gyis rtsen pa'i byis pa bzhin/ /klu rnams zla zer rtse gcig 'thung ba'i ku mu ta bzhin tshim gyur cing / /yi dwags tshogs kyang pad dkaྈ tshal du bung ba'i bkres skom zhi 'drar shes/ /gang bi nus mthus bdud kyi me tog mda' lnga'ang ri mo'i mtshon cha lta bur nyams byed cing / /thabs mkhas 'phrul kyis yi dwags phongs pa brgya snyed sum rtsen rgyal thabs mtho la 'god par mdzad/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis mnar med dmyal ba'i nang du'ang bsil bde sbyin slad dgyes bzhin 'jug brtson pa/ /khyod kyis 'jig rten gsum 'dir rgyal srid mdzod cig khyod 'dra mgon du thob rnams skal ba bzang / /rmongs pa'i nun nag shin tu cher gtibs 'jigs rung 'khor ba mtshan mo'i 'brog /'gro ba ngan pa'i g.yang sa zab ring sdig pa'i chom rkun brgyas gang bar/ /gom tshugs 'khyor bas shin tu ngal gyur ldab ldib smre ba'i lus can 'di/ /thugs rje'i nyin byed shes rab 'od mdzad khyod cig shar nas dbugs rab byung / /mthon mthing nor bu'i thor cog rtse mor 'od dpag med kyi snang ba rab mdzes gur gum phye ma chags pa bzhin/ /yid 'phrogs gzugs can 'od zer pho nya ring por rgyu ba'i tshogs la phyogs rnams 'dzum mdangs gsal bar ston pa bzhin/ /pad+mo 99

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/mchog ltar dag pa'i zhabs zung lha brgya'i gnag snum ral pa'i spo la 'khor lo'i ri mo dgod pa bzhin/ /su zhig khyod kyi mtshar sdug tshon la yid kyi ras bzang lan re bcug pa'ang byang chub dam pa'i mdog tu 'gyur/ /mtho ris gtso bo'i cod pan nyer btud rkang la lan brgyar phyag bgyis pa yi go 'phang rnyed par dka' min gyi/ /rdul bral khyod kyi gtsang ma'i zhabs zung mgo bo'i ze'u 'brur lan gcig reg pa'ang 'jig rten gsum na dkon pa'i phul/ /lha brgya'i zur phud gding bar bstabs pa'i 'dod khams dbang phyug lan mang ma byas su zhig yod de phyir yang lhung / /khyod kyi zhabs sen pad+ma'i dpal gyis ral ba bgos rnams nom grol bde ba'i khri 'phang mtho la rang nyid 'dzegs/ /gshin rje khros pa'i bzhin ras rab 'khrugs chu dwangs nor bus reg pa'i chab ltar dwangs byed cing / /drag po'i g.yul chen bsres pa'i mda' char ma sto ra yi me tog bla brer rab sgrub byed/ /sprul chen khro bo'i kha rlangs mi bzad sim byed bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'dzag pa'i sprin byed de/ /de ltar ma lus gdug pa'i dug non khyod kyi 'dzum zhal zhi ba'i zla ba gcig pus 'phrog /'khrud do dbyar skyes char gyis sa gzhi'i rnyogs pa dang / /ston ka'i dus kyi brtson pas chu mthong dri ma ste/ /khyod kyi 'od zer zla ba bzhu 'dra'i rgyun rnams kyis/ /'gro ba'i lus sems 100

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1sdug bsngal drag po'i yams nad do/ /bsod nams mang po'i dpung pa dang ldan mi rnams gang dag bgegs dang rgyal po'i chad pa sogs/ /'jigs dang phongs pa'i gnas skabs brgya las thar bar mdzad pas mthu chen khyod la bsngags mi 'gyur/ /stobs ldan sdig las kho nas rab bsgrubs bar mtshams med par dmyal mes 'tshod pa'i lus can yang / /mtsho chu kha ba'i reg pa can la chu yi me tog 'thog pa'i rtse dga' sbyin min nam/ /'jig rten phal cher rang gi phyir yang tshe 'di'i bde ba nyi tshes chog par 'dzin/ /khyod ni gzhan phyir bla med bde ba ma bstsal de srid brtson 'grus 'dor mi mdzad/ /skye dgu 'di dag 'jig rten gzhan gyi bde ba btsong nas 'tsho thabs sgrub par sems/ /khyod kyis de dag bde bas bde ba 'thob pa'i thabs tshul du mas sman yon btags/ /khyod ni 'og min lha brgya'i bla ma lags te dmyal ba'i gnas na'ang byis pa'i rol pas rtag tu 'jug /rnam 'dren tshe dpag med kyi rgyal tshab mdzad kyang mi mjed zhing du sna tshogs gzugs kyis cho 'phrul ston/ /spros pa mtha' dag zhi ba'i dbyings la bzhugs shing spros pa'i mig 'phrul mtha' dbus bral bas 'gro ba 'dul/ /de ltar khyod kyi spyod yul bsam mi khyab kyang bsam bya lags te skad cig dran na'ang don cher mchis/ /byis pas me tog ji ltar rnyed bzhin 'thu yi go 101

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rim dag la rtog mi byed/ /de ni mchod rten spyan sngar 'thor na'ang 'chol ba nyid du rang dgar 'bab par zad/ /nyin par gnyid kyi dgra bos gtse bzhin rim pa 'chol ba'i kun rtog phreng ba spel/ de ni yi ger bris na'ang go rim nges pa brtag tu yong min 'di ltar byung / /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa cha le cho le zhes bya ba dbyig 'dzin bu mo dbyar gyi lang pa'i thog ma la babs dus khu byug dang 'jol mo gnyis la ram 'degs bcol nas brtsams pa rdzogs so////10 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1༄/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gis cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i brjed tho chu stod zla ba'i dga' ston/mtha' bral stong pa'i mkha' dbyings mthon po'i nang / /byang chub spyod pa'i 'phrul 'degs rlabs po ches/ /mngon 'phags sgyu ma lta bu'i rten 'byung gi/ /rol rtsed kun nas ma bsgribs thal le ba/ /sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin yul la mnga' brnyes pas/ /rgya chen chos dbyings dkyil 'khor ma lus khron/ /rnam thar rgya mtsho'i mdzod dang snyan grags rgyan/ /lhan cig brdal bas brgyan pa snying rje'i gter/ /rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i dge mtshan bkra ba'i zhabs/ /'od kyis bde ba can gyi zhing khams kun/ /dus gcig rgyas par g.yogs bzhin sar gnas kyi/ /rgyal sras bye ba'i mgo bo dpal ldan mdzad/ /dro rer nu mtha' med pa'i phyogs kun nas/ /byang sems rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis rtse ba rnams/ /cod pan nor bu'i 'od zer 'thab pa yang / /mthong bas lhar bcas 'jig rten mig 'khrugs shing //nam mkha'i yangs khyad mi mngon bzhin bgyis nas//khyod zhal pad+ma'i rī kha blta ba'i slad/ /bzhud pa'i gnas tshod yul 103

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyis ches bskal yang / /grags pa'i rnga sgra mi mjed zhing 'dir slebs/ /de ni rje btsun khyod las dgung bdun du/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i btung ba la 'thungaXn/ /zab mo sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /rgyal thabs rnyed pa'i chos nyid thos nas lags/ /rab 'byams zhing na rgyal dang de sras rnams/ /rgya chen 'khor gyi dbus su khyod kyi gtam/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis brjod la rtag dgyes pa/ /sgyu ma'i rnam thar zla med 'di yi mthu/ /rlabs chen bsod nams ye shes shugs 'chang ba'i/ /rgyal sras grags chen rnams kyang khyod sku 'i zla/ /shar bas theg mchog chos kyi ut+pal tshal/ /dpe zla med par rgyas pa'i ya mtshan gyis/ /thugs drangs gyur nas stobs bcu mnga' ba la/ /byang sems skul ba'i cho 'phrul mdzad slad du/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab ste mi 'dzum pa'i/ /pad+ma'i mig bzang nub tu btod par gyur/ /de tshe shākya'i mgon po'i mdzod spu nas//ga/ser zhun bzhus pa'i rgyun 'dra 'od kyi sprin/ /gzi 'bar lta na sdug pa'i kha dog gis/ /mthu chen nyi zla'i 'od kyang zil gnon cing / /bye ba brgya stong zhing gi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /g.yo bas ngo mtshar mdzad bzhin thal byung ste/ /'od zer dpag med kyis mtshan bde ldan zhing / /ma lus lag mthil rdzas bzhin sa ler mdzad/ /mgon khyod bde ba can nas gang gi tshe/ /drang srong lhung ba'i nags su byang 101

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ ngo da 1sems kyi//ting 'dzin rin po che yi sgrom dbye phyir/ /rgyal sras bye ba brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / /lhan cig snying rje'i shing rtas bskyod pa na//rang gi bskal mang dge ba'i gzi brjid dang / /mkha' ltar yangs pa'i smon lam mthu ston phyir/ /kun tu bzang po'i 'byor ba 'di ltar brdal/ /dag pa'i 'khor rer bye ba brgyad cu bzhi'i/ /grangs snyed khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin byung ste/ /kun kyang ka ba bzhi zug gru bzhi lham/ /cha mnyam legs par phye zhing zin byas pa/ /rgya dang 'phang du dpag tshad brgyad dang ni/ /bcu gnyis tshad can sna tshogs rin chen dang / /sbos mchog me tog mchog tshogs las bgyis pa'i/ /mi 'dra'i khyad par dbyar gyi phun tshogs bzhin/ /shis pa'i me ltar dag cing dwangs pa'i gzugs/ /kha dog brgya yi mdangs bkra 'od rab gsal/ /dpag tshad bzhi stong lhag pa'i brgyad khri'i khyon/ /khang brtsegs re re'i 'od kyis gzi ldan byed/ /de dag re rer 'chi med na chung mchog /dpag bsam lcugs ma'i lag can sil snyan dang / /me tog spos kyi phur ma'i sprin 'gyed pa/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong rol pa'i mgrin glus khyab/ /mtshan dpe'i cha rer bsod nams brgya pa'i dpal/ /rnam dag me long gzugs ltar gsal rdzogs ba'i/ /rgyal ba bkod pa chen po'i seng khri la/ /bzhugs pa'i rnam 'phrul khang brtsegs gcig bzhin bstan/ /myu 105

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan tsho gsung 'bum/tig phreng mdzes dril g.yer drwa ba dang / /lha rdzas spos kyi phur ma yid 'ong dang / /'od 'bar dbyibs legs gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyi/ /bkod pa rgya mtshos chu sprin che ltar dkrigs/ /dri za mkhas pas yan lag bye ba phrag /'bum ldan lha yi rol mo blang ba lta'i/ /dbyangs snyan sgrog pa'i dril g.yer de dag gis/ /rang gi khang brtsegs snyan ngag mkhan bzhin byed/ /mdangs snum lo ma me tog cher phyugs shing / /sngo bsil grib ma stug ldan rin ched shing / /brgyad khri bzhi stong tshang bas khang brtsegs rer/ /ngal med mdzes pa skyed pa'i bsnyen bkur stobs/ /gser mchog bye ma mnyam brdal rin chen gyi/ /kha khyer sdug gus mtha' bskor me tog dang / /ngur pa pyos pa'i sgras khyab lha chu'i rdzing / /mtshar sdug dpal gyi thig ler 'khyil bas brgyan/ /'khor gnas phun tshogs de 'dra de dag kun/ /khang brtsegs re re'i rgyan du byin brlabs pa/ /de ltar gzhal med yon tan phreng ba'i gter/ /bye ba brgyad cu rtsa bzhi phrag re yis/ /khyod dang khyod kyi rgyal tshab mthu chen thob/ /bskor cing mdun du bdar bas brjid 'bar zhing / /'khor gyi gzi byin mi zad rjes 'brangs pas/ /mig 'dzum tsam la de nas mi snang gyur/ /skad cig de la mi mjid zhing khams 'di/ /rked med lag mthil ngos bzhin rab mnyam zhing / /seng ge'i rnam bar rtse ba de dag 106

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1kyang / /stong gsum 'jig rten glal ba lta bur sad/ /de nas shākya'i gtso la mgrin gcig tu/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin las brtsams te/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi'i shing chen las/ /brul ba'i bstod dbyangs me tog char ba phab/ /de tshe phyogs bcu'i phyogs cha re re bzhin/ /ga blo'i bye ma'i grangs snyed 'jig rten na/ /khrod kyi rnam 'phrul sgyu ma'i drwa ba 'di/ /chad lhag med par zhing khams re bzhin du/ /cig char 'jug pa'i spyod yul ches phra ba/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs bdud rtsis legs sbyangs pa'i/ /mig ldan mthong ba'i yul du thob gyur nas/ /'gro mang byang chub sems kyi myu gu tshugs/ /'on kyang dpa' bo khrod kyis 'jig rten khams/ /brgya phrag stong gi rdul las ches mang ba'i/ /bskal pa bgrang ba'i ya mthar de bzhin gshegs/ /gser 'od seṅge rnam rol spyan snga ru/ /shes rab zab mo'i rtsal dang sems bskyed kyi/ /seṅge'i sgra dang mthu yi khyad par kyis/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten mtha' dag zil mnan te/ /de yi sngar yang ga blo'i bye ma bas/ /rab mang sangs rgyas zhing la bsnyen bkur bar/ /dpal stug bden pa'i gsung gis rjes bsngags na/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong pa'i mtsho/ /brgal ba'i yul 'dir ngo mtshar gsar pa ci/ /khyod kyi gshegs bzhud byung ba gang bsnyad dang / /khyod kyi skyes rabs phreng ba ci smra ba/ /de kun sgyu ma lta bu'i 107

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma ting 'dzin gyi/ /chos nyid brjod pa'i sgo dang yongs sbyong dang / /dang po'i rgyu tshogs bsnyad las ma 'das phyir/ /thub pas khyod kyi rtogs brjod gang gsungs pa/ /de ni theg mchog lung gi snying po ru/ /gzung bar bya yi dkyus las 'phros tsam min/ /de ltar khyod kyi snying rje'i rtsa ba dang / /brtson pa'i sdong po sbyong ba'i yal 'dab dang / /ting 'dzin me tog shes rab 'bras bur bcas/ /ci dang ci nas rgya yongs ma chad cing / /bsam gyis mi khyab mnga' thang bsags bsags pas/ /khyod kyi zhing dang 'khor dang sku tshe dang / /mdzad phrin mthu yi khyad par ji snyed pa/ /ma 'dres chos nyid bsam mi khyab pa lags/ /gang gi 'byor pa bsam kyang bskal mang du/ /pha mtha' mi rdzogs bde ba'i rgyan ldan pa/ /bde ba can gyi yon tan bkod pas kyang / /skra rtse'i zil bas phyogs mtha'i chu gter bzhin//bser 'od rgyal po'i zhing la chog min te/ /de ltar rnam dag gser 'od mgon po yi/ /zhing khams yon tan rin chen bsags pa yi/ /dpal de'i 'bum gyi char yang bskrun med pa'i/ /zhing gi 'byor pa mchog dang rgyal sras 'khor/ /til gyi bong bu bltams 'drar rtag gnas phyir/ /rin chen kun bsags grags pa don ldan pa/ /khyod kyi sangs rgyas zhing ste dper brjod tsam/ /dbyar gyi dga' ba dang 'grogs yid kyi rdzing / /dang ba'i rlabs kyis dkrugs las nyer 08

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'ong ba/ /tshig phreng rab dkar dbu ba'i 'dzum ris 'dis/ /blo dang brtse ba'i rtse dga' 'phel bar shog /'jig rten dbang phyug gi cho 'phrul chen po'i brjed tho dbyar gyi dga' ston 'di rdo rong gi spyon pa bstan pa'i nyi mas chu stod zla ba'i tshes bdun gyi phyi dro gang dran myur du bris pa thugs rje'i bdag po'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho ba'i rgyur gyur cig /'di sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo la brten pa yin/ phal chen dang pad dkar na 'phags pa 'di'i cho 'phrul bshad bas mang yang bri ma thub pas der ltos// //—109

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma / /rje btsun ar+ya tā re la bstod pa/na mo gu ru ar+ya tā ra ye/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi zhal skyin dngos/ /srid zhi'i legs tshogs mtha' dag 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs sen me tog phreng / /bdag gi mgo la rtag tu gnas gyur cig /thun mong mkhas btsun dam pa'i rnam thar gter/ /thun min sras bcas rgyal ba'i gsang ba 'dzin/ /mthar thug rdo rje bzhi yi rgyal thabs can/ /bla ma sangs rgyas de la slar yang 'dud/ /gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i ston pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus spro dang bsdu ba'i bdag /dngos grub kun byed rigs brgya'i khyab bdag che/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma rgyal gyur cig /de yi dmigs med snying rje'i rin chen rdul/ /yid 'phrog na chung sgyu ma'i skrur bsags te/ /'gro la mi 'jigs bde ba'i mchog sbyin pa/ /sgrol ma yum khyod bdag la rjes brtser mdzod/ /sgrib bral chos dbyings yangs pa'i mkha' la shar/ /zag med yon tan dkar po'i cha shas rdzogs/ phul byung snying rje'i bsil 'od phyogs bcur 'phro/ /sgrol mdzad 'phags ma'i zla ba bdag la dbongs/ /110

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1khyod ni bde ldan zhing gi thig le ste/ /'og min chos kyi khang bzang mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /ma dag zhing du 'gro ba'i ma gcig mo/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jig rten sgrol ba'i snying stobs che/ /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rgyal sras gtso mor grags/ /rgyal sras 'khor gyis rgyal ba'i yum du bkur/ /sangs rgyas chos la rgyal ba nyid bzhin dbang / /sems can khams la rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzad/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mgul pa'i rgyan ltar blangs/ /bdag gi bde ba dga' ston rdzas bzhin bkye/ /de mthus rang nyid go 'phang mthon por byon/ /go 'phang de yang 'gro ba'i don du bsngos/ /pha mtha' yas pa'i sems can sgrol ba dang / /ma lus rgyal ba'i phrin las kun sgrub par/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog gcig pu'i rtsal sbyong phyir/ /chos kyi dbyings na nyag gcig dpa' ba lags/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /byang chub chos kun bsdus pa'i ye shes lus/ /'phags bzhi'i 'byung gnas sher phyin dge ma ste/ /rin chen gsum bdag khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /tshangs pas cod pan rtse mos zhabs rdul blangs/ /'dod lhas bdag nyid dman par ring du smre/ /sa gsum kun tu rgyal ba'i sgra grags pa/ /rgyal yum gtso mos rgyal bstan rgyal bar mdzod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mgon med 'gro ba'i phyir/ /bshum tshe de dag nga yis bur bskyang zhes/ /khyod kyis bden gsung gzhan 111

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du mi 'gyur bas/ /lnga bdo'i 'gro la bden pa mngon du ston/ /chos dbyings zab mo'i rgya mtsho rab snang mdzad/ /rgya chen shes bya'i nam mkha' 'od kyis 'gengs/ /'jig rten gsum na mtshungs med 'od byed pa/ /yum khyod lnga bdo'i smag la snang ba spros/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su ye shes rgyal srid brnyes/ /srid pa kun tu snying rje'i bka' lung bsgyur/ /'khor 'das ro mnyam rtogs pa'i dbang che ba/ /srid zhi'i dbang mos srid pa'i 'gro ba skyobs/ /zhi yang bdud sde sreg la shin tu rdo/ /'bar yang mi bzad nang gi gdung ba 'phrob /gang yang phan bde kho na'i mdzad pa can/ /gdul dka'i 'gro la thabs kyi rnam 'phrul mdzod//pad+ma'i chos gter la dbang rig 'dzin rnams/ /brtul zhugs nyi ma brgya ba'i zer rnon gyis/ /nag phyogs nun pa ma lus drungs phyung ste/ /bzhed don pad tshal rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag kyang khyod kyi ting 'dzin bde rum du/ /yon tan lus zungs rnam par rgyas byas nas/ /ring por mi thogs stobs bcu'i rtsal rdzogs te/ /lus can sdug bsngal mtsho las sgrol bar shog /bla ma rje btsun sgrol ma la bstod cing bsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mchog gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas chu byi dbyug zla'i nyer lnga la bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ //1 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga / /na ma ar+ya tā re/ /sgrol ma'i phyag mthil pad+mo'i ge sar rgyan/ /stong phrag nyi mas mi mtshon 'od kyi gter/ /gsal rdzogs rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i re pho yis/ /log 'dren dga' ba'i rgyal mtshan bsnyil gyur cig /ri dwags nags su yibs kyang rngon pa ldang / /nyam chung tha mal gnas kyang bgegs kyis 'tshe/ /kye ma rdo rje rnon po ut+pa la'i/ /ral gri'i 'dab phreng g.yo ba'i dus la babs/ /phyogs 'dir rtag tu gnas dang glo bur lhags//bdag dang 'khor la gdug sems rnyi 'dzugs shing / /gnod 'che'i zhags pa gdengs pa'i bgegs rigs rnams/ /bsad bskrad rmongs rengs sbyor bas tshar gcod mdzod/ /zhal gyi mkha' la khro gnyer glog 'gyu zhing / /phyag zhabs brdab pa'i sprin sgra mi bzad pas/ /sa gsum grum pa'i mngon spyod thog mda' yis/ /nag phyogs rgol ba'i brag ri cham la phobs/ /rgyal bsen klu gdon khro bo'i na bun bri/ /gdug rtsub nus mthu'i rtsal shugs brim pa rnams/ /'phags ma'i gsang gsum nyin byed 'od rnon gyis/ /chu zad lbu ba'i tshogs ltar snyil gyur cig /sna tshogs las kyi sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor dang / / smon log dmod pa'i dbal non bzod dka'i tshogs/ /dmigs med snying rje khros pa'i sdig mdzub kyis/ /bsdigs nas thal ba'i lhag mar mdzad gyur cig /rten 'byung 'khrul pa'i 'drer sna nga rdzun po ches/ /113

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'jigs zhum rtog pa'i cho 'phrul cher slong tshe/ /mtshon chen phaṭa kyi de nyid ral gri yis/ /spros bral dbyings su chod cig rje btsun ma/ /'gyur rtsis thebs na lcags kyang dag pa'i gser/ /sngags kyis bsgyur na dug kyang bdud rtsi mchog /de ltar rdul bral 'phags ma'i ye shes dbyings/ /log 'dren mtshan ma'i dngos kun ro gcig mdzod/ /bdag cag blo rtsing rmongs ba'i mun rum nang / /sna tshogs bag med spyod pa'i rdo 'phangs pa/ /sa bdag lha klu'i thugs la phog srid na/ /'phags ma'i byams chen sman gyis sos gyur cig /mdor na deng nas srid pa'i rgyud kun tu/ /yum gcig skyabs sbyin phyag rgya'i srung gur 'og /mchog sbyin yongs 'du'i 'byor bas nyer 'tsho zhing / /rgyal bstan srung la mthu dang ldan par shog/ //ra / /na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye/ /bang gi 'gyur med ye shes bden gnyis zhal/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgrol ba'i phrin las stobs/ /gcig bsdus bde chen dbang mo'i skur snang ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i me tog ni/ /phrin las 'dab brgya ldan pa'i sngags kyi gzugs/ /skyob pa 'jig rten dbang po'i spyan chab las/ /ston dus pad+ma'i dpal ltar bzhad cing 'khrungs/ /de ni sangs rgyas zhing mang rgya mtsho na/ /sgrol ma zhes byar grags pa'i dri bsung bcas/ /mkhas pa'i bung ba 114

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dga' skyed dngos grub kyi/ /sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas gcig pur rgyal rnams gsungs/ /mdzes sdug phung po de la ye shes kyi/ /snying po grangs med sprul pa'i sa bon mdzod/ /shes rab phar phyin zhib mo'i rdul 'dus pa/ /ting 'dzin gong bu gcig tu gyur pa yod/ /de las skad cig rer yang sngags pa yi/ /dngos grub don byed bum pa bzang po lta'i/ /dud med sgyu 'phrul ri rab rdul phran snyed/ /rnam par snang mdzad zhing gi rgyan du 'byung / /re zhig cig na rmongs pa 'dus pa yi/ /nun pa'i gling 'dir dam chos 'od mdzad phyir/ /tong kun rgyal po'i khab tu lha cig ni/ /chu yi pad+ma zhes bya'i nom 'phrul bstan/ /de yi thabs mkhas spyod pa'i shing rta ches/ /shākya'i rgyal po sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi/ /zol la brten nas mngon sum spyan drangs te/ /bsil ljongs mtha' dag 'od kyis snang bar mdzad/ /slar yang gsang chen theg pa'i rtse dga' yis/ /bod khams rig 'dzin zhing du bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /g.yo ru sbrags mdar mkhar chen rgyal rigs su/ /skye ba'i myu gu lang tshos dud pa bzung / /'jig rten sgrol ma byon pa legs so zhes/ /sa yi lha mos mchod yon stob pa bzhin/ /yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i mtsho byung bas/ /mtsho rgyal zhes grags snyan pa'i ba dan mtho/ /rin chen gter kha lha mig ldan pas rnyed/ /lha rdzas longs spyod lha yul ba las 'byung / /ut+pal 116

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstanas nyi'i gsung 'bum/—mig yangs mchog de'ang khri srong rjes/ /'jam dbyangs phyag na ut+pa la bzhin brnyes/ /de mthus rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang rnams//rgya mtsho chus gang bzhin du rgyas gyur cing / /bod 'bangs mtha' dag rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /bde chen snying rje'i mnga' ris gcig pur gyur/ /rjes rgyal btsan pos bla ma bde ba che/ /phul byung 'byor pa rgya mtshos bsnyen bkur tshe/ /phyogs 'dir jeg mchog rgyas pa'i rten 'byung slad/ /'di yang bla med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bsngags 'os rigs kyi tshangs pa'i ral pa brgyud/ /khri srong ma dros mtsho la g.yas su bskor/ /gsung mchog pad+ma'i rgya mtshor gcig tu 'dres/ /ga lha'i dpal mo gnyis par mtshon min nam/ /pad+ma'i rigs yum zhi khro dbyer med kyang / /thun mong ngor byas ti sgro brag sogs su/ /rdo rje phag mo'i dbang dang rim gnyis la/ /sbyangs pas dngos grub rgya mtsho'i pha rol gshegs/ /de nas rta phag bde ba'i me chen gyis/ /brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten gser bsregs bzhin du sbyangs/ /sa kun rdo rje'i gnas kyi dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma tshogs spyod pa'i zhing du bsgyur/ /mi dang mi min 'gro ba'i tshogs mang rnams/ /te ru ka dpal rigs su smin mdzad cing / /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed gdug pa rnams/ /rnam thar sgo gsum dbyings su phur bus btab/ /snga phyi'i gdul bya sna tshogs la brtse 1 6

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma bas/ /mtsho skyes spyan sngar rgyud lung man ngag gi/ /chos tshul mtha' yas bshad par gsol btab cing/ /nyan bshad dri zhus bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad/ /khyad par ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /chos nor dam rdzas gter kha dpag med sbas/ /mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs la gnyer byang gtad/ /bstan zhabs gter gyis skyong ba'i smon lam btab/ /skad cig bskal bar mnyam pa'i dbang 'byor mthus/ /'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya'i bod dang ni/ /de snyed bod chen rnams su'ang tshul 'di yis/ /bsam gyis mi khyab phrin las mnyam du mdzad/ /ljongs 'di bka' drin chen pos rjes bskyangs nas/ /blo dman skye bos brnyas pa speng phyir dang / /skal ldan mi rnams mthong la 'dun phyir dang / /rjes 'jug rig 'dzin sgrub la spro ba'i phyir/ /rags lus 'ja' tshon lta bu'i skur mdzad nas//'chi med lam srang mthon por rab 'phags te/ /phyir zhing lnga bdor skyes pa'i nyam thag 'gror/ /thugs rje'i spyan ras chags bzhin ring du bzhud/ /de nas la da'i yul gyi gtsug tor rtser/ /grangs med rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dbus su/ /mi zad lhan skyes bde ba'i chang gsol zhing / /pad+ma badz+ra mchod la brtson pas bzhugs//'di ni ris bral sngags pa'i phun tshogs gzhi/ /sa gsum gsang sngags 'byung ba'i rin jin gcig /gling bzhir lo tog khyad par 117
