pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/smin byed cing / /snang ba'i mchog sbyin nyi ma gcig pus nus/ /sher phyin snying po'i man ngag bdud gcod kyis/ /gzhan phan cher spyod g.yi yi lab sgron sogs/ /phyi ma'i dus kyang bsil ldan 'dzin ma 'dir/ /rjes dran sgo mang byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ /nyi ma 'od zer spang ston chos dbang sogs/ /tshangs pa'i me tog skyes rabs phreng ba kun/ /sems can 'dul ba'i phrin las grogs mdzad phyir/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis dus bzhir nye bar gnas/ /gang phyir thog med nas bsgrubs smon lam dang / /thabs shes bde ba'i dam tshig gis bsdams shing / /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sku gcig pa'i phyir/ /lhan cig tsan dan shing dang dri bzhin 'byung / /dus kyi mthar yang rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling / /dben par mchog gi rnal 'byor la bzhugs tshe/ /'od gsal gnyid kyi rang snang mchod rten drung / /snying thig gsang ba'i chos mdzod mngon du gtad/ /slar yang pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang cher/ /rig 'dzin bla ma mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs bcas/ /dpang du bkod nas brda yi thabs 'phrul gyis/ /sa steng chos kyi rgyal srid byed par gnang / /khyad par sbrags mda' mtsho rgyal bla mtsho ru/ /dung ba'i gzugs can mkha' 'gro'i gdangs snyan glus/ /snang sems bde ba chen por myos pa las/ /nges don nang gi mkha' spyod gsal bar gzigs/ /de tshe rab 118

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'bar chags pa'i kha dog can/ /lhan skyes bde ba'i na tshod dar babs shing / /kun rtog bag chags bcas pa'i g.yogs pa spangs/ /rdo rje'i phar phyin mang pos legs par brgyan/ /bde ba'i rol mo stong pa sgrogs pa'i sgras/ /ma lus de bzhin gshegs rnams bskul byed cing / /shes rab mtshon chas gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa gcod/ /srid zhir mi gnas 'gro ba'i don phyogs pa'i/ /bla med rgyud don snying po bde chen lam/ /yid 'phrog rig 'dzin rgyal mo'i gzugs gyur pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dpyid kyi dga' ba'i gnyen/ /rgya chen chu skyes rigs kyi thig le de/ /gting mtha' bral ba'i chos dbyings chu gter las/ /me chen phung po gar byed bzhin du bzhengs/ /spros pa'i snang ba nub pa'i mtshan mo ru/ /stong phrag nyi ma'i snang ba spro bzhin bzhugs/ /ye shes lang tshos sku yi bde ba bskyed/ /chos nyid rang sgras gsung gi nus pa spar/ /dgongs klong mnyam sbyar rig pa'i rtsal dbang rdzogs/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum thig le'i dbyings gcig bsres/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i dbang dang bskyed rdzogs la/ /brten nas dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub pa'i tshul//tshang la gnad 'dril nus pa phul byung ba'i/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i bum bzang gsar ba'ang byin/ /de nas ched du brjod pa'i me tog char/ /lung bstan swa ste'i glu dbyangs dang bcas pas/ /mchog 119

pod 1 rdo grub ba 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bde'i mdza' ba mi phyed grub pa'i rgyun/ /brgyud 'dzin phreng bar 'jug pa'i dge mtshan spel/ /kho mo chos dbyings zab mo'i phug tu gnas/ /de las 'dir 'ongs 'gro dang 'ong ba med/ /nyi 'od li khris dmar ba'i mkhur tshos can/ /nam mkha'i lang tsho ma de gang nas 'ongs/ /'gro med 'ong bral brtan g.yo kun tu 'gro/ /nyer bzhi'i gnas bdag gnas med spyod yul can/ /gang yang brtag dka' sgyu ma'i dpal mo bdag /rnga yab dpal ri sprul pa'i zhing nas 'ong / /mthong dang rjes su dran pa'i lus can gyi/ /rtsa khams ro mnyam rdo rjer byin rlob pa/ /gdan gsum sngags kyi grong khyer kho mo'i lus/ /dngos grub rdzogs ldan snying po'i dpal la ltos/ /nga ni bde chen rnal 'byor chu bo'i mdzod/ /rgyal rnams bde chen rgya mtsho bsrub las bskyed/ /de las dkon mchog lo tog cher rgyas te/ /nga las ma bltams dkon mchog gsum yod min/ /shul ring srid pa'i 'brog tu man ngag gi/ /sbyin gtong khang pa phyug po nyer bsgrubs te/ /tshur shog sku gsum 'dod dgu'i mchog longs zhes/ /skal ldan mgron la kho mo sdod cing mchis/ /kye kye chos tshul ba klu la shing ni/ /bden bral mdzes ma'i 'gram chang gis 'byed de/ /dge legs de yis rnal 'byor dbang po'i tshe/ /zla zer reg pa'i ku nu ta bzhin byed/ /ces gsungs tshogs brgyad srin po'i yul gling 120

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rnams/ /rtse dga'i rnam 'phrul rgyas pas zil mnan nas/ /brjod bral nang dbyings zhi ba'i pad+ma 'od/ /der ni 'dzum zhal mngon phyogs dgyes par gyur/ /dang po gzhom med na da'i skye gnas pa/ /bar du dam chos yi ge'i rgyun mang 'jo/ /tha mar mkha' 'gro'i brda yig gong bur gyur/ /mthar thug snying dbus mi shigs sprin sgrar thim/ /rig 'dzin bla ma de yi zla ba'i zhal/ /bsam yas chos kyi ga bur dog pa can/ /nub rir gzims la phyogs pa dbang mig lor// brtod pa dam pos bzung ba'ang 'di yis byas/ /sngon byung mkha' spyod bsgru ba pa'i gter brgyud kyi/ /lam srol phal cher nub cing 'chal ba na/ /myur bde'i lam bzang 'di nyid 'dzin pa brgyas/ /dhu ma thi la'i skal bzang rgyas par byas/ /lha dang lha min grub pa rig sngags 'chang / /dpag med mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis//sngon bzhin zab mo'i dgongs gter yongs bzung ste/ /skal ldan rnams la rgyun du snang bar shog /skye ba kun tu pad 'byung rgyal ba dang / /yum gcig rnal 'byor ma yi zhabs bsten cing / /dam tshig mi nyams gsang sngags snying po'i gnad/ /rnyed nas rtse gcig sgrub la brtson par shog /sangs rgyas 'byung ba las kyang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /'od gsal snying po'i lam mchog ma nor ba/ /dus rnams kun tu phyogs bcur rgyas byed cing / /go 'phang bla med 121

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gro la sbyin par shog /stong chen dbyings su rang byung rig pa'i sku//khyad chos drug gis mngon par byang chub ste/ /srid zhi'i 'khor lo mnyam par sdom byed pa'i/ /kun tu bzang mo tshe 'dir 'grub par shog /mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo'i lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dpa' bo'i yid 'dzin zhes bya ba sdom brtson mkhas dbang dam pa 'jigs med 'od gsal gyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas bris pa 'gro kun ye shes mkha' 'gros rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /de nas ched du brjod pa'i sogs sho lo ka brgyad po slad nas rang nyid kyis bsnan pa dge/ //ma / /na ma dz+nyā na tsaṇ+ḍa li ye/ /rab dmar nyi ma stong phrag bzhus pa'i rdul/ /'jigs chen dus kyi zhugs dang 'dres pa bzhin//sa gsum ma lus bzod dka'i gzi brjid kyis/ /zil gnon mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje rab gtum ma/ /dag cing 'ja' ltar dwangs pa 'od brgya'i dbyig /mthong bas bde chen dbyings su yid 'gugs pa'i//sku 'di lhan skyes dpal mo khyod min pa//dregs ldan sgyu ma phal la ci ste yod/ /ji ltar sos ka'i rgyal mo'i dus kyi mdangs/ /me tog rgyas pa'i nags klung shar ba bzhin/ /bde chen sgyu ma mu mtha' med pa'i mdangs/ /phun tshogs gzugs sku'i 13 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dkyil 'khor 'di na snang / /kye ma 'jig rten yid 'phrog dngos dgu kun/ /gsar du rang thab shor ba bzhin bgyid pa'i/ /'od 'bar pad+mo nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gang / /gnon pa'i zhabs sen de dag dpal dang ldan/ /dge legs mtshan ma stong gis rab spa ba/ /dran pas 'jigs kun 'phrogs pa'i zhabs drung 'dir/ /nor bu'i thor tshugs g.yo ba'i rig 'dzin brgyas/ /btud kyang ngo mtshar gzhan lta ga la yod/ /sman dang nor bu'i khyad par brgya stong gis/ /ma 'phrog 'jig rten 'big byed 'chi ba'i dug /zhabs sen me tog rdul gyis bsgrun ma thag /nyams pas 'bral rung chos su da gdod rtogs/ /'dod me 'bar ba'i na chung yan lag na/ /rgyan rnams sred pa'i dug gis skom pa bzhin/ /zhi bsil bdud rtsi'i reg pa la nyal ba/ /khyod gcig kho na'i zhabs gdub 'di dag lags/ /ldem zhing sgeg pa rma bya myos pa'i 'gros/ /'og pag ngang pa'i sgra snyan 'khrol ba dang / /lhan cig dpa' mo'i dbus nas bskyod pa'i tshe/ /rjes chags ngo mtshar gnyis pa snying la 'pho/ /rdo rje lta bur rlum zhing phra ba yi/ /sked skabs lcug phran bzhin du 'gyur ba na/ /'bum phrag dpa' bo'i yid kyang shig shig tu/ /'gul ba rten 'brel chos nyid min na ci/ /nu bum 'bur ba lhag pa'i chos can dang / /dku skabs zhum pa ma tshang skyon ldan min/ /mtho dang 123

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga dma' ba'i dbyibs kyi khyad par kun/ /skru 'di'i nang na rol rtsed 'gran pa 'dra/ /'o 'dzin rgyas pa zla ba lta bu dang / /mkhregs shing mtho ba dum pa bzang 'dra dang / /gzhon zhing 'jam pa me tog kha bus lta'i/ /gzugs 'dis ji lta bur na mi mdzes lags/ /chu sprin 'phyur ba'i rlabs dang nu 'bur ni/ /zlum po 'di dag re ldan zhing pa dang / /rig 'dzin dga' ba skyed la mtshungs mod kyi/ /bde chen sbyin pa'i nus pa sprin la med/ /gang gis mgul nas bcings pas gzhan sems kyi/ /'ching ba mtha' dag nges par zad byas nas/ /slar zhing yon tan khyud mo brgyad 'ching ba/ /phyag 'di ya mtshan las kyang phul byung lags//lhan cig skyes pa'i de nyid mi shes par//sgeg mo'i mdza' ba la chags snyan dngags mkhan/ /na chung lag pa pad+ma ltar bsngags kyang / /yid kyi 'ching ba de la de mi 'tshams /dngos grub dga' ba 'dod pa'i rna lung du/ /gang mtshan dbang gi lha mor snyan pa'i bcud/ /kyo ba'i zol kyis mig sngar babs pa yang /phyag rtser a mra bzhin du smin nas yod/ /dbang chen pad+ma'i lcags kyu 'di gdengs pas/ /lhun po ral zhing rgya mtsho gting nas 'khrugs/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos kun rang rang tshugs/ /zhig nas khab len nye ba'i lcags ltar gda'/ /gug cing rno ba lcags kyu'i mtshon 'di ni/ /dbang gi snyems pas bsgyings shing 'phyar ba 124

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ste/ /stong phrag dge mtshan 'khyil ba'i bum bzang 'dis/ /snyems pa'i rgyu mtshan de dag 'chad pa 'dra/ /'chi ba gtor zhing tshe yi rgyun 'bebs pa/ /a rnyi da lha'i byin rlabs za ma tog /bkur nas 'chi med 'dod pa su yod ces/ /'jig rten kun tu yid kyi shugs kyis 'jug /snying rje'i dpal mo dus gsum dus med par/ /rjes 'dzin dka' ba mdzad ma khyod bzhugs kyang / /sgom dang bzlas pa'i slong mo mi nus par/ /'chi bzhin rang mal nyal rnams kye ma'o smad/ /dpa' bo'i sen rtags btabs pa'i nu 'khor dang //'dzum gsum ri mos sgeg pa'i mgul pa dang //bim pa'i dmar ba la 'phya zhal gyi sgros/ /'bus dang phye ba'i tshal ltar so sor mdzes/ /rgyud don tshig rer rdzogs pa rdo rje'i glu/ /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rgyud du blangs pa na/ /dbyangs snyan dri za mo rnams pi waṃ yang rang rang gnas su bag la zha bar zad/ /rnal 'byor nus pa ba ku la yi khams/ /dngos grub me tog phung po bag la nyal/ /gsang sngags sgeg mo'i 'gram chang gis bran pas/ /las dang ye shes grub pa'i gnas skabs rdzogs/ /mtshar sdug tshems dkar 'od dang dbyangs bdun glu/ /bal pad+mo'i dri dang sprang rtsi'i ro/ /mngon par dga' ba'i phun tshogs 'byor pa kun/ /'dzum khro'i zhal 'dir dus gcig 'ong ba snyam/ /gzhon sha rgyas pa'i mkhur tshos thig le ni/ /rna 126

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rgyan nor du'i 'od kyis rab snum pa/ /rtse dgas 'gying bas phan tshun zhal gzigs na/ /mtshams sprin 'jings su glog dmar 'khyug pa bzhin/ /ltag 'og sum cha 'das pa'i zhal ras dbus/ /ran par mtho ba'i shangs kyi dbyibs legs pa/ /rigs kyi mdzes pa'i khyad nor srung bzhin du/ /mtshan dpe'i rigs gzhan la yang mdzes pa skyed/ /dwangs gsal dkar nag byes pa pad+ma'i mig /dbang po'i gzhu lhar 'khyogs pa'i smin ma can/ /khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'di dang mig 'di'i mdun/ /chos kun rang gi gsang tshig 'chad pa lta/ /dgyes mdzad zhal 'dir ga ka'i rdul snyed kyi/ /dpa' bo'i mig rnams bsam gtan byed pa'i tshe/ /yid tsam zur mig babs pas rjes bzung ba/ /snyim pa'i snod du bdud rtsi zag pa 'dra/ /stangs zil dbu skra'i dri zhim li shi'i rdul/ /rigs bdag snang mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer dang / /lhan cig 'dres pas chu mthong tha gru kun/ /g.yang dang ldan pa'i khyim bzhin rjid par mthong / /'od kyi mtshan ma bar snang la 'phyo bas//sa 'og gser gyi 'byung khungs shes pa bzhin/ /pad+ma can gyi zhal ras rgyas pa 'dis//sbas don sna rtse mkha' 'gro gdong yang shes/ /sems kyi bung ba myos byed sprang rtsi can/ /'di lags cha gzhan 'di yi ngad lags te/ /tshe dpag med kyang kha sbyor bde ba'i skus/ /rdo rje'i gnas 'di'i 126

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga dga' ba bstan par mdzad/ /sna yis sna bcings rlung gis rlung bskyod de/ /zhugs kyis zhugs par a dī ka dri'i sprin/ /rdo rje nam mkha' smra bsam brjod med klong / /'dren pa'i nges don lcags kyu 'di lags so/ /gang gi rang bzhin dka' thub bzlas brjod dang //yang dag 'jog pa phal gyis shes min pa'i/ /zab mo nang gi mkha' spyod bde ba che/ /rdo rje dbyings ma 'dis ni mngon sum ston/ /zab dang rgya che'i man ngag gzhan dag gis/ /bgrang yas bskal pa'i pha mthar rtogs bya ba/ /zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul nyi ma 'od po che/ /zha 'di'i de nyid shes pas tshe 'dir 'grub/ /sku 'di'i yon tan ci tsam zab pa dang / /rgya che de ltar dam pa'i bde ba yang zab cing rgya cher 'char ba'i tshul brjod phyir/ /bstod pa'i sgo 'di se'u bcu'i ngag 'dra min/ /de ltar rgyal yum 'phags ma tshe sbyin ma'i/ /yid 'phrog sku yi cha shas la bsngags pa/ /byis pas me tog gang dgar brgyus 'dra 'di/ /yum gcig rjes brtse kho nas bdag gir bzhes/ /'chi med tsaṇ+ḍa li'i sku rdo rje gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i cha shas rags rim tsam zhig nyung du'i ngag gis bsngags pa rdo rje sgra ma'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba rdo rong gi gzhon nu rigs par smra ba'i rgyud mangs mkhan/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas sa glang khrums kyi zla ba'i yar tshes la sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur 1 27

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs kyi med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cig/ //nga / /snying rje'i dbang phyug mgon med 'gro ba rnams/ /dbugs 'byin dud med sgyu 'phrul la zhugs nas/ /rab 'byams zhing kun mtshan gyi 'brug sgra yis/ /'gebs mdzad myur ma'i zhabs la skyabs su mchi/ /sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs me tog bsung tshor bzhin//mi 'jigs bde ba don gnyer sems can kun/ sgrol ma zhes bya'i mtshan tsam thos pas kyang / /phul byung zhing la rab dga'i 'jug pa skye/ /thugs rje chen po'i sbyang ba rnam dag dang / /rlabs chen bsod nams ye shes mthu grub pa'i/ /snyan pa yongs 'dus 'dab ltar rgyas pa'i 'dzum/ tā re'i yi ger me long gzugs bzhin chags/ /de slad dbyangs snyan mtho ris rol mos kyang / /yi ge gnyis 'di'i ngo mtshar mi sleb phyir/ /mkhas pa'i spru sgo gcig nas gcig tu ni/ /yum gcig khyod mtshan kho na rtag tu 'jug /byin rlabs gser sbyangs 'od 'bar mtshan gyi ni/ /'khor lo 'chang ba'i rigs ngan dbul po brgya/ /brgya byin gtsug phud rin chen snye ma'i steng / /rkang sen rol pa'i dbang phyug 'dod dgur 'dzin/ /'on kyang stobs bcu mnga' ba'i ming yig gis/ /dregs ldan gzi brjid 'gong ba ngo mtshar min/ /mtshan tsam dran pas bskal mang mthong dka' ba'i/ /pad+ma'i zhal ras mngon sum 128

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1blta la dbang / /rab gsar skra mchog nor bu'i myu gu ni/ /shis brjod gdangs snyan dal gyis dgod pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nang son pa/ /char sprin nang nub dpal gyi ri rtse bzhin/ /gzhon zhing mdangs gsal bcu gsum zla ba ltar/ /shin tu dbyibs legs bal mig yangs dang / /rim par 'tshams pa'i shangs sogs rang bzhin rgyan/ /dag cing gtsang ba rnams kyis zhal khyim mdzes/ /bim pa'i zhal sgros phye ba'i mthong skabs nas/ /thags bzang tshem dkar 'od dang me tog bsung / /lhan cig tshangs dbyangs bdud rtsi'i sil snyan gyis/ /skyo dub med par kun yid ngal 'tsho sbyin/ /rab 'byams brtan g.yo gsal rdzogs rang gi gzis/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i nyi zla spa 'gong zhing / /lha yi lha bzhin chos kyi rang sgra can/ /yid bzhin rgyan phreng mang pos lhag/ par spa/ /dri med lhun po'i mthil bzhin legs gang ba'i/ /brang gi ngos ni nu bum mtho bas brgyan/ /dpag bsam shing tog lta bur bzung ba yi/ /nu tog 'bur bas 'dud rtsi'i 'dzum zer 'gyed/ /phyag g.yas 'gro la mchog sbyin phyag rgya can/ /g.yon pas 'jigs bcas skyob pa'i phyag stabs mdzad/ /gos pa med pa'i snying rje'i spyan ras ni/ /dus kun mi zum ut+pal mtshan ma 'chang / /legs tshogs nye 'khon med par 'grem mdzad cing / /rgud pa mtha' dag 129

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yud la 'phrog nus zhes/ /bsnyeng bral dpa' mo'i stangs stabs dus kun tu/ /bstan 'dis thar 'dod yid kha cis mi 'phrog /sked skabs gzhu yi 'chang zung ltar phra zhing / /kun nas zlum phyir stod smad mdzes par phyed/ /'gying bas yid 'phrog sked chings shin tu 'tshams/ /zab cing g.yas 'khyil lte ba zlum por gnas/ /sil khrol g.yer kha'i dra ba brgya phrag gis/ /zhi ba'i 'gros la snyan ngag smra 'dra ba/ /rgyas shing 'tshams pa'i sku smad lta na sdug /skyil krung bcing ba khor yug ri bzhin brjid/ /de phyir khyod sku mngon sum mthong ma thag /mdzes sdug lcags kyus yid ni 'dren 'gyur te/ /de tshe byin rlabs zab mo'i skabs rnyed pas/ /ye shes zhags pas gtan du 'ching bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i dug can lha yul sgyu byed ma'i/ /lang tsho don gnyer dka' thub cher spyod na/ /blta bas mi ngoms srid zhi'i 'jigs phrog ma/ /khyod phyir brtul zhugs sgrub la mtshar du ci/ /de lta'ang rmongs pa'i 'jig rten chos nyid dang / /khyod kyi mtshan thos rnyed dka' la bsam tshe/ /gnas skabs phyi rol 'jigs pas yid skrag ste/ /myur ma'i mtshan tsam 'dzin pa'ang ches ngo mtshar/ /ga ka'i rdul snyed ma dag zhing rnams na/ /phra rags nang gi 'jigs pas sun phyungs nas/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs pad yid byed pa/ /yangs pa'i sa rdul las kyang ches cher 130

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mang / /gang tshe dge ba'i las can rnams kyi snod/ /dag pa'i zhing na smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ /kye ma'o thogs med 'gro 'dul mthu stobs bdag /bad kyi phrin las rgya che mnyam med lags/ /la lar zhi ma yid bzhin tshe 'phel ma/ /kha cig drag mo 'jig rten gsum 'dul ma/ /gzhan du ma nges 'jigs pa'i 'phrang sgrol ma/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mdzad ma/ /skal bzang yid mig mngon sum mgu mdzad cing / /la lar gnyid kyi me long nang 'jug dang / /kha cig mi'i snang brgyud nas 'dul la sogs/ /sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul chos dbyings khyab par stod/ /chags thogs spang ba yid mgyogs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /mos ldan mdun sar skad cig nyid byon nas/ /gdams pa'i dus ston gdul bya'i dus bzhin du/ /stsol bas lung gi chos tshul rgyas par mdzad/ /kun khyab dbyings dang ro mnyam rdo rje'i thugs/ /mkhas pa'i yid dang ngag gi sgor bzhugs nas/ /legs bshad chu bo'i rlabs ltar ring spro bas/ /lung gi rol rtsed kun nas kun tu 'phel/ /ye shes gzi brjid bsam mi khyab pa'i dpal/ /snying la zhugs pas ma rtogs log rtog dang / /the tshom bal pa dza ltar 'dzings pa'i rgya/ /gcod byed rigs pa'i mda' non ci yang 'gyu/ /de nas gdul bya'i chos rab rnam 'byed mda'/ /rgyal yum mda' mkhan dge ma khyod kyi mthus/ /'phangs pas gnas 131

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/min g.yang du mi ltung bar/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen 'ben la thal gyis 'jug /byis pa'i cal col sdeb sbyor mi legs kyang / /brtse ba'i yum cig bstod pa dang du bzhes/ /don la nongs rnams bu yi rgud pa ru/ /dgongs nas de rgyur bcas te bzlog par mdzod/ /dge bas tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun ma'i/ /zhabs sen me tog phreng ba'i la thod kyis/ /phyi nang 'jigs pa brgyad kyi nyer 'tshe kun/ /phrogs nas kun dga'i dpal la longs spyod shog /snying la 'phab/sa ma dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar 'od/ /zhugs pas tshe dang ye shes dpal 'phel zhing / /legs bshad gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyis/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i re ba skong bar shog /bdag gi ming dang sgo bsum bya byed kun/ /sems can nyam thag spid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i gru stegs dpal mo khyed bzhin du/ /gyur nas sangs rgyas phrin las byed par shog/ //ba / /'jigs med rnga sgra'i dbyangs kyi spyan snga ru/ /nyon mongs bdud sde 'joms pa seng ge'i sgras/ /'phags tshogs slob ma khrag khrig spa bkong ba'i/ /lha mo thugs rje myur mar grags pas skyongs/ /stobs chen thub par dka' ba'i dgra sde dang / /'jigs rung seng ge khros pa'i dpa' brtul brgya/ /bzhad pa brgyad ldan rdo rje'i nga ro yis/ /'dar ba'i spu long sbyin pa'i tā re ma/ /mche ba'i 13 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rtse brgya gdengs ldan glang po dang / /dus kyi chad pa 'dzin pa'i btson ra yang / /gang mtshan dran pa'i zil gyis rnam 'thor ba'i/ /byams chen gdung ba kun 'phrog tā re ma/ /rab 'bar brtan g.yo za ba'i me lce dang / /dbugs chen dug rlangs 'phyur ba'i khro ldan sprul/ /gang la skyabs gsol 'debs pas nyer zhi'i gzugs/ kun dga'i lang tshor 'bar ba'i tā re ma/ /reg gcod spu gri'i dbal ltar no ba thogs/ /shugs drag rgya mtsho phyur ba'i dba' brgal kyang//rdo rje'i yi ge bcu pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /mi 'che'i brtul zhugs 'dzin mdzad tā re ma/ /mdza' ba'i dga' tshal nyams pa'i bshes zal dang / /mi sdug skyin thang 'bab pa'i chom rkun g.yul/ /byams chen phyag rgya'i zil gyis gnon mdzad pa/ /dpa' mo dga' chen rgya mtsho tā re ma/ /gdug pa mdze yi nad kyis lus rul zhing / /sde bzhi'i khyad nor nyams pa'i dbul ba yang / /sang zhabs pad+mo mchog gis dbugs 'byin pas//zhal bzhes 'gong ba mi mnga' tā re ma/ /smyo 'bog zhags pa 'debs byed dbang po'i gdon/ /mi gson khrag la klal ba'i sha za yang / /bdud kyi bdud chen khros pa'i drag shul gyis/ /zhum pa'i gdung ba ster mdzad tā re ma/ /gtum chen rgyal po las gyur chad pa dang / /phun tshogs 'dod don nyams pa'i sdug bsngal kun/ /gang la brten nas rnam par zhi 133

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mdzad de/ /phan bde'i dge mtshan la sbyor tā re ma/ /khyod ni rnam mang rgyal ba'i zhing kun tu/ /'jigs dang gdung ba 'joms pa'i lha mchog ces/ /ngo mtshar grags pa'i dpal gyis mngon mtho ba/ /bdag kyang khyod zhal dran pa'i gdung ba skye/ /lha mo dam pa'i bdudartsi mchog sbyin ma /deng nas bdag la thugs brtse nyer bzhag ste/ /'chi med tshe dang ye shes snang ba ches/ /mi 'bral byang chub bar du skyong mdzod cig /ces pa 'di'ang dad gtong bag yod kyi yon tan du mas mtho ba'i dge rgan ma ti'i mtshan can gyi ngor gzhon nu 'jigs med pas bris pa rtag tu don yod par gyur cig/ //nga / /rnam par dkar ba'i legs byas phung por margad mdangs kyis nyer byug pa/ /gang la thugs rje myur ma zhes bya'i grags snyan zhags pa rtag mnga' bas/ /'jig rten gsum gyi tha gru ma lus cig char 'ching ba'i 'phags ma des/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 'dod lha'i bdag nyid 'ching zhing rmongs pa'i las mdzod cig /bskal mang goms pa'i snying rje mchog ni khro ba'i blo dang mdza' ba min/ /'gro la phan bzhed lhag pa'i thugs ni phyogs dang ris su chad pa med/ /kun nas dge ba'i mdzad bzang mchog ni nag po'i chos su bshes min pa'i/ /dpa' mo chen mo'i mthu stobs 'phrul chen bdud sde 'joms pa'i gshed mar bzhengs/ /134

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1sdig can bdud la sdang ba min kyang bdud dpung 'joms pa'i gshed du che/ /thugs rjes 'dod lha btang ba min kyang drag shul mdzad pas bdud sde 'dul/ /skal bzang 'gro la chags pa min yang bdud las dam rgyal dngos grub 'jo/ /bdud 'dul drag mo myur ma'i lha des de ring bdud dpung pham par mdzod/ /gtong ba chen po shin tu gtong bcas yongs su rdzogs pa mthar son te/ /chags pa med pa'i ye shes mchog las nam yang 'da' ba ma lags pas/ /sred len 'ching ba brtul la mi bsnyeng dpa' mo'i myur ma'i mthu byin gyis/ /ser sna'i kun sbyor cha bcas las byung bdud kyi rgyu ba bzlog tu gsol/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims mchog ni rnam byang chos su shes gyur mod/ /dag pa min pa'i brtul zhugs kun la mya ngan bskyed pa'i pho nya ba/ /gang la mnga' mdzad 'phags ma sgrol mas bsdu bzhi mthar phyin bden pa des/ /nyes spyod mi bzad bdud sde'i grong khyer rmang nas 'jig pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /srid pa ji srid skyo bas mi dub 'gro sgrol spyod pa'i khur bsnams shing / /srid dang zhi ba gnyis su mi dmigs zab mo bzod pa'i mthar son pas/ /'phags ma mchog ces grags pa don ldan oṃ mdzad lha mo'i stobs nus kyis/ /sdang dang rab rib nyes pa'i bdud dpung smod thabs bye bas smad par mdzod/ / bsam byis mi 135

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/khyab snying stobs go cha mi mthun g.yul gyis brdzi ba med/ /ji skad smras bzhin mi 'gong dam bca' chog shes thabs kyis bsub tu med/ /byang chub mchog las mi ldog brtson 'grus le los rgol ba'i skabs med mas/ /bya ba ngan zhen 'dod lha'i dmag dpung ming gi lhag mar mdzad du gsol/ /srid pa'i snyoms 'jug srid rtsa 'gog la shin tu nus pa phra gyur pa/ /gang dang thun mong nam yang ma gyur zag med zhi ba'i ting 'dzin sprin/ /zag pa kun zad mngon shes dam pa'i chu gter lto bar sprum pa'i ltas/ / snyoms 'jug sgrib pa'i g.yul ngo ma lus rnam thar rgya mtshos tshar chod cig /yul dang yul can mtshan ma nyer zhi chos nyid gsang ba de kho na//mthar 'dzin lta ba kun las rnam grol so so rang rig ye shes ches/ mthong rgyu ma mchis mthong ba'i rtse mor gzigs pa rnam dag tā re mas/ /bden zhen 'khrul rtog bdud kyi g.yul ngo lnga ba'i lam du sbyor mdzod cig /yon tan rin chen nor bu'i phreng ba kun nas dngar ba'i 'phags ma la/ /yon tan bsngags pa'i bstod dbyangs sprin chen rgya cher dkrigs pa'i legs byas las/ /yon tan mi zad bsil ba'i char zim 'jig rten gsum du rtag 'bab pas/ /yon tan chos mchog thob la gegs byed bdud kyi rgyu ba 'gog gyur cig /ces pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med pas rang 136
tshogs phyong dīs pa

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga / /legs ldan nag po chen po la bstod pa/phun tshogs dam pa gnyis kyi rgyal thabs bdag /'jig rten mgon la dang bas phyag bgyis te/ /de yi bka' sdod legs ldan nag po che'i/ /zhal la byis pa'i bstod dbyangs me tog 'thor/ khro gnyer rlabs 'khrugs rgya mtsho'i klong ltar gnag /mtsho dbus nyi ma'i gzugs shar 'dra ba'i spyan/ /cad zhal 'jigs rung nyams brgyar 'bar na yang / /dngos grub rin chen 'byung bas kun dga'i gzhi/ /rab khros 'bar ba'i gdong can nyi ma'i mig /yon por lta bas dgra sde sreg byed cing / /smin 'khyogs me 'bar glog 'gyu'i phreng ba bzhin/ /de mthus phyogs rnams 'od zer rngul chu 'byung / /tsha bsreg rno ba'i gzi ldan dmar zlum spyan/ /gzigs pa tsam gyis log 'dren khro bo'i dpung / /nyi mas gdungs bskyed mar gsar bzhin 'ju bas/ /bdud kyi dgra zhes grags pa'i ru mtshon thob/ /zhags pas ma bzung phur bus btab min yang / /che bar snyems shing stobs kyis dregs pa brgya/ /sdang mig zur gyis phog pa'i mod kho nar//ri mo'i gzugs bzhin g.yo ba med par 'ching //138

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs kyi rlung sgrom las/ /'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra mi bzad rab 'byin pas/ /ri gling rgya mtshor bcas pa'i sa gzhi'i pon/ /chu dbus rlung chen bsnun pa'i gru bzhin g.yo/ /bgrang du mi spyod gdul gyis mi lang ba'i/ /srid gsum gdug pa dus gcig za ba'i kha/ /drag por gdangs 'dis gdul dka' yongs 'dul ba'i//khur khyer rnams kyi thugs khral chung ngur bstungs/ /'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i sgrar bcas me lce yis/ /phye leb sbrang bu'i tshogs rnams len pa bzhin/ /hūṃ hūṃ drag po'i dbyangs ldan dmar mnyen ljags/ /bskyod pas phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs zas su 'gug /sra brtan mche ba no dkar gcigs pa'i ngos/ /bstan dgra'i gson khrag gos dmar lhon pa ni/ /thun mtshams sprin gyis g.yogs pa'i gangs ri'i phreng / /brdab pas gnam sa g.yo 'khrugs ston pa bzhin/ /rngams zhal 'od kyis dgra srog gab pa 'byin/ /dbugs chen tsha bas dgra yul myun par byed/ /phrad dang zos pa dus gcig rkan sgra gtog /ma rungs 'jigs byed 'byung po'i ri dwags dgra/ /g.yul la dgyes shing dpa' bo'i bshug glu yis/ /bskul tshe gtum chen drag po'i lha dmag tshogs/ /mtshon cha'i 'od kyis nyi zla zil gnon pa/ /'tshub pas nam mkha'i lam srang bar med khyab/ /de mthong ri rab 'gros la phyogs pa bzhin/ /'gul zhing lha min yul 139

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyi rgyal mtshan rnams/ /brgyal bas 'gyel gyur sbyin skyes dga' ma'i 'khor/ /yug sa'i gnas skabs sems shing rud mo ldir/ /khams nag ral pa brdzes pa'i skra gseb nas/ /glog 'gyu nam mkha' 'geng ba'i me stag tshogs/ /bzod dka'i 'od dmar 'tsheg cing drag rgyu bas/ /rgyu skar gnam sngon zab mo'i phug ring byer/ /bdud sde'i snying stobs bud shing za ba'i me/ /bstan dang de 'dzin rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal/ /sa gsum dregs pa'i tshogs rje nag po che/ /ma mo'i 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// //140

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1༄/ /bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga la bstod pa/jiḥ dza brnya ra'i ba gam tog /bde chen dngos grub rgyun 'bebs pa/ /'chi med zla ba'i lang tsho can/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /stong nyid phag mo'i bde klong du/ /khams lnga dag pa'i shes rab cha/ /khud med sgyu ma'i dbyibs gzugs su/ /rnam 'phrul mkha' 'gro lnga la 'dud/ /kun rtog zos pa'i tsaṇ+ḍa lis/ /dpyid kyi sprin sgra sad pa las/ /lhan skyes nyams brgyar rol ba mo/ /dbyings chen rma bya'i rgyal mo lnga/ /khyod ni chags mchog pad+ma'i zhing / /zla zhun kha ba'i gos can gyi/ /rdo rje phung po'i bod ljongs su/ /las rlung 'gong po 'du byed cing / /mthar 'dzin mu stegs rgyu ba gcod/ /ye shes dwangs ma'i longs spyod kyis/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog sgrub pas/ /bkra shis tshe ring mched lngar grags/ /mi phyed ma dang phra gzugs sogs/ /gnas yul ma mo mkha' 'gro'i sprin/ /thig le rlung gi gzugs can ma/ /kun kyang khrod kyi rnam 'gyur dang / /sna tshogs las sgrub phyag brnyan 'khor/ /skye 'gro'i lus dag yid gsum gyi/ / snang dang mi snang phyed snang grong / /khyab par nyul zhing kun dbang 141

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— ྾sgyur/ /kun rdzob spros pa'i 'dzum dkar brgyas/ /'jig rten mig sgyur rtsa rlung gi/ /sman mo'i grong khyer ji snyed kyang / /don dam spros med nam mkha'i sku/ /'od gsal dbyings lngar rnam dag ste/ /a wa ka ti mthon mthing gangs/ /shel dkar rtsa yi pho brang cher/ /bden gnyis ma mo tha mi dad/ /mthar thug nyi ma'i 'pho ba rnams/ /'gyur med dbyings su rgyas thebs pas/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum dbu mar 'dres//gangs chen rgyal mos phyogs dus khyab/ /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi/ /bstan skyong ya ma che rnams kyang / /mchog bde'i lang tsho gang ba mo/ /lo kyi yongs 'gyur dag pa lags/ /de slad rlung sems 'pho ba'i cha/ /dbyings lnga mi phyed ka dag klong / /bde chen thabs kyis bsdams pa las/ /snang srid ma mo'i srog tu 'dres//ma mo rang sems gnyug mar bstem/ /nyag gcig thig le chen po'i klong / /gdod ma'i rgyal srid dbang bsgyur te/ /don gnyis bsam pa lhun grub shog /ces pa'ang skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros pas 'di 'dra zhig bris zhes gnang rten bcas bka' phebs pa ltar bstan pa'i nyi mas sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis// // ༄/ /kun rtog spros pa'i grwa zur brgyad cu'i khams/ /kun zlum thig le gcig gi dbyings thim pas/ /kun snang bde stong 42

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga gnyug ma'i lhar bzhengs pa/ /kun bzang gzhon nu bum pa dbyings kyi sku/ /rnam med stong ba nyid kyi phyag rgya dang / /rnam mang bde ba'i ye shes mnyam sbyar bas/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan he ru ka'i/ /rnam rol srid dang zhi ba'i pha mthar gdal/ /spros med 'od gsal chen po rig pa'i dbyings/ /spros dang spros min rtog pa'i rdul spangs pa/ /spros bcas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol brgyar//spro dang sdud pa'i zlos gar cir yang rtse/ /rdo rje mi shigs snying po'i ti la ka /rdo rje gsang gsum grub pa'i dga' ston dbyig /rdo rje rtse mo'i thabs mkhas 'ba' zhig gis/ /rdo rje'i ye shes chen po rnam par 'bar/ /zab grags zab mo bzod pa'i shes rab kyis/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos kun 'bigs pa yang / /zab gsal gnyis med lha ba'i sngon 'gro ste/ /zab pa'i nang na myur ba rdo rje'i lam/ /de sgad dag pa gnyis ldan dbyings kyi mkha'/ /snang gsum nyes pa'i rdul dang bral ba ni/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor goms pa'i mthu yin zhes/ /theg mchog ston pas rang gi nges gsang bstan/ /rags pa lnga phung 'dus pa'i lcags nag rdul/ /phra ba lhan skyes ye shes gser 'gyur rtsis/ /sbyang bas bde chen mchog gi skru sgrub pa/ /thabs kyi nang nas rtse mor son pa'i thabs/ /thabs chen lam gyis bsgrub pa'i go 'phang ni/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog la gnas pa ste/ /gang yang thabs 113

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyi nus pa rab dman pa'i/ /lam ni 'dod pa nyi tshe tsam zhig ster/ /bya rtsol 'dzin zhen las 'das theg pa mchog /lhun rdzogs thig le chen po'i ngang gnas te/ /rtsol bcas theg pa'i rnam grangs brgya phrag gis/ /'gro mang byang chub mchog gi sa mthor 'god/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rig pa 'dzin/ /'pho med ye shes grub pa'i spyod 'chang tshogs/ /til gyi gang bu bzhin du bltams pa'i zhing / /theg rgyal snang ba gcig gis khyab par gdal/ /dag dang ma dag sprul pa'i zhing rgya mtshor/ /zhi dang khro gar du ma'i rol mdzad kyis/ /rab 'byams rgyud sde'i chos tshul gang gsungs pa/ /kun kyang bde chen gnyug ma mtshon pa'i sgo/ /bsam yas sku dang mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /yid can re ba rnam par skong mdzad kyang / /mthar thug theg pa'i 'bab stegs gcig 'gyur ba'i/ /kye ma'o thabs mkhas 'di ni bsam par dka'/ /de ltar ston pa rgyud 'chad rdo rje chos/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ston pa'i che ba las/ /bsngags brjod pad+ma'i dog pa nyung ngu 'di/ /sbyon pa 'jigs med byis pa'i mchod rdzas yin/ /zhes pa'ang me khyi zla tshes la sprang po a zas so// //144

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ra /mtsho skyes rgyal bar bstod pa/dri med da rgya mtshor pad+ma skyes/ /o ḍi ya na'i khab tu pad+ma'i rgyal/ /ma ra ti ka'i gnas su pad+ma 'byung / /don du pad+ma gar dbang mig mi 'dzum/ /sna tshogs mtshan dang rnam 'gyur cir snang yang / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i brtul zhugs rlabs po ches/ /don gnyis 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs mdzad de/ /grub pa'i dge mtshan sbyin las gzhan yod min/ /gsang chen dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo dang / /gnas yul mkha' la spyod pa'i lhan skyes ma/ /kun kyang bde chen phyag rgya'i dam tshig tu/ /sdom mdzad bde ba'i bdag nyid te ru ka /zhi chags kun snang snying rje'i 'dzum dkar gyis/ /khams gsum bde ba chen por rgyas btab nas/ /bro gar ta na ga na'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /brtan g.yo 'od gsal sgyu ma'i dbyings su sgrol/ /gzod nas kun mkhyen ston pa 'od mi 'grur/ /dag mnyam bde stong rol mo'i ye shes su/ /lhun rdzogs dang po'i mgon por sangs rgyas kyang / /zhing 'dir rgyal tshab chen po'i rig pa 'dzin/ /gang sku rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang du/ /rtsa gsum chos skyong 146

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug cher/ /bzhugs nas kha ba'i ri bo'i yid can rnams/ /dus kun rgyun chad med par brtse bas dgongs/ /de ltar srin po shin tu ma rungs dang / /byang phyogs gdong dmar gdul dka'i mi rnams kyang / /lhag par thugs rjes skyong ba'i gdul bya ru/ /rjes 'dzin 'di 'dra'i smon lam bsam par dka'/ /mdor na khyod mtshan thos dang dran pas kyang / /gang 'dul mdzad pa'i byin rlabs rmad byung gis/ /de la de yi mod nas skyob mdzad pa'i/ /yid bzhin gter gyi rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag ni 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rig 'jin bla ma khyod dang mi 'bral zhing //mkha' spyod rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs rnams dang / /lhan cig rim gnyis spyod pa'i dpa' bor shog /ces 'jigs med pas so// //ba / /mthing mdog 'od brgyas mdzes pa 'bum byin pas/ /khengs pas dregs pa'i rba rlabs 'khri shing can/ /dri med si rgyu'i chu gter dwangs pa'i ngogs/ /mtshan dpe'i zla ba gsar ngoms mtsho skyes rje/ /mtsho skyes rgyu skar lang tsho ma rnying ba/ /du ma'i phreng ba dngar ba'i lha gral na/ /ge sar zla gzhon 'dzin pa'i 'dab stong spubs/ /bcu drug lang tshos sgegs pa mtsho skyes rje/ /'pho chen ye shes rdo rje gnyug ma'i srog /snang stong mi shigs dwangs ma'i 'jo sgeg dang / /chags pa'i tha tshig nam yang mi lhod pa'i/ /spyod yul 146

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bsam gyis mi khyab mtsho skyes rje/ /gzhi dbyings rang byung gdod ma'i chos nyid dang / /gzhi snang 'od gsal mchog gi ti la ka /zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lo che/ /gzugs skru'i rol mor 'bar ba mtsho skyes rje/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong pa'i dbyings/ /rnam bcas bde chen 'khor lo mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /nom kun mchog tu mi 'gyur ye shes che/ /sgyu ma'i lang tshor snang ba mtsho skyes rje/ /gzugs sku'i rol mor snang yang rang bzhin med/ /gshis la rang bzhin med kyang gzugs skur snang / /snang dang mi snang mtshan ma nyer zhi ba'i/ /ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab mtsho skyes rje/ /zhing sngags lhan skyes mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag gis/ /bde mchog bde ba'i zlos gar rnam g.yo ba'i/ /gnas yul nyer bzhi'i grong khyer bkod pa na/ /brtul zhugs mchog 'is rol ston mtsho skyes rje/ /chags med chags pa'i 'phrul chen bye ba brgyas/ /zag med bde ba mchog gi dpal ster ba'i/ /mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i dga' ston rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dgyes mdzad he ru ka dpal mtsho skyes rje/ /khams gsum srog gi gshed gyur sgra gcan ltor/ /nyi zla'i rgyu ba bkag pa'i mod nyid la/ /rtag chen 'chi ba med ba'i skur bzhengs pa/ /tshe dbang grub pa'i rig 'dzin mtsho skyes rje/ /gcig dang du mar ma grub ye shes che/ /mkha' khyab zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor du//117

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/snang ba'i 'phrul chen 'gog tu ma mchis pa/ /phrin las snang ba mchog sprul mtsho skyes rje/ /thugs rje bka' drin mtshungs med mtsho skyes lha/ /yid kyi 'dun sar rtag tu bsnyen byas nas/ /ched brjod gtam gyi rdza rnga 'di brdung na/ /'dzad med grub gnyis snang ba char du stol/ /zhes pa'ang 'jigs med pas gang dran lhug par brjod pa mad lo// //༷148

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1༄/ /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i bstod pa/'phags yul chos kyi 'dun khang na le ka'i/ /khri 'phang zhabs pad 'dab mas gnon bzod pa/ /za hor mkhan po'i grags snyan sum rtsen rnga/ /dbyu gus bskul ba med kyang srid na ldir//mang thos sha tshugs rgyas pa'i mkhas mang yang / /gus bcas 'dzum pa'i mig gis khyod bltas te/ /dpyad gsum lam nas drang ba'i legs bshad dbyangs/ /nyan la ring ba'i yid kyis khyod drung 'du/ /'dab bzang ngang pas bsten pa'i chu gter bzhin/ /thar 'dod skal bzang skye bo khrag khrig 'bum/ /khyod la dge ba'i bshes kyi blo bzhag ste/ /gdams zab bdud rtsi'i bgo skal 'thung la 'dun/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims ljon bzang ma smad pa/ /ma ral ma 'dres shin tu dag gyur pas/ /mtshams sprin pir gyis bris 'dra'i bla gos 'di/ /khyod la mdzes par mi 'gyur 'ga' yang med/ /kha na ma tho'i rgyu ba mthar mdzad de/ /spong klog khrims kyi bslab pa'i 'dun khang na/ /khyod blo shin tu zhi ba brnyes gyur pas/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gral na khyod gcig 'phags/ /lhar bcas dregs dgu'i do ker 'khri 149

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shing rtser/ /khyod zhabs bkra shis mtshan ldan rtag 'god kyang / /khengs dang rgyags pas myos pa lta ci ste/ /chags med ye shes zhi ba lhag par rgyas/ /lha dbang lha rdzas 'byor bas khyod mchod kyis/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs snying po med gzigs te/ /'byor dgu'i longs spyod ring du brtul mdzad nas/ /bsod snyoms slong ba'i cho ga bstar ba lags/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod mchog brnyes pas/ /dbang po zhi zhing thugs kyang zhi gyur te/ /dul ba'i spyod lam ma rmas ma 'khrul ba/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i dpal gyis mdzes/ /su zhig log rtog rgol ba'i phyogs 'dzin kyang / /de la khyod kyis lhag par snying brtse zhing / /rigs lam rmad byung sman mchog bdud rtsi'i ros/ /nyes pa'i grub mtha' gos ral bzhin du mdzad/ /rtsod pa'i 'khrul 'khor bsham la nyer zhugs kyang / /gzhan phyogs pham dang rang nyid rgyal bzhed pa'i/ /phyogs lhung nyes pa gzhar yang ma mchis te/ /gsung rab zab mo'i dgongs don 'tshol phyir yin/ /skye bas thob pa'i shes rab phul byung zhing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i blo gros rtsal rdzogs pas/ /tshul gnyis theg pa'i gnad gsang kun gzigs te/ /shing rta chen po'i rnam thar dri med skyong / /'phags yul mkhas brgya'i rgyu skar rnam bkra'i dbus/ /'phags chen khyod kyi grags snyan zla ba'i gzis/ /gling bzhi'i 'khor yug 160

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1 'khyud mor bsdams byas pas/ /khri srong dad pa'i ku nud bzhad pa lags/ /bsod nams stong —gi dpal 'bar zhabs pad mos/ /bsil ljongs sā la'i sman tshal nyer bcags te/ /rgyal bstan gdus/sa dkar gcig gis sto ṭa'i gling / /khyab mdzad bka' drin mtshungs med zhi ba 'tsho/ /bka' drin gzhal bar nus min mkhan chen zhabs/ /bsngags pa'i gtam 'di sdeb sbyor mi legs mod/ /don gyi sbyor ba nyes par mi 'gyur gyi/ /blo gros ldan pas rna lung bzhin du chongs/ /zhes pa'ang 'gu log bi sprang phug ki bos smyo gtam thol byung mar ja gsum pa 'thung zhor la bris pa dge///161

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ra / /dpal chos kyi grags pa la bstod pa/shin tu zhi ba chos nyid zab mo'i dbyings/ /sgyu ma'i ye shes dag pa'i rol mo ru/ /snang ba'i zlos gar zhing khams mi mjed du/ /sgyur mdzad shing rta chen po chos grags zhabs/ /slob pa min pa'i ye shes chen po'i gar/ /ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gzugs su legs bsgyur te/ /'dzam bu'i grong khyer kun nas dge mdzad pa/ /'phags yul shing rta chen po chos grags zhabs/ /thub bstan nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba cher/ /log rtog sprin rum 'thug pos glags lta ba'i/ /rgol ngan ming mthar 'thag byed dngos stobs su/ /nyer zhugs spobs pa'i rlung lha chos grags zhabs/ /blo mchog mig stong rgyal pos nyer bzung ba'i/ /rigs pa mchog gi rdo rje gdengs stabs kyis/ /phas rgol lta min dmag tshogs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab chos grags zhabs/ /dpyad gsum shin tu rnam dag bde gshegs gzhung / /dri med tshad ma gnyis kyis legs bsgrub ste/ /zab dang rgya che theg pa gsum gyi tshul//srid na yun ring gnas mdzad chos grags zhabs/ /lha chen mkhas pa 'bum gyis 162

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdu / pod 1byin rlabs shing / /'phags yul mkhas pa du mas bsngags gyur pa'i/ /nu stegs mkhas pa stong gi dam bca'i nags/ /lung rigs zhugs kyis sbyangs mdzad chos grags zhabs/ /ji snyed chos kyi de nyid mngon gzigs phyir/ /sgrib bral mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' dpag par dka'/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal grags mkhas mkha' mthar gdal/ /che ba'i yon tan dpag med chos grags zhabs/ /skye ba brgyud mar lta ba log pa'i gnas/ /snying la rdo yi ris bzhin brtan byas pa'ang / /rigs lam me dpung lan cig 'bar ba'i gzis/ /ming gi lhag mar bgyid nus chos grags zhabs/ /chos la chos mig rdul bral mngon du brnyes/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi'i snang ba thob/ /log pa'i grub mtha' go zhig la mi bsnyengs pa/ /mkhas pa'i nang na rigs dbang chos grags zhabs/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung gtso bos byin rlabs shing / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa rnams yongs su rdzogs/ /gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol mo can/ /grub pa'i nang na dgyes mdzad chos grags zhabs/ /tshur mthong snang ngor rtog ge'i dbang phyug che/ /nyer bzhi'i gnas na grub pa'i dpa' bo che/ /'og min zhing du rigs brgya'i khyab bdag che/ /don la dbyer med dpal ldan chos grags zhabs/ /bde ba'i rang bzhin bde mchog te ru ka /rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon 153

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga chen po ru/ /yongs bzhengs bde ster mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang phyug chos grags zhabs/ /zab mo chos la gzigs pa phun sum tshogs/ /rgya che'i chos la shes rab rnam par dag /'phags pa'i chos la rang dbang shin tu 'byor/ /chos kyi dbang phyug chos rje chos grags zhabs/ /mtha' yas zhing na blo mchog mnga' bar grags/ /mkhas pa'i 'dun sar rigs smra'i gtso bor grags/ /'jig rten gsum na bdag nyid chen por grags/ /grags chen ldan pa mkhas mchog chos grags zhabs/ /'phags pa'i sar zhugs 'phags yul shing rta che/ /chos kyi grags pa bstod pa'i legs byas 'dis/ /lta log mun pa'i ri bo phyir bsnyil te/ /yang dag lta ba'i snang ba gsal bar shog /ces pa'ang sprang sbyon 'jigs med pas so////54

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga nga / /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po la bstod pa/legs byas lam bzang srong ba'i mnga' bdag rje/ /lugs gnyis bka' khrims btsan po'i ra ba las/ /chab srid 'da' ba ma yin mi yi dbang / /blo gros gting dpag dka' bas sgam po yin/ /mkha' la nyin byed shar ba'i 'od snang gis/ /'dab stong ge sar 'dzum pa'i mdangs brgya sbyin/ /sa dbang bka' mchid gtam gyis rab bskul te/ /thu mi'i snying stobs bzlo lhag par bzhad/ /ha ri tsan+dan tshal nas 'ongs pa'i rlung / /gang yang bsung zhim dri yi ngad kyis bgos/ srong btsan mi yi dbang pos bgyib kun/ /tshul bzang 'thad pa'i las kyi lhag par ba bos/ /'dab ldan ngang pa yongs kyi ded dpon ni/ /chu yi gter las 'o ma'i bcud bzang len/ /sa bdag srong btsan sgam po'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /rigs dang mi rigs brtags nas rigs pa sprub/ /gting zab chu yi phung po'i nye 'gram ni/ /nor gter nor bu'i rgyal pos kun nas gtams/ /sa skyong mi yi bdag po'i blo gros ni/ /yon tan brgya phrag brgya yis bsrung bar byas/ /mkha' la lding zhing rgyu ba'i 'khor lo can/ /de 166

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dag pad+ma'i mtsho la shin tu bsten/ /shes rab 'dab ma rgyas pa'i blo ldan rnams/ /srong btsan mgo nag rje bo'i mdun sar 'du/ /gser ri'i 'phreng ba dngar ba'i do ra na/ /brjid ldan lhun po'i rgyal po mchog tu 'phags/ /blo chen mkhas pa 'bum gyi gral dbus na/ /srong btsan bsod nams mchog gi brjid dang ldan/ /mu mtha' gzhal du yod min kun gsal la/ /mkha' lding shugs kyis bgrod kyang tshad bzung med/ /zab yangs blo gros mchog mnga' srong btsan thugs/ /dpa' mdzangs skye bos brtags kyang gting mi dpog /chu klung ji snyed 'bab pa de dag kun/ /phyogs mtha'i rgya mtshor gzhol zhing 'bab par 'gyur/ /srong btsan rgyal po'i mdzad pa ji snyed pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don phyir gzhol bar gyur/ /'dzam gling ljon shing me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /kun kyang ma dros mtsho las bskrun pa yin/ /gangs ljongs thub pa'i bstan la gang gnas pa/ /srong btsan blon lam 'phrul las nye bar 'ongs chu sprin snyug por bkod pa'i lto ba las/ /char bsil sbrang rtsi'i khang bzang gsos su 'bebs/ /srong btsan thugs bskyed rlabs chen sgyu 'phrul las/ /bdud rtsi'i chos char skal bzang gsos su 'bebs/ /tshad med snying brtses bskyangs pa'i drin chen mas/ /btang byas du sdug skyabs dang bral ba bzhin/ /gangs ljongs bka' drin mtshungs 156

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1med srong btsan gyis/ /rjes bzung skal bas dman gyur bdag ci byas/ /nyin mo'i dbang phyug nub gyur de ma thag /mi srun 'byung po'i bya tshogs dga' bar gyur/ /srong btsan zhi bar gzims nas bod khams ljongs/ /bdud dpung log par smra bas btab par 'gyur/ /bsil ldan chu klung rlan dang bral ba yi/ /gser mig gzhon nu'i sde tshogs bde mi 'gyur/ /byams ldan srong btsan mgon dang bral ba na/ /gangs ljongs yid can bde bas phongs par gyur/ /gling 'dir lo tog ji snyed smin gyur pa/ /de kun klu yi bdag po'i dpal las 'ong / /phan bde'i legs tshogs ji snyed mchis gyur pa/ /srong btsan ye shes dpal las nye bar 'ong / /mdor na zab mo'i mdo sde za ma tog /gang las gang zhig bstan pa'i yon tan tshogs/ /de kun de nyid gzigs pa'i srong btsan rjer/ /mnga' ba ma yin chos 'ga' yod ma lags/ /de slad gangs ri'i ljongs kyi mgon po gang / /mi 'bral dang ba'i yid kyisaXbasnyen byas te/ /bka' drin 'khor mtha' med pa'i srong btsan rjer/ /bstod tshig me tog dog pas cung zad bsngags/ /zhes pa'ang chos rgyal chen po la mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs can mdo khams kyi sprang phrug 'jigs med pas so// //157

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄/ /rgyal ba'i dngang po klong chen rab 'byams la bstod pa/dpal ngag gi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rta mchog grub pa'i rigs kyi thig ler pad+ma'i zhal ras bzhad pa dang / /lhan cig grags pa'i rta skad dbyangs snyan 'og min ba gam rtser son pas/ /'dod khams gtso mo dregs pa'i ral pa rlung gis ljon shing lo ma bzhin/ /bsnyil nas gang gi bran mor zhal 'ches rdo rje gzi brjid de la 'dud/ /mgon khyod gzhon nu'i na tshod la bzhugs tshe/ /dpal ldan gsang phu'i sum rtsen dga' ba'i tshal/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnga chen sgra yis bkang / /zla tshes phra yang nam mkha' dga' bar byed/ /de nas chos tshul me tog rab rgyas rig 'dzin gzhon nu rgyal po'i drung / /bsang don legs bshad zil dngar tshol la bung ba'i brtul zhugs gus mnos tshe/ /sde gsum klong dgu'i lung mang sbrang rtsi blo gros rkang pas nyer thob pa rab mang chu yi ljid kyis non pa'i dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin du gyur/ /rin chen mchog rnams rgya mtsho che'i/ /gting rum dag na dpal du gnas/ /khyod kyang sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /theg mchog bstan /68

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1la dpal du gyur/ /longs spyod dngos kun rtswa ltar bor yang ting 'dzin 'byor pa mtha' yas ldan/ /gcig pur zhi ba'i nags khrod bsten yang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du/ /bya ba dgu phrugs ring du btang yang mdzad pa rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub/ /sa lam yon tan gter bzhin sbas kyang grags pa'i yi ge phyogs mthar rgyu/ /zab mo'i blo gros blta dka' yang / /ston pa'i thabs la rab mkhas shing / /thugs rje nyid kyi gzhan dbang phyir/ /legs bshad snang ba brgya yis bstan/ /mchims phu'i gnas su snying thig 'chad tshe mtsho skyes rdo rjes zhal bstan cing / /rdo rje phag mos mngon sum dbang bskur sgog gyur gnas mang lung du bstan/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rags pa'i gzugs kyis gtor ma len cing dga' ba'i sgras/ /'jig rten cher g.yos de mthong mi rnam ngo mtshar rol mo brdung bas brel/ /ci tsam brtags kyang shes dka' ba/ /sangs rgyas theg pa'i gtsug tor rtse/ /khyod kyis nyi mas rdzas gzugs bzhin/ /sa ler snang ba'i bka' drin mdzad/ /zab gsal dri med mkha' ltar rab yangs mkhyen rab dam pa'i lang tsho ni/ /glegs bam rin chen me long ngos la yi ge'i gzugs su shar ba gang / /mdzod bdun zhes grags legs bshad rgya mtsho'i mdzes sdug nying khu bsags pa lta'i/ /sngon med ya mtshan skal bzang mkhas pa'i blo mig bdud 169

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/rtsir da lta'ang snang / /nor 'dod tshong pa chu yi rgya mtshor 'jug /mkhas rnams khyod kyi gsung rab rgya mtshor 'jug /chu gter rin chen sna tshogs 'byor bas gang / /khyod gsung zab don sna tshogs dpal gyis phyug /rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i sa 'og gnas dang skru gsum gtsang ris gzhal med khang / /legs bshad nor bu'i them skas spel legs rtsa ba brtan pos mtshams sbyar te/ /slob brgyud mkhas grub phreng ba'i phyi bzhin myur bar shog ces 'bod 'dra ba/ /sa mthor bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten 'dren pa snying rje zla med khyod phyag 'tshal/ /deng nas byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs kun/ /khyod kyi bka' brgyud dri med pad+ma las/ rdul bral chos kyi lus su skye 'gyur zhing / /theg mchog snying po'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /rdo rje'i gnas na 'od gsal lam byed bstan pa'i btsas/ /nom gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan gang bzhugs pa/ /khyod kyi bzi brjid nyi ma brgya bas reg mdzad de/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'di 'od zer phung po gcig tu mdzod/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa dpyid kyi pho nya zhes bya ba snying thig brgyud pa'i gral gzhug 'dzin pa/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas man ngag snying thig gi legs bshad la zhib tu blta ba'i skabs shig yid la ngo mtshar cher rgyas te mos gus kyi nyams dbyangs su bsdebs pa'o// //160

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mas//rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa la bstod pa/na mo gu ru a ba dī ba se na ya/ bsil ldan 'dzin ma'i 'khor yug rab yangs par/ /theg rgyal bstan pa'i ba dan 'dzin no cog /gang gi bka' drin bdud rtsis nyer 'tsho ba/ /rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling bar mgos phyag 'tshal/ /phul byung legs bshad 'od brgyas theg mchog zhing / /gsal nus klong chen nyin byed mnal ba na/ /mkhyen brtse'i cha gang 'jigs med zla ba khyod/ /lnga bdo'i mun gling skyob pa gcig pur byon/ /mchog grub smon pa'i me tog dus bzhin brjes/ /mtsho skyes lung gis rab bsngags bden pa bsten/ /brgyud 'dzin myu gu'i phreng ba'ang 'thon la phyogs/ /khyod 'khrungs tshe na 'di dag mnyam du byung / /la la ldum ra bzhin du gzhan gyis bskyangs/ /kha cig bung ba bzhin du ngal brgyas rnyed/ /khyod ni 'byung khungs mchog la gser bzhin du/ /lang tsho'i me tog ches phra'i gnas skabs na'ang / /sku tshe snga ma'i rmad byung mdzad pa dang / /skyabs gcig o rgyan bla ma rjes dran zhing / /byang chub thugs kyi gzhan dbang nyid gyur te/ /bsam yas yon tan ma btsal lhun 161

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstanas nyi'i gsung 'bum/gyis grub/ /pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob skyid grong rig 'dzin dang / /dri med gling pas chos kyi mdzod gtad cing / /don brgyud rtogs pa'i bang mdzod lde mig dang / /gter brgyud nor bu'i cod pan khyod la byin/ /theg mchog lam dang 'bras bu'i shing rta che/ /ci bder rgyu ba dka' spyad skrub pa'i srang / /ming tsam lhag mar gyur pa'i dus kyi mthar/ /sngon bzhin gsal mdzad mi ngal dpa' bo'i zla/ /byang chub mchog phyir rtag 'grus sbyor ba'i lam/ /g.yar dam bdun gyis brling ba legs bsten te/ /sna tshogs las dang g.yeng ba'i khyad par kun/ /nyer zhi'i stegs la ngal gso bgyid du bstsal/ /thun mong thun min byang chub sems gnyis kyi/ /rgya mtsho yongs rdzogs brtson pa'i hub gcig gis/ /gsol bas sangs rgyas snying po rab bskul te/ /rdo rje gsum mchog grub pa'i lang tsho rgyas/ /de tshe rang snang rdo rje'i 'og min du/ /ting 'dzin mchog gi bde bas dgyes rol ba'i/ /khyod kyi 'byor pa ci 'dra de lta bu/ /sa gsum dbang po rnams la'ang yod ma yin/ /'on kyang zas gos ngan ngon gyis 'tsho zhing / /rdo ba'i mal stan sra ba tsam bltas nas/ /skal pa ngan zhes snying rjer sems pa 'gas/ /phal dang dam chos ring bar mna' chu btung / /rmongs pas khrel ba'i bsnying tshig rlung la bskur/ /dam pa'i rnam thar bdud rtsi ngoms med gsol/ /de mthus 'jig rten 162

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1blun po'i spyod yul brgal/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i go 'phang rab mchog brnyes/ /khyad par sngon sbyangs yon tan gter gyi rgya/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i 'phrul gsang gis phye bas/ /spang blang sems 'dzin rtsol ba'i sgrog mdud grol/ /kun bzang dgongs pa'i rtsal chen phyogs med rgyas/ /yul snang kun rtog ri mo'i 'phrul du gzigs/ /rtog tshogs rig rtsal sgyu ma'i 'khor lor shar/ /rig pa gdod nas nom dag dbyings dang 'dres/ /nyag gcig thig le'i klong du chos kun rdzogs1 /zhib la grangs mang shes bya'i rdul phran dang / /bsam gyis mi khyab gnas lugs zab mo'i gting / /mtha' dag rang gnas ye shes gcig kho na'i/ /gnad la brten nas phyag mthil rdzas bzhin gzigs/ /rgyal ba rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang / /ka dag bdod ma'i dbyings su thugs yid 'dres/ /lhun grub 'od gsal zhing du bgro ba mdzad/ /'gro 'dul rgyal tshab skyes bur byin gyis brlabs/ /dag pa rnams la rgyan byed gzhan yang 'byung / /rnyog bral chu la zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /gang bar gyur kyang 'gengs phyir brtson pa yod/ /rgya mtsho che la phyogs bzhi'i chu klung bzhin/ /de bzhin mgon khyod dgongs pa rnam dag cing / /ye shes dgos 'byung nor bu'i gter brnyes pas/ /dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i chos mdzod nas/ /snying thig sprul pa'i glegs 163

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bam char du bsnyil/ /ring nas rnal 'byor goms pa'i byi dor gyis//shin tu sbyangs pa mkhyen brtse'i dwangs shel 'od/ /bse ru'i brtul zhugs za ma tog nang du/ /sbas kyang rang byung pad+ma'i thugs bskyed dang / /klong chen dgongs pa'i 'od zer gyis bskul te/ /sngon med legs bshad 'od lnga'i ri mo yis/ /rgyal bstan nam mkha' brgyan pa'i dpal mthong nas/ /phyogs kyi mdzes ma kun dga'i ca co 'phel/ /zab yangs dgongs pa gting mtha' mi mngon yang / /ma 'dres yon tan gzugs brgyas gsal bkra ba/ /khyod kyis blta bas mi ngoms gzugs can lnga'i/ /grags pa'i ba dan bltar mi mngon par sbas/ /de yis nyer bos skal bzang slob ma'i tshogs/ /skrub dang zang zing mchod pa'i char rgyun bcas/ /khyod kyi spyan sngar 'du zhing slar gyes pa/ /dbyar dus mkha' la sprin gyi 'du 'god bzhin/ /bdag nyid chos tshul legs par bsgom pa dang / /gzhan phan smon lam sgrub dka' grub pa dang / /brgyud gsum gdams pa'i byin rlabs bcud 'dus pas/ /khyod la su bsten 'dun ma legs pa'i rtse/ /mkhas rmongs bar ma'i blo yi rim pa dang / /mos pa'i bye brag las 'phro'i khyad par sogs/ /so sor gang 'tshams 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen pas/ /gzhan don spyod la bsnyengs dang bral ba lags/ /stobs 'byor rigs gzugs rab 'bring tha ma 164

stod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dang / /byams sdang bar mar gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs/ /snyoms paraXrjes 'dzin dman la lhag bar brtse/ /dul zhing g.yo med gcig tu phan 'dogs brtson/ /mthon pos bkur dang dman pas brnyas la sogs/ /cis kyang mi 'gyur 'chad la skyo ngal spangs/ /sa ltar 'gro ba kun gyi rten gnas 'os/ /khyod 'dra'i mgon bcas skye dgu skal ba bzang / /gang gis theg mchog seng ge'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /mtha' dbus yul gru phal cher khyab gyur te/ /snying po'i lam bzang bshad dang sgrub pa yi/ /dga' ston sa steng brgyud mar grags pa byung / /bzas zhag bdun nyi ma rtod la bzung / /mthu stobs mgon zhes grags pas sa gsum 'dar/ /khyod kyis snying po'i bstan pa nub ka'i dus/ /da dung rtod la bzung ba mthong ba'i chos/ /yon tan rang bzhin rtsi sman rgyal po ltar/ /sems can don du bdag nyid yongs bsngos pa/ /khyod la chu thigs tsam gyi dge bskyed kyang / /byang chen rgya mtsho'i 'jings su ro gcig 'gyur/ /de phyir khyod mtshan brjod dang rnam thar bsngags/ /dad pas gsol 'debs bka' la ri mor byed/ /gang yang phyir mi ldog pa'i skal ldan du/ /pad 'byung rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar bsngags/ /ji srid tshangs pa'i me tog yid bzhin mtsho/ /gangs can 'dzin ma'i dpal du gnas de srid/ /mtsho skyes rnam 'dren ngang pa'i rgyal po 165

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yang / /dgyes pa'i 'phur lding bod la rtsen par 'gyur/ /de sgad bsil ljongs 'gro ba'i phan bde ni/ /khyod zhal mthong grol zla ba'i rjes 'gro bas/ /da dung dgyes spyan gzigs pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /bod 'bangs skyong ba'i mchog 'di khyod la slong / /grangs med rig 'dzin zhing nas dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gros bstod dbyangs rol mo'i sprin gtibs pa/ /khyod kyi yon tan bdag 'dras dpog min yang / /rang yid rab dga'i ca co phreng bar bsdebs/ /de ltar bstod las byung ba'i dge tshogs rgyun/ /gang mchis khyod thugs bzhed pa'i klong rum du/ /'dres nas 'od gsal theg pa'i chos 'khor gyis/ /'gro kun gdod ma'i dbyings su byang chub shog /bdag kyang srid par rgyu ba'i rabs kun tu/ /khyod zhabs gtsug gi rgyan du mi 'bral zhing / /theg mchog gdams pa'i ro bcud rtag 'thung bas/ /rtsal rdzogs dag pa'i dbyings la dbang sgyur shog /kun mkhyen rig 'dzin bla ma 'jigs med gling pa la bstod pa dad brgya'i pad+mo rgyas byed bdud rtsi'i zil char zhes bya ba/ kad kor sprul pa'i sku 'jigs med rdo rje dpa' bos srid du ring ba'i lha rdzas kyi skyes dang bcas te bskul ba'i ngor dang / rang nyid kyi dad pa'i gsos su'ang bsams te/ /sprang rgan bstan pa'i nyi mas bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ //166

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1༄/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jigs rmed phrin las 'od zer la rtogs brjod dang 'brel bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i me hog ces bya ba/ —na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye/ /rang byung pad+mas 'jigs med chos kyi khrir/ /sangs rgyas phrin las byed por dbang bskur ba/ /skal bzang pad+mo'i gnyen gyur ye shes kyi/ /'od zer snang ba'i gter chen de la 'dud/ /khyod kyis sngon tshe dus mtha'i 'gro ba la/ /pad+ma'i zab gter sbyin par zhal bzhes ltar/ /bsil ldan chos kyi snang bas 'geng mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rjer gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /de las slar yang rab nyi khro bo'i lor/ khams kyi shar phyogs rdo rol 'dzin ma'i char/ /bod chung zhes bya sprug po gdong rigs su/ /skye ba'i myu gu bzung la gsol ba 'debs/ /bltams tsam nyid nas tshe rabs dran pa dang / /snying rje che zhing yi ge'i ma mo tsam/ /sbyangs pas klog mthar son pa'i mkhyen rab kyis/ /dpyod ldan yid 'phrog mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /de tshe sngags spyod )67

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsungs 'bum/dpa' bo'i gzugs can gyis/ /chos 'khor bskal ba'i mar me gsal 'bar dang / /glegs bam gter kha gtad nas de dag gi/ /bdag por lung bstan stsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgung grangs bco lngar shes rab rin chen las/ /skyabs sdom rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur dang //thun mong lam rim gdams pa legs nos te//nyin mtshan chos kyis 'das la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyer gcig lo nang dwags lha sgam por byon/ /mi pham dbang pos dge bsnyen nyid du bsgrubs/ /dharma shā rar bka' gdams lam rim dang / /chos drug zab khrid brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /cig char gnas su phag mo gsum ldan mar/ /mjal ba'i rkyen gyis gang snang bde bar shar/ /bde ba'ang mi dmigs dbyings dang ro gcig 'dres/ /ye shes byin chen zhugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /khams su gdan btegs ze chen kun rnam dang / /nges don zhabs sogs mkhas grub du ma las/ /dbang lung man ngag bdud rtsi ngoms med gsol//chos kyi rgya mtshor gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang yul bzhud tshe rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /mjal zhing tshangs dbyangs rnga sgra gsan pa'i mod/ /'jig rten chos kyis mi gos pad+ma lta'i/ /rgyal sras spyod mchog brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /ru dam gnas su sgrub la rtse gcig tu//bzhugs tshe 'tshub lhong drag po brgyud ma ru/ /byung rnams 168

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1lta dgongs nus pas zil mnan nas/ /rtogs pa'i bogs chen thon la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus der mnal lam o rgyan slob dpon ches/ /gser mdog bdud rtsi'i chu yis dbang bskur zhing / /dka' spyad dus su mi min skye bo yis/ /mngon sum zhal zas phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /bod skyong mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo tshe ring mas//rang gi gnas su spyan drangs zhabs tog bstabs/ /phyogs der lo bzhir 'das par rim gnyis kyi/ /rnal 'byor rgyun chags bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de nas nam zhig bstan bcos yon tan mdzod/ /gzigs las mos gus gdung bas rgyud bskul te/ /tshe rabs mang por rjes bzung rigs kyi bdag /kun mkhyen zhabs pad bsnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon des snga 'gyur bka' gter rab 'byams kyi/ /gdams ngag dbang bskur bum pa gang byos stsal/ /gzhon nu sangs rgyas smon lam dus smin pa'i/ /rten 'brel srog rtsa mthud la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs bskyed bzhes tshe 'od srung rgyal ba yi/ /sku gdung gter kha bzhes pa'i mnal lam gzigs/ /byang chub che drung yab sras lhan cig tu/ /bzang po spyod smon btab la gsol ba 'debs/ dgongs 'dus dbang bskur dus su dpon slob gnyis/ /nyang ral sangs rgyas gling par gyur pa'i tshul/ /ye shes me long ngos su sgrib med gzigs/ /sngon sbyangs 169

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las 'phro sad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam yas dbu rtser gu ru'i snang brnyan ni/ /grangs med 'phel ba'i rgyu tshogs rten 'brel las/ /phrin las dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas 'gyur zhes/ /lung bstan me tog 'thor la gsol ba 'debs/ yab rje'i spyan sngar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang / /'bad rtsol chen pos spyan dbye'i zhabs tog mdzad//bdog dgu rtsal sprugs mchod pa lan bzhi sogs/ /mnyes pa mthar phyin bsgrubs la gsol ba 'debs/ kun mkhyen rje yis snying thig bstan pa'i mdzod/ /bzung nas gzhan don spyod par bkas gnang zhing / /nyid dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ /dgongs klong ro gcig 'dres la gsol ba 'debs/ /ris bral rten gsum dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ /rgya cher mchod cing sgrub gnas gsum sogs su/ /bsnyen skrub sbyin sreg tshogs kyi 'khor lo yis/ /rtsa gsum dgyes pa skyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /dur khrod gnyan sa mang por gcod yul mdzad/ /tshad lhong mthar phyin gcan gzan khro bo dang / /kla klo gtsang po la sogs thug phrad du/ /zil gnon brtul zhugs grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbus gtsang mtha' dag 'dar nus bal po'i dmag /lhags tshe be har dbang bsdus brtul zhugs kyis/ /phas rgol sos ka'i than sprin bzhin mdzad de/ /rgyal bstan nus mthus bsrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /170

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ru bzhir than pas nyen la rjes brtse yis/ /sbyin sreg mdzad pa'i thal ba mtshor gshegs pas/ /mod la char gyi rgyun bzang 'dzad med babs/ /'gro mang sdug bsngal bskyabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnam mtshor bde ldan zhing gi bkod pa gzigs/ /tsa ri seng ge la rtser yo rgyan rje/ /mngon sum zhal mthong gsol 'debs mdzad pa'i mod/ /ye shes dbyings gcig gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /klu ring mdung rtse gya gyu'i gzhi bdag dang / /chu rgyud dge bsnyen la sogs dregs pa rnams/ /byang chub thugs kyi nus pas dbang gyur nas/ /dang bas sri zhu bgyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rgyal sde dge'i bstan srid srung ba dang / /byang rgyud rig 'dzin gling gi sa 'dul dus/ /mi mthun bdud dpung pham pa'i rtags mtshan gyis/ /grags pa'i rgyal rnga brdung la gsol ba 'debs/ /bra rong phyogs su bud med glu skad dang / /lhun grub steng du tshogs zangs sgra gsan pas/ /lkog gyur bde sdug du ma'i ngang tshul mkhyen/ /rten 'brel rang byan chud la gsol ba 'debs/ /brag dkar sprel rdzong 'phags pa'i sgrub gnas su/ /rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gzhol/ /dag pa rab 'byams rang snang ris med kyi/ /dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sog yul byon tshe grog po skam po'i nang / /dal 'gro'i klung chen 'babs pa'i 171

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dge mtshan gyis/ /yid drangs har han tā le bla ma zhes/ /skye dgus mgrin gcig bsngags la gsol ba 'debs/ /jo nang dpon gyis zhus te mchod gnas mdzad/ /phyogs der phan bde'i legs tshogs spel sgad du/ /mngon mkhyen nus stobs zad mi shes pa bstan/ /'brel tshad don ldan mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang wang dang sgo me chos rjes mtshon/ /skal ldan mang por snying thig chos char phabs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug byams pa dge legs kyis/ /'jig rten bla mar bsngags la gsol ba 'debs/ /gong ma'i lung gis mda' tshan bcu gnyis kyi/ /bla mar bskos sogs rnyed bkur cher byung yang / /zhen med smon lam mthun pa'i gdul bya'i ched/ /dgongs te bod yul byon la gsol ba 'debs/ /yongs shar shug chen gnyis su gtsug lag khang / /bskrun tshe rdo yi glegs bu'i gter kha phyungs/ /bskal bzang rgyud ris bka' 'gyur glegs bam sogs//dkon mchog rten mang bzhengs la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang sde dge lto byang khams hor dang / /rdo 'dzi smar dang zla snyi gser khog kun/ /zhabs kyis legs bcag skye dgu bgrang yas pa/ /zhal mthong 'brel bas bsdus la gsol ba 'debs/ /de dag rnams su 'khon sdum 'dre 'dul dang / /mngon shes la brten blang dor gnas mang bstan/ /mchod sbyin srog bslu rten bzhengs rgyas par 172

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1spel/ /gzhan phan sgo mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhag par dbang bskur sbyin sreg rab gnas dang / /gnas lung myong grol bdud rtsi'i sbyin pa sogs/ /rnam mang sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba yis/ /gdul bya'i don chen bskrubs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de tshe sgrub brtson ngag dbang chos 'byor dang / /ngor chen byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med sogs/ /dam pa mang por zab chos bdud rtsi bzhes//'chad spel phrin las bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab yid lcags rtar 'brong ri sprug po'i zhol/ /sbyang tshad lung pa pad+ma'i dbyibs can du/ /lha khang sgrub sde'i bkod pa gsar bskrun nas/ /mi g.yo'i chos stan bzung la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas der gtan pa med pa'i chos sbyin la/ /mdo khams sde dge nas bzung rgyal rong dang / /reb kong sog yul bar gyi gdul bya'i tshogs/ /nyi zer rdul bzhin 'khrigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /snying thig gong 'og mdzod bdun ngal gso gsum/ /rgyud 'bum la sogs chos 'khor 'byams klas kyis/ /rnying bstan gru bzhir rgyas pa'i sa bon btab/ /bstan 'dzin phreng ba spel la gsol ba 'debs/ khyad par thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /rdzogs chen snying thig sgom pa'i rnal 'byor khyus/ /mdo khams ri sul kun tu khyab mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob che la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyem gnas 173

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma rnams kyang yang dag lta ba dang / /mi 'che'i brtul zhugs 'dzin la rab sbyar zhing / /yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims dang yig drug sgras/ /sa steng rgyas par bkang la gsol ba 'debs/ /rmongs rtul blun po 'dus pa'i mtha' 'khob tu/ /mtho ris thar par bgrod pa'i lam bzang po/ /tshong dus srang ltar gsal ba khyod kyi drin/ /long ba mib 'byed khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /jo shaka zhal bltar lam gyis ngal ba rnams/ /dbugs 'byin zas kyi yo byad rkyen sbyar zhing / /bsam yas zhig gsor stong dngul gsum lhag gis/ /mthun rkyen zhabs tog phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /mchu zla'i tshes bcur bde gshegs rigs 'dus kyi/ /dkyil 'khor bzhengs sgrub mchod pa'i rgyun btsugs te/ /'gro ba'i re skong bsod nams dpag bsam shing / /pha mtha' yas par bskrun la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar sangs rgyas zhing la dge rtsa bskyed/ /theg mchog chos la bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ /grangs med gdul bya'i 'jig rten smin mdzad cing / /sku tshe mthar phyin bzhugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyu mchog cho 'phrul zla ba'i bcu gsum nyin/ /'ja' 'od me tog char gyis nam mkha' bkang / /de yi nam phyed longs sku'i chas zhugs te/ /'od gsal chos skur gzims la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod skru zhugs kyis sbyangs pa'i lhag mas kyang / /bstan 'gro'i don chen byed par 174

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1zhal gyis bzhes/ /dus rnams kun tu rtsi sman sdong po ltar/ /lus can nyer 'tshor gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod rnam thar nor bu'i rgyud mangs ni/ /mos gus sor rtses bskul ba'i rtogs brjod dbyangs/ /cung zad blangs 'dis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /theg mchog bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin shog /tshe rabs phreng bar dpal ldan bla ma mchog /thabs tshul kun gyis mnyes pa lhur len cing / /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus mthar dbyung ste/ /sa gsum bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog/ //ces pa'ang gam du 'khod pa'i dge tshul 'jigs med chos kyi blo gros kyis grub rje'i rnam thar gsol 'debs go bde ba zhig rtsom zhes nan gyis bskul ba ltar/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phreng bar gsol ba btab ste/ rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus chen la bris pa 'brel tshad rig 'dzin bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / //7ku

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brgya/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la bstod pa/gang gi rmad byung thabs dang snying rje'i mthus/ /'og min zhing gi sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi/ /dbang bskur bdud rtsi'ang rab dman bdag lta bu'i/ /skal bar thob mdzad drin chen chos kyi rje/ /khyod kyi yon tan dran pas mchi ma g.yo/ /bka' drin phreng ba rjes dran thal mo sbyor/ /da dung byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs kun/ /khyod zhabs spyi bos nod par smon lam 'debs/ /gang gi ze'u 'brur mgon po khyod bltams pas/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun dga'i glu len pa/ /gnyos zhes grags pa'i rigs kyi pad+ma dkar/ /yon tan 'dab brgya ldan la'ang mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gang du mgon khyod skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /bris pa'i dge mtshan yun ring gnas gyur pa/ /gter lhung zhes bya yi ge'i me tog gis/ /mdzes pa'i yul 'khor de la'ang mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig ma bon khyod lhums kyi pad+mo las/ /rnam par grol ba'i lang tsho'i gzi 'od kyis/ /skye dgu kun gyi bsod nams zhing mdzad pa/ /ri bo de'u chung de la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /rje btsun 'khrungs tshe dbu steng yar ngo yi/ /rdzogs pa 176

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dang po'i gdugs mdzes nyer bzung ste/ /srid zhi'i 'byor pa rgyas mdzad res kyi gza'/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i sras la'ang mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig rig 'dzin gzhon nu'i zla ba ni/ /dang por 'char tshe rang gi yon tan tshogs/ /sa la dga' ston bshams pa ltar bkod pa/ /rgyu skar lha mo nab so de la'ang 'dud/ /kun mkhyen rje khyod lan re dran pas kyang / /snying gi gdung ba sel phyir gal te khrod/ /rjes dran mtshan mar 'gyur na de yi slad/ /de'u mgo'i khyi rnams la'ang bdag phyag 'tshal/ /li thur bdun pa'i nyer bdun la gza' skar 'di gnyis 'dzom par kha byang thebs pa mthong bas rkyen byas te bla ma dran nas so// // ra / /na mo gu ru lo ki shā ra ya/ 'jam zhing zab pa rdo rje'i gsung dbyangs ni/ /mkhyen brtse'i lha mchog 'jig rten dbang po ru//rnam par shir ba'i ngo mchir sgro ma la/ /mi 'phrog dang ba'i me rtog gru char 'beb/ /khyod kyis bsil ldan ljongs 'dir mi dbang dang //paṇa grub lo tsā khyem bdag dra ma sogs/ du ma'i gzugs kyis phan bde'i gdugs dkar ni/ /rtsibs brgyar bres pa'i drin la su mi gus/ /lhag par snyigs ma las kyang cher snyigs pa'i/ /dus kyi rgya mtsho zab mor lhung gyur pa/ /bdag cag brtse chen gru yis rjes 'dzin phyir/ /phyogs 'dir skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul bstan la 'dud/ /177

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mkhas shing drang la blo gros brtan gyur cing / /gtong dang ngo tsha shes pa'i nor ldan pa/ /chen po'i rigs kyi nang du khyod bltams te/ /'byung khungs bzang po'i gser bzhin mkhas pas bkur/ /pad dkar rgyas pa'i zhal mnga' khyod kyi sku/ /lhums kyi khang brtsegs nang nas byung ma thag /gsal rdzogs drang srong dul ba'i cha byad kyis/ /'gro la tshangs pa'i spyod tshul slob pa bzhin/ /mtshan mos nyi 'od gur gum 'thor ba dang / /'bab chu'i na chung 'o ma 'jo ba sogs/ /bkra shis ltas kyi me tog ma rnyings pa/ /mang po'ang khyod bltams dus su byung bar gyur/ /mthun pa'i 'khor dang dam pa'i nye du dang / /chos bzhin bsgrubs pa'i nor dang rig pa yi/ /gzi brjid ldan slad khyim na gnas tshe yang / /khyod kyis 'jig rten phal cher zil gyis mnan/ /gzhon yang rgyan pa'i brtan dang zhi la gnas/ /mtho yang ma dregs skye bo'i bran ltar mdzad/ /'byor yang phyi phyir mngon par 'byung la dgyes/ /gsal yang dbongs pa'i gting ni dpag par dka'/ /khyod sngon nag po chen po gdong bzhi pas/ /sil snyan 'khrol ba'i dbyangs kyis sa skya pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin tshogs kyi dbus su spyan drangs ltar/ /dus 'dir sa ngor mkhas pa'i mgon du byon/ /bde ldan zhing du tshe dpag med mgon las/ /rgyal tshab dbang bskur cod pan nod pa ltar/ /'dir yang rgyal 178

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ba'i gdung 'tshob che rnams las/ /sdom gsum me tog gtsang ma'i thod rgyan bzhes/ /rab 'byams zhing na rgyal sras 'khor gyi dbus/ /pheg mchog 'chang ba'i skyes bur gyur zin yang / /chos smra'i drung na thal mo sbyar btud de/ /gus bcas lung mang nod pa'i gzugs su'ang snang / /brtan yang chos la gus pa'i dbang gyur pas/ /mkhas pa gnas pa'i yul nas yul kun rgyus/ /khyod kyis gsan pa'i yol gos ma bzung ba'i/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi thogs pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /skye dgu chos la ri mo mi byed phyir/ /rgyal bstan gzi 'od nyams pa'i dus mtha' 'dir/ /sngon byon dpa' bo rnams kyis chos tshol srol/ /gsal nus seng ge'i mthu rtsal khyod kyis bstan/ /mthu chen khyod lta bu yi dben pa'i bde/ /'du 'dzi phyi rol nyes pas ga la brdzi/ /de lta'ang gdul ba'i 'jig rten smin slad du/ /dus kun 'du 'dzis skyo ba'i spyod tshul bstan/ /legs tshogs rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten pa nas/ /rgyud rgyal rdo rje rtse mo'i zab lam bar/ /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi/ /ba dan phyogs kyi bu mos mthong ba btsugs/ /tshul khrims la gnas mang du thos pa dang / /mang thos snying po sgrub la 'dril byed pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i lag len ma nor ba/ /khyod kyi rnam thar brtags las shes par 'gyur/ /bstan 'dzin gtso bo khyod kyi rjes 179

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/slob pa/ /bshad sgrub stobs kyi 'khor los thub bstan gling / /dbang sgyur mkhas dang grub pa'i khyu mchog brgyas/ /gnas dang gnas su rdzogs ldan thig le bkod/ /dam chos 'chad dang 'bri dang spel ba dang / /de bzhin chos 'dul rab byung bsngags pa dang / /rnam mang longs spyod sgo nas bsnyen bkur sogs/ /thabs tshul du mas bstan la sman yon btags/ /gdul bya'i khams dang 'dul byed thabs kyi sgo/ /bsam mi khyab phyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun/ /mar dang mar gyi nying khu mthun pa bzhin/ /bdud rtsi'i ro gcig nyid du khyod kyis gsungs/ /ston pa mnyam med de yi bstan 'dzin ni/ /mchog dman gang gi'ang nyes pa mi gleng zhing / /de dag yon tan sen rtse'i rdul tsam yang / /sangs rgyas zhabs rdul lta bur dbu la 'jog /chos spong las kyi g.yang sar phyogs rnams kyang / /khyod bsnyen khyod kyi spyod tshul la bltas na/ /bde blag chos kyi lam du 'gro 'gyur bas/ /khyod ni lus can chos kyi zam pa lags/ /khyad par sngags rgyud kun la ches mkhas shing / /rab 'byams 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa mthar son te/ /'gro la dbang bskur sbyin pa'i mdzad pa yis/ /zung 'jug lam srol lam po che bzhin bgyis/ /dpal ldan te ru ka yi gsang mdzod nas/ /sngon med rdo rje'i chos gter spyan drangs te/ /thun mong min pa'i las dang skal ldan 180

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rnams/ /rdo rje chos dang skal pa mnyam par bsgrubs/ /sna tshogs grub mtha'i man ngag me tog gi/ /ldum ra'i tshal la nyin bzhin rtog mdzad de/ /gang gang rnyid dang 'khrugs pa de dang de/ /gso dang rnal mar 'jog la brtson zhing bzhugs/ /khyod ni grags pa'i dri bsung ring 'phro zhing / /mchog tu dga' skyed gzugs kyi dpal mnga' dang / /chos dang zang zing btung ba'i rgyun mang bas/ /dbyar dus sprin bzhin gdul bya'i dung ba 'du/ /dam chos sgrom chen bde gshegs za ma tog /khyod kyi zhal ras mthong dang zab mo'i dbyangs/ /thos dang tshul khrims dri yis phog pa'i 'gro/ /dza lha'i gling 'dir 'ongs pa legs pa yin/ /bden spru goms pa'i bsod nams gzi 'bar ba/ /khyod gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs mthon po yis/ /rgya mchos gos can lha yi rnga bo ches/ /swa snyi sgrogs pa'i nam mkha' bzhin du mdzes/ /de mthus chos min 'byung po'i dmag sde ni/ /stobs kyi rgyal mtshan bsnyil nas ring du byer/ /srid pa'i grong 'dir dri med mngon mtho dang / /nges legs chos kyi dga' ston dpag yas byung / /lha min khros pa'i dpung bcas kla klo rnams/ /mgon khyod ji srid bzhugs par gzi med de/ /mthu stobs rdo rje rwa bas mtshams bcad phyir/ /de dag bsil ba'i ljongs 'dir dus mang rdugs/ /gdug can 'byung po bsad bskrad gzir ba dang / /181

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brtan g.yo'i dngos kun lhag par gnas pa dang / /bkra shis tshe dang bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa sogs/ /rnam pa mang pos sa steng phan bde spel/ /ci mdzad chos kyi mtshams las mi 'da' dang / /de dag kun kyang ris su ma chad pa'i/ /bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tsho kho nar 'jug pa 'di/ /bston med gzu bo'i blo ldan kun la grub/ /bstan pa spyi yi sa chen skyong ba khyod/ /rang 'tshos ngoms pa ston rlom gdol ba'i khyur//sre ba'i rmongs pa mthong nas bdag gis ni/ /mthong thos gdangs snyan lta bu'i nga ro sgrog /chos kun sgra brnyan lta bur gzigs pa'i spyan/ /khyod la bstod smad mtha' dag mnyam gnas kyang / /rang gi yid la dbe ba gnas bya'i phyir/ /bstod pa brgyus pa'i phreng 'di brtse bas bzhes/ /de yi dge bas byang chub thob bar gyi/ /tshe rabs kun tu khyod kyis rjes 'dzin zhing / /smon dang spyod pa mtha' dag mgon khyod dang / /mthun par bslab nas khyod brnyes 'gyur bar shog /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dge slong gi gzugs su rnam par rol pa la cung zad bsngags pa'i tshig gi phreng ba pad+ma dkar po'i char zhes bya ba rdo rong gi sprang po 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas 'phar ba'i lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa dang por bkra legs mdangs chen gyi ri bo'i gtsug lag khang du mchod pa'i rol mor dkrol ba'o/ /swa ste ku ru// //18 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ba ra / /rgya gar chos kyi yul gru na/ /paṇa chen 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byung / /mkhas grub rnam thar ches 'phags kyang / /rin chen gling na khyad 'phags mang / /gangs can sa yi lte ba ru/ /chos rgyal tshangs pa'i me tog bltams/ /mdzad pa'i phyag rjes phul byung yang / /dus bzang mi la phul byung mang / /bod chen dus kyi rgud pa'i nang / /mkhyen brtse yid bzhin gter kha rdol/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pas 'gro mang btul/ /dgun skyes pad+ma ngo mtshar che /da dung ngo mtshar gzhan yang mthong / /pad+ma mdo khams yul 'khrungs te/ /zla ba'i rgyal po bdun cur gnas/ /dri bsung mkha' 'gro'i gling kun khyab/ /sbrang rtsi dga' ldan lha yang 'thung / /de yi rdzi phyobs la brten yang / /ge sar ro bcud mi 'dod cing / /bkres pa'i me yis lto zhum la/ /mi gsal glu ni 'dzer 'dzer bos/ /smre zhing lce tsha'i me tog tshal/ /'phyan pas ngal ba skal chad kyi/ /dung ba 'di dag ches ngo mtshar/ /tshul khrims bzhin du dri bzang ldan/ /ting nge 'dzin ltar rab dga' byed/ /shes rab bzhin du snying por gyur/ /byams pa lta bur mnyes gshin pa/ /dam pa'i chos ltar rab bzang ba'i/ /pad+ma mchog de'i mthu dpal gyis/ /de tshe sa 'di skal bzang ldan/ /dkar po'i so phreng dgod pas mdzes/ /de 'dra mthong bas yid rab dwangs/ /rdzi tshor tsam yang bkra shis 'byung / /bzung na 183

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mchog gi bde ba ster/ /sangs rgyas phyag gi pad+ma 'dra/ /de ni pad+ma'i sa bon mdzod/ /de yi 'khor gyi pad+ma ni/ /sa bon tsam dang sbal mig 'thon/ /kha 'bus yid tsam phye ba dang / /mchog tu cher rgyas la sogs pa/ /gnas skabs sna tshogs la gnas pas/ /lho byang phyogs rnams brgyan gyur pa/ /rgyu skar tshogs kyis nam mkha' bzhin/ /de la pad+ma'i 'khor los sgyur/ /rang byung pad+ma rgyal pos kyang / /pad+ma 'od brgya gsal ba zhes/ /yi ge'i me tog cod pan byin/ /legs tshogs phung po des bzung bas/ /bod khams pad+mo'i zhing du gyur/ /de yi dpal 'byor gyis dregs nas/ /bung ba'i 'jig rten ca co 'phel/ /kye ma'o bdud rtsi grub pa yi/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i me tog kyang / /sngon bzhin bsdus nas mi snang ste/ /dri medaXdabyings su nye bar zhi/ /'gro la chos dang bde ba yi/ /don chen byas nas mnal ba ni/ /zla bas ku mu ta tshogs la/ /bdud rtsi bsnun nas nub pa bzhin/ /de nas sa steng phal cher stong / /bkrag med gzi byin rab tu rgad/ /yul noms 'brog dgon nyam ngar song / /phyogs kyi bud med rgyan dang bral/ /kun nas bzang dang dge ba dang / /dag pa zhes bya phal cher nub/ /ngan la bkra mi shis pa dang / /khrag gis sbags pa'i rdzas dag byung / /skye dgu pad+ma'i cho rigs dang / /brtul zhugs dag las ring du nyams/ /dmyal ba spu gri'i lam 'dra ba'i/ /spyod tshul ngan la 184

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1yon tan rtsi/ /pad+ma'i nags na bag yangs su/ /sprang chang 'thung ba'i yul rnams kyang / /phyogs mtha'i glang chen khro bo rnams/ /brgyugs nas nyin bzhin slog cing 'joms/ /blo ldan 'di 'dra'i gnas skabs mthong / /phyir zhing dam pa'i yon tan dran/ /rmongs pa phung 'tsheng dpyod mi shes/ /sman dang dug lo mtshungs par sems/ /gtsang ma zhi ba'i chos dag ni/ /pad+ma'i ngang tshul yin par brjod/ /de la rtswa dang 'drar sems pa'i/ /mi yis pad+ma ji ltar 'thob/ /gang phyir pad+ma pad+ma yi/ /ngang tshul dga' ba'i dpal du 'ong / /nyes spyod mi yis rab gdungs pa'i/ /skal par pad+ma ji ltar mdzes/ /'on kyang thub bstan ma nub pas/ /dge legs lhag ma da dung mchis/ /bkra shis dngos kun de las byung / /da dung de ltar 'byung lags grang // //186

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄ / /dpal ldan bla ma dam ba la bstod pa dang /dam chos shog spe brgyad pa'i chos 'byung gi rtsa tho dang / snga 'gyur rnal 'byor chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang gi chu bo bzhi'i rnam bshad rnams gzhi mthun par sprur ba dge legs rgya mtsho'i rol mo zhes bya ba/oṃ swa ste/ pad+ma 'byung gnas 'od gsal sgyu drwa'i gar/ /snyigs dus mdo sngags bstan pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /grags pa gling 'di'i sgo na rab brjid pa/ /'gro ba'i mun sel khyed la phyag bgyid do/ /'di ltar thos te/ mgon po khyed gcig tu gzhan phan gyi ro la dgyes pa'i dbang du gyur nas 'gro ba lnga'i 'jig rten tha dad pa rnams su rlabs po che'i smon lam gyi khyad par dag gis rtse zhing rgyu ba'i skabs shig na/ yul gyi dam pa dpal sa ho ra dang / bsil ldan bod kyi yul du mi'i rje bo/ bsod nams kyi gzi brjid rgyas pa/dbang phyug dam pa'i bdag por spyi bo nas mngon par dbang bskrur ba/ rigs che zhing mtho bar skyes pa'i sems can skal pa 186
