bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bzang po rnams kyi mgo la zhabs sen rin po che'i cod pan chos kyi dge mtshan dang bcas pas dbang bskrur ba sbyin par gyur to/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rig 'dzin gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i nom par bstan pa/bde ba chen po pad+ma saṃ bha bas/ khyod sngon nas rdo rje'i smon lam rlabs po che btabs pa dang / de'i phyir rdo rje'i rnam thar bla na med pa rdzogs par sgrub pa dang / rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dgongs pa yongs su skong ba'i mthu yod par gzigs nas/ nam mkha' gang ba'i rig 'dzin dang / mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyi tshogs chen po'i dbus su/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi gsang mdzod gtad cing / khyod kyis rtsod pa'i dus mthar rdo rje sems dpa'i mdzad pa gyis shig ces bka'i cod pan dbu la phog ste/ lung bstan me tog dkar po'i gru char phab/ de'i mthu las grangs med pa'i rig 'dzin rnams ni phyogs bcur khyod kyi grags pa'i yi ge klog cing / mkha' 'gro ma ri rab kyi rdul snyed dag ni bstod pa'i glu dbyangs rtag tu len par byed de/ mdor na grub pa'i zhing rab 'byams thams cad khyod kyi yon tan mdzes pa'i me tog tshig gi srad bur rgyu ba la brtson pa'i phreng brgyud mkhan gyi khyim lta dur gnas par gyur to/ /de tshun chad sku che'i phreng ba thams cad du khyod rdo rje'i gnas chen 187

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'khum/rnams su bzhud pa'i ngal ba ma mdzad cing / chos la khyod 'tshol ba'i rtog pa med kyang mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas kyi sngags kyi chos mdzod thams cad khyod kyi phyag tu rang 'ong bar gyur te/ re zhig 'di ni ngo mtshar mi che'o/ /gang gi phyir na rgyu'i bdag nyid che ba yin pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas kyi dbang bskur ba med par yang 'jig rten na 'khor los sgyur ba dag lha'i 'khor lo rin po che tshol du ma phyin cing / 'khor lo de la mi bdag dga' bar byed pa'i sems med kyang / de gnyis gdon mi za bar 'dzoms par bshad pa yin no/ /bden pa'i brtul zhugs grub pa rnams kyis dam bcas pa ni rgya mtsho'i dus rlabs bzhin du dus las mi yol ba lags pas/ pad+ma badz+ra gyi spyan sngar sngon thugs dam ji ltar bzhes pa bzhin dus ngan tha ma la babs pa'i skabs 'dir/ skal pa mchis shing rkyen gyi mthu la rag las pa'i 'gro ba mang po la theg pa mchog gi dga' ston 'gyed pa'i slad du rigs phun sum tshogs par skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul skyed tshal gyi dus ston lta bu bstan to/ /de'i tshe yang rgya mtsho chu bo bzhis mi ngoms pa ltar thugs rgyud dbang gi chu bos ngoms pa mi mnga' ba'i phyir/ lang tsho'i dang po nyid nas khyab bdag pad+ma ka ra dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birla bha dra'i rig rtsal phyag rgya'i dbang dang / glegs bam lung gi dbang dang /188

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1 de stong phyag rgya chen po'i dbang dang / yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbang ste gtor blugs rnam pa bzhi'i rgyun bzang khyod kyi dbu la phab bo/ /rig rtsal phyag rgya'i dbang de brnyes pas ni/khyod dag pa rab 'byams kyi 'khor lo'i snang ba gzhal du med pas skad cig skad cig la chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par dgang ba dang / de dag ma lus pa sbar yang skad cig tsam gyis spros pa'i ri mo rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid kyi thig ler bsdu ba la dbang 'byor ba'i rnal 'byor brnyes so/ /'di ltar khyod ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi rdul phra rab 'dus pa/ ye shes rin po che'i rgyan gyi sprin stug po bkod pa'i gzhal med khang par/ stong pa chen po dang / snying rje sgyu ma dang / yi ge sgyu 'phrul dang / phyag rgya rdzogs pa'i rim pas rdo rje sems dpa'i gdung mthon por bltams shing / rdo rje bzhi'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhir sku bzhi'i dbang phyug gi skur bzhengs nas phan nus zab mo'i dbang gi cho gas dri ma gtor zhing /ye shes chen po'i nus pa rgyud la blugs pas smin grol chig rdzogs su sad pa'i rig pa rtsal gyi dbang rgyal thabs spyi blugs su bskur bar mdzad ma thag 'khor los sgyur ba'i sras thu bo rgyal sar bkod pa'i phyir gter gyi dum pas dbang bskur ba bzhin gyur nas snying po'i khams la gnas pa'i yon tan gyi lang tsho bzhad par gyur ma 189

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thag rdo rje'i lam bde myur du zhugs pas mthar son te/ spangs rtogs kyi me 'bras mi zad par dar bas/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi khyu mchog rnams dang skal pa mnyam par gyur pa la/de dag gis kyang e ma khyod ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal thabs la rang stobs kyis 'dzegs nas mkhyen brtse nus stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba zhig go zhes bsngags pa'i gling bu snyan 'jebs su sgrogs/ lha dang grub pa thams cad dang gnyis su med pa'i bo/ 'phang dngos su grub pa ste/ gsang ba rgya mtsho'i dbyig chen po'i mdzod kyi lde'u mig phyag tu son/ chos kun ye shes kyi rol rtsed du gzigs pa'i lta dgongs kyi phyag rgyas btab nas chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor/ dngos grub 'dzad pa med pa'i 'byor pas phyug cing snyems/ 'dod rga'i phrin las theg mchog chos kyi rgyal khab la dbang bsgyur nas/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal ma nyams par longs su spyod nas/ 'khor ba myang 'das/sems can sangs rgyas su bya rtsol med par yud tsam gyis bsgyur nas snang srid zil gnon gyi brtul zhugs grub pa'i che ba ni/gsang 'dzin bdag pos kyang sgra ji bzhin brjod pa la rngo mi thogs pas mtshon/ mchod yon de dag gi bka' drin la brten/ gar gyi dbang po'i zhing bsil ldan ljongs 'di yang shin tu bskal pa 190

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bzang po'i rtse mor son nas/ sa'i gzer thams cad du gtsug lag khang gi bkod mdzes kyis spa/ mdo sngags dge 'dun gnyis kyi mkhas grub kyi tshang brdol/ /khyim na gnas pa kun kyang rnam dkar gyi dpal 'byor la gtso bor bskyed/ lha klu mi dang mkha' 'gro'i gnas na bzhugs pa'i rgyud kyi glegs bam rnams dgongs pa'i rtsal dang / brtul zhugs kyi nus pas dbang du bsdus nas bsgyur bshad nyan gsum gyis gtan la phab pas yo ḍi yā na'i gsang mdzod kyang mog por byed cing / rig 'dzin lha dang ḍaki 'du bas gangs khrod kyi ri brag mtsho sogs rdo rje'i gnas chen po rnams dang tha mi dad par byin gyis brlabs/ chos nor rdzas kyi gter kha ming can ming med grangs med pa 'byung lnga'i dbyings dang dgongs pa'i rtsal du rgyas btab nas/ gdul bya las smon rten 'brel dus su son pas chos gter zad mi shes pas phyi ma'i bstan 'gro'i dbugs dbyung bas nag phyogs zil gyis gnon pa dang / dkar phyogs ru mtshon bsgrengs nas bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' thang kun nas kun tu rgyas par spel ma thag gangs ri la char sprin dkrigs pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ston 'khor dgongs pa gcig pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa 191

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyi rtse dga'i bde bas snyems pa dang / kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa nam mkha' lhar byas pa'i nang na rnam par rol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las kyi rigs kyis che ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gtso bo rnams blon por gyur pas zham ring byas shing / /rdo rje'i khro bo'i dmag dpung mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gnas kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag 'od zer dang sprul pa'i pho nyas lang long du gyur pa'i chos kyi rgyal po khams gsum las rnam par rgyalaXba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi thabs thob pa ste/ grangs med pa'i rdo rje'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin ri rab ltar mi g.yo zhing shin tu brtan pa'i mthar phyin pa/ bsod nams brgya'i gzi byin bzod par dka' ba'i rgyan mnga' ba brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi bla ma rnams kyang dka' ba mtha' yas spyad de/ gang dag gi zhabs rten la cod pan nyug pa tsam zhig don du gnyer pa de dag kyang khyod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya'i khyad par bstan pa'i skad cig ma kho nar/ sprin chen rlung gi lcags kyus tshabs cher bskul ba bzhin 'byon par mdzad na/de las gzhan pa'i sa gsum gyi dbang po thams cad la bka'i 192

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'khor lo sbyor ba lta ci smos/ de ltar khyod ye shes rang snang gi 'og min yongs su dag pa/ phal pa'i skye dgu sus kyang sngon bsam gtan gyi rkang pa ma bkod pa/ mchog gi dben pa la dgyes pa'i kun tu bzang po rnams kyi spyod yul gyi gnas dam pa de las ma bzhengs shing mngon par mi g.yo bzhin du/ rnyog pa lnga dang ldan pa'i dus mthar/ bod dang bod chen po'i 'dzin ma'i gzhi 'dir/rgyal po dang / blon po dang / khyim bdag dang / tshong dpon dang /gdol pa la sogs pa tha mal pa'i 'khor phal mo che rnams kyi dbus na/ so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i kun spyod dang spyod yul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis 'dre zhing snang ba ni/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob dpon sgyu ma'i rigs pa la shin tu byang bar bslabs pa dag sgyu 'phrul gyi rol rtsed ston pa lta bu ste/ ngo mtshar che'o/ /de dag kun tu'ang khyod kyis spyo ba dang / gzengs bstod pa dang / bzhad pa dang / gzhan yang sna tshogs kyi gtam gleng ba mdzad pa dang /phyag stabs sgyur ba dang / 'chag pa dang / bzhud pa dang / bza' btung spyod pa dang / mnal ba la sogs pa spyod lam gyi rnam pa ci dang ci mdzad pa thams cad sngags kyi bzlas pa dang / phyag rgya dang /gar dang / tshogs kyi mchod pa dang / sbyin sreg dang / nā da'i de nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa la sogs pa'i sngags kyi spyod pa gzi 193

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mdangs chen po can/ rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du sems can rnams la don chen po'i sgor nye bar gnas pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / dpag bsam gyi shing lta bu 'ba' zhig 'byung bar zad kyi/ tha mal pa'i spyod pa gzhan ni yong ye mi mnga'o/ /bad kyi rig rtsal phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin gcig pus tha mal pa'i nga rgyal gyi grong khyer/ snod dang bcud dang rgyud kyi dmigs pa sna tshogs dang / mtshungs ldan gyi sgo sna tshogs nas rgyas pa/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas brtan par byas pa/ khams dang sa dang 'gro ba thams cad du zhugs pa/ bal pa dza'i tshang tshing chen po ltar 'dzing pa rnams phye mar brlag cing thal bar byas pa'i drung na/ lha chen drag pos mda' 'phangs pas grong khyer sum brtsegs bsregs pa'i sngon rabs kyang sprang tshang 'jig pa'i skyes bu'i mthu rtsal bzhin du dman no/ /glegs bam lung gi dbang bskur ba brnyes pas ni/ khyod gsang sngags dang rig sngags thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i dbang dang ldan pa dang / sngags kyi tshul thams cad snang bar byed pa'i legs bshad mi zad pa dang ldan par gyur te/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ljags rdo rje las sprul pa'i go 'phang brnyes so/ /de la khyod kyi gsung rdo rje rnam pa thams cad pa'i yul ni don dam gzigs pa rnams kho na dbang du gyur pa 194

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1yin gyi/ bdag 'dra bas brjod pa ga la nus/ 'on kyang yul dus nyi tshe ba'i 'jig rten 'dir sems can gyi bsam pa'i dbang gis phal cher glang po che'i lta stangs mdzad de sbas nas/ nyi tshe'i snang ba tsam zhig bstan pa dang sbyar yang / khyod kyi gsung gcig nyid rgyal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rnal 'byor pa'i tshogs kyi gsung thams cad bsdus par mthong ste/ /sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis 'og min du bstan pa dang / 'phags pa lag na rdo rjes ri'i rgyal po ma la yar rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa'i rig 'dzin gyi 'dus pa kho na'i dbus su bshad pa dang /mi bdag lung bstan no rje dang / ku ku rā dza la sogs pa che ba bas kyang che ba'i sems can mchog rnams kyi gting mtha' med pa'i blo'i chu gter gcig nas gcig tu sbas pa'i rgyud sde dang rgyud sde'i man ngag rin po che dag /da lta'i dus su khyod kyi gsung skal bzang gdul bya'i thun mong gi longs spyod du gyur pa'i bang mdzod bzang po 'dir phyin par snang la/ gna' bo'i lo tsā chen po rnams kyis 'phags pa'i yul du dka' ba du ma thrud nas bgrod pa dang / de dag gi bka' brgyud 'dzin pa'i dam pa'i phreng ba bar ma chad par byon pa rnams ni don 'di nyid kho na'i thabs su bstar ba 'dra ba snang ngo / /kha bas mtshan pa'i ljongs 'dir gsang sngags kyi 96

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gdams pa tha dad pa/ mkhas grub kyi brgyud pa gzhan dang gzhan las 'ongs pa/ yul sna tshogs na so so so sor 'thor thabs su spyod pa/ phal cher mi mngon pa'i gnas na gab cing nub la phyogs pa du ma yang / khyod kyi spyan sngar sgrim pa med par phyogs thams cad nas 'du zhing / rang rang gi ngang tshul ma sbas par ston pa ni/ phyogs thag ring po sna tshogs na gnas shing spyod yul gyi gnas mi gsal ba'i bung ba rnams/ dpyid kyi dga' tshal na ma bos bzhin du/rang nyid gsal bar sgrogs shing 'du ba bzhin no/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis sngon sku tshe'i phreng ba dpag tu med par rdo rje theg pa'i gsung rab la sbyangs shing / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rig sngags bsgrub par dka' ba mang po bsgrubs te/ ma nyams ma bod par rtsa khams yi ge'i mdzod du rgyas btab nas mchis pa/ dus 'dir rjes su dran pa'i mtshan mar ye shes grub pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/ gsung rdo rje'i sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan bde chen sgyu ma'i 'du byed kyis bris pa'i brda yig gi glegs bam khyad par can rnams phul te/ ji ltar bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams gzungs kyi sgo'i yi ge re re las kyang don dang tshig gi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa mngon du 'gyur ba dang 'dra bar/ glegs bam de dag lde mig tu brnyes pa na/ gsung rab dang grub pa'i rig 96

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1sngags de dag gi sgo yang gnyid log pa las sad pa bzhin du phye bar gyur te/ de'i mod la rdo rje'i lam bzang zhib mo'i tshul thams cad sa ler gzigs shing / rig sngags de dag kyang rang gi ngang gis grub par gyur to/ der yang ma zad thog ma med pa'i dus nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma rnams kyi so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i glegs bam/ chos kyi dbyings kyi nam mkha' la glog gi gzi brjid kyi phreng ba 'gyed pa rnams dbyings phyug rdo rje rnal 'byor mas brda yig gi 'khrul 'khor non po la bskyon nas/ khyod kyi gzhom med nā da'i gtsug lag khang 'od zer lnga'i ri mo can du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa'i phyir/ blo'i mig dang ldan pa'i sems can dag ni khyod kyi sku la o rgyan te ru ka'i lha khang du 'du shes te/ lha khang de la ni dbang bskur ba dang / lung 'bogs pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pa med pas na/ gnyis su khyod kyi sku kho na ches khyad par du 'phags par yang mthong ngo / /kun tu bzang po'i mdzod kyi rgyan byed pa'i glegs bam de dag ni phal cher zhig /'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhing gi sa gzhi rin po che'i pad+mo ze ba mtha' yas pa 'di las sprang rtsi'i dog pa bzhin du khyod kyis brnyes so zhes gtam du grags mod kyi/ don dam par ni sngags dang rgyud thams cad bde ba chen po'i mig 'phrul du gzigs shing /197

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bde chen gcig pu nyid sngags dang rgyud kyi rnam pa thams cad du 'char ba'i rnal 'byor brtan pa'i mthus/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi nam mkha' nyid la rnyed par zad de/ de'i phyir khyod ni rtag tu dam mkha' mdzod kyi 'byor pa can kho na yin no/ /de lha bas na rdo rje sems dpas tha mal pa'i gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i 'gro ba la chos ston pa'i zhal gyi sgo ni gang / sems can dpag tu med pas rgyud sde'i de nyid mchog tu zab pa dang bkra ba'i gnas rnams blta ba la mig tu gyur pa ni su/ byin rlabs kyi lang tsho rnying pa'i chos tshul mang po thog ma'i na tshod la 'god pa'i sman bcud kyis len ni ci/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa na spyod pa'i rgyud sde'i ri dwags mig ma rnams dang gsung rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rtse dgas sbrel ba'i dpa' bo gcig pu'ang su zhig ce na/ de lta bu ni bdag nyid chen po khyod yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i dbang de brnyes pas ni/ khyod ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi gsang ba zab mo'i gting rnyed pa dang / sems dang ye shes rang snang ba'i shes bya'i snod thams cad du bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi gsol bas dgyes par gyur te lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na su yang shes rab dang brtson pa'i grus brgal bar dka' ba'i ye shes chen po'i rgya 198

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga mtshor gyur to/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog gi bde ba'i bka' rtags/ de nyid 'byed pa'i ri mo can khyod la gtad nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyal thabs kyi bdag por gnang ste/ mchog gi bde ba de ni lha sngags ye shes kyi dmigs pa thams cad las 'das kyang dkyil 'khor gsum gyi mtshams las ma brgal ba yin/ rten med cing gnas med pa'i ye shes yin yang /de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings la rten cing gnas pa yin/ 'jug ldang gi spros pa nye bar zhi yang / chos kyi dbyings la 'jug cing rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs kyis sgyu ma'i spyod yul du ldang ba'i mtshan nyid mi 'dor ba yin/ gcig dang du ma'i rnam par brtag tu med kyang / gcig pus du ma'i nyams su mdzad de phrin las sna tshogs kyis rtsen pa yin/ phyag rgya dang / sngags dang / sbyin sreg dang /dka' thub thams cad bsdus pa yin kyang / phyag rgya dang dka' thub la sogs pa'i mtshan ma thams cad mi rgyu ba yin te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med par mtha' yas pa'i bskal pa rnams su dka' ba spyad kyang rnyed par dka' ba'i gsang chen/cad kyis 'bad pa chung ngus rang nyid las brnyes pa ste/ don gyi dbang 'di nyid gzigs nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams/dus bzhi phyogs bcu gang nas kyang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnyed 199

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas ma 'tshol zhig /ces seng ge'i sgra sgrog go/ /de ltar rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid kyi dpal mo/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gting na 'dug pa/ brtag pa dang mthong bar dka' ba'i mthar thug pa de lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba dam pa'i rdo rje me tog gi mdas dbang du mdzad pa na/ lha dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / phra mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad/ gser gyi rigs mchog me lce non po'i rgyas btab pa lta bu dang / ston ka'i nam mkha' nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyas thebs pa lta bu dang / dga' ba'i nags tshal dpyid kyi dus kyi rgyas thebs pa lta bur/ sngon bas kyang tshad med cing mtshungs pa med pa'i dpal dang gzi byin gyis mdzes par gyur nas gnas te/ de mthong nas mkha' spyod dang ril bu mig sman la sogs pa dngos grub kyi na chung shin tu dregs ma/ dngos grub brgya'i 'khor dang ldan pa rnams kyang / nam zhig 'dis bdag cag dang rol rtsed kyi dus 'debs par 'gyur snyam ste re ba'i mig rtse gcig tu gtod par byed do/ /khyod kyis phyin ci log gi dngos po'i 'khor lo mtha' dag bde chen shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rig sngags kyis mtshan ma btab ste/ kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ chos kyi 200

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dbyings kyi rgyan byed pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa sgyu ma'i drwa ba lta bu'i gzugs 'dzin par gyur pa ni/ rgyal ba dang rgyal ba'i sras po dbang 'byor gyi spyod yul brnyes pa/ snod bcud thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs su byin gyis rlob pa'i ting nge 'dzin mdzad pa rnams dang seng ge'i rnam par rtse bas 'gran pa bzhin du snang ngo / /yul gyi spros pa rnams ni chom rkun lha bur gsungs te/'on kyang khyod kyi spros pa med pa'i bde ba'i rgyal thabs ni/ spros pa'i dun long ji ltar cher gyur cing sna tshogs su gnas par gyur pa de ltar gzi byin gyi phung po gcig tu 'bar bar 'gyur zhing /yangs shing rgya che ba dang / mchog tu brtan pa dang / kun nas yongs su dag par 'gyur te/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis 'jig rten na seng ge bzhin du skrag pa dang bag tsha ba thams cad dang bral bar spyod pa de'i phyir khyod la 'jigs bral gyi slob dpon phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba zhes brjod pa ni don chen po mchis pa lags so// //201

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄//'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la bstod pa/rgyal kun ye shes sku can 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gang dang dbyer med rje btsun mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /mkhas grub dbang po de la gus pa'i blos/ /bstod tshig me tog phreng ba cung zad 'thor/ /ngo mtshar bye ba'i gter chen chos kyi rje/ /rab gsal 'od stong rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /'jig rten kun phan mdzad pa'i snang ba yis/ /'bad pa med bzhin sems can kun don spyod/ /ring mo'i dus nas byang chub snying po'i sar/ /phyin drug 'gros kyis bgrod kyi mthar phyin kyang / /mgon med nyam thag 'gro la brtser dgongs te/ /slar yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzugs su snang / /rtag tu 'gro la phan pa lhur len cing / /'brel tshad yang dag dge ba'i lam la sbyor/ /chos sku zag pa med pa sgrub mdzad phyir/ /dge slong chos kyi nyi ma khyod cig yin/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por tshogs bsags shing / /smon 'jug byang chub sems kyi rtsal rdzogs pas/ /khyod kyi mdzad pa'i rol mo ji snyed pa/ /mtha' dag yid can rgya mtshor sman la ltos/ /'phags mchog dpag bsam lang tsho ma rnying 202

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ba/ /rmad byung 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims dris/ /kun nas kun tu bgos pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ /'dul 'dzin rgyu skar phreng ba zil gyis mnan/ /mdo rgyud gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che'i gnas/ /rnam dag thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab kyis/ /dpyad pa dri med shin tu yongs rdzogs pas/ /klog pa ba khyod 'gran zlas dben bzhin bzhugs/ /zab mo'i don la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag /mkha' ltar gos pa med pa'i ting 'dzin sogs/ /zhi ba'i ting 'dzin sgo brgya gcig char 'byed/ /spong ba pa khyod rgyal sras khyu mchog lags/ /'chad dang rtsom pa'i phrin las rmad byung bas/ /grags ldan mkhas pa rnams kyang zil mnan te/ /mtha' klas 'gro la smin grol chos kyi char/ /'bebs mdzad bya ba las kyi 'khor lor rtsen/ /blo dang dran dang rtogs dang chos kyi gter/ /de sogs mi zad spobs pa'i gter chen brgyad/ /dpal gos 'dab ma bzhin du rnam rgyas pas/ /legs bshad sgo brgya 'byed la dpa' bar gyur//'bad dang rtsol la rag las ma yin par/ /thug phrad shes rab mchog gi gter rdol bas/ /ma lus mi lus legs gsung dbongs 'grel bcas/ /khyod kyi thugs su nyin mo lta bur gsal/ /dpal 'byor snyan grags dbyar mtsho bzhin rgyas kyang / /'dam gyi spubs na pad+mo gzhon nu bzhin/ /chags med ye shes mchog la legs 203

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gnas te/ /sgyu ma la ni sgyu ma nyid rol gyur/ /snyan pa'i ba dan mtho ba'i che rnams kyang / /mi 'dul kha lo sgyur ba khyod drung na/ /rta bdun zer gyis khebs pa'i rgyu skar bzhin/ /ches gsal min pa'i rang gzugs kun nas rngams/ /dge legs snang ba 'bum gyis kun gsal lto /'geng mdzad chos kyi zla rgyas khyod mthong nas/ /chu shel phung por grub pa'i 'od dkar yang / /skyengs te chu 'dzin gsar pas 'geb la rings/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i sku dkyil mchog /gang la mngon sum gyur pa'i de ma thag /nyon mongs rnyogs skyon ngang gis zhi byed pa'i/ /mthong grol mtshan dpe'i nyi ma srid na mdzes/ /mdzes sku dri med gser gyi mchod sdong bzhin/ /thos grol tshangs dbyangs lha yi rnga sgra bzhin/ /sgrib med ye shes dwangs pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /yon tan mi zad gangs chen mtsho bzhin no/ /brda sprod gzhung dang tshad ma rig pa'i gnas/ /yang dag blo gros mchog gis legs gzigs te/ /rgol ngan log par smra dang log par rtog /de kun dngos stobs rigs pas sun 'byin mdzad/ /bzo dang gso ba pha rol rjes 'dzin sgo/ /rnam dpyod lde mig 'phrul gyis rab bye bas/ /rmad byung gzhan phan thabs tshul rin chen dbyig /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor 'gyed la ltos/ /rgyal bstan 'khor lo gsum gyi brjod bya'i don/ /drang dang nges 204

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1pa'i rnam dbye ji snyed pa/ /nges shes blo mig dag pas mthong nas ni/ /shing rta chen po'i rnam thar ji bzhin skyong / /de slad gangs ri'i ljongs kyi mkhas pa khyod/ /dam pa'i nang na shin tu dam pa ste/ /blo mchog mnga' ba rnams kyi 'byung gnas che/ /'phags mchog ye shes me long zhal skyin lags/ /shin tu ma rmongs dbang po rnon po'i yul/ /rmad byung lta sgom spyod pa'i gter mdzod mchog /zab mo'i nang rgyud sde gsum chos kyi tshul/ /yongs gzigs ye shes che ldan khyod cig rgyal/ /gsang sngags lam bzang kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /gum pa gsang ba shes rab tshig dbang ste/ /gtor blugs chu bo rnam bzhi yongs rdzogs pas/ /rgyud sde rgya mtshor mnga' dbang mchog tu 'byor/ / mthong na bde chen ye shes rab stsol ste/ /gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu grub pas/ /te ru ka dpal sku yi dngos grub stsol/ /rang gir mdzad pa'i 'bras rtags kun tu gsal/ /bka' dang rang gter yang gter dgongs gter dang / /rjes dran gter dang dag snang snyan brgyud de/ /bka' babs rin chen bdun ldan chos kyi rgyal/ /khyod gcig tshangs chen lhas kyang 'gran bzod min//de skad khyab bdag bla ma la/ /tshigs bcad de nyid grangs ldan gyis//bsngags pa phul ba'i legs byas las/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /dge'o// //206

pob 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga //dpal ldan bla ma'i ye shes kyi gsang ba la sngags pa zab don rdo rje'i ka ma kā/bla ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam zhing zab pa mi shigs na da'i dbyangs/ /bde chen mkhyen brtse'i nyams brgyar 'bar ba'i dbyig /dbang phyug brgyad ldan 'od gsal sgyu ma'i skur /rnam rol dang po'i mgon por phyag bgyi 'o/ /rnam mang rtog tshogs mtshan ma'i rdul khams brgya/ /'od gsal zhi ba dam ba'i chu mthong ngogs/ /dengs pa'i zung 'jug nyin mo'i snang ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i spros pa 'bum du 'jo/ /snying dbus gzhom du med pa'i thig le cher/ /srog rtsol nyi zla'i 'gros kyis phyag byas pas//rnam par mi rtog zab mo'i mchog brnyes pa/ /thams cad stong ba khyab gdal chen po'i gshis/ /gzod nas rnam thar bzhi ldan gnyug ma'i dbyings/ /bde dang mi bde'i mtshan ma nyer zhi yang / /lhan skyes mi 'gyur bde ba'i sgeg 'chang ba/ /bde chen gnas ni bsam par dka' ba lags/ /sgra gcan rlung brgya zos pa'i shugs ldang bas/ /ro dang rkyang ma'i mdud pa lhod lhod du/ /bshig pa'i 206

bstod tshogs sprugs bsdus/ pod 1nyams myong khong nas shar ba na/ /nges don gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa mthong / /srid dang zhi ba ro mnyam de kho na/ /shes dang shes bya'i 'jug ldang thim pa'i dbyings/ /gzhi rdzogs thig le chen por 'ub chub pa'i/ /ye shes mchog ni ye stong rnam par stong / /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i de bzhin nyid/ /rnam med stong pa nyid kyi phyag rgya ste/ /bde ba gang gis snyoms par 'jug bzod pa/ /e waṃ mnyam par sbyor ba'i ye shes yin/ /sna rtser 'bar ba'i gzugs can tsaṇ+ḍa li/ /dkyil 'khor bcu yi srog rnams bkug pa'i dbyig /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan phyag rgya cher/ /'khyil ba'i btsun mo mchog gcig khyod la mnga'/ /phul byung btsun mo'i sgyu ma de brnyes pas/ /nyi khri chig stong rdo rje lus kyi cha/ /'dod dgur thos pa'i ye shes me lce yis/ /te ru ka dpal dgyes pa ci ste min/ /gang du nyi ma zla ba mi rgyu zhing / /rdo rje sngags kyi 'jug pas ma bzung ba'i/ /nun pa'i lam de snang bar dka' ba ste/ /ye shes 'di ni shin tu phra ba lags/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang spros pa'i rdzun ris kun/ /zhi bas gtad med nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin du/ /klong chen bsam brjod med pa'i ngang gan pa/ /ye shes de ni shin tu yangs pa lags/ /dbang yul phung khams 'dus pa'i lcags nag rdul/ /'dor ba'i ngal brgya bsten pa med bzhin du/ /dag byed bde baX 207

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/chen po'i gser 'gyur rtsi/ /ye shes de ni shin tu rno ba lags/ /bya dka'i spyod pa yun ring ma bsten kyang / /'dod pa mchog la rol ba'i dga' ba yis/ /tshe gcig bla med bde ba'i mchog sbyin pa/ /ye shes de ni shin tu myur ba lags/ /sad rmi gnyid dang 'dzag pa'i gnas skabs kun/ /sgrib bral sku bzhi'i ngo bo mngon bskyed nas/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol mor 'byams klas pa/ /ye shes de ni shin tu mdzangs pa lags/ /mdor na grangs med rdo rje 'chang noms dang // bgrang yas dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun/ /ye shes sgyu ma bde ba'i thabs chen po/ /'di nyid kho na'i yang dag bgrod pa lags/ /de slad dag pa rab 'byams brtan dang g.yo'i/ /cho 'phrul dngos brgya snang ba'i gar mkhan mchog /dpal ldan bla ma'i ye shes gsang ba mchog /zab gsal gnyis med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'ang spyon pa 'jigs med pas me khye zla tshes kyi nyi shar la bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// //ra / /kha ba'i ri ngogs bsil ljongs sgo ṭa'i gling / /yul 'khor chen po mdo khams sa'i thig le'i/ /dum khu bkra shis lha rtse'i ljongs shig na/ /klong chen sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor mchog gcig yod/ /de la skye ba'i zag pa lta ci ste/ /sgyu ma'i ye shes mchog gi phyag rgya che/ /gdan gsum gzugs sku'i rnal 'byor la chags shing / /mtshan 208

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ ngo da 1nga dpe sgyu 'phrul drwa 'i snang ba ston/ /'od gsal zab mo'i snye dbyings mnyam pa che/ /gzhi snang dag chen rol mor 'bar ba'i gar/ /rnam rol sku yi snang ba 'bum phrag gis/ /srid pa'i grong khyer rnam gsum rgyas par 'geng / /ring nas dri med thugs rje'i 'od zer brgyas/ /srid na srid 'gro bskyang bas ma ngoms par/ /slar yang 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i zlos gar gyis/ /sems can khams la sangs rgyas mdzad pa mdzad/ /'phags pa mchog de'i grags snyan 'khri shing la/ /'khyud pa'i skal bzang 'du ba stong lhags te/ /drung du yun ring dus su brtags byas kyang //de yi gsang ba dpog bzod su yang med/ /mkhas par grags pa'i chen po 'bum gyis kyang / /de la sbobs pas rgol du mi spyod de/ /chos la chos kyi bzod pa mchog brnyes pas/ /tshul gnyis chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed la dpa'/ /grub pa'i sa mthor 'dzegs pa'i dam pa brgya/ /bdag nyid che de'i mdun sar nyer lhags kyang / /del zil gyis gnon pa'i skabs med de/ /slob pa min pa'i zung 'jug de yis brnyes/ /bsod nams chen po'i bdag nyid mang po yang / /de yi mdun sar chen por mi snang ste/ /gser sbyangs drung na snag tsha'i phung po bzhin/ /smon lam chen po'i stobs kyis zilaXganon mdzad/ /blo chen rgyal sras bye ba'i 'dun sa na/ /mi 'jigs mgrin pa'i dkyil 'khor 209

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/nga pa gzengs bstod de/ /zab don skye ba lnga ba'i dbyangs snyan po/ /sgrog mkhas blo gros rgya mtsho dri med 'od/ /de yis chos rnams mi lam ltar rtogs pas/ /mtshan ma'i chos la 'jigs pa ma mchis shing /ga/nga la'ang dogs dang zhum pa yod min te/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa thog mtha' bar dge ba/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor los nyer bzung ste/ /stong gi 'jig rten kho ra khor yug kun/ /rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las gcib sgas bcings/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis zin pa'i klog pa ba/ /rtog ge'i tshig la snyems pas mkhas par rlob/ /bstan pa yongs rdzogs 'gal med gnad gcig tu/ /gzigs pa'i mthu chen mkhyen brtse'i lha des grub//rnam par rtog la ye shes snyems 'chang ba'i/ /spong ba pa de gzung 'dzin 'ching ba can/ /rtog med rig pa ye bzhag chen po ru/ /spros pa'i drwa ba nub mdzad mkhyen brtse'i lha/ /brag las shog ser re ba'i gter rlom 'ga'/ /'dod lha'i byin rlabs grub pa chen por re/ /chos nyid klong nas chos sku'i gter 'byen zhing / /bka' babs bdun gyi mdzod brnyes mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /zag bcas yid kyi 'ching ba ma grol bzhin/ /zag med mngon shes thob rlom de zog po/ /gzhi grol gting mtha' med pa'i dgongs klong nas/ /sgrib bral gzigs pa'i gter 'byin mkhyen 210

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1brtse'i dbang / /chen po'i go sar 'gying ba'i ston pa brgya/ /phyogs re'i yon tan tsam gyis lhag par khengs/ /mkhyen brtse'i lha de yon tan yongs rdzogs kyang / /yon tan mnga' bar rlom dang khengs mi mdzad/ /'jig rten chos brgyad sgrub pa'i ston chen phal/ /zang zing gtong ba'i g.yab mos 'khor slob bsdu/ /bdag nyid chen po mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ni/ /dri med chos kyi snang bas gdul bya skyong / /bstan dang theg pa'i rnam grangs phyogs re bas/ /mtha' yas 'gro khams gdul bar nus min phyir/ /rang rang dbang skal 'tshams pa'i chos kyi char/ /skal bzang 'gro blo'i zhing sar rtag tu 'beb/ /nor 'dod nor gyi bdog pas re ba skong //gtam 'dod sna tshogs gtam gyi rol mos gso/ /thar 'dod thar pa'i lam kyis tshim mdzad pa'i/ /thabs mkhas bsam gyis mi khyab mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /'byor ldan rjes 'dzin phongs pa brtul ba'i tshul/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid de la mi mdza' ste/ /bkren dang ma rungs log pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /de la de yi byams brtses lhag par dgongs/ /rgyan dang byug pas nye bar ma bgos kyang / /tshul khrims phung po'i skru mchog lhang nge bas/ /gzugs bzang gzugs kyi 'jo sgeg zil gnon pa/ /tshogs kyi tshogs mchog 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /mnyam par bzhag pa min pa'i skabs med par/ /dpa' 21

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bar 'gro sogs ting 'dzin rnam thar la/ /rtag zhugs blo gros rgya mtsho dri med 'od/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la rang dbang bsgyur/ /tshur mthong blo yis yang dang yang dpyad nas/ /rtogs dka'i gnad gsang rtog smra ltar min te/ /zas pa med pa shes rab phung po'i mthus/ /srid dang zhi ba'i chos kun cig char gzigs/ /sna tshogs sgrib pa'i dra ba ma lus pa/ /zab mo'i ye shes ral gris tshar bcad de/ /rnam grol shin tu zhi ba'i myang 'das su/ /'ub chub mi slob lam brnyes mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /so so rang rig gnyug ma'i ye shes ni/ /mthar 'dzin lha ba'i spubs su mi bzhugs kyi/ /stong dang rten 'byung ro mnyam chen po ru/ /gzigs pa'i ngo mtshar mchog grub mkhyen brtse'i dbang / /rgyal kun ye shes gsang ba rdo rje'i gnas/ /klong chen dgongs pa'i ngang du rtsal rdzogs kyang / /tshu rol mthong la tshur mthong ltar ston pa/ /bdag nyid che de'i 'jig rten mthun 'jug yin/ /mkha' khyab zhing na rdo rje'i gzugs sku'i gar/ /mchog dang mchog min gcis tu ma nges kyang / /nges pa'i bzugs skru ngur smrig 'chang ba'i zol/ /mkhyen brtse'i lha de'i 'jig rten mthun 'jug yin/ /'pho med ye shes mi shigs rang byung sbu/ /rtag brtan bgres rgud med par lhan rdzogs kyang / /bltams dang bgres dang bsnyun pa ltar ston pa/ /de dag de yi 212

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'jig rten mthun 'jug yin/ /mthun 'jug rtsig pa sngar nas bsgyel zin kyang / /'jig rten skye bo thabs kyis gdul slad du/ /mthun 'jug stong gi rol mo 'bar ba 'di/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma mchog de'i spyod yul yin/ /'dzam bu'i gling na ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gtso/ /kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ste/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i mdzad bzang snang ba ches/ /shing rta chen po'i rnam thar gsar du slong / /rnga yab gling na rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i rje/ /mtsho skyes bla ma blo ldan mchog sred de/ /zhing sngags lhan skyes dpa' mo 'bum phrag 'bum/ /zab gsang bde ba mchog gi phyag rgyas 'debs///rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras bye ba'i gtso/ /rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam dpal gzhon nu ste/ /dag dang ma dag rgyal ba'i zhing khams su/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod yul rgya mtsho ston/ /mdor na rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ji snyed pa/ /dpa' chen de yi ye shes dgyes sprin te/ /srid dang zhi ba'i legs tshogs ji snyed kyang / /bdag nyid che de'i phrin las rgya mtsho yin/ /'phags pa'i rnam thar blo yis mi thug pa/ /brjod la stobs bcu'i dbang phyug ngal mdzad na/ /rmongs chen bdag 'dras brjod du ga la nus/ /nyung ngu'i ngag 'di mos gus yid kyis yin/ /dge ba de yis mtha' klas srid pa'i 'gro/ /rje btsun khyod zhabs phyag gis rab 'dud pa'i/ /skal bzang mngon 313

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med mi bstan nyi'i ba gsung 'bumasum gyur te tshe rabs kun/ /snang nas snang ba bla med bgrod kyur cig /dpal 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs mang brtse'i dbang po'am/ mtshan gzhan blo gros rgya mtsho dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya zhing / kha cig tu kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa'i rje btsun chen po de'i yon tan gyi phyogs phra ba las brtsams pa'i gtam 'di'ang mgon po gang gi bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pas gang dran myur du bris pa dge bar gyur cig///2 4

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1—tshog /bla ma dam pa dpal sprul rin po che sku phreng gi bstod pa bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ gang gi mtshan yang bsod nams gter/ /rnam thar mkhas pa dga' ba'i dpal/ /gsol ba btab na dngos grub kyi/ /dge legs kun 'byung bla ma rje/ /rigs las btsun pa sprug po gdong / /de yi nang na rje'u'i rigs/ /ya rabs dra ma'i khyim du 'khrungs/ /bltams pa'i lo ni lcags pho sprel/ /sku bong che la skye mched gtsang / /kho lag yangs shing nyams stobs ldan/ /dbu ni gdugs ltar rgyas pa ste/ /ro stod seng ge 'dra bar snang / /blo gsal smra mkhas snying stobs che/ /dpa' zhing brtan la brtul phod pa/ /des la shin tu gzhung rab bzang / /snying rjer ldan zhing chos la dgyes/ /de ltar yon tan rang bzhin gyi/ /dam pa'i rigs kyi pad+ma de/ /dang por rdo rong rdzogs chen pa'i/ /gdams ngag chu yis mang du gsos/ /de nas mkhas grub gzhan mang bsten/ /'phags bod paṇa chen gzhung la sbyangs/ /dbang lung man ngag bdud rtsi yis/ /bum pa bzang po 'dra bar gyur/ /sems sbyong bdun dang bskyed 216

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rdzogs lam/ /khyad par 'od gsal snying thib bi/ /rnal 'byor rtse gcig sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin las su rung / /brtul zhugs grub pa'i khyu rgyal dang / /lhan cig rdo rje'i gnas chen nyul/ /dpa' bo blo ka'i byen rlabs kyi/ /rgun chang 'thung bas rtag tu bzi/ /srog thur dbu ma'i dbyings su dengs/ /gtum mo'i 'od kyis gnyis spang khyab/ /dpyid kyi dga' ba mchog tu rgyas/ /nges don dbu ma'i bden pa gzigs/ /brtan g.yo mtha' dag bde bar shar/ /bdeXchen rol mos nyin mtshan 'da'/ /sdug bsngalaXsrid pa'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /seng ge bzhin du 'jigs med rgyu/ /bshad pa mkhas shing rtsom pa bzang / /dris na zab cing brtags thub pas/ /sngags shes rin chen tshogs nang na/ /bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i bla ma 'jig rten mig /o rgyan chos kyi dbang po sogs/ /skyes mchog mang po'i bla mar mdzad//snying thig chos kyi sdong po yin/ /'on kyang sbas pa'i brtul zhugs bzung / /khyim sngags phal pa'i tshul dag gis/ /mthong thos 'gro ba'i don chen sgrub/ /gting med rnams la ca co nyung / /lo ni brgyad cu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /sku lus yang la snyun dang bral/ /de nas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod gzhung / /'don bzhin zhi ba'i dbyings su gzim/ /bdag 'dra'ang grub pa'i he ru ka /khyod kyi zhabs rdul la 216

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1reg pas/ /skal bzang snyam nas dga' ba skyes/ /gus bcas lan brgyar thal mo sbyor////nga / /phyi nang rig gzhung rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /zab rgyas gsung rab mang po'i sgrom gcig gyur/ /dben pa'i gnas su sku tshe sgrub la dril/ /thugs dam zhal gzigs byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs/ /chos brgyad ro snyoms sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad/ /sdig spyod yul khams dkar po'i gling du bsgyur/ /byang chub spyod pa'i lam bzang phyogs brgyar spel/ /gsang chen rgyud rgyal rtse mo'i bstan srog bzung /o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po la/ /rnam thar dran bzhin dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /'di phyi bar do kun tu thugs rjes zungs/ /gong ma'i brgyud srol zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gi 'don rgyur bstan pa'i nyi mas jis pa'o//// 317

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/༄/ /mi pham rin po che'i bstod pa/rgya la bstan mdo dang sngags kyi lta grub gnad/ /zab myur blo gros non pos 'big pa la/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog mi pham chos kyi rje//dri med rigs pa'i gter chen khyod min su/ /rtog ge'i lam gyis tha snyad 'jal ba na/ /rtog ge mkhan po phal dang mi mtshungs pa'i/ /rtog ge'i gsang gtam brtol ba'i blo gros dang / /lhan cig rigs par smra ba'i— grags snyan rgyas/ /zab mo'i chos nyid gzhal la zhugs pa na/ /tshur mthong blo gros nyi tshe ma yin par/ /yang dag nges shes yangs po'i rbem skas la/ /brten nas mtha' zal gnas lugs ji bzhin bzigs/ /spros med ji lha'i chos dbyings legs gzigs nga/sa/ /spros bcas lam gyi mdud pa zhig gyur cing / /blos byas jeb pa'i gnad gsang kun mkhyen pas/ /glen sgom rdzogs chen sgom lor khyod mi mtshungs/ /sna tshogs grub mtha'i tshul mang thugs chud nas/ /grub mtha'i 'dod blo zhi ba'i nang dbyings su/ /rtsol rtog med pa'i tshul gyis snyoms 'jug pas/ /tarka smra ba phal cher zil gyis mnan/ /mkhas pa'i sa mthor 'dzebs pa'i che rnams kyang / / 218

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1yid gnyis spang ba min pa'i rang mtshang brgya/ /ngom pa'i zab don sa 'og gter 'dra ba/ /de kun khyod kyi thugs la nyin bzhin gsal/ /khyod kyi rigs tshul gcig tsam rtogs pas kyang / /zab mo'i chos tshul sgo brgya cig char du/ /'byed pa'i thabs tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /skal bzang snying la gzungs spobs snang ba ster/ /khyod kyis legs bshad 'od snang spro ba na/ /blo ldan blo yi pad+mo 'dzum byed kyang / /rgol ngan 'byung po'i bya tshogs ldong gyur te/ /rab dga'i ku mud zlum zhing shin tu zum/ /'phags pa'i yul na 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang //gangs ri'i khrod na mi pham chos kyi rje//tha' 'gyur dbu ma'i dgongs don smra ba la/ /shing rta chen por bston dang bskru ba spangs/ /de slad bdag kyang khyod kyi rnam thar la/ /gus pa'i nyi gzhon snying gi kun gsal ltor/ /'dzin pa'i ngo mtshar shin tu bsnyen byas te/ /sor mo'i chu skyes zum la gcig tu phyogs/ /zhes pa'ang 'jigs med pas ja phor gang btung ba'i yun tsam la bsam gzhigs med par bris pa'o/ / //en en dus kyi yun la/ /mang mang chos sgo 'byedaXpa'i/ /myur myur blo gros mnga' ba/ /mkhas mkhas mi pham chos rje/ /yang yang yid la byas te/ /zlam zlum spyi bo'i thig ler/ /zum zum thal mos mchod kyi/ /zab zab blo mchog stsol shog/ //219

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma ༄/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa la bsngags pa'i gtam/me tog 'dzum pa'i lang tshor co 'dri'i dbu dang phyag gi khor yug la/ 1sa srung glang po'i stobs kyis mi mtshon sgyu rtsal stong gis nyer bsrungs ba/ /de la mthu stobs dpung bas brdzi ba'i go skabs sus kyang mi 'byed mod/ /slong mo'i don slad ut+pal 'dab 'dra'i ral gris nyid la nyid gcod mdzad/ /g.yul ngo'i 'jigs pas bsdigs pa med kyang bdag nyid chen po'i yan lag thob/ /g.yo sgyu'i zhags pas btab pa med kyang snying rje'i bdag nyid bran ltar byas/ /'bru dang nor gyis nyos pa min yang byang chub sems dpa'i bdog pa rnyed/ /sems can chen po'i gnas kyi sgo gtan skal chen slong mo de 'dras khebs/ /sa phyogs gang na 'khar ba'i 'khri shing sor mos bsten pa'i mi mthong ba/ /de yi mod la sbyin pa'i phar phyin g.yab mos 'bod pa 'di byung zhes/ /nyi mas dgod pa'i chu skyes ji bzhin mchu yi mdzum mdangs stong ngom zhing / /lus dang longs spyod srid sder bcas la gtong ba'i lag pa rkyong du rings/ /220

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1slong ba bzlog pa'i cho ga bgyid la ring mo'i dus nas mi bshes shing / sems can sems la rab dga'i dus ston ster ba'i dam bca'i khur lci bas/ /yid 'ong mkho dgu'i bdog pa 'dum phrag char du snyil ba'i legs byas kyis/ /gtong ba don gnyer da ri drwa ba'i re ba'i shing rta phyur bur 'gengs/ gang tshe 'byor pa'i sprin phung chen pos bkren ldan kun tu tshim byas tshe/ /rnyed dka'i byang chub mgron du 'gugs pa'i thabs 'di bdag gis grub bo zhes/ /de blo rab dga'i ngo mtshar de 'dra sbyin gnas des kyang ma thob ste//de ni de ltar 'jig rten gsum du phan pa rlabs chen bsgrub phyir gnas/ /dbang phyug brnyes pa'i chen po rnams kyis yang dang yang du smad byas shing / /gos kyi tha gru ro ras dum bus brtsegs shing brtsegs mar g.yogs gyur te/ /lus la gshin dri kun tu mnam pa'i dbul phongs skye bo nyam thag brgya/ /sbyin pa chen po'i bsod nams zhing du snying rje'i bdag nyid mchog gis bkur/ /yo byad gtong ba kho nar ma zad lus dang srog gis slong mo mchod/ /slong mor phan pa kho nar ma bas mtha' klas yid can don du che//gzhan phan 'bras bu nyi tshe ma yin stobs bcu'i khri 'phang mtho la 'dzegs/ /sbyin pa'i che ba blo yis mi thug bdag nyid chen po'i spyod pa mnga' /sha dang khrag la gcig tu rngam pa'i bdud dang spin po'i dmag 221

pod 1 no grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dpung yang / /'jigs byed gshed kyi phyogs su mi bzhed de la bsngags pas mdun bsus te/ /ma mas bu sdug nu zhos gso ltar rang gi lus kyis tshim mdzad phyir/ /byams chen mnga' ba'i grags pa de ko de la chud zos yong ma gyur/ /bsod nams mchog sga mchod sdong nyid gyur yan lag phul byung 'chang bzhin du/ /dman ba'i sha khrag bslangs nas ster ba tshul du shes pa ma yin zhes/ /sems dpa' mchog ni rang gi lus las gnod sbyin dga' ba'i mgron 'gyed kyi/ /rig byed smra ba'i mchod sbyin gtam la phu dud mdzad pa ma yin no/ /bye ba khrag khrig bskal ba'i yun la mnar med zhugs kyis rab sbyang yang / /de yi lus kyis btsas mchog bzhag pa 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin gyi/ /lhag pa'i sems kyis khrag gi chu rgyun phra mo tsam zhig sbyin byas pa'ang / /bla med byang chub lag rtser sbyin pa'i pho nya yin zhes dga' ba 'phel/ /rkang gi dum bu nyung shas ster bas gdung ba rnam mang 'phel gyur kyang / /de la kho bo gdung bas gdungs zhes zhum pas gshung bar mi 'gyur gyi/ /de las ches lhag sems can dmyal sogs sdug bsngal mang ldan 'khor ba par/ /lhag pa'i snying rje lhag par rgyas te byang chub spyod la lhag par dga'/ /srid pa'i thog ma gzhal du mi spyod yun ni shin tu ring po nas/ bdag gi don la rjes su chags pa'i ngang tshul 22 2

bstod tshogs phyogs bsdus/ pod 1yid la brtan byas pa'ang / /snying rje chen po'i mthu dpung gcig gis ming tsam lhag mar lus gyur te/ /kye ma'o sems kyi rgyud ni goms pa'i shugs las bskyed pa yin zhes nges pa rnyed/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa la bsngags pa'i gtam thung ngu mi'am ci'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba/ gzhon nu 'jigs med pas gang dran bris pa dge/ // 223

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga nga / /a ho skal ldan shing rta'i chu 'gram/ /skal bzang shākya'i grong gi nye 'dabs/ /nyams dga' lum+bi ni yi tshal der/ /zas gtsang ris/sa kyi pad+mo bzhad do/ /de tshe 'jig rten gsum gyi khongs 'di/ /lha klu mi gsum dga' ba'i ca cos/ /glu yi 'dun khang lta bur gyur te/ /dmyal khams sdug bsngal me yang zhi skad/ /nga ni sa gsum 'gro ba'i mig ces/ /'jigs bral tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ros/ /stong gsum dkyil 'khor ma lus bkang tshe/ /'on pa rnams kyang rna ba dag go/ /btso sbyangs gser zhun lta ba'i 'od kyis/ /mkha' ltar yangs pa'i zhing kun g.yogs te/ /dmus long mun pa'i skye gnas rnams kyang / /de tshe mig dang snang ba rnyed do/ /bgrang bya sum stong nye ba'i khongs 'dir/ /de lta'i ya mtshan gzhal med byung yang / /cha tsam mthong thos yul gyi skal bar/ /ma thob bdag 'dra de tshe gar song / /mgon po gzhon nu'i rol rtsed mdzad cing / /btsun mo'i 'khor dbus sgyu ma ston dang / /dka' spyad byang chub shing drung gshegs pa'i/ /gnas skabs kun tu nyin re zhing yang / /phyogs bcu'i zhing nas grangs med gdul bya/ /'phags yul ribs bzhi mi yi nang du/ /bdud rtsi sbyin pa'i mgron la bsogs nas/ /sa 'di de 'dra'i 'khor gyis gang ste/ /kye hud de tshe dbus 'gyur tshal gyi/ /gnag rdzi tha shal tsam du skye ba'i//skal ba ma gzigs sdig pa'i 226

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gong bu/ /bdag 'dra mi ru zlog ste ci rung / /skyes mchog byang chub bla med brnyes nas/ /phyogs bcur gdul bya re re'i phyir yang / /thogs med rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i shugs kyis/ /skyo dub ngal ba med par gshegs te/ /bdag 'dra 'di na ma brgyud bya ba/ /khams gsum kun tu yong ye med kyang / /sdig 'phrog 'khor lo mnga' ba'i phyag der/ /thang gcig ma btud skal pa ngan no/ /dri med zla zhal de yi spyan sngar/ /glen lkugs dud 'gro'i rten la phyin yang / /'di ltar rnam mang rgud pa'i rgya mtshor/ /bying ste mi mchi rta dbyangs bzhin no/1'on kyang bdag dang bdag 'dra du ma/ /thub pa'i sku tshe snga mar bsdu bzhis/ /mgron du bos pa'i 'khor la gtogs phyir/ /de yi tshe yang 'bangs su dgongs mchi//ring nas las kyi chu bos khyer yang / /drang srong smon lam zhags pas brtod phyir/ /rgyal bstan lnga brgya phyi ma'i dus mthar/ /gsung rab rin chen gling du thon byung / /phan mdzad chos kyi phrin bskur mang po/ /slob dpon klu sgrub zhal sgo brgyud nas/ /mthar gyis rje btsun bla ma'i drin las/ /yid dang rna ba'i bdud rtsir rnyed do/ /de tshe dga' skyo 'dres ma'i nyams kyis/ /kye ma'o thugs rje ldan pa'i ston pa/ /'di ltar 'phrin tsam shul du bzhag nas/ /gar bzhud snyam ste mchi ma klog go/ /sa steng chos kyi snang ba 'gyed pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin nyi zla'i phreng ba phal cher/ /dus 227

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyi rim pas zhi bar gzims te/ /chos min 'byung po'i bya rnams dkod 'dug /ston pa'i legs gsung nor bu'i sgrom chen/ /nags mchog gang du thog mar phye ba'i/ /drang srong lhung ba'i nags tshal de dang / /ri dbang bya rgod phung po de yang / /dga' ston zin pa'i skyed tshal bzhin du/ /ha cang nyams su dga' rgyu med de/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran mtshan ma phal cher/ /skyo shas skul ba'i pho nyar song 'dug /dkar po'i chos dang de yi 'bras bu/ /dga' dang skyid pa'i dngos po gang mthong / /ston pa'i bka' drin kho nar nges pas /des kyang rgyal ba nyag gcig dran no/ /'jigs rung snyigs ma'i spyod tshul rnams dang / /sdug bsngal mang pos yid rab byung tshe/ /blo gtad gzhan na med par nges pas/ /des kyang ston pa'i rnam thar dran no/ /mang du dran yang kun rtog ri mo/ /ngus kyang rang nyid gdungs ba tsam las/ /mtshan dpe'i mchod sdong bltar ni mi snang //kyi tud mi bzad las kyi nun pa/ /de ltar rang rgyud chos kyi sgrib pas/ /bslad phyir sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams dang / /gang gis bdag cag phyag mtshan bzhes pa'i/ /shākya'i skyes mchog de yang ma mthong / /da dung rang gi spyod la bltas tshe/ /byas tshad chos spang min pa mi 'dug /de phyir ma byon sangs rgyas rnams kyang / /de 'drar 'gyur dogs gdung ba skye'o/ /tshul 'di bsams shing skye ba kun tu//228

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1skad cig tsam yang dam pa'i chos la/ /log sgrub mi byed bsam sbyor gtsang mas/ /rgyal ba dgyes skyed smon lam 'debs so/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i zus su bsams te/ /mchi ma klag pa'i smre sngags 'di yis/ /sngon bsags chos kyis phongs pa'i sgrib mun/ /mtha' dag yud la byang bar gyur cig /brtser bcas bden pa gsung ba de yis/ /ma byon rgyal rnams nga yi mdza' zla/ /nga la rtse gcig dad par byos dang / /mdza' bo'i tshogs la bcol gtam bgyi yis/ /zhes gsungs bka' 'di rnam pa gzhan du/ /mi 'gyur snyam nas re ba'i mig yangs/ /zla med ston pa khrod la gtod kyis/ /thugs rje'i rgya mtsho btang snyoms ma bzhugs/ /byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs phreng bar/ /khyod kyi yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mdzod khang / /dngos po kun byis legs par bzung ste/ /khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig byed par shog cig /ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po rjes su dran pa'i smre sngags kyi gdung dbyangs don dang ldan pa zhes bya ba bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzes byed chu stod zla ba'i rgyal ba dang po'i nyin sbyar ba 'dis kyang skye ba thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pas rjes su dgongs par gyur cig gu// //ra / /ngo mtshar la a ho/ /'gro drug sred pa'i rgyal khams yangs por/ /nges med rgyu ba'i sprang rgan thrun pa/ /mi srid dgu srid 229

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/las kyi sgyu ma/ /ma mthong bya ba gtan nas med de/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab nyi ma'i 'od kyis/ /skal bzang kun dga'i pad+mo phye ba'i//zhing bzang 'di 'drar slebs cig ma myong / /da res slebs pa skyid pa'i dga' ston/ /smag rum dmyal ba'i gnas nas 'thon te/ /lan cig sa steng phyin snyam tsa na/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi zhabs sen drung na/ /mig 'bur trig ger slabs nas gda' 'o/ /glen lkugs ngan 'gro'i yul gyi sems can/ /da lta 'phags pa'i slob 'bangs nang na//chos kyi dga' nyams bskyang nas bsdad yod/ /a ho 'dus byas 'di yi 'gyur ba/ /rje btsun thugs rje'i bum pa bzang por/ /'jus nas smon lam dkar po btab zin/ /da dung bde nas bde bar los 'gro/ /skyid do snyam nas dga' bro 'khrob dang / /bsags pa don ldan rbeg mchog longs spyod/ /da lta 'di yod snyam pa med de//re ltos mi bslu khong la bsten nas/ /rang skal mi 'chad gdeng zhig yod do/ /las kyi rgya mtshor nya ltar 'gyu yang / /'phags mchog skyabs sbyin phyag rgya'i lcags kyur/ /legs smon srad bus sbrel ba'i nya chung / /chu gnas gzhan dang yun ring mi 'grogs/ /a ho lnga bdo'i snyigs ma'i mi nang / /skyid bro brdung dang 'jigs med smyon pa//'dam kyi nang na 'dzum dkar shigs se/ /pad+ma dkar po'i lad mo khyogs dang / /dgun gyi yul ngan zhig gi rkyen dbang dang 230

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'grogs pas shes pa skyo ba na a mtshar du bris pa yin no//dge'o////ra / /a ho nam mkha'i rnal 'byor chen po gnyug ma'i dbyings su/ /lhun grub gzhon nu bum pa 'od kyi lus can/ /zung 'jug thog ma'i sangs rgyas mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer/ /mi 'bral snying dbus bkar ngal 'tsho mdzod cig /nged cag brgyud pa bzang po'i bu chung gzhon nu/ /rtogs pa'i rtsal shugs rdzogs pa re zhig med kyang / /pha mes rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i shul lam mthong bas /da ni theg mchog rgyal pos yid kha gang yod/ /theg pa'i nang na mtho ba a ti yo ga /thabs kyi nang na bde ba sgom med cog bzhag /byung rgyal nyams kyi ngang nas snang ba gdod 'ded/ /da ni ci yang mi 'dod ro nyal rgyag 'dod/ /dpyad kyang bzhag so mi rnyed rtog pa nying 'khrul/ /bltas kyang blta yul mi mthong rten med gnas med/ /lta ba byar med ngang du sgom pa rang bzhag /da ni bya ba blos btang gcig pur nyal 'dod/ /ngo bo ka dag zer yang dag pas mi tshim /gzhi grol gnyug ma zer yang grol sar mi 'jog /rtogs ldan 'ud kyis bslus pa mang zhig mthong bas/ /da ni 'grigs 'grigs yin yin smra snying mi 'dod/ /dag pa ka nas dag ste yang dag mi dgos/ /grub pa lhun grub yin te da grub ci bgyi/ /bsal bzhag sems kyi spros pa shigs se thongs la/ /da ni gnas lugs ngang la lhod de 23

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga sdod 'dod/ /bya rtsol spros pa'i zhen 'dzin yid kyi 'ching thag /rtsol med tha mal sdod pa 'khrul ba'i yo lang / /rtsol dang mi rtsol zer ba rtog pa'i rdzun ris/ /da ni gtad med ngang la gang dgar nyal 'dod/ /snang ba phyi na med de chos sku'i rig gdangs/ /stong pa nang na med de mnyam nyid khyab bdal/ /zang thal phyi nang med pa'i yin lugs shes nas/ /da ni mi spro mi bsdu tsog ger sdod 'dod/ /zab mo rigs pa rno yang phig sa mi 'dug /gnas lugs thos pa mang yang bo mkhan dka' bas/ /gnyug ma tshig gis mtshon dus yod yod mi 'dra/ /da ni rtog ge sgog po'i spros pa gcod 'dod/ /gzhung brgya spu ris 'byed pa'i brjod sgros med kyang / /rang bzhag yangs pa chen po'i lta stangs gcig gis/ /spros pa'i grwa zur 'bum phrag cig char chod na/ /tha snya da tshig skam spur ba 'gram pa'i gcog rdo/ /tshe gang chos ra 'grims nas 'chi kha lag stong / /mgo thod sgom la bzhag nas skye shi'i kha brgyud/ /de dang de 'dra'i ngal ba 'bras med bzhag nas/ /gdod ma'i nang dbyings chen por sib kyis 'jug 'dod/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal zer yang rtog pa'i rang mdangs/ /zhi gyur myang 'das zer yang sems kyi chos nyid/ /'khor 'das rig dang mi rig lag pa'i lto rgyab/ /'chi med byang chub zhi ba thag ring mi bzhugs/ /sgrib bral dbyings rig dbyer med gnyug ma'i gzhi klong /23 2

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1khams gsum rtog pa'i 'jug ldang shugs kyis dengs pas/ /klong chen ye shes dam pa'i me long gcig tu/ /chos kun mnyam par zlum pa sgom gyi skyel so/ /a ho dga' bo skyid do rdo shod smyon pa/ /pha gcig kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i gzhung lugs mthong nas/ /tshur mthong byis pa'i ngag la dga' ba mi skye/ /theg mchog rdzogs chen bsam na khyad chos 'dug go/ /de slad rten 'brel bzang po'i kha g.yang bos pas/ /gnas skabs rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar mthong zhing / /mthar thug khyad chos drug ldan gdod ma'i dbyings su/ /'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'i dga' ston zhu'o/ /zhes pa'ang rdo rong gi thrun pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis sbyon tshig rkang pa dum chod byas pa dge zhing bkra shis//// 233

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ༄/ /snyigs ma'i skye bo'i rnyed bkur gyi longs spyod la skyo ba'i gtam skal bzang rna rgyan zhes bya ba/zhing rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi snang brnyan/ /ma 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig rje btsun gyi bla ma/ /thugs ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs kyi 'jug pas/ /sprang bdag gi blo sna chos phyogs la bsgyur mdzod/ /dus bskal mang bsags pa'i legs byas kyi mthu las/ /chos bcu gnyis tshang ba'i mi lus zhig rnyed kyang / /'di rnyed par dka' ba'i gnas tshul la rmongs pa'i/ /khong stong log mkhan gyi rnal 'byor de e gzigs/ /mi mkhas par grags pa'i dpyod ldan gyi skye bo/ /nor chos brgyad sgrub pa'i gsog 'jog la mkhas te/ /tshe phyi mar 'gro dus gro rgyags shig med na/ /skyas chen po 'degs dus ci 'dra zhig yin ang / /nor 'byor ba rgyas pa'i ston chen gyi bla ma/ /zhal ja chang btung ba'i dga' ston la rol zhing / /thugs nga rgyal chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis dgyes pa'i/ /tshul 'di 'dra snyigs ma'i pho nya ru 'dug go/ /gnas rgyal khams 'grims pa'i rtog ldan gyi rnal 'byor/ /spyan seng ge'i lta stangs nam mkha' la sgril zhing / /234

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gsung hūṃ sgra gcig gis rta mdzo brgya zlum ste/ /rdo gor mo 'phen 'dra'i man ngag de ci zhig /dus lan gcig bsgoms pa'i zhi gnas kyang med bzhin/ /gtam mngon shes yin brdzuXcal col du sgrog pa'i/ /mi de 'dra zog ma'i sgrib byed la mkhas te/ /dpe yal ga'i ri dwags mchod gnas su 'os sam/ /lam pheg chen pa zhes zhal bzhes su mdzad bzhin/ /ma drin chen bsad pa'i sha khrag gis dgyes shing / /thugs snying rjes gzigs yul sbyin bdag tu dgongs nas/ /bgegs dgra ru 'dzin pa'i sems dpa' de a ho/ /rtags ngur smrig bgo ba'i rgyal mtshan dang 'grogs kyang / /las spong klog gnyis ldan bya ba de bor nas/ /gtam glu gar sgrung rgyud bzhad gad kyi 'khor lo/ /rten dal 'byor 'joms pa'i mtshon cha ru e gzigs/ /gos ras dkar lhon pa tsi na la yod mod/ /skra ral pa'i thor gtsug nu stegs kyis 'dzin te/ /rgyan rkang lag gdu du rked med kyis 'chang na/ /de rnal 'byor dpa' bo'i khyad chos su re 'am/ /grogs chung ma len pa tshangs spyod kyi 'gal zla/ /chas zlum po'i ḍā ru ngal dub kyi khur chen/ /tshig 'ud gog skam po bslu brid kyi g.yo zol/ /de gsum ldan sngags kyi brtul zhugs su re'am/ /thabs myur lam zab mo gsang sngags kyi sgrub rdzas1 /don snang stong zung 'jug gnyis med kyi phyag rgya/ /rtags rdo rje dril bu'i dkyil 23 5

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga 'khor zhig mthong na/ /yon rin thang brtsi ba'i sngags 'chang tsho e gzigs/ /lha drang srong chen po'i rjes 'jug tu rlom bzhin/ /tshul 'khyogs spyod sna dgu'i ngang tshul la gnas pa'i/ /dus snyigs ma'i rang gzugs dge sbyong gi bzo bcos/ /de bstan 'dzin yin zer ngo mtshar zhig che'o/ /tshul 'di dang 'di 'dra'i ngan spyod kyis kun khebs//khong lnga bdo snyigs ma'i thun gsum gyis bskul nas/ /chos thar lam snang ba'i dgra zla ru slebs tshe/ /mi 'jigs pa med pas skyo glu ru blangs so/ /tshul de 'dra shes pa'i blo gros kyi khye'u chung / /sgo rnam pa mang po'i spyod ngan gyis dkris sa pa'i/ /grogs byis pa'i skye bo'i sun 'byin zhig byas tshe/ /nor bkur ste'i tshogs kyang de ka la phyogs 'dug /yun ring por 'grogs pa'i sred len gyi pho nyas/ /dus rtag par bsgrubs pa'i rnyed bkur gyi longs spyod/ /klu 'jog po lta bu'i dpal 'byor la spyod kyang / /lam ring mo 'grims dus phan pa zhig bdog gam/ /dgra 'chi bdag gshin rje'i g.yul ngo der slebs tshe/ /nor rin chen thang ma stong gsum du bdal yang / /de'i sug 'bul len pa ri bong gi rwa co/ /cad rang la phan pa ga 'dra zhig yod ang / /thabs rnam mang ngal ba'i dka' tshegs kyis bsgrubs pa'i/ /nor rnyed bkur snyan grags tshangs chen las lhag kyang / /de gar song cha med bar snang gi bya rjes/ /rang gcig pur 236

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'gro dus ci tshugs zhig bya snyam/ /nor dang po bskrub dus g.yo sgyu yi byaXb/ /phyi lus ngas/ 'khyug 'khyug mgo skor gyi rdzun ma/ /nang rang sems 'khyug 'khyug bsam gzhig gi 'khor lo/ /de'i bya spyod mtha' dag brel do yi phung po/ /nor bar du bsrung dus ngal dub kyi yo lang / /nyin ring por 'bad pa'i dka' thub kyis smad pas/ /lus shin tu nyam thag mgal dum bzhin nyal yang / /las bsod nams ma bsags 'bad rtsol gyis phan nam/ /nor tha ma spel dus 'du 'dzi yi 'khor lo/ /thabs sna tshogs tshul gyis dpal 'byor rang spel kyang / /sngon sbyin pa byas pa'i bsags rgyab zhig med na/ /gsog ji ltar mkhas kyang 'phel rgyu zhig e gda'/ /khab sbud pa gsog pa'i khyem bdas/ dang yon gnas/ /dus nyin gcig 'das pa'i sos dal kyang med par/ /nor longs spyod bsgrubs pa gar song yang med na/ /de khyab 'jug chen po'i lto zhal du phul lam/ /gro sran ma tsam gyi longs spyod zhig yod kyang / /yid zug rngu'i tshor ba de tsam zhig mchis na/ /mnog shin tu chung ba'i dbang thang gis ci bya/ /rgob rnyi las thar ba'i gdams ngag de e dran/ /dgra rnam g.yeng 'phel ba'i rnyed bkur dang snyan grags/ /don snying po med pa'i rang tshul 'di shes nas/ /sems thar pa 'dod pa'i skal bzang gi gzhon nu/ /gnas dben pa dran nas tshugs thabs rang 2 37

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mi gda'/ /mgon sras bcas rgyal bas lan brgya ru bsngags shing //lha thub pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bsrung ba'i/ /gnas ngo mtshar sman ljongs dben ri yi rgyal khab/ /pha kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i gdan sa ru dgongs sam/ /nags ljon shing phreng ba mdzes rgyan du gnas shing / /gtsug ri bong 'dzin pa la thod du bcings pa'i/ /grogs nyon mongs med pa'i mdzes sdug gi lhun po/ /lus mi gtsang gze ri'i sdig grogs dang 'dra'am/ /g.yu'i mdzes pa 'gog pa'i ljang gsal gyi 'khri shing / /rlung shin tu 'jam pa'i bsil chab kyis bskul tshe/ /lus bsil ba'i reg byas lan brgya ru sim byed/ /khyed mi chen dgyes pa'i rnga yab kyis e 'gran/ /gnas ma bcos lhun grub rdo leb kyi khang bzang / /chod phag phug du ma'i mdzod khang yang med de/ /nor chog shes bsags pa'i 'dzad med kyi gter chen/ /'di kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i bsags rdzas kyi pha khang / /mdangs shin tu gsal ba'i na chung gi grogs mos/ lha mig stong dbang po'i rgyud mangs la 'gran pa'i/ /skad yan lag brgya ba'i 'jo sgeg dang 'grogs nas/ /yid thar bar bskrul ba'i pho nya de dran byung / /mdog be zur gzhon nu'i gzi mdangs la 'gran cing //mig nyi ma'i lus kyi mtshungs zla ru 'os pa'i/ /gnyen lho mon dga' mas mgrin gru zhig blangs tshe/ /chos 'dus byas 'jig pa'i ngang 238

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1tshul de dran byung / /reg 'jam zhing sdug pa'i 'dab brgya yi ze'u 'bru/ /gnas nges med 'grim pa'i rkang drug gi gzhon chung / /glu snyan la 'jib pa'i mgrin rnga dang lhan cig /bcud sbrang rtsi'i snying po ci dga' ru blangs song / /sgra lhung lhung 'bab pa'i phu chu yi bshes gnyen/ /dus rings par rings par mi rtag gi pho nya/ /tshul nga cag 'dra zhes gdams ngag tu 'doms pa'i/ /don 'di 'dra ston pa dben ri yi khyad chos/ /dus char ldan rgyal mo'i gsog brun (skrun)gyi me tog/khong mi sdug srin mo'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i//tshul de mthong bsags pa 'dzad mtha' ru shes pa'i/ /tshul 'di 'dra ston pa'i bla ma ru gzigs sam/ /snyigs ma'i skye bo'i rnyed bkur gyi longs spyod la skyo ba'i gtam skal bzang rna rgyan zhes bya ba ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba la mngon par spro ba'i byis pa 'jigs med pas so////pa / /pha bka' drin mtshungs med o rgyan gyi chos rje/ /skyabs mchog gsum kun 'dus drin chen gyi bla ma/ /de dbyer med rje btsun ye shes kyi me long / /nga'i snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo ru rtsen mdzod/ /gshis mtha' brgyad spros bral nges don gyi 'jam dpal/ /de tshig tu brjod pas go rgyu zhig mi gda'/ /blos ji ltar brtags kyang bsam rgyu zhig mi 'dug /da rtsol med lta bas khyed zhal de blta 239

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'dod/ /las byas byas nam mkha'i mdung skor dang mtshungs shing / /yid gang shar sprul mdud rang grol du 'dug pa/ /de shes nas thabs gsal gnyis med kyi 'jam dpal/ /don mnyam nyid chen por lhod lhod du 'jog snyam/ /lha'i bskyed rim bsgom pa rnam rtog gi ri mo/ /lam rtsa rlung sbyong ba blos byas kyi nol 'byor/ /de shes nas bya rtsol blo 'das kyi 'jam dpal/ /thabs cog bzhag 'khyel ba'i man ngag gis blta 'dod/ /sems spang du mi 'tshal 'jam mgon gyi rang gdangs/ /lam bsgrub tu mi 'tshal sa lam kun gzhi rdzobs/ /de shes nas mnyam rdzogs gzhi grol gyi 'jam dpal/ /blo 'jur bus ma yin lhod 'bol du blta snyam/ /blo tshogs drug 'gog pa srid rtse la yod cing / /sems dang du len pa khyi rgan yang shes mod/ /de mthong nas gnyug ma dag mnyam gyi 'jam dpal/ /blo bsal bzhag med par gu yangs su blta 'dod/ /yid kun rtog 'ching ba khams gsum gyi rtsa ba/ /sems cir yang mi 'dzin ha shang gi lta sgom/ /de shes nas rig stong mtha' bral gyi 'jam dpal/ /thabs gsal dwangs byed pa'i nyams myong gis blta 'dod/ / dbyibs kha dog med de stong chen gyi chos nyid/ /rgya ris chad bral ba kun khyab kyi rig gdangs/ /phyogs mtha' dbus med de mkha' mnyam gyi ye shes/ /tshul de shes 'jam mgon rang zhal de mthong ngo /240

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ho ho/ gshis yod pa ma lags bden med kyiXrol mo/ /de med pa ma lags kun snang gi ye gzhi/ /blos gang du brtags kyang mthong rgyu zhig mi 'dug /tshig yi ger brjod pas mtshon rgyu zhig ma lags/ / phyi brtan snod ma yin bem chos su ma grub/ /nang g.yo ba ma yin gang zag tu mi gda'/ /chos rtag dang mi rtag brjod gzhi las 'das pa'i/ /don yin lugs zab mo spros mtshan las 'das so/ /mi brtson 'grus can 'ga' 'jur dran la 'byams song / /khong shes rab can phal rtob ge la zhen song / pha blo ldan mchog sred byin rlabs kyi mthu las/ /mi nga cag pheg rtse'i dgongs don la dga' 'o/ /zhes pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med pas lcags sprul gyi zla12tshes25la skad cig yud tsam gyis bris pa'o// // ra / /ri bo sprin dkar gyi lu thod can/ /khyod la na bun 'di mdzes mod de/ /drag po'i 'thor rlung zhig slebs tsa na/ /mgo rjen lus rjen du 'gro nyen yod/ /nags klong rtsi sman gyi yo lang can/ /khyod la lcugs phran 'di mdzes mod de/ /ston dgun reg bya yis bran tsa na/ /sku rkyang dbu rkyang du 'gro nyen yod/ /khu byug rgyud mangs kyi sgra dbyangs can/ /khyod kyang char bsil 'dis 'tsho mod de/ /grang reg kha ngar gyis brdol tsam na/ /sgo ṭa'i sman ljongs nas bros dogs yod/ /ne'u seng me tog gi 'dzum zhal can/ /khyod kyang ge 241

yod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/sar gyis khengs mod de/ /drug pa'i hor zla de song tsa na/ /thal ba'i mdog ngan zhig 'char las che/ /pad+ma 'dab stong gi lang tsho can/ /khyod kyang g.yu sbrang 'dis bkur mod de/ /chab rom gdong ba la bab tsa na/ /grogs po lnga lam du 'gro dogs yod/ /rtsa ljang bsil 'jam gyi reg bya can/ /khyod kyang g.yu mdog 'dis mdzes mod de//nyi ma lhor bgrod kyi mthar slebs tshe/ /rtsa skya'i grags ngan zhig 'thob kyis dogs/ /lo tog 'bru sngon gyi rtsi bcud can/ /khyod kyang zhing sa na brjid mod de/ /ba mo'i tshe gegs zhig byung tsa na/ /khong rul snying stong du 'gro dogs yod/ /gzhon nu bstan rgyam gyi ming rgog can/ /khyod kyang gson yul du snang mod de/ /gshin rje'i bka' khrims kyis ded tsa na/ /gcer bu lab stong du 'gro nyen che/ /chos gtam rna lam du grags nas yod//'chi chos blo thog tu blang ba med/ /byur ngan sna 'dren gyi 'gong rgan khyod/ /rang phung rang brlag zhig byed nges yod/ /lha chos rten drung na bzhugs bzhin du//sdig spyod kha zas su za lugs la/ /thar ba'i re ba de zad par mchi//bar do'i 'phrang ring du ltad mo ltos/ /gson tshe rnam g.yeng gi yo lang 'gyed/ /'chi kha sen rjes kyis brang rgog 'geng / /bar do'i 'jigs skrag gi 'khor lo bskor/ /de 'dra bstan rgyam gyi rnam thar yin/ /zhes pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 242

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1kyis bris pa'o// / /ra / /ho ho/ mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i 'od gsal gyi klong du/ /yid dpyod kyi zhen 'dzin rang grol du dag song / /rang byung gi rig pa bzo med kho mthong nas/ /'bad rtsol gyi spu ris bri 'dod cig med do/ /'dzin stangs ni mi 'dug gnyug ma yi dran rig /bzo bcos ni mi dgos gtad med kyi shes pa/ /dpyad sgom ni mi byed rang bzhag gi chos nyid/ /mtha' bral gyi klong du cham gdal du song ngo / /ba nas pa dang 'gyu ba'i shan 'byed kyis ma brel/ /mngon 'gyur dang lkog 'gyu'i rtsis gdab kyang ma dgos/ /gsal sgrib dang bral ba'i klong chen gyi dgongs pa/ /dmigs gtad kyi mtshan ma zhi ba de skyid do/ /snang ba la stong pas rgyas 'debs kyang ma yin//stong pa dang snang ba res 'jog kyang ma dgos/ /ka dag dang lhun grub dbyer med kyi dgongs klong / /phyogs 'dzin gyi mdud pa rang zhig tu thal thal/ /rnam rtob la sgom du re ba des ci bya/ /rtog med kyi snyoms 'jug de 'dras kyang ci lto/ /rtog bcas dang rtog med 'dzin rtsol las 'das pa'i/ /sgom med 'di sgom gyi drag shos rang yin no/ /'khrul rtog gi ltad mos bslus pa yang min mod/ /yul snang gi 'char cha nub pa'ang ma yin/ /nang gsal gyi rig pa 'dzin med du bzhugs des/ /gzung 'dzin gyi ri bo rmang sgyel zhig byas 243

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— —skad/ /brag gseb kyi sgom chen 'di 'dra rang gsungs bda'/ /sprang pos ni rdzogs chen rtogs dus zhig nam yod/ /'on kyang ni bla ma pad 'byung de'i drin las/ /rib stong gi chos sku'i gtan srid kyang 'dzin thang / /ces 'jigs med pas so// //༄//dbyings dag chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /rtsal bde chen badz+ra ku mā ra/ /de dbyer med gnyug ma'i 'od gsal che/ /'di khrag 'thung stong bi srog snying yin/ /lha sgom kyang rung la ma bsgom rung / /gzhi ye grol chos sku'i rgyal khab na/ /don ris stong gi dpal chen yab yum zung / /dus bzhi mnyam nyid du 'bral med bzhugs//sngags bzlas kyang rung la ma bzlas rung / /brjod tshad 'di brjod med kyi rol mor gda'/ /brjod med de spros bral don gyi sngags/ /de 'pho 'gyur med par gdod nas gnas/ /mnyam bzhag la bsdad rung ma bsdad rung / /shar snang 'di ye shes kyi rol bar gda'/ /da lhar gyi shes pa tha mal pa/ /'di mtshan med rig pa'i phur khu yin/ /snang snang 'di dag chen phur pa'i lha/ /grag grab 'di mi shigs rdo rje'i sngags/ /dran dran 'di mi rtog ye shes thugs/ /snang srid 'di dkyil 'khor gsum du che/ /der lha yang ye shes rol ba'i lha/ /sngags kyang ye shes rdo rje'i sngags/ /thugs kyang mi rtog ye shes thugs/ /thams cad ye shes kyi rol mor 'dug /don ma bcos 244

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rig pa'i phur bu de/ /blo gnyis 'dzin gdon gyi snying la rgyobs/ /thug phrad rang grol gyi smad las des/ /khams gsum 'di ka dag dbyings su sgrol/ /ngas de ltar rtogs pa ma lags te/ /grub chen gyi gzigs mo 'di yin zhes/ /rtogs ldan tshos gsung gleng mol ba thos/ /thos pa bzhin drangaXpor smras pa lags// // pa / /pha snyan brgyud rdo rje'i lam ston mchog /mkhyen brtse'i zlos sar de yang yang dran/ /gshis rdzogs pa chen po ye grol la/ /gnad gtad med lta ba'i gzer ka zhig /lam yi ge med pa'i chos mdzod der/ /pha bla ma'i drin gyis de ring mthong / /dbyings mtha' brgyad spros bral sgom blo 'di/ /lam theg rtse'i dgongs don mi byed pas/ /da 'od gsal ma bcos cob bzhag gis/ /gzhi rang bzhin rnam dag gdar sha chod/ /sems rtog pa'i 'gyu dran dengs pa tsam /don gnyug ma'i chos sku ma lags pas/ /da gzhi grol ka dag zab mo'i dbyings/ /sems rig pa'i la shan dbye ste ltos/ /sgom ro gcig snang sems 'dres blo tsam/ /zung 'jug gi 'od gsal ma lag/sa pas/ /da gzung 'dzin gtad med yongs grol ngang / /kun rtog gi spros pa shigs la zhog /lar snang ba yul gyi rdzun ris la/ / shes bya sum sgril gyi man ngag yod/ /lam rig stong kha sbyor ma shes na/ /snang sems gzhi grol gyi a bo min/ /nang 'dzin pa sems kyi 246

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan kyi nyi'i gsung 'bum/byung tshor na/ /sgyu ma ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag yod/ /lam 'od gsal rtsal sbyong mi shes na/ /khyab gdal gyi chos skad lad mo yin/ /bar las rlung nyi khri yal ba na/ /gshis gzhon nu bum pa'i chos sku yod/ /ye grol gyi lam gnad ma 'chug na/ /stong gsal gyi dran rig gzugs brnyan tsam/ /lam rdzogs chen sgom pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /gnyid shes bya bum 'jug gnad du che/ /sman gzhon nu'i reg bya gang dgar thongs/ /don ye shes kyi phyag rgyar rtsed mo mdzod/ /srod tho rangs gnyis kyi ston gral na/ /gnyid rmi lam gnyis kyi mtshams shig na/ /yid chos skur grol ba'i nyams myong yod/ /lu ba'i gos can ltar cis mi mdzad/ /lam lhar snang tsam gyis mi ngoms pa'i /bu las 'phro las kyi skal bzang dag /pha sngon byon gong ma'i rnam thar bzigs/ /khyad chos drug ldan du mchong la shog /ces pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med pas so// //ra / /rgya yan cog bzhag rang byung gi rig pa/ /ye babs rang gnas ka dag gi chos nyid/ /lta grub mkhan pos mthong sa na mi gda'/ /'dzin zhen med pa'i nye lam zhig dgos so/ /gdal ba ༷ chen po kun khyab kyi ye shes/ /rtog pas ma bzos klong chen gyi dgongs pa/ /rtos be mkhan pos mthong sa na mi gda'//rang babs 'jog pa'i nye lam zhig dgos so/ /ye grol gshis lugs mtha' 246

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bzhi las 'das pa'i/ /kun byed snying po byang chub kyi sems mchog /dmigs gtad mkhan pos mthong sa na mi gda'/ /dmigs med 'jog pa'i nye lam zhig dgos so/ /gzhi med rtsa bral 'od gsal gyi rig pa/ /bsam brjod spros zal mkha' mnyam gyi ye shes/ /rtog dpyod mkhan pos mthong sa na mi gda'/ /gnyug mar 'jog pa'i nye lam zhig dgos so/ /phyal ba lhug pa rtog bral gyi rang mdangs/ / skye 'gags gnyis med dag gsal gyi dgongs pa/ /'dod zhen mkhan pos mthong sa na mi gda'/ /blo 'dzin med pa'i nyams len zhig dgos so/ /ye bzhag rang bzhag gzhi bzhag gi dgongs pa/ / ye gdal phyam gdal khyab gdal gyi rang rig /gtad med 'dzin med rtog med kyi ye shes/ /cer grol rang grol mtha' grol gyi chos nyid/ /'jur dran gnyen pos 'ching sa na mi bzhugs/ /spang gnyen ye grol tha mal gyi shes pa/ /ma byas ye zin rtsol med kyi 'bras bu/ /ma bgrod ye phyin chos sku yi rgyal sa/ /mi bsgom rgyun chad med pa yi sgom pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i nye lam de mkhyen nam/ /lha stangs mthon po nam mkha' la bsgril ba'i/ /u tsugs can gyi glen sgom la gzigs dang / /ha shang rgan po'i tha tshig gis bcings pa'i/ /'dag zhal mkhan po'i rnam thar de mthong ngam/ / //ra / /gnyug ma mtha' bral gyi gnas lugs chen po/ /ji 247

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bzhin rjen pa ru ston pa'i bla ma/ /'bral med snying dbus kyi thig ler bzhugs nas/ /'od bsal ye shes kyi snang ba sprul shog /zab mo gsang chen gyi theg pa'i dgongs bcud/ /blo bral rig stong gi ye shes chen po/ /rtsol med rang bzhag tu lta ba'i man ngag /shin tu rnal 'byor gyi khyad chos kho na/ /spros pa'i grwa zur dang mdza' ba min pa'i/ /stong chen brjod bral gyi kun zlum thig le/ /rang gnas ye shes kyi snying por bcas pa/ /zung 'jug 'od gsal de ngo mtshar che'o/ /mtshan 'dzin gnyis snang gi drwa ba stug po/ /blo 'das ye shes kyi ral gris bcad pas/ /zhen 'dzin dmigs gtad kho skye snyam mi 'dug /nam mkha' rdul bral gyi klong ltar 'dug go/ /sna tshogs rnam rtog gi na bun lang long / /sgong bsgyur sbyong byed kyi rtsol ba med kyang / /rgya yan cog bzhag la ci bder bsgyur bas/ /klong chen ye grol gyi gshis su dengs song / /mi dge'i rnam rtog la spang rgyu ci yod/ /shar tshad ye shes kyi rol mor 'dug pa/ /dke ba'i rnam rtob la bsgrub rgyu ci yod/ /blos byas yid dpyod kyi 'ching bar 'dug pa//sdug bsngal ngan pa la dogs rgyu ci yod/ /sdug bsngal rig stong gi rang rtsal yin pa/ /dga' bde'i tshor ba la re rgyu ci yod/ /dga' bde tha mal gyi snang tshul lags pa/ /'jur dran a 'thas kyis bcing ba ma yin/ /'khrul ba rgya 'byams su lhod pa ma yin/ /rang 248

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'gros bcos slad dang bral ba'i dgongs klong / /mnyam rdzogs zang thal gyi nyams myong ngo mtshar/ /tshogs drug yul snang gi sgyu ma'i grong na/ /kun byed glang po kho ci bder yan tshe//rang grol rjes med kyi ltad mo che bas/ /spang gnyen 'dor len gyi ngal dub mi dgos/ /de slad rdo rje yi mched po khyod kyang / /stong sgom nun can gyi bslu brid bor la/ /yod med yin min gyi mtshan ma zhi ba'i/ /gdod ma'i nang dbyings der myur du phebs song //'jigs med pas so////rab/ /tha mal gyi shes pa zang thal ye grol la lhos dang / /yid kyi dbang po tshig dang yi ges brjod du med pa nam mkha' la mdung bskor bas 'big rgyu med pa ltar 'dug go/ /bcos bslad dang bral ba gnyug ma'i ye shes la ltos dang / /ma dag las rlung gi rgyu ba cha dang bcas pas bsgribs kyang ma gos pa nyi ma sprin gyis bsgribs kyang rang ngor bslad pa med pa ltar 'dug ko/ /rang grol la rgyun chad med pa'i sgom pa la ltos dang / /rnam rtog gi 'khrul 'khor ji ltar 'khrugs kyang rang ngo la skyon mi 'jug pa pad+mo la chus mi gos pa ltar 'dug go/ /kun khyab cho 'phrul sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i rang rig la ltos dang / /yul snang ji ltar shar kyang rang gi grogs su che ba rlung ji ltar 'khrugs kyang me chen po lhag par 'bar ba ltar 'dug go /kun snang 'od gsal gyi rang gdangs 249

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gag med kyi 'char tshul la ltos dang / /bden par med bzhin du sku dang thig le'i snang ba cir yang 'char ba 'ja' tshon nam mkha' la bkra ba ltar 'dug go/ /gzhi grol gyi ye shes mkha' mnyam yangs pa la ltos dang / /rgya chad dang phyogs lhung med pa shin tu tshad med pa'i nam mkha' dwangs pa'i klong ltar 'dug go/ /ye gnas kyi chos sku phyam gdal chen po la ltos dang / /'khrul pa dang grol ba thams cad rang gi ngang las ma g.yos pa rlabs ji ltar byung yang rgya mtsho chen po las g.yo ba med pa ltar 'dug go/ /kun byed kyi ston pa 'pho med spros bral la ltos dang / /ngo bo la dri ma med kyang dri ma rang rtsal du shar ba nam mkha' la sprin gyis bsgribs kyang sprin rang gi ngang las byung ba ltar 'dug go/ /ha ha/ ma bcos pa'i chos nyid/ma 'khrul pa'i gnas lugs/ mi rtob pa'i ye shes/ ma yengs pa'i dran pa/ ma mthong ba'i mthong ba/ mi bsgom pa'i bsgom pa/ yul dang yul can thams cad dbyer med chu la chu bzhag pa lhar 'dub go/ /tshig las 'das pa'i rang bzhin/ sems 'a sa 'das pa'i rig pa/ blo las 'das pa'i don dam/ yid las 'das pa'i shes rab/mtha' las 'das pa'i 'od gsal/ nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil ltaraX'adug go /gza' gtad med pa'i nyams myong / ched 'dzin med pa'i mnyam bzhag/ gzung 'dzin med pa'i ye shes/ rtsis 260

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gdab med pa'i rjes thob/ rgyun chad med pa'i rnal 'byor/ bar med chu bo'i rgyun ltar 'dug go/ /spros med la spros par 'dzin pa mtshar che/ blo bral la rtog ges 'jal ba dgod bro/ gnyis med la gnyis su 'dzin pa re sdug /dag dbyings la pho tshod byed pa thang chad/ brjod med la brjod byar re ba yi myug /a cang ku re tsam du 'ud gog rngam po che bsgrags pa yin/ gzhon nu 'jigs med gang shar rang grol gyis shar mar bris////pa / /'phags mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs spyan 'dren pa'i glu dad pa'i myu gu zhes bya ba/ chos dbyings spros pa kun bral ka dag gi klong na/ /lhun grub nges pa lnga ldan rigs kun gyi khyab bdag /gdod ma'i sangs rgyas 'jam dpal ye shes kyi sku can/ /kun khyab chos sku'i klong nas sprul sku ru bzhengs shog /srid zhi mnyam par gdal ba'i chos nyid kyi klong na/ /gnyis snang mtshan ma nyer zhi rang byung gi ye shes/ /'pho med sems kyi rdo rje 'jam dpal gyi dpa' bos/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i rol gar 'gags med du bzhengs shog/mi shigs sems kyi chos nyid brjod bral gyi klong na/ kha sbyor ye shes rdo rje bde chen gyi lang tsho/ /rtag chen gnyug ma'i sku can 'jam dpal gyi rdo rje/ /rig gdangs sgron ma rnam bzhi'i 'ja' sku ru ston shog /snang med snang ba'i gar rol sgyu 'phrul gyi ye shes/ / 261

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzugs med gzugs su brdzu ba'i lhun grub kyi 'od bdangs/ /thogs med cir yang 'phrul ba'i 'jam dpal gyi ye shes/ /khye'u chung rgyang zhags sgron ma'i ltad mo ru ngom shog /bri dang sang ba gnyis med mtha' bral gyi dbyings su/ /las rlung zas su za ba'i khrag 'thung gi spyi rje/ /'khor 'das kun gyi spyi dpal gshin rje yi gshed po//ye shes sgyu ma'i bkod pa'i rnam rol gyis bzhengs shog /khams gsum yid kyi rgyu ba gzhi med du sangs pa'i/ /nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku 'jam dpal gyi ye shes/ /gtum chen zhe sdang rdo rje'i rol mo ru bzhengs nas/ /zag bcas sems kyi mtshan ma yongs grol du shig cig /'khrul rtog rdul khams dwangs pa'i gzhi dbyings kyi klong nas/ /brjod med grags stong rdo rje'i rgyangs glu 'di blangs pas/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du gyur nas/ /byin rlabs mchog gi char chen 'dzad med du snyil shog /ces pa'ang sprang rgan 'jigs med pas gang dran glur blangs pa dge bar gyur cig/ //ma / /dbyings dag pa rab 'byams klong yangs na/ /lha mtshams sprin gyi mdangs ldan yod do zhes/ /yid dang ba'i mos ngor rab bsam te/ /ngag 'o dod kyi sgra dbyangs 'di 'bod na/ /thugs brtse chen gyi gzigs pa ma g.yel zhig /snying kun rmongs kyi 252

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1me lces zin bzhin du/ /blo mos gus kyi gdong ba ra ri zhig/lha zur phud lnga pa'i zhabs pad phyogs/ /da grub 'bras kyi skal ba mi sprul na/ /sprang snyug bsngal gyi g.yang sar slar yang 'gro/ /yid shes rab kyi 'byor pas phongs bzhin du/ /blo dad gsum gyi sprang sgye 'di bzung ste/ /skyabs lag na ral gri'i zhabs drung na/ /ngag smre sngags kyi ku co 'don zhing 'dug /da dngos grub kyi nor skal mi gnang na/ /sprang skyabs med du 'khor ba'i g.yang sar mchi/ /mi nyam chung gi sprang po 'jigs med pa'i/ /blo gtad sa de khyod las gzhan ma rnyed/ /ngas nyin mtshan du gdung yus kha ton byas/ /da mtshan bzang gi bser zhal mi ston na/ /sprang 'dun ma'i gtad so su la 'cha'/ /lha mkhyen pa'i gter chen sems la btags/ /mig mchi ma'i chu rgyun drag tu g.yo/ /lag thal mo'i ge sar gtsug tu bcing / /lus gus pa'i rnam 'gyur 'di bcas nas/ /lha 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i mtshan nas 'bod/ /skyabs thugs rje can des gsan lags sam/ /ngas rtse gcig tu 'phags mchog yid la byas//lhas nyin gceg kyang dgyes zhal bstan pa med/ /nga'i re ba la re 'bras dka' dka' 'dra/ /dus da dung yang re thag rgyun ma chad/ /'di gzigs sam 'jam mgon mkhyen pa'i lha/ /zhabs rtsibs stong gi 'khor lo dpal yon can//spyi gtsug tu 'jog pa'i bka' drin zhu// //253

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ra / /snying la blo gros snang ba/ /sbyin mdzad chos kyi nyi ma/ /dpal ldan o ka'i sangs rgyas/ /kun mkhyen blo ldan mchog sred/ /paṇa grub bye 'i gral na/ /mtshungs med mi yi seng be/ /rig grol rtogs pa'i gter chen/ /mkhas pa blo ldan mchog sred/ /mkha' khyab zhing khams rgya mtshor/ /ji snyed rgyal dang rgyal sras/ /spro zhing sdud pa'i bdag nyid/ /bde gshegs blo ldan mchog sred/ /dbyings las g.yo ba med bzhin/ /gang 'dul mos pa'i snang ngor/ /mtshan dang sku yi bkod pa/ /snang mdzad blo ldan mchog sred/ /rmongs shing dman pa'i bdul byar/ /thugs rje lhag par rgyas te/ /rtsol med gzhan phan mdzad pa'i/ /brtse chen blo ldan mchog sred/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje/ /sgyu ma ye shes lus can/ /bde chen nyams brgya 'bar ba'i/ /dgyes mdzad blo ldan mchog sred/ /blo chen 'bum gyi spyi bor/ /zhabs sen zla snang 'jo zhing / /mi zad sbobs pa'i sater chen/ /blo mchog blo ldan mchog sred/ /'od gsal snang bzhi'i grong na/ /kun snang ye shes rol mo/ /'gags med snang zhing 'phrul pa'i/ /rang rig blo ldan mchog sred/ /a ho/ gnyug ma blo ldan mchog sred/ /btsal nas rnyed rgyur mi gda'/ /gdod ma'i grol gzhi chen po/ /ye bzhag 'pho 'gyur med pa'i/ /gnas lugs rig stong dbyer med/ /mi shigs rang byung thig le/ /don gyi blo ldan 264
