gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mchog sred/ /tsit+ta phyi nas 'tshol ba ho ho/ /rang gnas gzhan du 'tshol ba ho ho/ /rang ngo rang gis ma shes ho ho/ /lag pa'i lho rgyab nor ba ho ho//dge'o////ra //pha bka' drin 'khor med mkhyen brtse'i lha/ /sangs rgyas mi gzugs kyi rdzu bag can/ /mtshan brjod na rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal//bu'i snying dbus bzhugs la byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal khams kyi bla ma bzang bzang dang / /grags pa 'ur 'ur gyi rjes mi chod/ /nga'i bla ma dran chog rgyal po de/ /bslu med kyi mgon po khyod la zhu/ /pha rig 'dzin khyod kyi bka' drin las/ /chos rdzogs pa chen po gnyug ma'i bab/ /ye grol gyi rig pa rjen pa der/ /sprang bdag 'dra'i yid kyang go ba skyes/ /der bcos ma'i dad pa sog sob po/ /bzo ma dang mgar ma'i rdzun rkyal du/ /phugs khong nas rdib pa'i shes pa kho/ /bcos min gyi dad par song la khad/ /pha bla ma sangs rgyas yin zer mkhan/ /rgyal khams na ci yod ci med de/ /spangs rtogs yongs rdzogs kyi nges shes la/ /thug na spud pa bus pa 'dra/ /nged kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i bu rgyud la/ /mos gus tshig rjes su shor ba med/ /dad pas khams 'dus gso ba zhig /las can gyi slob mar bsngags pa yin/ /nga brgyud pa bzang po'i rigs skyes kyang / /rtog ge mgo mkhregs kyi than skad 'dis/ /rgyud tha rgod kyi nyam ngar cung 266

pod 1 rdo grubs 'jigs med bstanas nyi'i gsung 'bum/zad 'phyan/ /rgyal rigs da phrugs su lhung ba bzhin/ /de 'on kyang mgon po pad+ma'i zhabs/ /thugs sras rig 'dzin gyi tshom dur bcas/ /yid dang ba'i mos ngor bsgoms bsgoms pas/ /da rang lugs nyams kyis dogs pa med/ /nga'i chos grogs chos par re ba 'ga'//gdamasaXngag de nged kyi chos grwar zhus/ /bsngags brjod de rtog ge'i rtsod grwar byed/ /nyin zos srib nyal gyi dam thar can/ /nga'i man ngag kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i chos/ /blo rtse kun mkhyen gyi gzhung la gtod/ /tshe rabs kyi gros phugs bcol sa de/ /don rdzogs pa chen po khong la zhus// //ra / /pha zab lam rdo rje'i bla ma mchog /mtshan brjod na 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i lha/ /de yang yang dran pas snying khams 'di/ /dad pa'i tshos mdog tu lam gyis 'gro/ /gnas ri khrod 'dod pa'i sgom phrug tsho/ /bya ba blos btang snga dra ṭa pas/ /rtog ngan gyi dug ro lang tsa na/ /zhen log gi las mtha' log ta re/ /chos 'chi khar phan nges zhig mdzad bzhed na/ /gro brgyags su gtad pa bzhi ldan dgos/ /lto gos gtam gsum po mi phyid na/ /mtho dra ṭa na dma' sar lhung gis dogs/ /lto nu ges gdungs ba'i dka' spyad dang / /rgyab lhags pa phyur ba'i snying rus zhig /byung na bzang gsum gyi rtse mo lo/ /mdo 'gags su ko mnyed yong yong mdzod/ /phyi 266

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1phyugs lug ko ba ma lags te/ /nang gshis ngan sems kyi ko gyong 'di/ /thabs zab mo bla ma'i gdams ngag gis/ /mnyed lhan lhan babs tshe chos pa lags/ /lam dal 'byor rnyed dka'i blo rtse nas/ /jeg dgu yi rtse mo rdzogs chen bar/ /de rang sems 'dul ba kho na'i phyir/ /mgon skyob pa mtshungs med de yis gsungs/ /da bsam gzhigs rang gi sems la thongs//rtog dpyod kyi rtse mo nang du skor/ /dpyad sgom gyi rno so rang la ston/ /'ug pa'i mgo can de ci thul zhu//dkar phyogs kyi nyin mo mi grag ste/ /mi skal ngan mtshan mo lhang lhang grag /nyes spyod kyi ltas ngan sna dgu'i mdzod/ /phung byed kyi 'ug rgan ga na gda'/ kho yul drug thang nas mi rnyed kyi/ /sems bag med shing rtser nyal tshabs che/ /thugs bsam gyi bkye 'gyed de ru thongs/ /dgra zhe 'khu'i snying rdo de na gda'/ /ming la rtag 'dzin gyi 'gong bo zer/ /'dir snang gi phyi tshis byed kyin yod/ /phyag rdog po gcig gi dge sbyor kyang / /log 'chu ru 'khrid mkhan kho las med/ /da chu bur rdos 'dra'i bem rgog dang / /sha med spu med kyi tshe srog 'di/ /'chi bdag gis dgung la ma spur gong / /shul ring gi skyel ma ci rnyed mdzod/ /tshe nam gzhug sbrang ma'i tshang khang 'di/ /shi gshin rje byang 'brong mig ra yis/ /nam gcur gyi nges pa mi shes pas/ /'chi ka'i 'phyor chas de ma mdzad cig /lam ring po bar 267

dzo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/do'i 'phrang na yod/ /gyi ling gi gzhon pa ga 'dra bdog /dgra kha drag dmyal ba'i las mkhan yin/ /'jigs med kyi gdeng tshad ci 'dra gda'/ /lar dmyal ba zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /mi sdig can shi ba'i 'gro khung yin/ /sdig pa cha lugs kyi steng na med/ /las dge sdig rang gi sems la ltos/ /nga 'chi 'chi shi na skrab skrag zer/ /'chi kha la btags nas gson du re/ /tshe phyi ma'i 'dug chus gang byung byed/ /spyang grung gi mi pho tsho yin le le/ /spyang btsan phyug sgrub pa'i pho rgod dang / /glen 'ug pa snod btum mi ngan gnyis/ /'chi bdag gi srin po khrag mig mdun/ /dkar nag gi thang sha mnyam par gcod/ /dus de tshe mal gyi tha ma zhig /gcin stug gis bkang ba'i stan thog na/ /brang rus kyi pags pa mnye tsa na/ /'khrul snang gi sun ma byung tsa na/ /tshe 'di phyi'i bar lag 'byed tsa na/ /shul ring gi thag pa bsdos tsa na/ /zhum 'o dod 'bod tshe a tsa ma/ /mig hur hur byed tshe a tsa ma/ /dbugs shugs ring 'byin tshe a tsa ma/ /dgra 'chi bdag zhags pas rke nas btags/ /las ngan gyi nyes pa rna bar bsgrags/ /shi dmyal bar khrid pa'i grong sgo na/ /gos med kyi gcer bur 'jigs pa la/ /bshes med kyi gcig pur 'jigs pa la1/ /nor med kyi lag stong 'jigs pa la/ /sdig can gyis mi mkhan a tsi tsi/ /mi phyugs kyi shi skad thos tsa na/ /shi bar do zer ba'i grags 268

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1pa can/ /dus do mod kyi mtshan mo tshun chad kyang / /gnya' thog tu 'char grabs 'char grabs lags/ /da 'chi chos rang drin rang che zhig /ran pas mi tshad 'phyis pa tsam/ /de thugs la dkongs sam 'jigs med bzang / /sprang sbyon gyi yid la shar tshod lags/ /zhes pa'ang rā ri dra 'du shes gsum pa'i ban gzhon zhig gis gang dran skad cig la bris pa'o// //ra / /pha bla ma mkhyen brtse'i zlos gar mchod/ /gru tshig thung rkang pa dum chod ma/ /ngag snyan pos len 'dod mi 'dus ste/ /gang dran gyi sbyo glu tshig gsum len/ /glu blang na chos kun glu chos te/ /mgrin pa 'di glu yi bang mdzod yin/ /nged de 'dra'i do ha mi shes pas/ /glu blang na gre ba dog mor gda'/ /de 'on kyang bshes gnyen ma ti'i mtshan/ /bzhi cha gsum bral gyi chos skad 'di/ /glu tshigs bcad lam nas drongs shig ces/ /bka' bstsal de zlog tu cung ma spobs/ /lam theg pa'i rtse rgyal rdzogs pa che/ /zab pa'i zab gnad cig ma shes na/ /zab kha la btags kyang don rtsa chung / /bstod mi shes smad ra'i gzhi mar 'gro/ /spyir rdo rje theg pa'i zab khyad dang / /dgos bla med theg pa'i dgongs don la/ /go ba rags pa tsam ma byung na/ /rdo rje sked bzung zhig dka' bar snang / /da mang rab de tsho phar bzhag nas/ /mi nyan shes kyi rna ba bzang po la/ /mgo med 259

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mjug med kyi rna rgyan zhig /'dogs pa dus su babs pa lags/ /sems rig pa gnyis kyi tha snyad 'di/ /sgom chen gyi zhal na rlung ltar grags/ /grog grags pa che sar yod na ko/ /de zhib mor bshad du ci zhig dgos/ /de thugs la bcangs nas skabs don 'dir/ /bzhi cha de rig pa ka dag la/ /gsum sems la byas pa'i gol sa 'di/ /gzhi med rtsa bral du chod la shog /sems kun rtog brgyad cu'i dbye ba de/ /gsum du bsdus pa mi shes na/ /sems ci zer 'di zer thabs rdugs nas/ /gnas 'gyu'i brda chad la skyabs su mchis//lar 'gyu ba sems su btags pa tsam/ /'gal 'du'i sna 'dren ma lags mod/ /spyi rgya de rlabs kyis ma chod na/ /khol tshes bang thag mi chod lags/ /don de slad kun rtog spros pa'i khams/ /ngo bo brgyad cu ru phye mod kyi/ /yul 'dus byas dngos po'i snang ba kun/ /dus gsum du bsdu ba 'di yi lugs/ /dus ldan min 'du byed yin mod kyi/ /dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i shes bya la/ /phung po lngas bsdus kyi chos kun 'du/ /'dus ma byas chos kyang zhar la mtshon/ /de yul las yul can phye ba yis/ /rtog pa rnam gsum du grags pa de/ /shugs 'byung gi dran pa gnyug ma'i khams/ /bzo med du khrol ler shig la zhog /der bzhag na rtog med rig pa'i gshis/ /dkar dmar nag gsum gyis ma bslad pa'i/ /gshis 'od gsal 260

gsungs mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rig pa bum pa'i sku/ /nam mkha'i gzugs can de 'byon zhing 'ong //'di rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po zhes/ /sgom chen stong gi snying rdo ste/ /rtogs ldan khri yis ma rtogs pa/ /rtogs dka'i zab mo gsang ba yin/ /de bzhi char grags pa'i brda chad 'di/ /dang po 'das dus kyi rjes gcod la/ /gnyis pa da lta'i cha 'dzin te/ /cha gsum pa 'byung 'gyur sngun bsu yin/ /de dag dang bral ba'i gnyug sems la/ /cha bzhi pa'i brda chad mdzad pa ste/ /klong chen gyi rig pa ka dag la/ /gsum bzhi yi tha snyad cig yod dogs med/ /ngo 'phrod na tshig brgya don gcig ste/ /'ug pa glad log gi byis pa la/ /go sba bar bshad pa'i brda chad kyang / /ko dmar g.yogs rgyab tu 'gro yin gda'/ /bzhi cha snying dbus na gzims te yod/ /gsum las rlung rta la bskyon nas song / /rlung rang sar bzhag naXdaga' ba la/ /gsum zal 'thob pa'i lam gnad yin/ /bzhi cha la gzhon nu bum sku zer/ /thams cad stong pa'ang khong la zhu//gsum yid dpyod rtog pa'i 'ching ba zer/ /'ching ba dang bral na bzhi cha yin//phra rags kyi kun rtog yod do cog /gsum gyi phyogs mthun du hril tril 'du//snang gsum kho bzhi cha ma lags kyang / /bzhi cha'i phyogs mthun du mkhyen par mdzod/ /lar bzhi cha 'di gsum gyi sbyang gzhi ste/ /gsum po kho sbyang bya'i chos su bzhag /'bral ba la ngang gis 'bral 261

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba dang / /sgom byung gis bral ba gnyis shig yod/ /'bral lugs dang po mkhyen bzhed na/ /mi 'chi ka ma la dris shig ang / /'bral lugs phyi ma la bslab bzhed na/ /'od gsal dang sgom la bgro gleng mdzod/ /bzhi cha gsum bral gyi go ba 'di'i/ /mtha' bcad na srid pa'i sgrung rabs tsam/ /phyogs bsdus na spyo glu tshig gsum yin/ /pha kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i mchod par bzhes/ /zhes yongs 'dzin dbe rgan blo gros nas bka' phebs bstsal ba ltar/ sprang phrug mdo med 'jigs med bstan rgyam gyis dran tshad sa bshad rdo bshad du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// //ra / /pha kun mkhyen brgyud par snying nas 'dud/ /lam rdo rje theg pa'i snying po'i bcud/ /sems gnyug ma'i de nyid sgom 'dod na/ /gzhi dam tshig sdom pa mig bzhin srungs/ /gnad rim gnyis zab mos khog phub ste/ /'od gsal gyi rang bzhin phyag rgya che/ /yid kun rtog rlung gi kha lo can/ /de sprin tshogs nam mkhar dengs pa bzhin/ /dbyings stong par dag pa'i rig gdangs cha/ /ches phra yang nyi ma brgya ltar gsal/ /gshis bde bas khyab kyang chags rtog med//rang nyams su lhong yang smra dka' ba'i/ /gnad ngo mtshar can 'di shes byos la/ /de ma brjed dran pa'i lcags kyus zungs/ /yul bzang ngan bar ma'i snang ba dang / /blo sna tshogs rtog pa'i yo lang 262

gsung mi mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1kun/ /nang 'od gsal rib pa'i rnam 'phrul du/ /blta shes na mnyam bzhag rtogs pa'i grogs/ /don gting mtha' bral ba'i stong pa dag /khyab gdal gyi rig pa dbyer med las/ /rtsal 'gags med cir yang 'char ba 'dir/ /nged rdzogs chen pa'i gsang gtam mang po yod/ /lar rdzogs chen blo 'das rig pa dang / /dpal dus 'khor rgyud sde'i ring lubs kyi/ /lam mi 'gyur bde ba'i bsgrub gzhi gnyis/ /ming 'dogs tshul tsam las so sor med/ /rtsa tsu nyi'i nam mkhar stong gzugs kyi/ /snang ba mtha' med du 'byung ba yang //sor sdud kyi dmigs pa yid byed mthus/ /gzhi 'od gsal 'di nang 'char ba yin/ /tshul de phyir bde stong dbyer med dang / /gnad rig stong zung 'jug la sogs pa/ /ming du mas bsnyad bya'i sems nyid 'di/ /skyong mkhas pa lam gyi snying por zungs/ /rang zab don rtogs pa'i mi min yang / /shar rgyal mo rong pas bskul 'debs tshig /nan ches nas yid la gang shar bris/ /de'i dge bas 'gro kun grol bar shog /sprang rgan bstan nyis yud tsam la bris pa dge/ //ra / /'od gsal gyi rig pa gtad med du btang nas/ /snang grag la klong chen ye rgya yis btab pas/ /bde stong gi cho 'phrul mkha' mnyam du gdal te/ /gzung 'dzin gyi 'ching ba chos nyid du 263

ngo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga dengs song / /lhun grub kyi 'ja' sku snying dbus su mthong nas/ /bya rtsol gyi spros pa cog bzhag tu btang yod/ /dmigs gtad kyi mtshan ma rang grol du bshig na/ /rlung sems kun dbu ma 'od gsal du bsdus 'gro/ /a ho ya snang shes 'di bden med kyi rang bzhin/ /snying dbus kyi rtsa 'khor nyer ba'i yi yul chen/ /bde stong gi zhabs bro ldir ldir gyi ngang nas/ /spros med kyi brtul zhugs gang dga' ru skyongs shog /stag sham dang rus pa'i rgyan cha tsho khrol khrol//kha hū ཾ dang cang te'u dbyangs gdangs dang lhan cig /ro lang gi gnya' bar brtul zhugs kyis zhon pa'i/ /rkang bro de snying la kam kam rang shar byung / /'jog sgom gyi dran pa lhod lhod dang 'bol 'bol/ /gnyug ma yi 'od gsal shig shig dang khrol khrol/ /shan 'byed kyi ngang mchu nges nges shig med na/ /tha mal gyi lta ba'i zhal ngo de bskung dogs/ /las rlung gi dra ba rtog tshobs kyi bzhon pa/ /snang gsum dang bcas pa'i sgrib byed kyi 'ching ba/ /rtsol med du grol ba'i nang gsal gyi bum sku/ /rang bab tu bzhag na rdzogs chen gyi lha sgom/ /bde chen gyi rig pa 'pho med du bzhag pas/ /gsal ngar gyi rang mdangs 'char nub rang med de/ /kun rtog dang sgo lnga'i 'gyu dran gyi snyem thag /da ltar gyi rig pa rjen ded des bcad thal/ /lta sgom la mtho ba 'od gsal gyi theg pa/ /brtul zhugs la rno 264

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ba 'khor 'das kyi ru shan/ /zung 'brel du sbrel ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug /da lta nas gdod ma'i nang dbyings su chas 'gro/ /zhing skyes kyi blo ka'i 'du ba dang lhan cig /brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa skyong thabs rang med na/ /rdo rje yi phung po rang byung gi dur khrod/ /'di nyid du rig stong kha sbyor la bzhugs mdzod/ /gnas chen la a ba dhu ti yiXbang mdzod/ /gnyan khrod la snying ga'i rlung rig gi thig le//lhan skyes kyi 'du ba 'dum phrag gi rgyal khab/ /de nyid du cog bzhag ngal bso ru bzhugs shog /rdo rje yi lus la las rlung gi dra phad/ /byar med kyi ngang du rang dwangs shig nus na/ /bangs khrod dang gnyan khrod phyi rol nas ma tshol/ /ye shes mchog bzhi sbyor 'od gsal gyi lha khang / /'pho chen gyi rig pa zang thal gyi 'ja' lus/ /'di nyid du grub pa'i rten 'brel rang yod do/ / //pa / /mnyam pa chen po'i chos nyid mtha' bzhi'i spros bral/ /kun snang sgyu ma'i lang tshor rtag tu snang ba'i/ /ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i/ /snang stong gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor de ring ston shog /dag chen ye shes rol mo 'bum du 'bar zhing / /rmad byung 'phrul gyi rol mos 'jig rten khyab mdzad/ /grags snyan rol mo stong ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ /phul byung phrin las rol mos srid 'di skyongs shog /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po ye shes gcig nyid/ /266

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bumang mkha' khyab zhi dang khro bo'i gar gyis rtsen pa'i/ /rnam rol snang ba 'bum ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ /gzungs dang spobs pa'i char chen snying la stol shog /thogs med spobs pa'i blo gros mtshungs pa med cing / /mi 'jigs seṅge'i sgra dbyangs lhug par 'jo ba'i mtha' yas gdul bya smin mdzad 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ /tshul gnyis snang ba dam pas bdag yid khyab mdzod/ /skye dang 'chi ba'i mtshan ma ngang bi/sa zhi bas/ /rtag chen gzhon nu'i 'jo sgeg cir yang ngom pa'i/ /mkhyen gnyis ye shes sku can 'jam pa'i rdo rjes/ /mtshan rdzogs sku yi dkyil 'khor mngon du ston shog /lam lam mtshan dpe'i snang ba stong du 'jo zhing / /mthing mdos ral pa'i zur phud ldem ldem g.yo bzhin/ /zhing mang 'od brgyas 'gengs mdzad 'jam pa'i rdo rjes/ /dran dang rtogs pa'i char chen yid la phobs shog /'od bzang ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor kun tu skyod cing / /'khril ldem zhi ba'i nyams bzang 'dzad pa med pas/ /lha klu'i dregs pa zil ba non 'jam pa'i rdo rjes/ /byin rlabs me tog char chen rtag tu stol shog /go cha chen po bgos pa'i 'khor gyi dbus na/ /mi shigs dwangs ma'i sku mchog lham mer gsal zhing / /smon lam chen po'i gzi brjid mtshungs zla med pas/ /'phags mchog 'jam pa'i lha des byin rlabs nga shog /ces pa'ang gzhon nu 266

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'jigs med pas yar klung pad+ma bkod du byi ba zla ba'i tshes11kyi snga dro bris pa'o////ra / /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i lang tsho gsar pa/ /rjes chags dmar 'od snang ba 'bum dang 'grogs nas/ /dga' chen rol mo'i sil khrol dar dir sgrog bzhin/ /gzugs sku'i snang ba ston shog mkha' spyod dga' ma/ /zhing sngags lhan skyes dpal mo 'bum gyi gral na/ /snang stong gnyug ma'i 'od gsal lha sbur bzhengs pa'i/ /mkha' spyod rnal 'byor rje mo mkhar chen dga' mas//yid la ye shes snang ba char du snyol shog /las rgya'i lus la brten nas bde chen sgrub pa'i/ /'bar 'dzag gtum mo'i nus pa yod snyam zad kyis/ /grol lam gnyug ma'i ye shes zad sar 'khro ba'i//byin rlabs snang ba stsol shog mkha' spyod dga' ma/ /phyin drub khyim so 'dzin pa'i mthu nus rdug cing / /bsdu bzhi'i dga' ston 'jo ba'i sbyin lag phra la/ /rtogs pa'i nyams rtsal rdzogs pa da dung med kyi/ /khye'u chung rtse grogs mdzod cig mkhar chen dga' ma/ /'bras bu ma bcos cog bzhag 'khyil ba'i klong du/ /dgongs pa'i gtan srid ji srid zin gyi bar du/ /mi shigs mtshan dpe'i snang ba 'bum dang lhan cig /snying la zlos gar sgyur cig mkha' spyod dbang mo/ /shes dang shes bya'i spros pa dbyings su zhi ba'i/ /khyab gdal gnyug 267

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ma'i de nyid bsam brjod bral ba/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i dmigs gtad nyer zhi'i tshul du/ /mthong ba'i dga' ston sprul cig mkha' spyod dga' ma/ /dag chen ye shes rol pa'i 'khrul 'khor chen pos/ /ma dag las rlung rgyu ba dbu mar bsgral te/ /dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod zab mo nang nas rdol ba'i/ /'phrul gyi lde mig mdzod cig mkhar chen rje mo/ /dhu ti'i rtsa mdud gzhig dka' dam por bcing ba/ /bde stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'phrul gyis bshigs nas/ /mi 'dzad sa bcu'i spangs rtogs yid bzhin 'jo ba'i/ /'phrul chen rol mo 'khrol shog mkha' spyod gtso mo/ /ka dag khregs chod lta ba'i rtsal chen rdzogs shing / /lhun grub snang bzhi'i lam bzang mngon du byas te/ /nang dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i rgyal thabs chen por/ /mi ring myur du 'jog mdzod mkha' spyod rje mo/ /stong sgo ma nun rdo'i g.yang sa ring du bgyid cing / /mi bzad rtog ge'i 'jigs pa ming tsam byas nas/ /klong chen bsam gyis mi khyab 'od gsal ngang du/ /tshe 'dir btsan sa zin par byin gyis rlobs shig /dag dang ma dag snang ba mnyam par zlum pa'i/ /kun khyab mnyam pa chen po'i e dbyings klong du/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam 'dzin zhen rang sar grol ba'i/ /dngos grub snang ba sprul shog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje/ /'pho med rang byung rig pa'i rang zhal 268

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mthong zhing / /'pho 'gyur rtog pa'i drwa ba dbyings su thim nas/ /'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i/ /byin rlabs char chen phob shog rgyal yum phag mo/ /zhes pa'ang 'jigs med sbyon pas cal col du smras pa'o//dge'o// //rab/ /snang stong mi shigs thig le 'od gsal gyi lha skur/ /gnas yul nyer bzhi'i bkod pa lhun grub tu rdzogs pa'i/ /gzhom zhig mtshan ma rnam spang ye shes kyi rang gzugs/ /dag chen dkyil 'khor rdo rje phung po yi grong na/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol mo 'gags med du rtsen pa'i//rig rtsal dpa' bo blo ka'i tshom bu yi tshogs kun/ /bde chen gnyug ma'i gar stabs mig 'phrul ltar bsgyur bzhin/ /grub gnyis byin rlabs snang ba gru char ltar snyol shog /srid gsum zas su za ba'i sgra gcan gyi lto bar/ /dkar dmar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rngam zas su rol bas/ /sgyu ma'i lang tsho rab 'bar 'od gsal gyi phag mos/ /mi 'gyur ye shes mchog gi byin 'od zhig phob shog /bslu byed sgeg mo'i rgyu ba srin zhal du bstabs pas/ /bslu med nam mkha'i 'dzum zhal snying dbus su ngom pa/ /rang byung 'dus ma byas pa bde stong gi phag mos/ /'pho med zag bral chen po'i byin 'od zhig phob shog /dbyings phyug snying po'i sna rtse'i reg bya dang 'grogs pa'i//pad+mo rnam par rgyas 'dra'i lang tsho yi sri zhus//269

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nor bu'i dgyes pa skong ba'i ngo mtshar dang lhan cig /gzhon chung lag pa'i grangs ldan rtsed 'jo ru phebs shog /ga bur bdud rtsi'i this/sa pa lugs 'byung du 'bab cing / /lugs ldog rol mo bcu drug sil khrol du 'khrol bzhin/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i grong du rtse dga' la rol ba'i/ /mi zad dus ston ster cig mkha' spyod kyi dga' ma/ khu rdul dri ma bkrus pa'i nyi gzhon gyi da la/ /'char nub bri gang yongs speng mkha' dkyil du rtsen pa'i/ /rtag chen snang ba dam pa'i 'jis rten kun 'geng ba'i/ /ngo mtshar byin 'od phob shog ye shes kyi phag mo/ /ro snyam (snyom)zil gnon dgongs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang nas/ /mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dpa' gdeng dang lhan cig /rus pa'i 'phyang 'phrul g.yo ba'i gar stabs la dgyes pas/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral 'grim pa'i rten 'brel zhig zhu'o/ /zhes pa'ang lcags sprul zla ba dang po'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcur gzhon nu 'jigs med pas so/ /// pa / /pha bde gshegs kun dngos mtsho skyes kyi rdo rje/ /lha ye shes sbu can ye shes kyi me long / /de zung 'jug khyab bdag mkhyen brtse yi dbang po//mi kho bo'i snying dbus thig le ru bzhugs mdzod//gshis ba yi grol gnyug ma kun bzang gi rang zhal/ /lam ma bcos lhub pa'i nyams myong gi ngang nas/ /don mnyam rdzogs chen po 270

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mngon sum du blta ba'i/ /thabs zab mo shes pa'i blo ldan de skyid do//dbyings skye 'gags med pa ka dag gi klong nas/ /mdangs nang gsal rig pa lhun grub kyi grong khyer/ /de dbyer med gnas lugs ci bzhin du rtogs pa'i/ /khong skal ba rab kyi rnal 'byor de skyid do//mtha' spros pa'i gra zur ri bong gi rwa co/ /blo gnyis snang 'khrul pa thag khra la sprul 'dzin/ /tshul de ltar shes pa'i blo gros dang ldan bzhin/ /lam spros med rtogs pa'i gdeng ldan de skyid do/ /gshis mtha' grol chen po rig stong gi 'od gsal/ /yul yul can mtshan ma rgya yan du sangs pa'i/ /don bsam brjod med pa klong chen gyi mkha' la/ /sems rang sar grol ba'i rtogs ldan de skyid do/ /phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i grong khyer gyi ltad mo/ /de spang blang med pa'i nyams myong gis bltas tshe/ /nang ris pa gtad med yong grol du thal te/ /blo 'khrul pa zhig pa'i zhig po de skyid do/ /don yul med zang thal rjen pa ru mthong ba'i/ /sgom zab mo nyin mtshan kha sbyor gyi gdams pas/ /sems rig pa la shan ci dga' ru bye bas/ /da 'khrul snyam med pa'i sgom chen de skyid do/ /don tha mal rig pa lhod grol gyi spubs su/ /thabs cos bzhag bzhi yi man ngag bis rol pas/ /sgom dran 'dzin 'ching ba yid yul na mi 'dug /lam rtsol med mkhyen pa'i blo mnga' de skyid do/ /chos rdzogs pa chen por nges shes 27

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shig skyes pas/ /khong jeg brgyad grub mtha'i 'tsho skyong gi ngal ba/ /de sgrub 'dod 'gram chu ldang don zhig med pas/ /sems gu yangs sdod pa'i rnal 'byor de skyid do/ /yul tshogs drug rol pa bden med kyi brdzu bag /nang 'dzin pa'i shes pa rang rig gi brdzu bag /chos ci shar ci snang ye shes kyi rol mo/ /de kho thag chod pa'i rtogs ldan de skyid do/ /gzhi rig pa'i rang gdangs sna tshogs su shar tshad/ /de snang ba gdod 'ded brtul zhugs kyi ngang nas/ /tshul bzo bcos med par byung rgyal du spyod pa'i/ /khong gtad med gdeng ldan smyon pa de skyid do/ /chos ma dag snang ba ye shes su shar ba'i/ /srid khams gsum gnas zhes dogs yul du mi shes/ /don sa lam 'bras chos gzhi rdzogs su bzhugs pas/ /'bras gzhan nas mi 'tshol grub thob de skyid do/ /tshul tho co spyod pa zhig po ni ma lags//tshig 'ud gog 'thag pa sgom chen du mi bsam/ /rdo rkang pas brdzi ba grub 'bras su mi 'dug /gshis dab mnyam rtogs pa'i grub brnyes de skyid do/ /lus nam mkhar 'phyo ba mu stegs la yod mod/ /mgo'i ral jigs 'chang ba sa mye tshos shes 'dug /mig nam mkhar sgril ba 'an bus kyang nus mod/ /don gzhi grol rtogs pa'i grub chen de skyid do/ /a la la ho// //ba / /pha rig 'dzin pad+ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gshis skye med 27 2

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed gson dang skal bzang thar 'dod rnams/ /snying nas byang chub zhig thob 'dod na/ /sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas che/ /lam chen po bdun ldan gyi rtse rgyal mchog /shin tu rnal 'byor gyi theg pa 'dir/ /bsten nus na mgon po stobs bcu pa/ /tshe gcig la 'gugs pa'i skal ba yod/ /blo kun rtog gi rdzun ris yo bo che/ /don rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid la/ /dpyad sgom gyi rnam par shar ba dang / /gnas dba' 'gyu sdug gi shes bzhin la/ /bsam gtan gyi snying rdor re ba gnyis/ /snang gsum gyi dngos gnyen ma lags pas/ /las rlung gi brtsigs pa sgyel 'dod na/ /lam cog bzhag 'khyil ba'i man ngag gis/ /tha mal gyi shes pa byung rgyal la/ /rtog med kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /phyi yul snang gi spros pa rdzun po che/ /nang kun byed kyi rig pa'i rnam 'phrul can/ /chu nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang yul gyi 'char sgo ma 'gags kyang / /der 'dzin gyi bzo rgya mi 'chos par/ /snang mkhan gyi rig pa rkyang 'ded mdzod/ /rlung kun rtog mtshan ma'i rgyu bar bcas/ /yul med du sangs pa'i ye shes la/ /klong chen gyi rig pa so ma zhes/ /tha snyad kyi tshig this btags tsam las/ /gzhi med rtsa bral gyi chos nyid du/ /sems rig gi mtshan ma ba/ la yod/ /da ltar gyi shes pa chu 'bab ma/ /bzhi cha gsum bral gyi dgongs pa 273

bad 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'di/ /mngon lkog gi 'gyur ba'i rang sa ste/ /sems 'jog na gnyug ma'i yid 'dir zhog /yul snang la bzo bcos mi byed cing //rnam rtog gi rjes snyogs ma yin te/ 1ye babs kyi kun gzhi'i dwangs cha 'di/ /btsal shes na rdzogs chen de ka rang / /tshig de skad thru gtam thol byung ma/ /blun phrug gi byis pa 'jigs med pas/ /yid gang shar gyi rtog pa'i ri mo las/ /gang bab bsgyur bzo med par smras/ /zhes pa'ang 'tsho byed gar dbang gi ngor brjod pa'o// //ra / /lam byang chub zhi ba'i sa mkhan pa/ /skyabs drin chen bla ma las gzhan med/ /chos tshig gsum don yang mi mkhyen na/ /ston g.yag glang rgan gyi dpe 'then zhu/ /chos mgo nas legs pa'i rten 'brel de/ /bu las can slob ma'i rgyud la yod/ /chos zhus lo thos los tshim srid na/ /rngon pa rtsi tshol gyi lad mo sho('o)/ /lam bslab gsum bstan pa'i chos mdzod sgo/ /mi thar 'dod skye bo'i 'ju thas ste/ /tshig thos don rgyud la ma sbyar na/ /mgo chag kha brdal gyi gong ma tsam//tshe mi rtag sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /blo chos brgyad zhen pas ga la 'ching / /chos blo sbyong zhus zhus rtag 'dzin can/ /'ug pa'i rdzun drug gi spun zla lags/ /lam chen po bdun gyi srog rtsa de/ /gnad zab mo byang chub sems su 'du/ /sems de bskyed zer ba'i sgom chen phal/ /smon 'jug gi 'dzub mo 'dzuṭa sa med/ /don bla 274

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1med byangaXchub bsgrub 'dod na/ /thabs zab mo gsang sngags 'dra ba med/ /stu dga' rnyed tshol gyi sngags 'chang tsho/ /bong sha dang ri dwags rnga ma bzhin/ /lam rdo rje theg pa'i myur khyad de/ /gzhi smin byed dbang bzhi'i gnad la thug /dam nyams kyis ri lung bkang dra ṭa na/ /pha bsad rnga brdung gi rnam thar yin/ /rgyu rdo rje bzhi yi nus pa de/ /smin 'dod na nan tan dbang la mdzod/ /chu 'khyags la re ham tsha drags na/ /wa snyan rgan sgro ba'i rjes gcod yin/ /lam bskyed rim sgom pa'i rnal 'byor can/ /rdzogs rim gyi rtos/sa pa gam na yod/ /gnad dag rdzogs smin gsum mi shes na/ /ri bong gis stag la rdung stangs yin/ /don stong pa bzhi yi bde chen la/ /sems chos skur grol ba'i zab gnad yod/ /rlung bum can dgang ba'i sngags gzugs phal/ /rbud pa rlung rkyal gyi che brjod yod/ /gshis ye grol cog bzhag 'khyil ba'i klong / /ba/zung 'dzin gyi snang ba thad kar chod/ /tshig gnad la 'beb pa'i drag sngags dang / /'thab na kun rtog gi gdong ba dmar/ /lar dma' mo gzhi nas ma pheg na/ /mi srid kyi bya rog dkar po min/ /mtho drags nas dma' sar lhung ba de/ /mi chos dang dgu chos kyi a bo yin/ /gos ngur smrig lhon pa'i dge sbyong dang / /lcug snal ma ser po'i ska rabs tsam /yon tan gyi snying rdo ma lags pas/ /chos snying por dril na rang 276

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sems thul/ /dus deng sang gi btsun pa'i lha gral 'ga'/ /don sgrub pa gtso bor mi 'dzin par/ /dkor gral shes nyul ba'i sta gon la/ /sgo gsum chig dril gyi brtson pa mdzad/ /de bsams shing mgon po shākya'i tog /thugs snying rje'i gzhan dbang kho na yis/ /gsung sde snod bstan pa'i dam chos mdzod/ /rjes gnang la mchi mas khrus gsol byas/ /shing dung gi kha la shog bu'i lce/ /de bskyod na mi grag ci grag ste/ /'dis rgan rabs mkhas pa ma mnyes kyang / /sprang rang gis sbyo glu blang bar zad/ /tshig 'di yang 'jigs med pas so////ma / /nam yang mi bslu'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog /khyed shes blo gtad gting nas 'byong gis/ /skyabs med sems can drin chen ma gcig /de ring skyobs shig skyabs mdzad rgyal ba/ /'phrang ring bar do'i grong khyer chen por/ /drin chen ma de gcig pur song gis/ /mi bslu gtan gyi skyabs ba/nas rnam gsum/ /de rang bden pa'i byin rlabs yod ran/ /'jigs rung gshin rje'i khrims ra dos mo/ /de ring a mas 'grim dgos byung gis/ /ded dpon phan mdzad gang na phebs song / /phan pa'i mdzad bzang de ring skyong ran/ /sngun nas 'khrul snang sun mas slebs shing / /rgyab nas las rlung shugs kyis bdas te/ /shul ring lam nas a ma song 276

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gis/ /sangs rgyas phan bzhed de ring e gzigs/ /drin chen ma gcig snying las lhag pa/ /gting ring myun pa'i nags khrod nyul zhing / /phyi ma'i lam chen de ring blang gis/ /mchog gsum ra mda' da ni phebs ran/ /kyi hud 'chi bdag snying rje med pa'i/ /zhags nag khu ṭa pa de tsam myur ches/ /dus kyi sta re gdengs stabs rngam pas/ /drin chen ma la de tsam btab drag /reg 'jam lus kyi drod la bcar zhing / /mngar ba'i 'o rgyun kha la bsnun pa'i/ /drin ched ma de gshin yul song gis/ /bu sdug da lta ci zhig byed ang / /byams pa'i gdung ba 'dzum mdangs dgod cing / /brtse ba'i tshig snyan yid la 'bab pa'i/ /drin chen ma de gshin gral 'dzin cing //phung shul nus pa rlung gis spur song / /a ma'i brtse gdung rdo rje'i rgya mdud/ /snga rabs dran na dga' ba skye ste/ /da lta dran na da phrug byis pa'i/ /mya ngan sdug gi snon ma kho na/ /kyi hud kyi hud sras bcas rgyal ba/ /nyam thag rgan mo pu bye sa ra/ /sdug bsngal chu bo'i rlabs kyis btab tshe/ /ci slad thugs rje'i phyag ring mi skyong / /gzigs shig sangs rgyas stobs bcu'i dbang phyug /dgongs shig 'phags mchog snying rje'i bdag nyid/ /de ring byis pa 'jigs med gzhon nu'i/ /drin chen ma la dpung gnyen mdzod cig /ces sprang phrug 'jigs med pas re che lha la 'bod pa yin pas da lta 277

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba dang phyi rabs kyi gang zag snying rje'i bdag nyid rnams kyis kyang gzigs nas thugs gtad bsngo smon gyi sgo nas ma rgan mo dag pa'i zhing khams su 'dren pa zhig ci nas kyang zhu zhu// //༄ / /smra 'dod kyi pho nad zhe phug la thebs byung / /gtam ngan gyi bshal skyug 'byung nges zhig red mod/ /khyed rang gi sku chas rtsog 'dod ni med kyi/ /sku spyod kyi na bza' tsha ṭa tshoṭa la rem mdzod/ /'dir snang gi bya bzhag zad mtha' ni mi snang / /'grub 'dod 'dis ston chen dbu yul 'dra 'khor thang / /chos brgyad la thugs khur che tshod rang lags te/ /smig rgyu yi chu rags 'o brgyal las mchis sam/ /sku don dang bstan chus nam mkha' dang mnyam song //mtshan snyan gyi bla ma sangs rgyas su bzhag mod/ /gdams ngag gi bdud rtsi stsol dus ni med na/ /thar lam gyi ston pa dka' dka' zhig yin drab/ /byin rlabs la re bas skyabs gnas su mchod mod/ /sde dpon ni ma red khral 'ur ni ci dgos/ /tshong dpon ni ma byas bu lon ni mi dgos/ /bla chen tshos de lugs mdzad na ni bzang drag/thob thang 'di mi chen khe drag tsho'i red mod/ /bla ma la go sa mtho bas ta ci byed/ /bla ma de byang chub sa mkhan rang red mod/ /bla chen la bla ma'i rnam thar 'di dka' drag /snam ther gyi slog rnying khra khra dang shig shig /rta gog dang mdzo lhog gog gog dang thar thar/ / 278

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'di 'dras ta dge ba'i bshes gnyen du cir 'gyur/ /gzhan phan gyi mdzad phrin dgung sngon la yal song / /dkyil 'khor ni dar gos lhab lhub tu bkra 'dug /dung rgyag gi 'ur sgras ya log ni zing zing //gdungaXgral gyi chas gos 'ja' tshon las phyor te/ /'ur 'ur gyi grags skam rlung 'tshub kyis spur thal/ /nyams pa de bdun ldan yod skad ni 'dug mod/ /bla chen tshos brtul zhugs 'di 'dra la bltas na/ /zhing bcu yang lug rgan bshas skob las med 'dra/ /med na ni ngas kyang ma rgan re gsod nus/ /chags med kyi ye shes 'od gsal gyi klong na/ /sgom med du gzim pa'i zhen med kyi grub thob/ /'byung 'gyur gyi 'bul nor dgongs klong du bltams pas/ /snang tshul 'dis sprang po'i zhe kha ni snyig steg /nor med kyi sems can gdul bya ru mi bzhed/ /phyug po tsho dag pa'i las can las med 'dra/ /nor ldan la sangs rgyas byang sems su lung ston/ /bla ma 'di kun phan nyi ma zhig min drag /thar 'dod ni mi 'tshal byang chub kyi lam 'khrid/ /snying rje ni mi dgos theg chen gyi lam ston/ /bden med ni ma rtogs phyag rdzogs kyi ngo sprod/ /'di 'dra dag bla chen thubs dam gyi rtsa ba/ /byung rgyal kyi mdzad spyod mi nag la 'gro ste/ /chos mig dang ldan pa'i gang zag la mi lto/ /legs bshad kyi ljags rtse thung thung las med na/ /dbang rtul gyi mi nag 'ba' zhig —279

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang bsdus shig /a ho ya bla ma de 'dra ru bzhugs na/ /grwa slob kyi mdzad spyod gu yangs la ci khag /rang drin zhig rang la gcod 'dod 'dra yod na/ /khag med du bzhugs rgyu'i dus skabs kyang ma red/ /shes rgya dang 'dug pher rkun khram dang thun mong / /klog 'don 'dis btsun pa'i lha gral na bzhag mod/ /mi chen gyi gces phrug khyim 'dzin gyi las can/ /de 'dras kyang 'bri klog legs po re shes skad/ kha zas kyi gsog bskrun byi long la yod mod/ /gos phrug gi so nam mtha' mis kyang shes 'dug /spong klog 'di btsun pa'i las ka rang lags na/ /btsun gzugs tsho'i btsun tshul thal phung du phos drag /gzan sham 'di 'phags pa'i rtags mtshan du grags mod/ /glang snying gi skye bos gyon na ni ci cha/ /rdor dril 'di rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtshon byed/ /tshong mkhan gyi phyag na ci zhig ltar 'gyur ang / /g.yag rgan gyi tsha sna 'jen skor la bsam na/ /sbyin bdag la thugs brtse ci 'dra zhig yod ang / /chibs rgan la zhon na gshed ma dang 'dra ba/ /khyim phug tu bzhugs tshe sangs rgyas re yin lo/ /tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i don ldog kyang mi mkhyen/ /bdag med la thugs dpyad sngon song yang med na/ /ldan grol gyi yon tan gar yod ni ma go/ /dkor nag 'di khyed la zhim zhim zhig mi 'dra/ /tshogs gral na gzan sham rma bya las mdzes te/ /shab 280

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1zan gyi tshong zong tsi na la sprod tshe/ /gri ring dang kos brjes shan pa bzhin chas nas/ /ci mdzad dang 'di mdzad yod snyam yang mi 'dug /rur smrig dang klog 'don rang byan la tshud nas//dad zas ni nas phye 'gam 'gam du mdzad 'dug /khe skyed dang reg bde'i pha rol tu son nas/ /skya ser gyi las go gnyis chod 'di a ho/ /sku tshe 'dir khyed cag pho rgod rang lags te/ /brang gog la sen rjes 'jog dus shig byung tshe/ /gshin rje yi khrims la mi thabs ni mi 'gro/ /shul ring gi lam nas sku rkyang du phebs yong / /deng sang ni steng na a sngon las mi snang / /sa 'og na spo do rdo mdung las mi mthong /gcig pu ru phyi ma'i lam chen zhig len dus/ /mi mthong gi dgu mthong gzigs mo ru ngom yong / /dpa' brtul gyi snying sran khyed rang la yod mod/ /lcags zhun gyi btung ba sku khog tu blug tshe/ /zhe rus kyi bsran tshugs dka' dka' ltar 'dug go/ /da lta nas thugs bsam btang na ni dga' yong / /glu thung 'di zhal gdams nyams dbyangs ni min mod/ /glang rgan gyi sa skos rang gnya' ru 'bab pa'i/ /dpe sgrung dang mthun pa'i skyon brjod kyi rmig skos/ /rang mtshang gi sa log rang thog tu 'phang ngo / /zhes pa'ang sprang sbyon 'jigs med pas 'chal gtam mgo rgyag rnga rgyag mar bris pa lags////281

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma / /sgyu lus kyis khur nas song song yang / /ngo so mi rnyed a re sdug /mi theg gi khur bo khur khur yang / /gla rngan med pas a thang chad/ /gar song gi g.yog tu 'brang 'brang yang / /gces ka mi byed thang re chad/ /gang 'dod kyi mngag sar brgyugs brgyugs kyang / /drin lan med pa sdug re che/ /nyin mtshan du khol por phyin phyin yang / /byams brtses mi skyong yi re mug /ci nus su bang gis bskyod bskyod kyang / /lcags tshan rnyed pa las bskos che/ /'gro 'dod kyi gom pa'i stobs zad kyang / /dmod pa 'dor ba bskos thang lci/ /sna rtsid thag rtsub mos 'then 'then nas/ /sna bug da lta 'dral la khad/ /sked yob lcags leb mos brdung brdung nas/ /rtsib ma da lta chag la khad/ /'phongs snyed thag nar mos bsdams bsdams nas/ /rnga shing da lta 'chad la khad/ /rgyab yab lcabs zor mos bcad bcad nas/ /glo snying da lta mthong la khad/ /lce sgang leb tsam du 'phyar ba la/ /brjid 'dod kyi che rtags ci zhig ste/ /sdug a thang chad pa'i rang rtags yin/ /sna rlung gi 'ur sgra dir dir po/ /rngam 'dod kyi dpa' rtags ci zhig ste/ /sems skyo dub che ba'i sdug mtshang yin/ /rkang gom 'gros mgyogs pa'i 'dur rgyug 'di/ /sgyu rtsal gyi ngom 'dod ci zhig ste/ /'phongs lcag gis brab pa'i sdug rtags lags/ /g.yag rgan tshos de skad gsung gyin gda'/ /snying 28 2

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rje'i bdag nyid tsho'i thugs la zhog/ //pa //thang chen po sngo phyug dar ma red/ /me tog gis g.yo ṭa na de bas lhag /ston dgun gyi thugs bab ma byung na/ /ba mo'i bka' bkyon zhig phog ngo yod/ /sman lo gzhon mdzes sdug dar bab red//gzhon lha phrug gis 'khyud na de bas mdzes/ /sngon las la thugs bab mi 'dug na/ /'du 'bral gyi yo lang zhig 'byung ta re/ /gzhon chung gi gdong pa lha bas lhas/ /sman rked med kyi mig zur mda' bas no/ /lha phrug tsho mda' rtses rmas ta re/ /mda' ske rgyan du bzhed na ci dgyes mdzod/ /chung lha sman gyi mkhur tshos mdzes mod de/ /rgan kha sngon sha tshugs skyi re bung / /'dang snga mtha' phyi phuṭa la ma btang na/ /sems 'gyod pa'i dus zhig yod las che/ /ban dar ma'i 'phyor nyams 'ja' bas legs/ /sman gzhon nu'i sgeg nyams lha mo 'dra/ /'phyor nye ba'i gra sdeb bzang mod kyi/ /byi phrug gi grags pa snying la gzan/ /mtshan smad kyi dus ston skyid mo dang / /nyin phyed kyi bza' 'dzing thal spul ma/ /res 'jog gi bya ba mtha' ring po/ /bye(phye)bral la gtod pa'i dus shig mchi/ /nub gcig gi dga' bde'i g.yang slong dang / /bskal chen gyi rang sdug ngu 'bod ma/ /de mnyam tshong byed pa'i pho rgod tsho/ /tshong pham po red dam rgyal po red/ /de tshong khe lon zhes dgobs na ni/ /sos dal du bzhugs 283

ngo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ bar long mi gda' bas/ /tshe grogs la g.yab mo myur du mdzod/ /nyin mtshan du lha sman 'khyud la bzhugs/ /lha zhi khro rab 'byams bsgom na'ang / /stong 'dang zhig red mod mthong rgyu dka'/ /da bsgom na lha sman bo li sgoms/ /byin rlabs zhig de yi gsang na yod/ /bdag sras dang gzhan sras bsgom ci dgos/ /sras lha phrug 'dra ba zhig bskyed na chog /da bskyed na rigs kyi sa bon skyed/ /dngos grub zhig de yi bsang na yod// //284

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1༄/ /dga' ston tshogs kyi glu badz+ra khri lha'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru/ gdod nas rnam dag stong chen kun khyab kyi klong nas/ /bde chen mchog tu mi 'gyur 'od gsal gyi rig pa/ /mnyam rdzogs longs spyod chen po'i sgyu 'phrul la chags pa'i/ /rang snang don gyi bla ma mtshan dpe ru bzhengs shog /mtha' bral chos dbyings dag pa'i ye shes kyi klong nas/ /rig bdag drug pa'i rgyal tshab rje btsun gyi bla ma/ /rigs rnam kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje yi gzi brjid/ /spyi gtsug dza brnya rar 'bral med du bzhugs mdzod//zung 'jug nges pa lnga ldan 'og min gyi gnas mchog /sprul pa'i gling na nyer bzhi'i zhing khams su bkod pa'i/ /mkha' spyod gnas kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag tu g.yo ba'i/ /dga' ston lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de a ho/ /mkha' khyab rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' dbyings kyi klong du/ /'pho med sems kyi rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ /zab gsal gha na tsakra'i dga' ston gyis mchod pa'i/ /thabs chen myur lam zab mo'i glu dbyangs zhig len 'dod/ /skyed tshal 'bras 286

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma bus brgyan pa'i bza' shing gi ldum rar/ /gtum po'i ngang tshul rdzogs pa'i ha la yi ljon pa/ /lcugs phran shin tu rgyas pa'i 'gyur ba 'di mthong nas/ /'jigs shing 'dor bar phyogs pa'i blo dman des ci bya/ /brtul zhugs grub par grags pa'i gso byed kyi rig sprus/ /dug chen 'dul sbyong ngal bas sman mar du bsgyur zhing //mkhas pa'i ngang tshul can gyi man+t+ra yi thabs las/ /'chi byed 'tsho bar bsgyur ba'i ngal dub des ci bya/ /byung rgyal nyams kyis sgeg pa'i rma bya yi gzhon chung / /dgag sgrub spang blang bral ba gtad med kyi spyod pas/ /'ching byed las kyi grol 'bras mngon gyur du bgyid pa/ /lam zab sa ti yo ga'i khyad chos su gzigs sam/ /rim rtsol spros pas ma yin blo bral gyi rig pa/ /klong chen mkha' ltar dag pa'i ye shes kyi klong na//'khrul grol gnyis su med de chos zad kyi dgongs pa/ /dgag sgrub gnyis su med de ye grol gyi gshis lugs/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung med de khyab gdal gyi dgongs klong / /grub mtha'i zhe 'dod med de rdzogs chen gyi lta ba/ /brtson dang mi brtson med de bsgom med kyi rnal 'byor/ /a 'thas 'dzin zhen ༷ med de lhun 'byams kyi yo lang / /gang shar rang sar grol ba'i zang thal gyi rang rig /gtad med rang yan chen po gnyug ma yi de nyid/ /lta sgom tha snyad med de brjod bral gyi ye shes/ /ming tshig yi 286

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ges mi mtshon blo 'das kyi 'od gsal/ /phyi snang yul med zang thal cog bzhag gi sgom pa/ /bcos bslad rtog pas ma bzos tha mal gyi shes pa/ /snang stong tha dad med pa'i gdod ma yi chos sku/ /yid dpyod theg brgyad las 'das theg rtse yi grub mtha'/ /snang srid dag pa rab 'byams gzhi gnas kyi dkyil 'khor/ /rnod bcud dag mnyam rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad zhig med na/ /mis 'gyur nam mkhar bsgril ba'i lha stangs kyi ngang nas/ /'ur 'ur mchod dbyangs gyer ba'i 'phyor sgeg des ci bya/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba'i nyams myong gi ngang nas/ /rgyud drug snying rje'i 'dul ba'i thabs mkhas shig med na/ /a 'thas zhe sdang rngams pa'i 'khrul rtog gi ngang nas/ /sdang mig glog ltar g.yo yang dgra bgegs ni mi thul/ /gdan gsum lha ru shes pa'i dag snang gi ngang nas/ /cir snang bde chen dga' bzhi'i rol mo ru rtogs pa'i/ /gsang chen thabs kyi dgongs spyod de 'dra zhig med na/ /za 'dod bza' btung dgram pa'i tshogs 'khor des ci bya/ /gang snang lha ru shes pa bskyed rim gyi zab gnad/ /sgra grag sngags su goms pa bzlas brjod kyi yang rtse/ /gdod ma'i rang zhal mjal ba nyams myong gi snying po/ /rtsol med rang bzhag rtogs na de ka rang lags so/ /'pho med sems kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig gis bsdus pa'i/ /'dir 'dus 287

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ las smon mthun pa'i rdo rje yi mched lcam/ /thabs chen myur lam zab mo'i dgongs spyod kyi ngang nas/ /zag med chos skur grol ba'i rten 'brel zhig zhu'o/ /zhes dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang 'brel ba'i gru badz+ra karti'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di'ang lung rtogs yon tan gyis phyug pa'i dad ldan las can gyi slob bu'i dam par gyur pa 'jigs med dpa' bo rdo rje'i gsung ldog tu ma nus par kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal pa kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang pos gang shar lhug par spel ba dza ya nu// //288

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ra //gsang sngags shā na tsakra'i glu dbyangs mtsho skyes rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /e dbyings nyer bzhi'i zhing mchog dbu ma yi grong du/ /waṃ yig mchog tu mi 'gyur lnga ldan gyi thig le/ /bde chen nam mkha'i gzugs kyi gar stabs su bzhugs dang / /longs spyod 'khor lo'i dkor mdzod rgyangs glu ru chas 'gro/ /kun rtog spros pa'i mtshan ma chos dbyings su zhi ba'i/ /ka dag bzod nas rnam grol 'od gsal gyi rig pa/ /lhun grub rdo rje'i lus kyi byed bcing la brten nas/ / mchog gi ye shes grub pa gsang sngags kyi khyad chos/ /dpyid dngaXthig le mnyam sbyor thabs chen gyi lam gnad/ /phung khams bsam gyis mi khyab 'od gsal du bsdus pa'i/ /bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor zhig med na/ /dbying phyug sna rtse'i ston mo byung rgyal du ma mdzad/ /yul lnga rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal gyi dbyings su/ /ro gcig phyag rgya sgyu ma dag mnyam gyi rtogs pas/ /ging chen mi mgo'i cod pan thor tshugs su bcings nas/ /gtad med 289

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/brtul zhugs rol pa'i zlos gar zhig rtsen 'dod/ /gang snang dag pa rab 'byams ye shes kyi rol mo/ /'od gsal nam mkha'i rdo rjer ye grol du dengs pa'i/ /don dam rig stong gnyis med klong chen gyi dgongs pas/ /khams gsum a wa dhu ti'i 'khor lo ru sgro la gtong / /gzhi grol thog ma'i ston ba lhan skyes kyi 'od gsal/ /sa/sang spyod a dī ka dri'i dga' ston dang sbrags nas/ /rnam grol 'chi ba med pa'i bcud len zhig yod de/ /mtsho skyes grub pa'i rdo rje'i thugs dbus su gab yod/ /stag sham rus pa'i rgyan cha sil khrol du g.yo zhing / /cang te'u dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dbyangs dang lhan cig /gtum po ro lang zhon nas dur khrod du nyul bzhin/ /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i gral na tshogs 'khor la phebs 'gro/ /mnyam bzhag gzhug ma'i chos sku 'od gsal du 'jug cing / /rjes thob rlung gi g.yo ba gzugs sku ru ldang ba'i/ /dgongs rgyud rdo rje'i rnal 'byor de 'dra zhig 'dod de/ /skye 'chi rmi lam lta bu'i g.yo 'khrul 'dis bslus dogs/ /nges don 'pho 'gyur med pa dum sku yi yin lugs/ /bya rtsol spros kun nyer zhi snying thig gi theg pas/ /tshe 'dir ye shes bla ma'i kun bzang gi dgongs klong / /nang dbyings btsan sa zin pa'i dngos grub zhig zhu'o/ /zhes shri gā na tsakra'i rdo rje'i glu mtsho skyes rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di yang kun 290

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mkhyen bla ma yab sras kyi bka' 'bangs gral mthar sdod pa'i rdo rong gi sprang po lam zan pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis rgyal kun sor rtog ye shes zhal skyin du brdzu ba'i khyab bdag blo ldan mchog sred sin ka'i chu gter gyi pad+mo las mtshan dpe'i lang tsho gsar du 'khrungs lo'i nyi sgrol zhes pa shing pho spre'u'i lo'i rgyal zla'i tshes bcu'i rgyal dbang o ḍi ya na'i rgyal thabs su dbang bsgyur ba'i dus rdo rje'i lam gyi gnad du nges par bsdus pa gtam du brjod pa dge bar gyur cig gu/ dge'o//dge'o//dge'o////pa / /snyan 'gyur mgrin pa'i rnga gsang lhod lhod 'jo zhing / /ljang sngon 'dab ma'i 'gyur ba 'bum du skyod bzhin/ /lto ldir bum pa'i bste gnas 'tshol zhing rgyu ba'i/ /thi bya de ring slebs so gnas khang bdag po/ /bsil ljongs sgo ṭa'i grong na ge sar snang zhes/ /lho mon smyug ma'i tshal nas nye bar 'ongs pa'i/ /spu sdug na gzhon grogs po thi bya'i dpal mos/ /gshog 'gyur gar gyi rol pas de ring slebs byung / /'khril ldem lus kyi 'gyur ba sto nga du g.yo zhing // zlum mdzes lang tsho ma rnying sgro gshog skor bzhin/ /thogs med nam mkha'i lam nas dal gyis rgyu ba'i/ bya 'di thi bya lags so gnas khang bdag po/ /sa mchog bye ma'i khang chung sngon nas yod de/ /mi srun bye'u chung rgya bos phrogs sam ma phrogs/ /brtag pa rnam pa du 291

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstad nyi'i gsung 'bum/mas legs par brtags te/ /gshog 'gros dal gyis skyod 'di thi bya lags so/ /rtswa ljang myu gu'i tshal nas 'tsho ba 'tshol zhing / /yid 'ong ngag gi rdza rnga lhug par 'khrol bzhin/ /sngo bsang nam mkha'i ngogs su lding zhing 'gro ba'i/ /thi bya da lta byung ngo gnas khang bdag po/ /zhes pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med pas nyams mtshar du bris pa tsam kho na'o// //29 2

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1tshog /glu tshig byis pa'i rtsed 'jo zhes bya ba/rdo zhun dwangs ma'i dum bu/ /mthing mdog zla ba'i dbyibs can/ /'phen sdud cho lo'i brdzu bag /ston mkhas gzhon nu'i 'du long / /ldem ldem 'dzub mo'i zhags pa/ /mkha' khams bla na bskyod de/ /bar snang snang ba'i grong khyer/ /rde'u chung 'phrul gyis brdal song / /skyed tshal g.yu ljongs logs nas/ /sgyu rtsal she mong dar bas/ /chu skyes dpung pa bcom ste/ /rna lung rgyal rnga brdung ngo / /ge sar nu ma'i 'o sbrang / /bung ma gzhon pa'i bcud len/ /'dzin bzod 'dab stong dpal mo/ /lag sor pho nyas phrog song / /reg 'jam rtsa sngon phon po/ /gnon la ring ba'i stabs kyis/ /mthe bong phan tshun 'gran bzhin/ /ne thang dkyus sar btang byung / /phra ldem byin pa'i 'khri shing / /long gnyis 'bras bu'i khur 'chang / /dri bzhon bskyod pa med kyang / /rlung rdul gzhan gyis bskul song / /gom stabs tha gu chung yang / /mi lhod rtsal kyi dpung pas/ /khyon yangs phyogs kyi tha khron/ /'gro ldog srang lam byas so/ /bzhad gad slong mor slong ba'i/ /bkyal tshig gtam gyi yol gos/ /do ra khor mor bcings pa de 293

pod 1 rdo grubaX'ajigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba slad rtsed 'jor gdags so/ /go skabs mgrin pas phye zhing / /lam srang mchu yis blangs nas/ /bag yang gad mo'i chu rgyun/ /lhung lhung mkha' lam brtol 'gro/ /lhug lhug rlan gyi rkyal ba'i/ /bye rdul mkha' la brtsegs pa/ /brtan dang kun tu nyams pas//'dzum dgod ngud mo 'byin to/ /mchu 'dab rnam par dbye zhing / /'grig 'grig so phreng ngom bzhin/ /gsal byed tha ma'i grogs po/ /sgrogs mkhas gzhon nu'i gzugs can/ /e yig phra mo'i gdangs can/ /'dzer 'dzer skad kyi 'gyur bas/ /chu thigs mgron por bos te/ /mig zur tha gru g.yog go/ /tha dad gzugs kyi rnam 'gyur/ /lam lam mig sngar ston pa'i/ /rkang gnyis gzhon nu'i lus can/ /de dag de ltar gnas so/ /hrul hrul rtsub mo'i mal nas/ /nyer nyer lci ba'i bem rul/ /yor yor 'gul ba'i mi rgan/ /khyug khyug las 'dir mi dgyes/ /gad gad mnyam pa'i sa phyogs/ /drang drang rkang pas dkyu ba'i/ /gsal gsal gzhon nu'i gdung can/ /yang yang rtsed mos sbos skad/ /ha ha/ mkhas la bkyal kas nyer mkho med/ /bag med don log don rlom pa/ /de dag 'di 'dras dgyes de sgad/ /byis pa'i zlos gar 'di bris so/ /zhes so// //ba / /la mthon po 'phyor yag gi steng na/ /sman khra moXzla gzhon gyi gdong can/ /ngag 'gyur khu ṭa la yi ru len skad/ /mo tshul 294

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1min tshul zhen zhig yin drag /thang chen po spang leb kyi ngogs su/ /sprang rgan po gos hrul gyi g.yogs can/ /ngag 'degs 'jog rgyangs glu ru len skad/ /kho mya ngan sdug yus kyis yin drag 1brag mthon po rang byung gi phug na/ /khong brtul zhugs mthar phyin gyi grub chen/ /ngag snyan 'jebs thol glu ru len skad/ /de 'od gsal nyams rtsal rang yin drag/ //ra / /sprin rab dkar dri med gtsang la mdzes 'jam yang 'dzom pa lha rdzas dang / /mnyen 'bol tshang ba ras bal gos/ /brkyang na lho byang hril gyis kheb/ /dril na shel phreng rdog po tsam/ /bzo ma byas srub kyi 'dzum ris dod/ /srub med kyang bzo sgros du mar shar/ /de rgya mtsho klu yi 'du byed kyis/ /rgyu spun med pa'i thas/sa su btags/ /'thag dang drub pa mnyam du byung / /drub zin tsam nas tshal brgyar ral/ /ral snyam tsa na yug gcig 'gro/ /ya mtshan rdzu 'phrul sprul pa'i gos/ /mthong bkrag che ba 'ja' tshon te/ /sprin dang 'ja' tshon mtshe ma'i spun/ /reg bde bsil ba gtsang chu ste/ /chu sprin sor mo khu tshur bzhin/ /steng dgung sngon yangs pa'i rgyan du btags/ /'brug rnga sgra'i rgyal mos gos su lhon/ /ri mtho brjid kyi mgo la gdugs ltar 'khor/ /rlung stobs po che yi rgyal mtshan te/ /sa la g.yang zhag 'bod pa'i dar/ /mgo nag mi yi g.yang rten te/ / 296

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rmig chags dud 'gro'i g.yang gi bla/ /mi rgyal po che yang bzung du med/ /'phyor bag ma bzang yang gyon mi btub/ /mdzod phyug po brgya la mi chug ste/ /'on kyang gnam sa mtha' dbus kheb/ /mi phyug dbul med par dgos 'dod ster/ /sa ri klung med par rtsi bcud 'gug /mthong na bya rnams bkra shis sgrog /sprugs na bdud rtsi'i chab rgyun 'bebs/ /'bru 'dod kyi zhing sa khong 'dzum rgyas/ /bu 'dod kyi rma bya rtse bro 'khrab/ /bdag bzung gi gnyer la mi ltos shing / /bsri phangs kyi sems las ma dbos par/ /dus nam dgos tshe na phung gis 'du/ /don byas ma thag tu rang sar gyes/ /phywa khu ye zer na de la gyis/ /g.yang khu ye 'dren na de la sgrongs/ /char sprin 'bol mo g.yang gi mdzod/ /chu khur ba mo skye dgu'i gsos/ /khyod kha sang dbyar gyi zla ba la/ /dpal gzugs can bzhin du mkha' la 'khrigs/ /'brog thams cad mar khu'i rgya mtshor btang / /'brog mi'i rkyal ba mar gyis bkang / /rong thams cad 'bru sna'i thang mar brdal/ /stong sde'i bang ba nas kyis bkang / /mi thams cad skyid pa'i rgyangs glu len/ /byad mdangs snum la 'dzum bag chags/ /phyugs thams cad rgyags pas gar rtsed sgyur/ /gcig las gnyis 'phel ri thang gang / /mdo phrug rta yi bang kha dar/ /bkrag mdangs lha yi ri dwags 'dra/ /chu dang nags tshal la gnas pa'i/ /bya rnams 296

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rdzogs ldan bde bas myos/ /rtsa ljang myu gu'i longs spyod kyis/ /ri dwags rnams kyang dregs pa 'dzin/ /de 'dra dpag med khyod las byung / /sku drin mi chung che lags te/ /dus deng sang ston zla'i mjug ma la/ /khrod kyang chu yi dbang thang nyams/ /phyag dar khrod kyi gos bzhin zad/ /ring por mi thogs yal du nye/ /de 'on kyang 'dus byas sgyu ma'i gzugs/ /da lta med kyang da lta yod/ /res gcig nub kyang gzhan du 'char/ /dar rgad gcig tu ma nges pas//da lo sku khams bde mo zhu/ /sang phod cho 'phrul zla ba'i dus/ /rgya mtsho klu yi bang mdzod nas/ /nam mkhar 'phags la phyogs bcur lding / /rnga sgra sgrogs shing lhab lhub g.yo/ /bar snang nyul zhing sa kun 'gebs/ /'dzad med char gyi pham phab bcas/ /sa steng mi yi dpal du shog /gzhi mgron 'dzom pa'i smon lam zhu/ /chad mdo rdo yi ri mo 'bri/ /rdo brkos ri mo 'gyur med lags// //ra / /ma nyal longs la phyogs su ltos/ /nyal na gnyid kyi rgya mtshor ltung / /gnyid mtshor lhung na 'jigs pa che/ /shes rab 'grib cing brjed ngas skyed/ /phyogs su ltos dang nyams dga' yod// mi yul mi dga' ci zhig dga'/ /dga' na shes pa phyir la 'phro/ /'phro na gnyid kyis sdud mi 'gyur/ /gar gyi ltad mor 'dus pa dang / /bzhad gad shags la nyan pa dang / /stobs 'gyed rgyan po lta ba 297

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ yang / /gnyid kyis khyer ba gcig ma mthong / /'di na thang shing gar byed cing / /khu byug 'jol mo shags kyis rtse/ /phug ron stobs 'gyed 'phul tho rdeg /khug rta mkhar las bya bas brel/ /bung ba glu len me tob dgod/ /'di ltar rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /ltad mo'i 'dun sa cher 'dug nas/ /nyin gnyid log par ji lhar 'thad/ / nam mkha' smag gis ra ro ba'ang / /nyi 'od bdud rtsi reg pas sangs/ /me tog gnyid kyis mis zum pa/ /nyin mo'i dus ston gsar bas sad/ /byi'u tshang mal gnyid log rnams/ /phyir byung ca co sgrogs shing rgyu/ /'di 'dra'i dbus na khyod gcig pu/ /nyin gnyid shor ba las mthu che/ /skye dgu gnyid las slong don du/ /gnam la nyi ma 'di ltar shar/ /nyi ma mgo la shar bzhin du/ /gnyid log nyi mas ci zhig bya/ /spyi mthun mig gi bsod nams las/ /'dzam gling 'di ltar bkra ba sprul/ /dus kun mig btsum gnyid log na/ /'dzam gling bkra ba don med yin/ /byol song kha twas gsal nyams bstan/ /rtse gar 'khrab cing gtam dag gtong / /khyod 'dra'i mi yis rmongs nyams bstan/ /nyin mtshan gnyid kyi nun par zhugs/ /'bu sbrang rnams la'ang don cig yod/ /rang 'tsho bskrub phyir spyod yul rgyu/ /khyod kyis bya ba kun bcag nas/ /nyin gnyid log phyir mdo shor yin/ /da res mngon mtho mi lus thob//298

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mkhas pa'i gral 'dabs lan mang nyul/ /dud 'gro'i spyod las 'phags rgyu la/ /mnyam pa'ang ma byung mtshang re che/ a cang de tsam ku reXyin/ /khyod dang dud 'gro 'dra dogs med/ /blo gsal smra shes don go khyod/ /rang nyid su yin mno bsam thongs nga rgyal skyed la mgo 'phang stod/ /rang tshul 'tshos la rang spyod skyongs//rang mgo gnyid kyi rdo leb 'og /mi 'chor nges pa'i sems stobs skyed/ /'jigs med dung thod can gyis bu ki lo la bka' bkyon phab pa'o////299

pod 1 rdo grub mi 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga ༄//tshig gi me hog zhes bya ba/kha ba'i gos dkar dri med dung mdog can/ /dgun gyi rgyal mos bkab pa 'khur bzod pa'i/ /lcug phran sar ba sar ba'i nying lag can/ /ljon pa'i shing 'di lha yul lha mo bzhin/ /nyi gzhon 'od kyi byugs pas reg ma thag /dwangs shel kha dog 'dzin pa'i chu thig tu/ /zhu ba'i gzugs can kha ba ba mo'i rdul/ /shing lo'i 'gram par yang dang yang du 'khyud/ /ldem drang khengs pas dregs pa'i nags kyi klong /khur chen sprud kyis sma dbab bgyi'o zhes/ /kha ba'i chu rgyun ku mud dog pa bzhin/ /nam mkha'i lam nas ljon bzang spyi bor 'bab/ /sprin dkar kha yi zegs ma sgyug pa'i chu/ /dkar gsal kha ba'i zol gyis nyer 'ong ba/ /ljon shing mgul bar cung zhig ngal gsos nas/ /dbyib/ 'dzin khong par rings par rings par song //nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon du mi gsal zhing / /grang reg 'dzin pa'i rlung gi gar stabs la/ /zhon pa'i go skabs nye bar gnas pa'i tshe/ /kha ba'i rdul 'di ri nas klung du rgyu/ /gang tshe nyi ma 'bar ba'i 'od zhag gis/ /kha ba'i rdul mang kun tu bzhus pa'i mod/ /shing gi 300

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1grib bsil kho ra khor yug kun/ /rlan gyi thigs pa gos su 'dzin par gyur/ /de tshe bdag cag khur dang zal lo zhes/ /dga' ba'i gar gyis rol mo rgyas pa'i shing / /yal ga'i g.yo ba 'bum du brtsen pa 'dis/ /nags kyi bya tshogs snying la rab dga' 'phel/ /nags kyi mthongs su rnal 'byor ldan pas nyal/ /phyag dar khrod kyi gos ni kha bas g.yogs/ /slar yang ba mo'i khri las nyer ldang ste/ /nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas de skyid/ /ces pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med pas nyams mtshar gyi phyir dang nags mthongs la dga' ba 'phel ba'i phyir shar mar bris pa'o// //ba / /shar mdo smad sla nga'i ༅ / /bya de mo'i bu sdus/ ngang dkar ma/ /chung sgo nga'i spubs su bsdad bsdad nas/ /sgong shun gyi gzeb tu bcings bcings nas/ /nun nag gi khrod du nyal nyal nas/ /dus bab kyi nyin mo kha sang la/ /lus sgong lpags kyi shubs nas thon de byung / /kho yul drug gi snang ba'i thang chen du/ /blo 'jug shes rnam drug rtsen la re/ /nyams gshog rtsal rdzobs pa'i pho rgod zhig /yong snyam la nged kyang re mod de/ /tshe zad dang dus min ma phyed pa'i/ /'chi rkyen de thog 'bab bzhin du byung / /dus da nangs btsas pa'i do mod la/ /srog rgyu ba phra mo'i rgyus thag bcad/ / lar sgro gshob/ rgyas kyang mi slebs pa'i/ /shi bar do'i 'phrang la 301

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/'dzegs nas song / /de spun zla gsum gyi tha chung yin/ /phu bo tsho re zhig bson ltar snang / /chung byis pa'i ring nas phye bral byung / /lar 'dus byas kyi rang mtshang rngam po che/ /'di dang 'di 'dra la bsam tsa na/ /'di bya phrug gcig po'i sgos skal min/ /khams gsum gyi sems can kun gyi yin/ /de legs par bsam na yi re mug /thog tu byung na ji tshugs bgyi/ /na dga' shi skyid cig dgos rgyu la/ /nga dang nga 'dra tshos byed lugs 'dis/ /ci min 'di min zhib 'byung rgos dogs// //ra / /ye ye/ 'od mdzad chos kyi rgyal bu/ /skyid pa'i ya mtha' red de/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gzigs nas/ /dka' ba brgya yis brel 'dug /rtsod dus 'dod khams 'gro ba/ /sdug pa'i ma mtha' red de/ /rang gi sdug bsngal mthong nas/ /skyo ba yid na mi 'dug /ye ye/ spyan ras gzigs la med pa'i/ /dngos grub bsgrub rgyu med kyang / /da dung ma ṇi 'dren pa'i/ /bgrang phreng phyag dang ma bral/ /nyam thag 'gro ba'i re sa/ /ma ṇi min pa med de/ /phreng ba sngas su ba yug nas/ /gtam nyob nang na yengs 'dug /ye ye/ myos byed chang 'thung ngang la/ /nam zla gar thal med par/ /go zhig chod yod snyam pa'i/ /rong phrug mgo 'khor bo tsho/ /ri bo ta la'i khang brtsegs//rin chen ba gam can dang / /phun tshogs bza' shing ra ba/ /bdud 30 2

gsung mgur ba phyogs bsdus/ dza da 1rtsi'i snye ma dud rnams//spyo chu byur bu can dang //than snye ske ring skyes pa'i//zhing sgog skya bo re la/ /bltas nas 'dor phod e 'dug /ye ye/dpag bsam lo ma'i lding khang / /'phags tshogs rtse ba'i nang na/ /rab dkar bdud rtsi za ba'i/ /gru 'dzin chu bo'i mu khyud/ /'da' byed ma ṇi'i gru gzings/ /mi 'dzin stong par spub nas/ /be'u lug gson mchu 'ching bas/ /brel ba 'brog pa'i brgya ṭa phrug /re nas sgye mo'i khyim du/ /rgyab khra tsher ma'i kha can/ /srin mo'i g.yog la sdod dang / /'dun ma'i gtad so legs 'dug /ye ye/ tshur bltas rang la bsam tshe/ /kha mang rang mdo shor 'dug /phar bltas gzhan la bsam tshe/ /col chung rang chus brjed 'dug /kun kyang snying rje'i dbang phyug /dngos grub gter kha 'gyed la/ /khyor ba gcig tsam 'dzed pa'i//bsam pa gzhi na mi 'dug /ye ye/ a cang ku re yin gyi/ /phongs pa nang 'thab mi byed/ /snang ba yengs la bor nas/ /byung rgyal ngag gcig longs dang / /ye ye/ lho phyogs bar snang lam nas/ /dal gyis 'ong ba'i sprin khyod/ /chu gter lho ma'i nang nas/ /'ong ba'i mgron po yin na/ /nga tsho'i bla ma bzhugs pa'i/ /ri rgyal gru 'dzin phyogs kyi/ /mtshar ba'i gtam zhig shod dang / /snang ba'i skyo grogs yong gi/ /phyi snod rtsi thog nags la/ /pham phab char pa med cing / /nang bcud shes pa skyo dus/ /btam snyan spring yig med na/ / 303

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/che brjid ri bo 'dra zhing / /dal 'gros glang chen mnyam yang / /phyogs 'dir 'ong ba'i las don/ /bstan rgyu zad nas gda'o/ /ye ye/'dab bzang lcung ka nag chung / /dgung sngon 'phur lding byed khyod//lho mtha'i chu gter phyogs su/ /rgum bu thu zhing 'gro na/ /khyod smra mkhas skad snyan 'gyur bde/ /lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i gling rtser/ /nga tsho'i rje btsun bzhugs kyis/ /sprang po'i skyid sdug tshul 'di/ /ji lta ba bzhin zhus la/ /rjes bstan gsung gi skyes shig /'dug na cis kyang ma sgyur/ /bu nga'i rna bar blag dang / /sa 'dir khyod dang nga gnyis/ /bsam pa mdza' bor bsdebs te/ /yun ring khyim tshes 'grogs pa'i/ /phyi thag de ka yin no//ces 'jigs med pas so// //ma / /rtsa rkya kha bas g.yogs pa'i gsang stong na/ /pho rog lhags rlung 'gam pa yi re phywa/ /byin chags thang shing phyug mo'i nags khrod na/ /khā tas nyi shig 'thu ba bag re dro/ /'thab 'thab lcags rgyun khye khar ma zad par/ /brdung brdung lcags yu khyi mgos ma bcag par/ /sun med 'brog sde'i ru sgo nyul na yang / /lto phyir gzhan mig khrel ba snying por zad/ /be rga sngon du btang nas khug stong mchan/ /bsod chung sprang zas gcig la khyi rub brgya/ /da dung rgyug rgyug song song sgras 'ded pa'i/ /las ngan sprang po'i las la snang ba skyo/ /zas la gtsang sme med pa'i bag yangs po/ /gang byung de 304

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gar za bas rtsol sgrub sla/ /ci snang zas su shar bas sems khral chung / /blo bde rgyun chad med do khu ta'i bu/ /rdor 'debs g.yos skol thabs ldan mi yis byed/ /chu thab khol po mi dgos skyid cig yod/ /dkon zas dus khral dbyar gyi rgyal mos sprod/ /dka' tshegs rnyed tshol mi dgos skyid cig yod/ /byung khungs mi zas bzang dgu'i cho rigs btsun/ /byed las 'di med 'dzam gling lo tog med/ /ngo bo tsha skyur kha bska'i ro bcud rdzogs/ /don rtsa rang la zhim na zhim par zad/ /spra sgo lcag snas phye zhing lta ba dang / /chen po'i mtshan snyan bsgrags nas 'bod pa sogs/ /slong thub ldom bu mang pos thob dka' ba'i/ /zhim dgu'i bza' ba thang mar brdal ba yang / /o ka yo wa la sogs saṃ skri ta'i/ /gsang sngags yi ge'i phreng ba zlos bzhin du/ /ljan ljin phyi sa'i rdzab chags rdo rje'i mchus/ /dud cing dkrugs pa'i byin rlabs byas ma thag /'dzin pa'i rgya bshig gces pa'i 'ching thag bral/ /ser sna'i sgrog bcad bdag po'i lab bsgul nas/ /rnam pa rdzas bdag khros pa'i bsdigs rngam ste/ /mdo don khā ta rang lto 'tshang ba 'byung / /gong ma'i ngo bsrung mi 'grub ma byin rung / /pha gzhis shor na phangs pa gzhi na med/ /mthon po'i zhal ngo mi 'tsho ma mnyes rung / /rang shong nags spugs rgyal khams kun na yod/ /btsan po'i zhabs tog mi 'ong ma bzhab 306

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rung / /'phur chog gshog pa'i gdeng tshad brtan po yod/ /phyug po'i ngo bsrung mi 'grub ma byin rung / /za zhing so nams stong khams sde bas byed/ /so nams las gla mi thing mi bra na/ /skyag pa khyim du bsdus la kha rgya zhog /yang na de yang mi bra zungs la sdod1 /rul ba'i khyi ro zos kyang mi brgyags te/ /no tso cor li gzugs dang khas phung bar/ /mthong bas g.yon can mi yi rgyus shes nas/ /mi blor mi bstun rna ba gtser skad dang / /mi sdug spu long ston pas mis mi 'dzin/ /ma bzung pha yul nags kyi sa mi 'chor/ /ma shor rigs mthun 'dab chags khyu mi 'jig /ma zhig yid gcugs bza' tsho'i sdeb mi 'thor/ /ma 'thor 'grogs yun ring bas lo bzhin dga'/ /phar 'gro dpa' snying che bas rdog pa brtan/ /bzan len bya brgya'i nang nas thob skal mnog /tshur rgol khong zon rno bas glags rnyed dka'/ /bya brgya jag nyes byung yang rang mgo thon/ /mi sems g.yengs dang mang snang 'ur ba sogs/ /gzhan blo'i glabs shes las kyi dus shes shing / /rku na gab mkhas 'phrog na 'jab mkhas pa'i/ /rnam dpyod rang rna dro ba khā la yod/ /mi dgos gzugs ldems ngag snyan sgro sa mi btod/ /shugs 'byung lhug par sdod pas rang bzhin drang / /dgos nges rang don sgrub la blo rtse 'khyug /'dzur dang skor ba'i thabs mkhas smyug ltar ldem/ /sred 306

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga nga ldan yid kyi skom pa mi sel bzhin/ /dal med ca co zer ba'i rol mo'i shing / /ngo tsha spang ba de dag lha yul na/ /da dung rang gi rgyags pa nyin bzhin 'phel/ /'phral dga' snang ba 'drid pa'i pi waṃ dang //zol med rgan nyams chags pa khu ta'i skad/ /mgo yang byis pa'i rna bar snga ma ste/ /yul gyi nyes dmigs rig pa phyi ma 'thad/ /de phyir khwa ta yog mgos 'ded mi dgos/ /bzlas chog yi ge drug ma yod bzhin du/ /don med 'chal gtam smra la dga' ba'i kha/ /bsrung na yog ma bo zungs la 'di gcig srungs/ /ya gi skye mched nu bzhi'i gdugs rtse nas/ /ma gi mnar med dmyal ba'i gdan mtha' yan//'khor ba sdug bsngal phung po'i rang bzhin te/ /skyag zan khu ta'i lus la smon rgyu ci/ /'on kyang dgos nges 'jig rten phyi ma'i rgyags//rang skal sen rtse gang yang mi 'ang bar/ /don chung 'jig rten tshe 'di'i 'tsho thabs la/ /dpa' rgod su lhag blta bas chog snyam pa/ /rang dang gzhan gyi khrod na mang mthong zhing / /de lhar byas na nag chung yos mgo yang / /spyang grung skyes bu'i mthu rtsal mi dman par/ /rig nas 'jigs med gdol ba de yis bris/ /ha ha ha/ da se/'o/ /dge'o//dge'o////nga / /sngon chad drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan/ /kun 'byung las nyon btsan po'i khrims kyis/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang la dbang 307

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ྾ —med bsgyur bas/ /mchog gsum bla ma'i skyabs zhabs ma chud/ /yun ring 'grogs pa'i a ma rgan mo/ /mthu chen sdig pa'i las dbang btsan pos/ /gti nug byol song gnas la bor bas/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i skal ba chad song / /drin chen a ma 'khor med drin chen//mi bzad las ngan snying rje med pas/ /mya ngan g.yang la ltos med bor bas/ /das/'a skyid bde ba'i nor dang phral song / /nu zhos gsos pa'i a ma rgan mo/ /sha tsha med pa'i las rlung ngar mas/ /nyam thag dud 'gro'i g.yang la bskyur bas/ /thar lam sgrub pa'i rten du ma gyur/ /bdas gi ma gcig brtse ldan rgan mo/ /brtse bral nyes mang las kyi zhags pas/ /ngan song g.yang la dbang med 'khor bas/ /tshobs mchog 'dus pa'i gral du ma slebs/ /kye ma kyi hud mi bzad las ngan/ /lo la a mas ci zhig nyes ang / /a ma rgan mo ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i/ /sdug yus ci zhig za la yod ang / /kye ma kyi hud drin lan 'khor med/ /a ma rgan mo'i las bskos 'di ci/ /kyi hud sras bcas rgyal bas e gzigs/ /a ma'i nyams myong mya ngan 'di ci/ /bde legs bye bas stong khams khyab kyang / /'phags zhal blta ba'i skal ba mi 'dug /dam chos rin chen thang ma brdal yang / /sdom gsum bslab pa'i rten du mi rung / /'phags tshogs 'dus pa skar ltar bkra yang / /'phags pa'i gral na sdod du mi dbang / /kye 308

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma kyi hud kye ma ma la/ /brtse ba'i 'grogs pa'i a ma snying sdug /lha bas lhag pa'i lus rten min yang / /lha dang lha min gnas ris tsam du/ /sdod du mi ster skal ngan 'di ci/ /nam mkhar 'phur ba'i sgro gshog gda' ste/ /thabs dang shes rab 'dab ma mi gda'/ /yid dbang 'gugs pa'i skad snyan gda' ste/ /legs par smra ba'i ngag snyan mi gda'/ /shing lo'i bsil grib 'dug par gda' ste/ /'phags lam mchog gi grib bsil mi gda'/ /rgyangs glu len pa'i smra lce gda' ste/ /zab don myong ba'i ro 'dzin mi gda'/ /zan rgum 'thu ba'i mchu sgros gda' ste/ /legs lam sdud pa'i spobs pa mi gda'/ /gom 'gros bsgyur ba'i rkang pa gda' ste/ /thar par 'gro ba'i blo mchog mi gda'/ /'grogs pa'i grogs la byol song 'dab chags/ /bza' ba'i zas la srin bu'i sha khrag /btung ba'i skom la 'dam chu rnyog can/ /spyod pa'i las la srog gcod sdig chen/ /bsags pa'i nor la kun rmongs gti myug /bsam pa'i sems la nyon mongs 'thibs 'thibs/ /rkang gnyis mi dang 'brel btam mi 'ong / /gnyen med bshes med a ma sdug go/ /zhim pa'i bza' btung kha la mi 'go/ /'tsho ba med pa'i a ma sdug go/ /dge sdig las la speng blang mi shes/ /blo mthu med pa'i a ma sdug ko/ /dam pa'i lha chos bskrub tu mi shes/ /'chi chos med pa'i a ma sdug bo// /309

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs medaXbastan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dkon mchog mtshan snyan rna bar ma grags/ /dpung gnyen med pa'i a ma sdug go/ /sngon chad drin chen a ma rgan mo/ /da lta skyo grogs bye'u ngag snyan/ /grangs med bskal pa brgya stong bye bar/ /khyed dang nga gnyis ma bur gyur mod/ /bu sdug 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ /da lta gzhan phan kha nyam chung yang / /snying la snying stobs go cha bgos nas/ /nam zhig rnam grol gtan bder khrid do/ /de skad gzhon chung mya ngan sbyo glu/ /gang 'di 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i khang bzang / /zla gzhon snang ba stong ldan chen por/ /yi ge'i lam nas gsal bar byas so/ /zhes pa'ang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dben gnas gshin rje'i phug par gnas tshe bye'u kha la kha 'dra zhig mthong tshe nyams mtshar du bris pa'o// //ra / /shar nyi ma ser po'i mnga' zhabs na/ /lus lang tsho dar bab pad+mo mchog /dgung zla ba gzhon nu'i thod chings shig /'dogs 'dod na smyo glu tshig gsum nyon/ /ha rā i saṃ wa skad mthon po 'khar ba'i rnga kor yin/ /dbyangs gdangs dang nga zhes zer mod de/ /sems 'phreng ba'i glu gsum mi 'dzen na/ /yid skyo ba'i nyams la sangs dus med/ /ha ri yī saṃ āḥ 'bu bung ba'i gshog rlung zi zi bo/ /skyid me tog tshal na snya na skad de/ /sdug ba mo/'i gnya' shing 'khor ba na/ /tshe phyi ma'i dung khar rkang pa 'jog /310

gsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ha ra ā saṃ lnga mi bya 'jol mo'i gre lce bde lags na/ /ma lho mon nags ma'i khu byug de/ /snying byams pa'i shugs kyis dran dran yang //zhal mthong ba med pas snang shes skyo/ /ha ra yī saṃ aḥ yum snying la sdug pa'i mi'am ci/ /gru pi waṃ len pas ci skyo ste/ /ma sku drin che zhes mi brjod na//bu bdud du 'babs pa'i nam zla yod/ /ha ra karma a/ /brag shel dkar mchod rten bzang legs te/ /gru brag cha blang ba rdzun du che/ /mi rnam dpyod can gyis bltas tsa na/ /rtsa sog ma bus pa'i thal ba tsam/ /rnyi ji ji ji ji ji ji ji / rnyi ji ji ji ji ji / rnyi ji ji ji/ snye ba rnyi/ rnyi rnyi rnyi/ i i slo zhes zad mi shes pa'i snyan 'gyur ka ma ba'i gdangs las drangs so/ /de'ang tshigs bcad dang pos nyan par bskul zhing dgos 'brel bshad/ gnyis pas bshes gnyen bsten pa ste/ gang gi don du bsten pa'i dgos ched/gang bsten bya'i mtshan nyid bshad/ gsum pas mi rtag pa dang de'i sa khongs tshe 'di blos btang rdzogs par bshad/ bzhi pas skyabs 'gro'i rgyu mtshan dang skyabs 'gro dngos bstan/ lnga pas snying rje chen po sgom lugs bstan/ drug pas rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis stong nyid la 'jug tshul bshad do/ /dge zhing bkra shis// //ba / /khar sang zla ba snga ma la/ /sa snum gsher bdud rtsi'i lang tsho can/ /rtsa mchog ljang lo 'khril bas khyab/ /rgyan me tog bkra ba'i 311

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/do shal lhon/ /deng sang gzi mdangs nyams nas gda'/ /bya mthong na dba' ba'i khu byug khyu/ /dbyar gyi spring yig klog cing grag /sprin tshon po mthong nas snyan par 'god/ /da lta mon yul 'phur nas song / /bcud sbrang rtsi rgyas pa'i me tog tshal/ /mthong nas yid dga' dung ba'i tshogs/ /dbyangs rab gsal rgyud mangs len 'dra de/ /da lha smre sngags ldab ldib 'don/ /shing sngo ljang lo ma'i khur bu can/ /nyin bzhin me tog gsar pa bkod/ /rlung sman dris phyogs kun 'geng ba de/ /da lta shing lo dmar po brul/ /chu klung chen sprin char phyug po'i gsos/ /chu bran du ma'i 'khor pyis dreg/sa/ /rlabs nam mkhar lding zhing rtse ba yang / /da lta nyin re song zhing 'khum/ /phyi dbyar gyi ltad mos mig brid nas/ /dge sbyor rlung la bslur ba khyod/ /dus da lta skyi ser grang ba'i nang / /bya bzung lag pa stong par 'dus/ /nor longs spyod nye du mdza' bshes kyis/ /mgo rbongs sdig gi khol po rnams/ /dpe 'di bzhin 'jig rten pha rol tu/ /bcig pur 'gro tshe shes pa skyo/ /gzhon so dkar dus kyi snang ba kun//rim gyis dran yul tsam du song / /rgan skra dkar 'chi ba'i pho nya ru//sngar nas slebs te da gzod skyo/ /sngar na gzhon sems shed rgyas pa'i dus/ /skyo shas skyes na don chen 'grub/ /da stobs nyams dbang po 'grib pa'i tshe/ /skyo yang rang sems ngal bar zad/ /de 312

bsung mgur phyogs bsdus/ pod 1—'on kyang ngan 'gro'i rten bsam tshe/ /da dung thabs med nus med min/ /lha mchog gsum thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /tshe mjug chos la 'dril bar shog/ //༄/ /sngo ljang shing lo phyug mo/ /dbyar gyi ri bo'i phun tshogs/ /mthing mdog bar sprin bla re/ /dwangs gsal nam mkha'i mdzes rgyan/ /sgrol ma'i zhabs rdul rjes dran/ /blo bzang yid kyi longs spyod/ /bsil byed snying rje'i lding khang / /yum cig thugs kyi dpal 'byor/ /gser mdog me tog nags tshal/ /dbyig 'dzin lan du'i rgyan cha/ /'od stong me shel thig le/ /shar nub nam mkha'i skyes cig /tshe dang ye shes gter kha/ /skal bzang snying gi dga' ston/ /mchog sbyin byin rlabs bdud rtsi/ /thugs rje myur ba'i pham phab// // pa / /khri thog bla ma'i kha la nyan tsa na/ /mi dgos dgu dgos dgos tshad lung ba gang / /de kun dgos na yong ba mi 'dub ste/ /mi thog kha pho che ba yin nam ang / /dgon stod grwa ba'i byed lugs mthong tsa na/ /mi byed dgu byed yog li 'phur ma 'gros/ /de kun byas na chog pa mi 'dra ste/ /don chen 'gyod med gdeng zhig los yod ang //dgon smad ma jo'i spyod tshul bltas tsa na/ /ma sdud dgu sdud byi bo'i tshang snyud ma/ /de kun bsdus na legs pa mi 'dra ste/ /khur bo tshur 'jog byung na ci khag ang / /mthon po'i lta ba brnyab 313

ngo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'gum/pa'i lag ring po1 /rkang pa ngan 'gro'i g.yang la 'jog bzhin du/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i grags skam la chags pa/ /de 'dra'i zog po bkur na khur du spru//'jigs med pas so//314

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— 4 ༄/ /na mo gu ru shri pad+ma ka ra ya/ /dal ba rnyed dang bstan la mjal ba dang / /dad pa mang dang rab tu byung thob pa/ /'di 'dra rnyed par dka' bas 'bad pa brgyas/ /snying po len pa'i thabs la bslab 'tshal lo/ /mthon po'i thob dang phyug po'i longs spyod dang //btsan po'i dpung shed gzhon nu'i lang tsho sogs/ /mtha' dag bor nas nges par 'chi dgos na/ /tshe 'di kho nar sems pa shin tu blun/ /ston pas 'khor los sgyur ba'i srid spangs nas/ /shing drung rtsa yi gding ba bsten mdzad na/ /dus ngan 'du 'dzi spru' gyi tshang nang ltar/ /'jigs pa'i gnas 'dir bdag cas ji ltar dga'/ /thub pa chags bral zhi ba'i mthar son pa'ang / /'du 'dzi spangs nas byang chub mchog brnyes na/ /nyes brgyas rmas pa bdag cag chags sdang gi/ /yul ngan nang du dge ba ga la 'phel/ /gzhung mang sbyangs shing man ngag thos pa dang / /sgrub la 'dun pa'i skyes bu brgya rnyed dag /'dod dang 'du 'tsho chom rkun gyis bcom ste/ /tshong dang gyod dang khyim gyi sgrog tu tshud/ /phyi snod phal cher gog cing zhig shul gyur/ /skye dgu phal cher las kyi chad pas mnar/ /gang la bltas kyang 'jigs dang skyo ba'i rgyu/ /'di 'dra'i nang du bde skyid ci zhig yod/ /mdor na 'ching ba mi bshad 'dod pa'i dgrar/ /skyo ba skyed la bskyed nas mang du bslab/ /skyo 'di byang chub 316

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma lam gyi gleng gzhi ru/ /'jig rten gnyen gyis lan cig min par gsungs/ /'jig rten bya ba spun pa 'phyar ba bzhin/ /snying po med par gting nas rig gyur na/ /dam chos sgrub la cis kyang mi bzlog pa'i/ /thag chod blo sna 'di 'dra zin pa 'ong / /phyug po'i nor bzhin dam chos thang bdal yang / /gang la 'jus kyang phag sna brag thug bzhin/ /gcig tu rdugs 'di chos brgyad 'gong po yis/ /rang rgyud zil gyis mnan pas nongs par gsungs/ /dam chos byed 'dod lhad dang bral nges shig /yod na da lta thub bstan gnas pa'i phyir//mngon mtho nges legs chos skor gang 'dod kyang / /rin chen gling nas gser bzhin blang bas chog /de tshe gdams pas rang gi bya ba byed/ /chos la blo 'gro song nas phyir mi ldog /chos dang rang rgyud dpyid dang ldum ra bzhin/ /mthun pa'i rten 'brel ngang gis 'grigs pa lags/ /chos kyi nying khu jeg pa mchog sga lam/ /mtho ris thar pa skrub pa'i lam rnams kun/ /de la gzhol zhing de yi khong chud de/ /sangs rgyas theg pa gangs chen mtsho 'drar bsngags/ / theg mchog lam bzang nges par sgrub snyam na/ /lam de'i sngon 'gro ci tsam spyang ba dang / /lam de'i 'jug sgo gang la byed pa dang / /'jug sgo de la ji ltar slob pa dang / /zhugs nas ci zhig bya ba'i rnam bzhag sogs/ /rgyal bas gsungs shing shing rta chen pos bkral//317

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bumamakhas nas mkhas par brgyud pa'i man ngag bzhin/ /brtson 'grus chen pos legs par sbyangs pa gces/ /'on te tshig phreng nyung ngus lam gyi gnad/ /tshang bar 'doms pa'i zhal gdams la dgyes na/ /sangs rgyas sras po dpal ldan zhi ba lha'i/ /spyod 'jug gzhung la chog shes med par gzigs/ /gzhung nyung don rgyas tshig sbyor gsal zhing snyan/ /rigs pa'i rgyan ldan nyams len gnad du 'dril//rgya bod mkhas pa'i thub/sa dam byin rlabs can/ /'di 'dra rnyed dka' lhag pa gang nas rnyed/ /yang yang blta zhing mkhas pas zhib tu mnyan/ /dus kun sems shing dbyangs kyis kha ton bya/ /sngas su bzhag cing smon lam rgya chen gdab/ /sgo rnams kun nas 'di la bya ba mdzod/ /bkra shis mtha' bzang mis mchod rang sems gtsang / /lha dga' 'dre zhi rgyal dang mkhas pa dgyes/ /rmi lam tshun chad legs pa'i lam du 'ong / /dge sbyor de yin chos spyod de la zer/ /de ltar theg pa mchog la blo sbyangs nas/ /sangs rgyas rigs kyi nus pa cher rgyas na/ /don gnyis bsam pa myur du rdzogs slad du/ /bla med rdo rje theg la 'jug par bya/ /'jug sgo dbang dang dbang srog dam tshig gis/ /bzung dang smin lam rim pa dang po dang / /dngos gzhi rdzogs rim bogs 'don thabs dang bcas/ /gsar rnying rgyud sde'i lam srol grangs med kyang / /rang cag las smon dkar po'i me 318

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1tog phreng / /snga 'gyur chos kyi re khra la babs phyir/ /skyabs gcig o rgyan pad+ma'i bka' brgyud 'dir/ /blo rtse gcig tu dril nas 'jus na 'thad/ /de skad rang blor gang shar yi ge'i phreng / /rkang par bcad 'di bsod nams dpal ldan pas/ /bskrul nas nags kyi mi rgan bhu su kus//bris pa'i dge bas 'gro la phan byed shog/ //ba / /mkhyen pas bzang goms kho na snying por dgongs/ /brtson pas ngan goms bag chags drungs nas phyungs/ /de mthus bzang goms rab kyi rtser son pa/ /thub mchog zla med de la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /yon tan mtha' dag goms pa'i rjes 'gro zhing / /goms pa rang gis 'bad rtsol la gnas kyang /yon tan la dga' de nyid mngon 'dod cing / /goms phyir rtsol ba sna gcig mi byed mtshar/ /ngan goms kho na'i dbang song gdul bya yi/ /kha lo sgyur phyir sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon/ /de yi rjes zhugs bzang goms mi slob na/ /rjes zhugs zer ba'ang mdzub mo 'dzuṭa yul dka'/ /shin tu blun yang goms pa lhur blangs pas/ /tshigs bcad gcig gis lam pas ('bras)khyad par rtogs/ /blo no smra lce bde ba'i khengs ldan brgya/ /le lo'i dbang gyur lag pa stong par 'gro/ /rang blo chos la bcug kyang mi 'jug pa/ /tshe sngon bzang goms med pa'i lag rjes te/ /da lta'i mi tshe'ang ngan goms la btang na/ /phyi ma'i 319

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshe yang lam bzang ji ltar rnyed/ /skad cig bsam kyang don chen mi zad pa'i/ /sgor gyur sangs rgyas bstan pa bdud rtsi'i ro/ /rnyed nas ma myang chos kyi sgra tsam yang / /mi thos dmyal bar song tshe ci zhig bya/ /bde 'gro'i rten rnyed lam ston bla ma dang / /chos tshul dpyod pa'i blo mig 'dzom dus su/ /bzang goms mi bsten skyabs med mgon med du/ /ngan 'gror song tshe bzang goms ji ltar 'ong / /na tshod thog mar rtsed mos nam zla phul/ /dar ma'i rnam dpyod ngan goms lang shor btang / /rgud tshe bzang goms bslab kyang stobs med pas/ /kye ma'o go 'phang bzang por ji ltar 'gro/ /'du 'dzi'i nang du 'jig rten long gtam spel/ /gcig pur 'dug dus btsem drub shing bzor brtson/ /sang rjes gnangs 'ong rnam rtog lug gu rgyud/ /de 'dra'i dkyil nas bzang goms nam yong soms/ /brel dus brel bas g.yengs shing sos dal dus/ /rgya bod hor sogs 'du 'dzi'i gtam gyis 'da'/ /dus rnams kun tu shags dang bzhad gad sbyang / /bzang goms ma byung zer te gang nas 'byung / nyin mo gtug 'grul las mang bya dgos snyam/ /mtshan mo gnyid brod myur du nyal dgos snyam/ /nyin mtshan mtha' dag de 'dra'i ngang song na/ /mi che'i lhag ma zhes bya gzhan yod min/ /nyams myong spyod lam kun dang sre ba la/ /chos kyi nyams myong sna 320

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma nga gcig yod pa dgos/ 'on kyang sgra spyi'i go yul rjes dran(rjes dran drug)tsam/ /spyod lam rnam bzhir sbyong ba bya dka' min/ /'jig rten drun po chos la ma 'dris pa'ang / /phongs pas nyen tshe dkon mchob dran byed na/ /shākya'i rjes 'brangs brel ba phra mo'i phyir/ /dam chos brjed do zeraXn ngo yang tsha/ /mchos gsum lan re dran yang tshe rabs su/ /'tsheng nges bsod nams ro rgyags thob 'gyur na/ /rtse rgod g.yeng bas brjed ngas dgra 'bod pa/ /bdud kyi me tog nyag phran mngon sum bzhin/ /brel bas ma loms zer te ji ltar yang / /de tshe 'du 'dzi'i gtam dang shags 'gyed ni/ /bris na glegs bam che tshad bgyid du byung / /chos tshig gcig dran ma khom cang bden nam/ /gyod dang khe spogs nye du'i kha 'dzin sogs/ /log pa'i yul bsam de la dga' ba bsgom/ /de nyid bzlas brjod byed cing yid gtad na/ /mi dbe ngan goms ma bslab ci zhig bslab/ /g.yo sgyu khram sogs 'jig rten khyem pa yi/ /ngan spyod kho na'i rgyus la sbya nga byas pas/ /dkar chos zla ba yar ngo ltar 'gyur na/ 1rgyu 'bras mi 'chol zhes pa rdzun du bas/ /khe bas tshong dang chom rkun g.yo thabs dang / /sna bos gyod dang bzas chos gtam sogs/ /goms shugs ji bzhin ngag kyang rjes 'brangs bas/ /gtam rnams 'dod pa'i phyogs bzhin 'gro zhes grags/ /dam pa yin min sems rgyud 321
