pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'khum/bzang ngan khyad/ /sems rgyud bzang ba goms pa bzang la rag /ngan pa'i spyod tshul goms pa lhur len cing / /bzang por re na du bas rgya mtsho dpogs/ /drang srong rgyal mtshan thogs pa'i gral ring gis/ /btsog gtam chos ltar 'don la mi khrel bar/ /rab byung kha nas chos gtam thon pa la/ /tshul 'chos yin zhes zhe khrel gtong ba'ang mthong / /khyim pas ngan las gang dang ci byed kyang //rang gi las skal yin ces mgrin gcig sgrogs/ /rab byung chos la gus shing chos smra na/ /las skal mi zer zol ma yin zhes 'phya/ /kyi hud 'jig rten bla ma'i bstan pa ni/ /'di ltar tha ma'i gnas skabs son mthong yang / /yid 'byung mi skye dmu rgod bag med kyi/ /phyi rjes ci stogs byed pa skyo ba'i yul/ /'du 'dzi bcad na de 'dra min no lo/ /dben pa'i gnas su'ang mtho ba'i sar song ste/ /grong la blta zhing grong gi gtam 'dri phyir/ /lam 'grul 'tshol na 'du 'dzi nam zhig 'chad//ne'u gseng mdzes pas phyugs kyi rtsa lhas dang //nabs tshal dra bas rtsa btu shing 'breg dang / /dben pa'i skyibs kyis rkun po'i gab khung dang / /ri dwags tshogs las rngon pa'i me mda' sogs/ /mdor na gang gang dben pa'i 'byor pa mchog /de de 'du 'dzi rjes dran sgor song nas/ /'du 'dzi rmi lam nang du'ang mi brjod pa'i/ /tshul 'dis dben yang don du 'gyur ba dka'/ /kha 32 2

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1cig 'di ltar ngan goms cher mthong bas/ /skrag nas bzang goms 'ba' zhig rtsal sbyong byed/ /ri klung phal cher me yis 'bar mthong tshe/ /mig ldan skye bo bsil ba'i phyogs su 'bros/ /gzhan dag kho bo bzang goms mi slob pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan ngan goms 'thug pas nongs so zer/ /me chen du bas nags klung glal ba na/ /bsam med bya tshogs nan gyis me nang 'jug /lam 'grul 'phyis na do nub 'dod pa'i sar/ /mi sleb zer te snga nas sga chas 'jug /tshe phyed rdzogs kyang bzang goms bslab 'phyis pas/ /'chi dus 'dod sar mi sleb yong mi sems/ /thog med ngan goms drag po'i ri gzar rbab/ /brtson 'grus shugs kyis bzung ste bde mtho'i sar/ /'dren 'di lo re zla res sgrub nus pa'i/ /bgyi ba chung ngu min te su yis shes/ /rgas pa'i 'og tu myur ba myur bar ni/ /bzang goms mthar dbyung snyam pa snying stobs che/ /sems shed rgyas dus bzang goms phra mo nas/ /gsog la zhum pa snying stobs shin tu dman/ /ri bo bags kyis 'dzegs shing grog ma'i mkhar/ /bags kyis bsags nas chen por gyur pa ltar/ /bags kyis sbyangs shing mthar gyis bslab nas su/ /goms par 'gyur 'di sras bcas rgyal ba'i lugs/ /ma bcus bkod ma'i chu yang skam 'gyur la/ /bus na me stag phra mo'ang mched 'gyur ltar/ /bslab na skad cig res kyang bzang 323

pob 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa goms 'phel/ /bskrur na sngon goms rnams kyang brjed nas 'gro/ /'on kyang babs kyis slob zer rdzun du zad/ /nam zhig cig char kho nar sgrub bo zhes/ /smra 'di rgya nag hwa shang sku 'das nas/ /sngon med spru la pa'i gar gyis rtsen nam snyam/ /gzhung mang dkyus gcig 'dzin pa ches sga ste/ /nyin rer tshig re 'dzin pa shin tu dka'/ / dge sbyor chig dril sbyong la tshegs med de/ /zhar dang zhor la sgrub pa ches rab dka'/ /de skad smra na lta ba snyigs ma'i dus/ /ngo mtshar med mod sngon byon mkhas grub kyi/ /mdun sar gtug na ngo mtshar chen po yi/ /gleng gzhir mdzad nges bstan bcos ltos dang shes/ /nam mkhar yal rgyu'i long gtam phreng ba bgrang / /rang dang 'grogs pa'i dge sbyor rgyab tu 'phang / /sprul ltar 'jigs pa'i ngan goms mgul bar btags/ /'di ltar 'jig rten gzhan du 'gro nus sam/ /dge sbyor zhes bya phyag skor tsab tsub dang / /kha ton 'bag 'bug rkyang du zad pa min/ /rgyal bas 'jig rten sems tsam zhes gsungs pas/ /rang sems bzang goms sbyong ba gnad kyi mthil/ /'di ltar dam pa'i gsung sgros du ma las/ /mthong yang bzang goms phyogs su mi khyer bar/ /zer mod shes mod kho nar bskyal ba yis/ /blo dred chos las zhud pa 'di 'drar byung / /blang 'os gdam pa'i khyad par ci mthong yang / /don la mi dpyod tshig 324

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gi snyan cha rtog /snying po mi len rtsom mkhan bzang ngan smra/ /rgod bag rtsed mo'i gleng gzhir byed pa yis/ /don la mi rton tshig 'brur rton pa dang / /chos la mi rton gang zag la rton dang / /chos kyi zhing la ngag 'khyal zo ba sogs/ /de ltar byed na gdams pa'i dgos pa ci/ /chos kyi rje yis rang gi legs bshad la/ /rton pa rnam bzhi'i tshul gyis 'jug gsungs pa/ /gnyis su mi 'gyur gcig tu bden gsungs pa'i/ /bka' yin de phyir gzhan du byar mi rung / /chos 'di rgyal bas sku tshe grangs med du/ /'bad pa brgya yis btsal nas legs bsgrubs te/ /nyid kyis ri mor mdzad nas bshad pa'i phyir/ /'di la 'chal gtam rtsed mo bgyir mi rung / /ji srid bde gshegs bstan pa gnas kyi bar/ /sa steng legs bshad khyad par gang 'byung ba/ /de kun rgyal ba ston pa'i chos 'khor du/ /ro gcig nyid ces mdo sde rnams las 'byung / /tshul 'dis rnam par 'thag pa bsdus pa'i mdor/ /dam chos spong ba'i las sgrib ches phra zhes/ /gsungs pa'i gnad la'ang nges pa btsal dgos te/ /'di las don che gzhan ni 'ga' ma mthong / /mang du brjod pas ci bya mdor dril na/ /dran pa 'dris pa'i dmigs pa kho na las/ /skye bar gsungs shing 'phrin gyi pho nya bas/ /'phrin tshig skyor dang skrud mdud 'dogs la ltos/ /dam chos mi brjed byed pa'i 'phen pa 326

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga bsam/ /chos kyi gnad 'gag snying po mtshan mar bzung / /de nyid yid kyis mang brjod 'dris su gzhug /yang yang dran phyir srad bu'i brjed byang gdags/ /dus rnams kun tu dbang po'i sgo sdom zhing / /rang gis rang brtags rang nyid rang gis bcos/ /thabs tshul du mas da nu rgod sems kyi rta/ /'dul sbyong byas te legs pa'i lam du gzhug /rtsa shing bem por blo gros yod min yang / /sangs rgyas dbang gis chos sgra 'byin byed ltar/ /bdag kyang bzang goms yon tan yod min yang / /'di ltar brjod nus dpal ldan bla ma'i mthu/ /ring nas bsags ba'i ngan goms ma zhu'i nad/ /sun 'byin 'phrul thal rdon po'i sbyor ba 'dis/ /bshigs te chos kyi lus la nad med cing / /chos skyes bde bas nyin mtshan 'da' bar shog /lus can kun gyi ngan goms rgya mtsho'i chu/ /skem byed rta gdong ri bor nga 'gyur zhing / /brtson 'grus me chen 'khrugs pa'i dmar 'od kyis/ /bdud sde'i snying la 'jigs pa ster gyur cig /bdag cag pad+ma rgyal po'i zhabs drung du//phan tshun dam chos spyod pa'i grogs gyur te/ /theg mchog bde ba'i lam bzang gcig nyid nas/ /gnyis med chos sku gcig tu 'grub par shog /blo la chos kyi gnad don legs bzung ste/ /rang blo chos kyi snod du bsgrub bya zhing / /blo dang chos sres blo chos ro gcig tu/ /'gro bar mdzod 326

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ces gal chen lan dgu ru/ /bskyar 'di rdo rong yul gyi mu to ba/ /ming la snyan pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi/ /don la lod pa chos med ro nyal mkhan/ /de yis bya mang 'du ba'i nags su bris/ /maṅga lam// //3 27

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/༄ / /bslab bya'i snying gtam zhim mngar sbrang rtsi'i gong bu bzhugs so/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyir dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i rten la khyim pa dang rab byung gi phyogs gnyis las/ dang po ltar na dpon gyis mnga' ris dang / 'bangs mis kyang rang khyem chos kyi lam dang mi 'as la bar skyong tshul dang / brtul zhugs kyi gzhi lnga dang / rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi bzhi bdun sogs la rten nas 'jig rten pha rol gyi rgyags sgrub lugs mang du yod kyang bshad pa'i skabs su ma bab/ phyogs gnyis pa rab byung yin na/ /dge tshul slong gang yin kyang de dang de'i bslab bya legs par nyan nas 'bad pa chen pos srung ba gzhir bzhag ste/thos pa la dang por brtson dgos/ de la sgra snyan skar rtsis sogasaXkyang spyir mkhas bya'i gnas tsam yin kyang / snyigs dus kyi tshe thung 'dir de 'dra'i spros pa mang po la g.yeng ches na zan rgam thus pas zan log rbab la shor ba'i dpe bzhin 'gyur bas/ byang chub sgrub pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba 'ba' zhig gtso bor bzung nas 328

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ci shes byed dgos/ de byed na ston pa sangs rgyas nas bzung ste chos brgyud kyi byin rlabs bar ma chad par thob dgos pas/ dpe ltas rkyang pa lta bus mi chog gi/ skyes bu dam pa la bsten nas gdams ngag gi zhun thar legs par gcod/ de nas kha phyir bltas kyi slob gnyer kho na'i rjes su mgo bo mi 'khor bar/ rtse ༷gcig tu sgrub tshugs bzung ste thos pa la snying po len dgos kyang / grogs ngan 'du long gi gseb tu mthun 'jug ngo bsrung dang /dgra gyod 'khon gsum/ tshong so nam/ bsam blo 'dun gros/ zad med ngas 'khyal gyi 'khor lo sogs bya ba ngan pa la mi tshe zad nas sgrub pa rnal ma nyin gcig kyang byed rgyu mi 'byung bas 'du 'dzi rgyang bsring nas dben pa bsten/ dben par bsdod kyang bag med rnam g.yeng / sos dal ro nyal/ dran tshad lag len gyi ngang la nam zla bskyal na phyugs rdzi ri khar nyal ba dang khyad med pas/ dus rgyun du blo ldog rnam pa bzhis rang gi rgyud btul te/ blo sna chos la 'gro ba dang / bsam rgyu chos las med pa/ yengs ma lam du skad cig tsam lus kyang long med kyi 'du shes dran sos nang nas bskrul ba la bslab/ de'ang res ma sgom kyang 'ong la/ res sgom kyang mi 'char ba'i glo bur gyi nges 'byung spu su tsam skye ba la sngon du tshul bzhin sbyang dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang / nges 'byung gi bsam pa chig rkya 329

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga pher baXdang / nam dgos kyi dus su sleb pa 'ong ba la blo ldog rnam bzhi khrid gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin du bsgom dkos pa yin/nang ma re bzhin de ring drang srong gi gnas su tha mal pa'i kun spyod mi bya bar dge sbyor kho na skyong dgos snyam du 'phen pa btang /thun nang du chos bsam lo byas kyang thun mtshams rnams su shes pa ngan lang la btang na yang skyed med cing rim gyis blo dred la 'gro bas dus thams cad du rang gi rgyud la brtag cing dge sbyor gyi rgyun mi brjed pa'i dran pa nar re bsten/ de 'dra'i rtsol ba ha cang bsten dra ṭa na'ang zhe sun skyes nas sdod snying mi 'dod pa 'byung bas grim la lhod chags pa pi wang gi rgyud lta bu'i brtson 'grus rtsom tshul shes dgos/ bar skabs ci ribs par gong ma'i rnam thar nyan cing bltas na brtson 'grus kyi bogs 'don yong bas rje btsun mi la sogs bka' brgyud gong ma dang / zhi byed dang /smyung gnas kyi bla brgyud/ rdzogs chen snying thig gi brgyud pa sogs kyi rnam thar blta zhing spro ba bskyed/ de dag gi rjes su slob pa'i yi dam bca'/ nub re bzhin nyin der dge sbyor gyi 'phel 'grib bang byung brtsis la/ 'grib nas snang na rang la nyes pa bgrang zhing /sang nyin nas 'di ltar ma song bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'phen pa drag po gtong / 'phel bar 'dug na/ 'di 'dra dben pa bsten pa las 3 30

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma nga ma byung snyam du phyi phyir dben pa la dga' ba bsgom zhing / dkon mchog gi bka' drin dran pa dang / smon lam rnam par dag pa'i rgyas 'debs sobs bya/ bya btang dang rnal 'byor pa'i sha tshugs bzung yang / de la mngon rloms kyi g.ya' zhugs/ gzhan la brnyas smod dang khyad gsod gtong / rang la gzhan gyis bzang por mthong du re zhing / nang du yon tan ci skyes ngom chos su khyer/rtogs pa ma shar bzhin du chos bshad la dga'/ drod ma thob bzhin du tho co rtsing spyod byed pa sogs chos ma 'grub gong nas bdud 'grub pa'i rgyu yin pas sa 'og gi gter dang thal dong gi me bzhin du sbas pa'i brtul zhugs bzung / lar blo chos su 'gro ba dang / chos lam du 'gro ba thams cad bla ma dkon mchog gi drin la rag las pas dus rtag tu gsol 'debs mos gus la 'bad cing / nyams rtogs skye ba'i 'gal rkyen stobs bzhi'i bshags pas sbyong ba dang / tshogs bsags kyi sgo mang po'i mthun rkyen bsten pa gal che/ de ltar man ngas gi ba/nad dang ldan pas dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa snying por byas na rim nas rim gyis phyin ci log gi blo sna shas je chung / phyin ci ma log pa'i blo sna shugs je che dang je mang la 'gro ste/ de 'dra ba la sems 'dul ba zer sems 'dul ba min pa'i gdams ngag gi don po bzhan med de/ rte31

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ bsnyengs dang bral la mang du gsol ci 'tshal/ /phan pa'i gdams ngab don po 'di lags te/ /lo kyi thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ /sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ zhes ji skad gsungs pa bzhin no/ /skyabs 'gro dang blo ldos rnam bzhis chos kyi rtsa ba tshugs pa na theg chen spyi'i lam gyi snying po byang chub sems gnyis la nyams len gyi mthil du bzung nas slob dbos te/ de'i tshul ni 'dir mgo med mjug rdum cig bris kyang go mi chod pas spyod 'jug dang / rdzogs chen sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta chen po/ dwags po rin po che'i thar rgyan sogs las zhib tu shes par bya/ khyad par du don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom tshul thun mong ma yin pa phyas rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug na/ gzhi dbang dang dam tshig gis bzung ste/ so so'i ngo sprod dang / lta sgom spyod pa'i rnam dbye/ gegs sel bogs 'don sogs mkhas grub gong ma'i bsung rab dang /bla ma nyams myong can gyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi ltar nyams su blang bas ring por mi thogs par sa lam gyi yon tan dbyar gyi myu gu ltar rgyas par 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa'ang yid lhung lha ru dbon sras karma nges don chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes dam pa'i yon tan gyis thugs rgyud phyug pa gang gis 33 2

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1phrin yig gnang rten dang bcas pas bskul ba ltar/ zhal gdams slong ba'i don gnyer mkhan gzhan 'ga' zhig la'ang phan par bsams te/ 'jigs med bstan nyis rang gis chos byed ma myong yang / rgyal sras zhi ba lha sogs chos la nyams len mthar phyin pa'i dam pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun zegs ma tsam bris pa mchog tu dge bar gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o//bha wargyu/ shu hūṃ////ma / /bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen/ de mchod brjod yin/ deng sang la las rgyu zas med pas lto rgyab kyis mi bzod 'dug zer zhing / tshong rku jag gsum la 'gro/ 'dun ma yag nyes mo thob dang zer nas mo phywa byed/ phal cher la mo ngan babs zer te bden par snang / phal cher mi bsad/ rgyu phrogs/ mdzub mo kha la bcug nas thon 'dug /la las dam pa'i chos shig sgrub dgos pas gnas skor la 'gro/ gnyan sa 'grim/ 'di las bzang ba'i chos med zer te/ de tshor 'gro sa nas sdom pa shor ba dang / 'dres khyer ba sogs mang po yod pas dpyad dgos/ la la ci bsam 'di bsam/ sngar dpyad phyi 'dang gang yang med par ro nyal brgyab sdod de/ de ring nyal bsdad pas mi yong / sang nyin gyi za chas zhig sngon nas ma bsgrubs na/ ba nyal ba'i kha la/ rtsa gnam gyis mi spro da pa yin/ la las da lo 'di byed/ sang phod 'di yong / de dus 'di 'dra dgos 333

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhes phor chag nang du yul gling gi bkod pa bris/ yar rgyug mar mdur/ rdo la bug pa 'bug zer te gcig rjes gnyis mthud mang po dran rgyu byed rgyu yod kyang / bsam pa'i steng du gom pa song ba re zung tsam red/ ngas bsam tshad thig las mi bzur/ bshad tshad sa la mi lhung snyam nas rang la brtsi 'jog gnam sngon po tsam yod pa rnams kyang / bsam pa la khar lus bzhin du/ phung po dur khrod du slebs pas skyo/ zhes pa ltar 'gro ba'i dus la babs tshe/ phag sna brag la thug pa ltar thabs med stobs shor/ mthu rdug ste kha skya krad de/ bdang mchi ma tsa re/ sa tshugs med pa'i phyogs su 'gro gi 'dug /de ltar na de 'dra'i rigs thams cad thabs bzo mo dang /thabs mkhas po yin yin mi 'dra/ de ci la 'dra ste/ thams cad 'ol tshod mun pa mda' 'phen dang / bzo chas tshad la ma phab pa sha stag red pas/ 'dod don gyi 'ben la ma bcar ba dang / lhag chad nor 'khrul song ba la yus ci yod/ 'dod don sgrub pa la mi bslu nges pa'i thabs bzo mo zer ba de/ thabs dang thabs byung /thabs min nyes dmigs dang bcas pa'i rgyus la mkhas pa'i bla mas bstan cing / thabs dang thabs min gyi dbye ba legs par dpyod nus pa mang pos gtan la phab pa zhig dgos/ thabs de 'dra ston pa'i bla ma de su red zer na/ srid pa gsum na bla ma 334

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gcig /rkang gnyis nang na gtso bo gcig /smra ba'i nang na zla med gcig ste sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho na yin/ khong gis sems can bde skyid dang sprod pa'i thabs bstan ched mngon mtho sgrub byed dang / nges legs sgrub byed gnyis su 'du/ de'ang mngon mtho la brten nas nges legs sgrub dgos pas/ dang por mngon mtho sgrub dgos/ de'i tshul mang yang mngon mtho khyad par can dag pa'i zhing gi mngon mtho bsgrubs pa'i steng nas nges legs sgrub pa 'di theg chen gyi mdo sde mang po nas bsngags bsngags pa yin/ de'i nang nas bde ba can du skye ba len pa'i rgyu tshogs sprub lugs glen gtam byas na/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med rnam pa'i sgo nas yang yang yid la byed pa dang / yan lag bdun pa sogs kyi dge rtsa mang po rgyun mi gcod par gsog pa dang / theg chen sems bskyed ci nus su spyang ba dang / dge rtsa gang bsgrub bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyur bsngo ba dang bzhi po 'di blo la bzung nas che shes chung shes bslab dgos/ 'di bzhi la mang du bslabs nas bsgyur bas mi chog /da lta mang du bslab/ rgyud thog tu 'dres nges bslab/ 'chi ran dus bar du 'phro ma chadaXpar bslab nas/ gnas gang du/ rkyen gang gis/ sdug bsngal che chung dang yun ring thung ji lta bu'i ngang nas shi rung 'chi kha bag chags stobs ldan sad nges pa/336

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rang zhe rang la khel shag shag bya dgos/ de la da lta rang gi sems zhing sbyang gi tshogs la shin tu lob cing byang ba/ rta rtsal can dal brel gyi gnas skabs kun tu rta las mi lhung ba 'dra ba zhig sbyang dgos/ de yong ba la dang po mi 'grul bcad/ skad cha bsgyur/ phag ltas sgog nyan sogs lta dga' nyan sred mang po'i rgyun rbad kyis ba'i ma ste/ sems phyi rol du ma shor bas rgyu tshogs bzhi po rtse gcig tu bsgom/ 'di dus sangs rgyas kyi sku dang zhing khams kyi yon tan bkod pa rnams la bskyed rim gyi gsal snang 'don lugs lta bu mi dgos/ da lta thag ring na bla ma bzang po bzhugs rabs/ de la yon tan 'di dang 'di yod/ chos 'di dang 'di 'dra gsung /de'i bzhugs gnas na chos dang zang zing blu dpal 'byor 'di tsam yod sogs zhib tu thos nas/ de la bsam blo mang du btang bas de kho nas sems phrogs pa bzhin song ste/ e shi re/ bla ma de bzhugs sar nam thon na/ der thon rgyu zhig yod na pha ma/ phu nu/nye mdza' sogs su'i kha la'ang mi nyan/ su la'ang blo 'dri gros bstun mi byed par bud mi 'gro na snyam du kho thag chod pa dang /don de brjed mi thub par rgun 'brum gyi chang 'thung ba ltar yon tan gyi ro mngar yang myang na yang 'dod pa/ ci tsam myang yang tshim pa med pa de la sems yang yang 'khor yong ba de ngo ma lta bu zhig 336

—zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1byas nas sbyong rgyu red/ zhing bkod sogs 'dir bri ma thub pas gzhan nas i shes ltos/ bde ba can na shing dang chu dang me tog dang zas gos sogs longs spyod dang / rin po che'i sa gzhi'i yon tan sogs bshad pa rnams 'brog na mar mod rabs dang rong na ja nas 'bol rabs/ sa skyid rabs/ mi bzang rabs bshad bsdad pa lta bur go mi nyan/ sems can las ngan sdig can mang pos bzung ba'i yul du dge ba byed mkhan re re gnyis gnyis yod kyang rang 'od mi 'byin zhing stobs chung / de sdig pa'i dbang 'bras kyi nus pa red1 des na de 'dra'i yul du dge ba byed mkhan tshe thung / khas dman/ mi 'dod pa gang yang yong ba mang / sems can dge ba can mang po'i las kyi dbang 'bras bdo ba'i yul du chos byed mthu che/ sman dang rig sngags kyi nus pa'ang 'phral la mthong / smon lam dkar po 'grub sla/ dge ba'i stobs mngon tshan che ba sogs yong / de bzhin du bde ba can gyi zhing na sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi sngon gyi smon lam dang / tshogs gnyis kyi mthu las byung ba'i gnas dang yo byad kho na ma gtogs/ sems can tha mal pa'i las nyon gyi dbang gis grub pa'i sa phyar ba tsam mam/spar mthil tsam yang med/ de ji ltar yin na/ zhing de'i ljon shing gcig tsam mam/ me tog rdog gcig tsam la'ang sangs rgyas 'od 337

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/྾ ྾dpag med kyi sngon smon dang spyod pa'i lag rjes 'di dang 'di ltar yod/ de'i dbang gis zhing der pheg chen gyi lam bsgrub pa thams cad stobs che/ shugs drag /'grub myur/ tshegs chung zhes bstan pa red/ de'i bar skabs thams cad du bzang spyod smon lam ci thub 'don/ lar 'di dus 'don pa gtso bor mi byed/ bsam rgyu gtso bor byed/ de'ang lhod ches nas rnam g.yeng gi rlung gis khyer ba dang / dam drag nas shes pa sna sun la 'gro ba gnyis gang yang mi bya bar grim gyi nang na lhod yod pa gzhu brdungs pa'i rgyud 'dra ba dgos shing / yun thung grangs mang khang rgan chu thig gi dpe bzhin ga le bslab/ ngal bso la sdod skabs rnams su yang / rtsa ba'i dmigs pa btang ba tsam ma gtogs/ de dang phyogs gtan nas 'dzol ba'i tshong dang gyod dang khyem gyi so nam sogs la rtog pa spro mi nyan pas/ dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi sems la ngal gso/tshul de lta dus lo re'i nang du zla ba gsum re'am/ re re'am/ tha na'ang zhag bcu re lta bur bcad rgya byas nas bsgom/ de dag gi dus su bsgom pa de dus gzhan thams cad du'ang khyer nas dpa' bo'i ral gri sked dang mi 'bral ba bzhin du 'gro 'dug za nyal sogs spyod lam dang spyod pa thams cad la slebs gang thub bya/nangs par lang tshe bla ma 'od dpag med dang / rgyal sras thu bo 338

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rnam gnyis sogs la dmigs nas phyag gsum re btsal te/ de ring bi nyi ma 'di gron dzar la mi gtang bar bde ba can du 'gro ba'i rta khal dang gro rgyags tshags su ci tshud bya dgos/ mi gzhan ma'i rta khal gyis nyi ma bca' bcu la e 'phong mi 'phong bshad gi 'dug pas des bde ba can du 'khrol ba'i re ba mi 'dug /ja'i rtsigs pa brgyab/ mar gyi ya do brtsigs/ nas rkyal gyi rags then/sha thud mar khu'i khrod du 'bogs rkyal byed gi yod pa'i phyug po thams cad rtsam khug dang kha phor tshun chad shul du bsgyur nas bud song bas de 'dra'i gro rgyags ci tsam yod kyang tshe phyi ma mi dgos/bar do'i 'phrang la yang 'khyer thabs mi 'dug /des na rangaXnyid da gzod gnas gtan 'pho/ yul gtan brje byas nas/ shi dang 'pho dang shi 'pho dus byas pa/ /phyir mi 'ong zhing phrad par 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kha mi 'khor gyi sar 'gro dus/zhon rgyu'i rta/ 'ded rgyu'i khal/ 'tsho ba'i rgyags/ 'grogs pa'i grogs thams cad kyi skal ba rgyu tshogs gong smos bzhi po kho na ma gtogs ci yang med/ da res kyi tshe mjug 'di la nye'u sa ko mog la rgya mtshor shes pa bzhin du ring po zhig yod snang shar nas rang gis rang bslus pa ma gtogs don la lug gi rnga ma g.yug pa ltar thung rtsed de ba zhig las ci yang med/ tshe phyi ma zer rgyu de ring tshad 339

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/thung tshad 'di tsam zhes 'jog rgyu'i mtshams mi zin pa zhig yin te/'khor ba ya mtha' thug med nas da bar 'ong ba la/ mgo nas rdzogs te rnga ma la zad 'gro rgyu med dus/ da dung yang de 'dra ba zhig los yin te/ skye bo'i rjes su spyod pa'i 'khor ba bas/ /de bas ches mang ba zhig btung 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ des na nga rang la tshe phyi ma'i rta gro rogs gsum bsdu tshag byed pa 'di las gal che ba'i kheb gcig kyang med pas/ 'di kho na la hril gyis 'dril snyam du 'phen pa shugs drag gtong / dar cig mal du bsdad la sngar bsgom pa'i rgyu bzhi tshang ba'am/ min kyang sha chod rus chod gsos btab/ de nas me 'bud ja bskol sogs kyi tshe yang de'i rtsi dang mi 'bral ba ci yong byed/ gzhan du 'gro dus kyang 'di bzhin du rang gzhan sems can thams cad phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi drung du chos mnyan pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro bar shog cig ces dang / rang khyim du yong dus 'di bzhin 'od dpag med kyi spyan sngar slar 'jug par shog cig dang / zas za dus 'di bzhin du bde ba can du bsam gtan dang chos kyi dga' ba'i zas la spyod par dang / skad cha chal chol lab dus bde ba can du byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun noms dang lhan cig smra bar dang / nyo tshong dus/ yang na rig pa rig pa brje/ zer ba ltar byang sems 340

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1 rnams dang chos kyi nyo tshong gis dus 'da' bar shog sogs rtsal spyang na/ tshig zin gyi khungs mi snang yang mdo sde rgyan du/ rgyal sras spyod tshe ji lta ji lta bur/ /sogs dang / mdo phal po che'i spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i le'u dang shin tu 'gros mthun pas mi legs pa ci yod snyam/ gzhan yang 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal gyi yul rkyen mang pos yid skyo ba na bde ba can du 'gro dgos pa'i bya gtong du shes pa dang / bde skyid kyi yul rkyen nyams dga' bas sems brid pa da bde ba can gyi bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu tshogs la bsam tshe/ sprang tshang lhar rgya chung ba/ dur khrod kyi rdzas ltar ngan zhing smad pa/ dug can gyi zas zhim ltar mtha' ngan pa 'di 'dra la dga' rgyu ci yod/ nga bde ba can du 'gro ba'i lam rgyags bor nas 'di 'dra'i nang du mgo 'khor ba ni lha'i rgyal srid bskyur nas srin mo'i 'dzum dkar lta ba dang 'dra snyam du dran pa bsten/ sdug pa yid 'ong gi dngos po ci mthong ba dang / zas bos la longs spyod pa sogs kyi tshe sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mchod snyam pa sogs mdor na rgyu bzhi'i phyogs kyi dran 'dun ma bor ba byed/ nub mo nyal khar de ring rgyu bzhi la bag chags ci tsam theb pa byas 'dug /phyug pos 'du 'god rtsi rtsi byas nas cher ma byung 'dug na/ nga rang lo sum cu lhag lon tshar/ mye tshe gcig la lo mang med de/ da 'dug 341

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma long ci tsam yod sus shes/ lo gcig la zla ba bcu gnyis/ zla ba gcig la zhag sum cu las med/ de'i gcig de ring yin/ long yod yod la song na nyi ma lus 'phabs gling gi phyed steng gi nam mkha' la slebs pa nas bzung ste/ ba glang spyod kyi nam mkha' la thon 'gro ba'i bar na dpag tshad khri tsho bco lnga skor yod/ de rdzogs ring la ngas 'dun ma rlung la bskrur nas lag stong khar bcug rgyu red 'dug /snyigs dus tshe thung gi mir skyes/ 'byung ba bzhi dang gdon rgod sogs 'chi rkyen rags la mang ba'i nang du rlung gseb kyi mar me ltar gnas pas de ring kho nar ma shi ba yang sangs rgyas kyi bka' drin yin pa la/ de chud zos la btang / mdo shor zer na de la zer/ blo nyes zer na de la zer/ rtsam khug khyes khyer dus de ring nga la lhong brdab zer ba'i rke min/ ha bo/ ha bo/ snyam du yang yang bsam la/ sang nyin ma shi bar mgo bo btegs rgyu yod na ni de 'dra byed re shi zhes dam bca' bzung / rgyu bzhi dga' tshad sobs 'dug na/ sa le/ ngas de ring sangs rgyas byung ba mnyes par bgyis so/ /de ring nga'i mgo la nyi ma shar ba la don 'bras byung ngo / /'di ltar nga rang bem gog mi mjid kyi zhing du yod kyang /bde ba can du snga skyas btegs zin te/ skyid pa'i mgo tshugs so/ /phyi'i rten 'brel la/ rgyu yungs kar gyi bzhi cha tsam las n+ya gro rnya'i 342

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1sdong po dpag tshad tsam skyes/ de bas nang gi rten 'brel shin tu 'gyur che bar gsungs pas/ dus de ring kho nar dzam gling gi rdul grangs dang mnyam pa'i lor lha dang mi'i bde ba myong ba dang / rgyal sras kyi lam bzang sgrub pa'i sa bon btab 'dug /'on kyang de rang nyid bzang ba'i she mong ma red/ sangs rgyas dang bla ma'i drin red/ rus sbal nam mkha' la 'gro ba rang shed ma red/ ngang pa'i she mong red/ da dung col chung mgo yang byas na kha nas shing lo 'chor/ de shor na 'gro sa mtho bas mi phan/ thur du lhung yong bas/sang nyin phan chad kyang dge sbyor gyi 'phro je bzang la gtong dgos snyam du 'phen pa gtong zhing / nyal ba'i 'og tu bde ba can gyi snod bcud la sems gtad de gnyid log /de ltar byas na rim gyis dge ba'i bag chags shugs ji cher 'phel ba'i rtags su rmi lam na yang zhing bkod dran pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa sna tshogs rmi ba sogs 'ong /de nas kyang sgom 'phro rlung la ma bskur na/nges par phyi ma'i tshe la bde ba can du rnam 'dren 'od dpag med kyis rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'ang dge tshul nges legs kyi nan ngor bstan pa'i nyi mas sha zin spu zin bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ //yang/ /dge tshul ye shes bzang po nas zhal gdams nyung ngu 343

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/bris shig zer/ khyod kyis na ning mi nyag dge slong las klong snying sngon 'gro'i khrid yig tshig 'grel e shes bltas 'dug pa shin tu go bcad/ da dung yang de dus kyi tshig rgum tsho brjed du mi 'jug par bshar sbyang btang / 'di tsho rang rgyud la e khel re lta dgos snyam pa'i dran 'dun bslab na/ de las lhag pa'i zhal gdams ci yang med/ la las zhal gdams dgos zer/ en re bris nas byin tsa na yig nyob cig gi nang du bcug /don bsam rgyu ma dgos/ tshig ci yod tsam yang ma bltas par/ shing mda' sgro med nags su 'phang ba lta du sha stag mthong / de 'dra bris nas ci byed/ bris shig zer nas kyang ci byed/ gang ltar yang 'phral du lag sner babs tshod cig 'bri na/ khams gsum 'khor ba zer rgyu 'di zo chun gyi 'khrul 'khor ltar ngang gis thur du 'gro zhing / gyen du 'bad pa du mas kyang 'phen dka' bas shin tu skyo ba'i gnas shig yin par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ de'i tshod ka dang sbyar na khyod kyang dal rten gtsang ma thob/ byis pa'i dus nas chos sgor 'jug rgyu'i rtsis bting / rim gyis mkhan slob kyi drung du bstan la rab tu byung / gdams ngag kyang ci rigs thob pas da sngon yar la song ba'i lugs yin/ da phyin chad yar mar gar 'gro rang nyid la thug pa yin te/ rgya cher rol pa las/ gzhan gyis gleng ba'i skabs ni ma 344

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dbye bar/ bdag ni rtag tu sgrim te 'bad par byos/ /la las byas shing sbyin pa yod ma yin/ /ma byas par yang 'grub par 'gyur ba med/ /ces gsungs pa 'di bden pa'i bka' gzhan du mi 'gyur ba yin/ des na da lha rga rgas rnams kyis ban gzhon tsho la kha ta byed tsa na/ khyed tsho bya khang 'og tu bcug pa'i lta lugs 'dra ba byed dgos/ khyi khang thog tu phud pa 'dra ba byed mi nyan zer/ de'i don 'di 'dra yin/ bya khang pa gting ring gi nang du tshud na/ steng na gos gdang sogs 'phur sa gar yod bltas nas skad cig kyang sdod mi tshugs par de'i steng du 'phur nas 'gro zhing / de tsam gyis kyang chos shes mi byed par/ da dung steng na gnam skar sogs gar yod bltas te/ ji srid phyi rol gyi gnam la 'phur sa rnyed kyi bar du steng nas steng du lta zhing ngal bso med par e thar kho na byed pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du rab tu byung nas ci byed dang 'di sgrub kyi 'dun ma sna gcig med par/ nyar re nyor re'i ngang la mi tshe bskyal ba ma yin par chos tshig re re tsam yang e zin dang /bslab bya re re tsam yang e shes bltas/ che shes chung shes mkho med du g.yug nas mi btang bar gces spras chen pos zhib tu bsam/rgyud la bsre/ dad pa sbyang / smon lam tshun chad btab/ de tsam gyis chog shes kyang mi byed par gong nas gong du blo skyed ci thon la ngal 346

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/bso med par 'bad na/ rim gyis blo kha je mtho/ rgyud je bzang /yon tan je 'phel la 'gro/ khyi ni khang pa rtsag rim mang po can gyi steng du bzhag na bag mi phebs shing brtse ṭa gnyis pa'i ('og ma'i)thog tu mar mchong grabs kyis brel 'tshub zang zing byed/ der mchong ba na de las kyang dma' ba'i brtse ṭa gsum pa sogs 'og nas 'og tu ji srid thang la ma thug par lceb cing 'gro ba yin/dpe de ltar las 'phro ngan pa'i mi rnams bka'i lha gral du bzhag kyang / chos kyi so nam la mi lta bar/ chags sdang sgom/ 'chal gtam gyi ngang la mgo 'khor/ dmu rgod bag med kyi kun spyod kho nas dus 'da'/ rim gyis je thur song ste/ tshong dran/ gyod rmo/ g.yo sgyu khram gsum la slob gnyer byas/ pho skya mo nyog gi dkyil du bsdad/ bud med dang lhan cig rtse dgod dang btsog gtam gtong / nyin mtshan kun tu bud med dran/ de nas rim gyis tshangs spyod kyi brtul zhugs mgo zhabs log /ska ra ṭa ser po/ rgos 'jol bcing /skya ser gang yin ngos mi zin pa byas/ de bas kyang sdom sems kyi lhag ma zad de/ be'u mchu rtol mchu tshun chad bcing / phru gu mang pos mtha' 'khor/ lus ma brjes bzhin du yi dwags kyi 'gro bar song ba de 'ong / de dag kyang zhib tu phye na/ bya khang pa'i 'og nas steng du dur gyis 'phur ba la/ mig yar la gtad nas mtho nas 346

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1— mtho ba'i phyogs su 'phur 'dod pa'i blo de nges par sngon du 'gro dgos pa bzhin/ chos mthun gyi spyod pa ji bas dze bzang du 'gro ba la/ dam pa'i rnam thar dang mdzad srol gang shes kyi rjes bzhin bltas nas de 'dra'i rjes ci zin bya snyam pa dang / tshe 'di bas phyi ma/ de bas kyang phyi ma'i phyi ma sogs je skyid ji bzang du 'gro ba'i thabs kho na la rem dgos snyam pa'i zhe bcad brtan po zhig nges par yod dgos/ khye khang steng du phyin pa ltar spyod pa mar mar gzhol ba rnams kyang / bsam pa la ma shar bar spyod pa thur du shor ba min/ sha sbrang me tog gi dri la mi 'khor bar sha rul gyi dri ngan la chags pa dang / kha ta bu ram gyi la du bsgyur nas bshang khang nyul ba ltar ma rabs kyi sems ngan ngo tsha bor ba'i ngan spyod la dga' zhing / tshe phyi mar bde ba'i thabs rnams kha rje bsod nams kyis ma 'chun nas yid ches don gnyer med pas lan no/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma da res 'chug mi rung snyam pa'i zhe bcad snga ma 'dra ba zhig yod na/ lan re nyes spyod kyi dbang du song yang de ma thag dran pa rnyed nas phyir bcos kyi thabs kyis ltung ba las ldang ste/bya sa la babs kyang myur du gnam la 'phur ba ltar go 'phang mthon por 'gro ba la tshegs med par shes par bya'o/ /de dag ni bstan bcos yin la/ bstan bcos ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul 347

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'khum/bshad pa ni/ chags med rin po ches/ lag pa na yang 'bad nas bris/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//dge'o////pa / /lags dam pa'i chos gsha' ma zhig mdzad na 'di bzhin 'tshal te/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba ji ltar bsgrub kyang snying po rdul tsam yang med pas so nam gyi khur po phogs/ zas nor gyi 'byor pa ri rab tsam yod kyang ngoms pa dang chog shes spu rtse tsam yang med pas gsog bsrung sga brel do skyur/ rnam g.yeng gi bya ba bskal chen 'bum du bsgrub kyang zin pa dang tshim pa til 'bru tsam yang med pas chos brgyad kyi bgyi ba thongs/ gnyen grogs kyi kha 'dzin la bskal par 'bad kyang 'grub pa dang tshar phyin pa chu thigs tsam yang med pas mdza' bshes kyi zhen pa bor/ da lta longs spyod la chags pa/ zas gos la gsog 'jog /'di snang la zhen sred/ srid sde la dga' gdung sogs 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba ci 'dra zhig bsgrub kyang 'chi ba'i tshe cung zad tsam yang rjes su mi 'brang / dam pa'i chos gcig pu ma gtogs sus kyang skyob mi nus par thams cad kyis glas la bor te 'gro ba na sems pham pa zhig yong / 'jig rten gyi las thabs ji ltar mkhas kyang 'chi bdag gshin rje la ni mi thabs byed rgyu med/ btsan po stobs rtsal can ji lta bu zhig yin kyang 'chi bdag gi g.yul ngo bzlog mkhan 3 8

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ni ye mi 'dug /phyug po mnga' thang can ji ltar yin kyang gshin rje 'chi bdag gi rgyal po la lkog zas ni mi 'phrod/ da lha skyid po'i gnas khang na 'dug /bde ba'i mal na nyal/ zhim po'i zas za/mngar po'i skom 'thung / dron po'i gos lhon/ 'khor 'bangs du ma bcas te lha g.yag zhol mo 'gying ba bzhin/ brjid mer re/ snum chil le/ gzi 'od lam lam du 'dug kyang sgren mo lag pa stong par 'jig rten pha rol tu song ste/ ro sngo sgog ge/ gdong skya lam me/mgo sa kha le spo tho zhig sngas la bzhag kha phor de sngas mgor spubs nas mi rtag sgyu lus kyi khang pa shul du bzhag ste/ gcig pu sa tshugs med pa'i phyogs su 'gro ba na dam pa'i chos ma gtogs pa gling dang skyabs su zhig yod/ da lo bla ma yin zer gyi lang rgyan gyis brgyan pa la zhon/ nges med kyi yul du gdul bya'i don du phebs zer/ dar kha'i mdud pa bor nas byin rten du 'gyed/ hūṃ re gsung nas rta re/ phaṭa re byas nas mdzo re len gyin yon bdag gyi sgo drung 'grim/ mi klad med tshos zhabs pad btegs tsa na thugs rgyal cher song / dngul rgyab khur mang po sgrom bur bsags kyin bsags kyin sku tshe thams cad chos brgyad la dril te mya ngan las 'das pa'i tha snyad brjod pa na thugs gad che ba'i dpal 'byor la brtse bar dgongs te gser zhwa rta ber gyi bdag nyid chen 349

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/po mthu ldan dregs pa'i skur bzhengs pa la ltos/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la zhen pa'i 'bras rtags mi shes pa kha med du gda'/ rtogs ldan rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yin zer/ rgyal khams phyogs med du 'grim/ sbyin bdag shin tu mang / mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul chen por ston/ lta stangs nam mkha' la sgril/ dad zas dang 'bul nor brag phug tu bsags nas/ skru tshe btang ma thag grong nyul myur mgyogs can du 'gro ba la ltos/ chos brgyad dbang che ba'i rtags mtshan ci'i phyir mi mthong / da tshul de legs par bsams nas tshe 'di blos btang / gyong lto gos gtam gsum la skur/ dgra gnya' reng du btang / zhing tha reng du bzhag nas/ mthon po'i ngo dga'/dma' mo'i skyong bran/ mnyam po'i kha 'dzin thams cad cham gyis bzhag ste/ mi med kyi lung stong skam por song la sdod cig /lung stong skam po na 'dul rgyu'i dgra mi 'dug /bskyang rgyu'i gnyen mi 'dug /ljon shing dang brag ris ni 'gras mi gsog /bya dang ri dwags kyis ni 'gras mi gsog rtsa ljang dang chu klung gis ni 'gras mi bsog na ci'i phyir mi bde/ bya dang ri dwags ni 'grogs na bde ba lags te/ gtam gyi lan 'jal mi dgos/ mgu 'khang dang chags sdang mi dgos/ snga dro mdza' bor yod bzhin du phyi dro dgrar sdang ba'i byis pa dang mi 'dra/ bya dang ri dwags ni grogs bzang po 360

zhal gdams phyogs ba bsdus/ pod 1lags te/ zas bgo dang nor bgo mi dgos/ ngo bsrung dang yus che mi yong / phan pa brgya 'jal ba gnod pa gcig gis 'joms pa'i byis pa dang mi 'dra/ bya dang ri dwags ni chos mthun gyi grogs po lags te/ 'dus nas so sor gyes te 'dus mtha' 'bral lo zhes brda ston/ gang byung de nyid du spyod pas gsog 'jog spongs shig ces gtam 'doms/ gza' gtad med par rgyu bas nges med 'grims shig ces bskul ma 'debs/ 'jig rten byu bya ba bsgrub nas 'khor ba mtha' med du 'grim du 'jug pa'i byis pa dang mi 'dra/ bya dang ri dwags ni gegs med kyi grogs po lags te/chags pa dang mdza' bor bdag bzung mi byed/ 'khon pa dang khros pa'i zhe 'gras mi 'grem/ 'dug na sne btog /song na gegs byed pa'i byis pa dang mi 'dra/ mdor bsdu na sna thas rang mgo la gzad de/ rdo ba dang shing los gang ba'i sa phyogs su chu dang lo ma'i 'tsho ba la bsten pa zhig bka' drin mi chung bar ci nas kyang zhu zhu zhu mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen rem rem rem// //ra / /lar ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bstan pa sde snod rin po che 'di go bar bya ba'i chos yin/ 'dris par bya ba'i gzhung yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag la bslab na thams cad gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu tshogs 'phel ba dang mos pa sna tshogs 361

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa'i sems can gyi khams smin pa'i thabs la mkhas par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang deng sang gi slob gnyer mkhan po kha cig ni ci tsam du thos pa mang ba de tsam du khengs pas dregs te/ da ni mang du thos pa gzhung lugs shes pa/ sde snod la mkhas pa'o zhes rtog cing / gang zag gzhan thos pa ma bsags pa dag mthong ba na'ang 'di dag ni blun pa rtul ba bus pa glen pa mi mkhas pa yin no zhes khyad du gsod la/ mkhas pa gzhan dag gi gzhung lugs shig bklag kyang dam pa'i chos la gus shing don du gnyer ba med bzhin du dang po glegs thag dkrol dus nas 'di'i nang na ga 'dra zhig yod/ ci 'dra zhig bris 'dug ang snyam nas mtshar ltas kyi 'du shes bzhag ste/ rig pa rtsa mgo la bkram/ mdzub rtse gdong nyag la btsugs/ mgo la sgri lang ste/ che ge mo zhig zer na tshad ma'i gzhung dang mi 'grigs/ ga ge mo zhig 'dod na mngon pa dang mi mthun/ cig le zhig khas blang na rigs pa 'di 'dra zhig gis gnod 'dug ces dpyad dpyad nas dpe cha de bltas zin pa na bsdu rgyu bdag rgyu 'dod rgyu 'jog rgyu thams cad ci yin 'di yin med pa zhig tu song / da ga re nga rang gi rang lugs 'di 'dra zhig bzhag nas gzhan zhig dang brtsad na des 'di zer yong / de la 'di zer dgos/ des lan 'di 'debs yong / de la ci drag 362

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ zad 1bsam nas bsdad dus nyin blo mi bde/ mtshan gnyid mi yong /gal te gnyid zhig byung yang rmi lam tshor de 'dra de dag kho na rmis rmis nas tho rangs sad 'ong dus kyang yid ma bde sing sing 'gro/lam zab mo byang chub kyi sems dang snying rje'i sgom rim lta bu re 'dug na de go sba a'u tsi snyam nas sgyur/ rtog ge'i gzhung phran re mthong na/ 'o 'o de ka la gcig blta dgos zer nas kha phyes/ de ma thag shes pa hur phyung ste/ ga re de don ldog red dam/ bzhi ldog zhig red/ dgag pa zhig red dam/ sgrub pa zhig red dam/ 'di khyab pa grub bam/ 'gal ba 'du'am zhes dran rtog gi spu ris bris bris nas phyi dro tsa na snying phyod phyod glo ba tig tig por 'gro/sangs rgyas kyi ldog pa dang sems can gyi rdzas spyi la gtad 'dug sa nas dad paXdang nges 'byung gi blo sna thams cad je chung je 'grib tu song / 'chi tsa na thos tshad tshig ro/ dpyad tshad stong 'dang / bltas tshad chud zos su gron pa'i rdzun rkub de dud/gzugs shes ldan min 'du byed brtsis shing dpyad tshad po thams cad nun nag nang du rdo 'phang ba ltar gyur te rjen cer re phebs yong / legs par bsam na rigs lam 'dis log rtog bzlog dgos par 'dug /de bzlog nas rang nyid yang dag pa'i lam la 'jug dgos par 'dug /der zhugs nas rnam par grol ba'i ye 363

pod 1 rdo grubs 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shes mngon du byed dgos par 'dug /chos mang du thos pa zhes bya ba mang po zhig nyan pa tsam la mi 'jug /thos pa gang zhig la brten nas khams gsum la skyo bar 'gyur ba de nyid mang du thos pa yin zhes chos mngon pa las bshad pas/ tshig gi 'dzin mtshams phran phrin re shes pas mkhas par smra ba 'di'ang brtag dgos/ sgyu ma mkhan bzang pos zhus pa'i mdor/ chos thos nas rang gis nyams su len pa dang / gzhan la legs par bshad pas phan 'dogs pa gnyis thos pa mang ba'i snying po yin zhes bstan pas/ don 'bras 'di dag mi len bzhin du tshur mthong gi rigs lam gyong po 'ga' zhig gis mkhas pa'i rnam thar skyong bar rlom pa 'di'ang dpyad dgos/ nged kyi slob gnyer 'di srin bu pad+ma'i rjes shul gyi chu tsam las med kyang rnam thar 'di tsho la nyams myong re yod pas gzhan 'ga' la'ang 'dra'am snyam nas sprang sbyon 'jigs med pas sbyo gtam byas pa'o// //pa //lags/ bdag cag gi ston pa stobs bcu'i dbang phyug nyid kyis kyang slob pa'i lam gyi gnas skabs na brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pas legs par btsal ba'i chos ni phrad par dka' ba lags te/ brgya lam na me tog u dum wā ra skye ba bzhin no/ /de'i phyir khyod kyis 'khor lo chen po bzhi dang ldan pa'i lus rten 'di 364

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1lta bu rnyed pa na dam pa'i chos la don du gnyer ba shugs drag po lhur blang ste/ mang du thos pa'i yon tan gyis mi ngoms par bung ba rnams pad+ma dag las sbrang rtsi len pa bzhin yang dang yang du thos pa rin po che tshol ba ni ngo mtshar to/ /'on kyang thos pa ji ltar bsags kyang de 'dod chags dang 'bral ba dang / zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung po la mngon par skyo ba'i rgyur ma gyur na de la ni mang du thos par mi gdags so zhes chos mngon pa la sogs pa las bstan pa yin pas thos pa'i chos la dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rigs pa yang dag gi lam nas nges shes bskyed cing / nges shes gang la 'drongs pa'i don de sgom pa'i phyir tshe 'di blos thongs/chos brgyad rdog pas non la mi med kyi lung stong du zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgrubs shig /tshe 'di blos btang bar ston pa'i sbad du rgod sna yu ma byas te bya bral gyi ltar snang ling ling ling byed pa rgyal khams na mang mod kyi/ snying nas 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad lam kha'i ro bzhin du 'bor nus pa de nyin mo'i skar ma ltar 'dug pa dgongs chub ltar lags/ de'i phyir khyod kyis dal rten rnyed par dka' lugs/ rnyed na phan pa che lugs/ tshe la rtag pa med lugs/'chi bdag zlog thabs bral lugs/ shi tshe dam pa'i chos ma gtogs pa longs spyod dang nye dus skyob mi nus par rang nyid 366

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba/cig pur sa tshugs med pa'i phyogs su 'gro lugs la bsam blo btang ste/ dam pa'i chos 'ba' zhig la blo sna gtad de/ sha dang rus pa'i ri bo bsnyil thub pa/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho skam nus pa zhig dgos/ dam pa'i chos zhes bya ba nyams su ji ltar len na/dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa nas theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po'i bar gyi gzhung lam thams cad 'gal med lam gyi cha rkyen gcib tu rtogs te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sangs rgyas su lha ba'i mos gus gzhir bzung / 'khor ba sdug bsngal du shes te thar 'dod kyi blo sngon du btang / bslu med gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum kho na la 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i dpung gnyen du skyabs tshol/ 'gro drug mar shes shing sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi seng ge'i sgra chen po 'jig rten du bsgrag par bya'o zhes byang chub kyi sems rin po che la dran pa mngon du bzhag ste/ bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi rjes su slob nus pa zhig byung na khyod 'dun ma legs pa'i rtse mor byon pa lags/ gtam du bya ba thor bu yang dga' zhig bya bar bdag spobs te/ gang zhig shing rta chen po'i gzhung lugs la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa'i bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis kyang chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par bye zhing dam pa'i chos las ring ba rnams la brgal brtag mdzad pa 356

zha gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1na'ang rtog ge bas ni chos spong ngo zhes skye bo blun po noms kyis sdang zhing speng bar byed na rang cag lta ci smos/ de'i phyir khyod sgrim la gzhan sun 'byin ma smra zhig /don du mi 'gyur gyi chags sdang gi gzhir 'gyur ta re/ gzhan yang bdag gis 'di bya'am mi bya na'ang legs so zhes las kyi mtha' sna tshogs sgrub par 'dod nas blo gcig tu mi tshugs pa ni skyes bu brtan pa rnams kyi tshul ma yin gyi/ blo ri rab bzhin du brtan pas rigs pa'i bya ba 'ba' zhig las mi 'da' ba zhig dgos pa lags/ zhes sprang spyon 'jigs med pas rang nyid la yon tan spu nyag tsam yang med pas don mthun gyi bsdu ba dang mi ldan par rig cing shes bzhin du chos grogs dharma'i ming can gyi ngo mi ldog tsam du bris pa'o// //ma / /rnal 'byor pas sgrol ba'i las byed pa la/ dang po chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi gnas lugs lta bas gtan la phab/ sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis goms par byas nas rnam par rtog pa'i srog rang bzhin skye ba med pa'i dbyings su gcod pa ni rtogs pas bdag bsgral ba zhes bya ba yin te/ gsang ba snying po las/ thog mar bdag nyid rtogs goms bsgral/ /de nas gnyis med blo yis ni/ /blo ngan sems can snying re rje/ /gnyis su med par bsgral bar bya'o/ /zhes so/ /thugs rjes gzhan sgrol ba ni/ dgra bo 'dis nga la 367

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga nga gnod pa 'di byas/ nga'i yon bdag la gnod pa 'di byas snyam nas dgra la zhe sdang dang sbyin bdag la chags pa skyes nas dgra 'di bsgral dgos snyam na chags sdang 'khor ba'i rgyu yin pa mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs yod mod/ des na sems can thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yin pa la rang ngo rang gis ma shes par nga med la nga ru bzung / bdag med la bdag tu bzung nas mtha' med 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ gang dag zhi bas mi 'dul ba dag la bdag gis mngon spyod drag pos bsgral nas sangs rgyas thob pa zhig ci nas kyang bya snyam pa'i snying rje byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslang ba zhig ci nas sa/la che/ de ni don gyi sems zer ba yin/ stongs kyi sems ni las la sbyor tshe khro zhing gtum pa'i sems dang ldan pas bdag mdun gyi lha thams cad sku mdog nag po rab tu khro ba drag po'i las la rngams pa'i tshul du bskyed de/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas pho nya phyag rgya bzhi'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi rgyud kyi ngar 'dzin gyi dgra bo dang khyad par du dmigs bya gang yin pa de snying rje'i lcags kyus snying nas drangs/byams pa'i zhags pas ske nas bcing / dga' ba'i lcags sgrog bis yan lag bsdam/ btang snyoms kyi dril bus dbang po myos 368

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma par byas te liṅga la phye mar chu blug pa bzhin thim pas ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad dang ldan pas bkug rjes/ bsgral ba dngos la babs tshe/ rang dpal chen po/ sgrol phur badz+ra tī la ya/ dmigs bya zhing bcu tshang ba dngos su gsal te phur pa kho'i snying gar dril bas tshe bsod nams thams cad dri ljang gu'i rnam par bdag la thim pas bdag 'tsheng / bsgral bya'i rnam shes a dkar po'i rnam pa de rang gi shangs bug nas drangs sku'i dbyibs brgyud yum gyi mkha' la babs hūṃ yig tu gyur sdig sgrib thams cad das nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par mkha' nas thon zla dkyil la gnas pa rlung gis btegs nas 'og min du phaṭa kyis 'phang bas rgyal ba'i sras su kyur te sangs rgyas pas dgra 'tsheng/ rnam smin gyi lus ye shes kyi mtshon chas gtubs te sha khrag ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs te lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstabs pas lha 'tsheng ste 'tsheng ba gsum dang / bdag dpal chen por gsal bas log pa'i skyon bsal/ phur ba sras mchog khri la yar gsal bas rdug pa'i skyon bsal/ dmigs bya zhing bcu tshang ba dngos su gsal bas 'byam pa'i skyon bsal ba'o/ /de lta bu'i dgongs pa dang ldan na sngags pa phur so'i kha nas 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams ngag yin te/phur pa zhe sdang khros pa'i rgyud las/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshis 369

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ /phung po rdo rjer gtams byas nas/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /de ltar ma yin par lha rang rgyud du bzung / sngags log par bgrangs/rang phyogs la chags/ gzhan phyogs la sdang / chags sdang gnyis las ma 'das pa'i lha drag po zhig gzhan na yod par bzung / de 'grub tu re nas drag sngags mang po bgrang / 'dre bgegs la zhe sdang drag po bskyed nas hūṃ sgra dang phaṭa sgras lung pa bkang nas mig sdang mig bsgrad kyang 'dre sems kyi rnam rtog gi rtsal yin par ma shes na/ 'dre zhe sdang gi rang gzugs la zhe sdang ba bskyed na me 'bar ba'i steng du shing bsnan pa dang 'dra bas/ sba rgyab dang gnas brtan nu ge'i rnam thar dran dgos so/ /'dre snying rjes 'dul dgos te/ lha bskyed dang sngags bzla shes pa'i 'dre mang po mthong chos su grub ste/ snying rje can gyi 'dre mi srid do/ /des na lha khro bo yang zhi bas zhe sdang langs te khro bo'i snyur bzhengs pa ni min mod/ nyan thos rnams la'ang zhe sdang med na sangs rgyas la lta ci smos/ de'i phyir na bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab lha sku'i phyag rgyar snang ba las/ gzhan na khro bo zhes kha gdangs mig bsgrad nas rgyun du khros yod pa'i rang mtshan pa zhig yod pa rgyud sde gang na'ang ma bshad de/ zhi ba rang rgyud du 360

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bzung na 'dod khams kyi lha dang / khro bo rang rgyud du bzung na las kyi gshin rjer skye bar gsung pas/ deng sang grong chog pa rnams kyi mtha' gyen du mi 'gro ba ni/ lha dang 'dre gzhan du bzung nas/ sbyin bdag la chags/ 'dre la sdang nas rgyal ba'i bka' chags sdang gis bslad nas rang gzhan gnyis ka gnas skabs rgyal 'gong dang / mthar dmyal ba'i rgyu bsgrub pa 'dis lan pa yin/ de min na zhi ba'i dbang bskur ba dang / drag po'i mnan bsreg 'phang gsum byed pa gnyis ka snang tshul mi mthun yang /don la dmigs bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing gnas spar ba la khyad med pas dbang bskur ba la bzang po dang / mnan bsreg 'phang gsum ngan par bzung na sangs rgyas kyi chos la lar bzang bar 'du shes la lar ngan par 'du shes na chos spong gi las yin pas gnad shes pa gal che zhing / khyad par mnan bsreg 'phang gsum gang gi tshe na'ang / rang rgyud chags sdang gis bslad de rgyal ngan du skye ba'i rgyu mi bsags par byams snying rje byang chub sems kyis zin pa zhig gal po che'i gnad dam pa yin pas grong chog pa dag gis thugs la zhog /rem rem/ sku mkhyen gsung mkhyen thugs mkhyen/zhes pa 'di ni grong chog pa mi tshe stong zad mkhan rnams la phan pa'i blos a rje ming gis bris pa ste/ thog mtha' bar du dbe'o////361

pod 1 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga ba / /shar rgyal mo rong ba 'jigs med ye shes la yig 'dzar phul ba/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam ma nor ba de brgyud ldan gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten dgos pas bsags sbyang spel gsum gyi gnad 'dus pa bla rnam la 'bad pa gal che/ de nas o rgyan pad+ma dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres la/ bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog gang gis kyang ma bslad cing spang blang dgag sgrub kyi rtsol bas ma gos pa'i gshis rang babs kyi rig cha rjen pa de shes par byas te/ phyi'i yul snang mi snang dang / nang rnam rtog 'char mi 'char sogs la rjes 'ded rtsis 'debs gang yang mi bya bar/rig pa zang thal gyi ngang las ma g.yos pa la bslab/ cung zad yengs grabs byed tshe yang / nga yengs 'gro'am zhes dang / 'di ltar yengs 'dug ces dang / mi yengs pa'i phyir du gnyen po ji ltar bsten na drag ces sogs tsab tsub zeng zeng gtan nas mi byed par rig pa de ka hur phyung la gshis thog tu sa bzung /mdor na ngo sprod gegs sel bo ṭa 'don thams cad kha kha so so mang po mi dbos/ da lta'i rig pa ngo bo mi rtog pa/ gdangs ma 'gags pa/ rtsal phyogs med du 'char ba nyams su myong yang brjod mi shes pa de ka'i rang 'gros bzo med du skyong bas chog par gsungs yod pas thugs la zungs mdzod/ nga rang nad ros 36 2

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mnar nas zhal gdams bslab ston zer ba'i za zi'i rigs ci yang 'bri long med kyang khyed thag ring nas 'ong ba sha tsha nas glen gtam yig nag tu phab ste byin pa dge bar gyur cig/ // ra / /lags/ tshig gi sbyor ba dam pos bsnyad na go bar dka' bas grong tshig kho nas phan pa'i gtam bya ba la/ mang po zhig zhu mi nus mod/ don la/ de rang gshin rje 'chi bdag gi rgyal po slebs te/ srog gi rgyu ba phra mo ni bcad/ che'i 'du byed kyi rgyu ba ni 'gags/ dbus sa me stag lha bu ni yar te/ gces par bskyangs ba'i lus ni shul du bzhag /brtse bas 'grogs pa'i grogs ni rjes su mi 'brang / tshe gang bsags pa'i longs spyod ni gtan 'jog tu song / bar do'i snang ba mang po mtshan mo'i skar ma bzhin du snang ste 'jigs pa'i mun nag chen po la 'jug /snyug bsngal gyi 'phrang gzar mo la bshar/ las ngan gyi rang rtags mang po phyir shar tsa na sos dal du 'dug rgyu yod pa e gda'/ deng sang 'chi ba yong zer rung / tshe mi rtag zer rung / don du snga dro chos nyan pa dang bshad pa la bsam gyin phyi dro tshe 'di'i 'dug chus la ling ling byed lugs la 'chi ba dran yod pa mi 'dug pa dngos gsal red mod/da sngar song de tshar thal ba lags kyang phyin chad nam yar lang dus mun thur rub dus thams cad du 'chi ba 'ong dus mi 'gyod 363

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa zhig ci drag snyam du thugs la 'jog thub pa ma 'chug rem rem rem/ skad cha lab dus/ rgyu 'grul byed dus/ gshang gci 'dor dus/ kha zas za dus nam yin kyang 'dir snang gi bya ba la skyug log pas blo skyo thibs se yod pa zhig dkos pa lags/ dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa bya ba gzhan na ci yod/ dkon mchog gsum la dad pa skad cig ma gcig skyes kyang / snying rje til 'bru tsam blo la shar yang dam pa'i chos yin/ dam pa'i lam ci 'grub zhig ma byas na da res kyi thod rus sa la bzhag phan chad ni mi lus rta brun 'thor 'thor du 'ong rgyu med do//nyid gnyer khang du phebs la dbyar kha sha rul dum dum re'i 'khris su chags pa'i sha 'bu ci tsam yod gzigs dang ngan 'gro dang mi lus la mang nyung yod pa mkhyen sga bar 'dug /shing kha shog lce'i dpe ltar thar lam yang dag gis ma zin pa'i bzlas brjod shab shub dang / tshe 'di don ba nyer gyi nad ro khong du bsnyal nas ltar snang gi sgom sgrub byed lo de 'dras ga 'dra yong ba/ da legs par bsam blo thongs la dam pa'i chos kyis dus 'da' ba zhig la blo thag rbad kyis bcad/ zog po brdzus ma'i sangs rgyas la yid ma gtod/ mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags la skyabs ma 'tshol/ sdig grogs byis pa'i skye bo la gros ma 'dri/ bslu med kyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la blo snying brang gsum gtod/ bla 364

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma la sangs rgyas su blta ba'i mos gus ma brjed/ skyes bu dam pa la skrur ba ma 'debs/ gnyen gyi kha 'dzin la shi spar ma 'tham/dgras gnod pa bskyal ba'i sdug yus sems thog tu ma len/gzhan kyis tshig brlangs po zher 'debs pa 'dra mo zhig byung tshe 'dis nga la ci'i phyir ngan smras byed ces snying gi dbus su lhang lhang 'char tsa na phung byed kyi 'gong po slebs byung / 'dis nga lhod la gtug go zhes brang brdung la gnyen po'i ye shes dan dan 'byung ba zhig dgos/ nor gsog skrun dang mdza' bshes kyi ngo srung la rem rgyu de dang / gzhan phyogs la sems 'khu ba de tsho chags sdang gi rab tu bye ba lags te/ nyon mongs kyi zhabs phyi nus pa yin/ nyon mongs kyi zhabs tog bsgrub na ci sdug 'di sdug med pa zhig yong ste/ 'khor ba thog med nas nyon mongs kyi g.yog byas pas da lta zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po'i rang bzhin can gyi 'khor ba na 'u cag sdug tsum me lus yod rgyu 'di e gzigs/ deng phan chad nyon mongs dgrar bltas/ gnod byed kyi mi la gnyen du bzung / rang re'i rgyab na shig gis zos tshe a tsa 'dre shig rnams zer zhing mi bzod na sdug bsngal dos chen po rnams lta yang ci smos/de bzhin du sems can gzhan rnams kyang bde ba 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sha stag ste/ byis pa rnams kyi kha sgrung du/ skyid 366

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lhag lhag sbug tsum tsum zer ba ltar/ sdug bsngal phra mo re byung yang blo ma bde sing sing 'gro ba 'ba' zhig yin tshul blo thog tu longs la bsam pa bzang po e 'ong ltos/ 'di ma brjed/ 'di ma brjed/'di ma brjed/ sku tshe ring / zhes sprang po 'jigs med pas dge rgan dpal dge'i bzhed skong du bris pa lags// //ra / /ji skad du/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten phan pa drang srong che/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya lam 'byung srid tsam/ /da lta dal 'byor dam pa rnyed pa la/ /gang dag thar 'dod bag med spang bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten la phan par bzhed pa don bzhed pa rnams ni me tog u du wa ra bzhin du 'byung bar dka'/ de'i bstan pa dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i gzhung ni 'phrad par dka'/ de'i lam srid pa zlog byed kyi thabs yang dag pa ni rnyed par dka'/ dal ba phun sum tshogs pa'i lus rten ni 'thob par dka' ba lags te/ nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin no/ /mi lus la'ang rnam grangs mang mod de gang dam pa'i chos las 'jig rten gces par 'dzin pa/ 'jig rten pha rol las tshe 'di gtso bor 'dzin pa/ dam pa'i brtul zhugs las kha na ma tho ba lhur len pa/ yang dag pa'i lam bzang dur khrod kyi mi ro nag po bzhin du 366

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'dor ba rnams ni mi lus byur po che zhes bya ste/ khyod de'i grangs su ma 'dug cig yun ring por rmas ta re/ gang mi dge ba'i las kyi lam mtha' dag sdom zhing / dge ba'i chos la dran pa mngon du 'jog la/ dbang po'i sgo mtha' dag dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis bsdams te/ dul zhing nges pa'i tshul las 'da' bar mi byed na/de niXmi lus rin po che zhes bya ste/ khyed kyis de'i ngang tshul zungs shig dang / khyod drang srong gi rgyal mtshan can du 'gyur ro/ /khyod skye bo mnga' thang can du song ste/ chen po'i mdun gros la dbang ba/lugs kyi bya bzhag la mkhas pa/ 'byor ba'i gsog bskrun la byang ba/ dgra'i 'dul thabs shes pa/ gnyen gyi skyongs lugs rig pa/kha mchu'i sgyu thabs rtogs pa/ che dgu'i mi grwal na slebs par gyur kyang / des khyed kyi dal rten don yod du grub pa ma lags/ tshe rabs kyi 'dug chus grub pa ma lags/ ngan 'gro'i sgo 'phar bcad pa ma lags/ thar pa'i sgo mo che phyes pa ma lags te mya ngan gyi mchi ma bku ba'i ltas ngan shar ba lags so/ /gal te khyod stobs chen gyi lha gral du son te/ skye bos mchod gnas byed pa/dad zas sprin lhar 'du ba/ snyan grags rnga ltar ldir ba/ gson po'i skyabs 'jug gnang ba/ gshin po'i skra rtags len pa/ 'bul nor gyis ri lung 'geng ba/ sbyin bdag gis sa steng khyab par gyur 367

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyang / des khyod la bdag nyid chen po rnams mi bsngags mi bstod mngon par mi bkur/ rjes su yi rang bar mi mdzad de/ khyod rang nyid yun ring po ro myag gi 'dam rdzab dang / chu bo rab med par 'o dod 'bod pa'i sta gon snang ba yin te drang por smras pa yin no/ /de lha bas na khyod kyis dal 'byor rnyed par dka' lugs/ tshe srog rtag pa med lugs/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin lugs/'jig rten bya ba la yid brtan med lugs la bsam blo btang ste tshe 'di blos thongs/ nam 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad lam kha'i ro bzhin du 'bor nus pa de'i tshe khyod kyis rgyal ba gong ma'i rjes shul zin pa yin/ skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar 'khyodas pa yin/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang nye drung na 'dug par gyur pa yin no//de'i phyir de nyid gzhir bzung ste/ da gdod jeg pa chen po'i lam la zhugs shig theg pa chen po'i lam zhes bya ba khur du 'khur ba'ang med/ khar bcug ste mid par bya ba'ang med/ kun tu nyul te btsal bar bya ba'ang gzhan med de/ chos gcig dang ldan na theg pa chen po'i lam la zhugs pa yin no/ /chos gcig gang zhe na/ lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa byang chub kyi sems te/gzhan phan don gnyer dang rdzogs byang don gnyer la bcos min gyi sbong ba thon pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa zhig go/ /de yang 'di 368

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ltar nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag srid pa'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gyi dbang gis zag pa dang bcas pa'i nyer len gyi phung po rnam pa lnga yongs su blangs te/ skye ba snga ma dang phyi ma rim par brgyud cing / sems can dmyal ba pa rnams tsha grang gi sdug bsngal gyis gdung / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa rnams bkres skom gyi reg byas rgud/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba rnams bkol spyod kyi duḥkhas gzir/ mir gyur pa rnams kyang 'tsho ba thung dur gyur pa la sogs pas nyams smad/ lha'i ris rnams kyang 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal tsam gyis sma phab ste/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi phyogs de dag dang / gzugs kyi khams kyi bsam gtan gsum pa man chad ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal kyis khyab pa yin la/ bsam gtan bzhi pa yan chad ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal tsam zhig ste/ mdor na grid pa mtha' dag la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis dam la ma bzhag pa ni ma mchis so /de ltar sdug bsngal gyi 'khrul 'khor du ltung ba'i sems can de dag 'o skol gyi mar gyur myong sha stag ste/ 'di ltar zag bcas kyi sems la thug par gyur pa'i thog ma med pa bzhin du/ lus kyi ya mtha' 'ang mi srid pa yin la/ de nyid ji lta ba bzhin du ma'i thog ma'ang srid pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag snga ma grub pas ni gtan 369

ngo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshigs phyi ma dag grub par nus mod kyi/ snga ma ni ma grub bo zhe na ma yin te/ bdag tu lta ba 'di ltar che ba/ 'di ltar stobs dang ldan pa/ 'di lhar gting zab pa/ sbyong dka' ba/ gdul dka' ba/'chos dka' bar 'dug pa 'di bdag lta snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi ma la phan btags shing nus pa cher bgos pa las byung bar rtogs so//de lta bu'i yid can rnams la phan 'dod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par 'dod pa zhig gal che/tshig 'di snying la phur cig /don 'di yid la zungs shig /'di ngas rang gi rgyud la theg pa chen po'i lam nyams su blangs nas rang gi rtogs pa bzhin du smras pa ni ma yin te/ skad cig gcig la kha nang du log ste bsam pa bzang po sbyang ba med pa dgongs gsal ltar lags mod kyi/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos smra ba rnams kyi zhal lung dang mthun par gzhon nu 'jigs med pas bris pa ste/ gtam du bya ba'i yi ge 'di shog dkar gyi ngos su dril te lteb ma 'jog /sems la len pa zhig skru tshe ring / zhes 'jigs med rab rgyas la'o// //ra / /dpal ri ba don grub rdo rje la phan pa'i gtam bya ba/'phags pa'i yul gyi shing rta chen po dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ mgo 'am gos la glo bur me shor na/ /de dag 370

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bzlog phyir bgyi ba btang nas kyang / /yang srid med par bgyi sbad 'bad 'tshal te/ de bas ches mchog dgos pa gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mi skye zhing mi rga la na ba dang 'chi ba med pa'i myang 'das mchog gi go 'phang la 'gro bar bzhed na myur po myur por sgeg mo'i mgo la me shor ba dang / sdar ma'i pang du sprul zhugs pa lhar/ dam pa'i lha chos gsha' ma ma mdzad na sang bya gnangs bya'i ngang la mi tshe zad nas/ srog ni 'grib/ shes pa ni nyams/ bem rig gi 'brel ba ni rgyun chad/ tshe 'di'i snang ba ni nub/ phyi ma'i snang ba 'char/ g.yang sa dog por zhugs/ mun pa stug por chud de ngan song gi sdug bsngal rang thog tu bab tsa na bzod brlag med de/ da lta co skra nyag ma re 'then nam 'du srin phra mo tsam zhig gis lus la zos sam me stag chung ngu tsam zhig gis lus la 'tshig kyang gdong sha'i tshugs 'chor ba'i sdug bsngal zhig 'dug na/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal lta yang ci smos/ gal te ngan song du re zhig mchis kyang sbar mi lus rnyed nas dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i skal pa can du 'gyur ro zhes ma sems shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na mi lus rin po che thob pa ni pho sgo che bas ma yin/stes dbang legs pas ma yin/ rgyu med rkyen med du ma yin par/rgyu legs par byed pa'i tshul khrims dang / rkyen smon lam bzang po 371

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/zung du 'brel ba'i mthu las yin na/ da lta rang re'i rnam thar bzhin gang byung byung / ci thod thod byas pas ga la 'ong / tshul ngan pa de lta bus ni bskal pa bye ba brgya stong mang por bde 'gro'i sgra tsam yang mi thos pa'i ngan song gi gting rdo chen por 'gyur ta re/ de lta bas na myur du nges par 'byung 'dod kyi blo shugs drag po bskyed de thar pa'i lam rnal ma la long bas glang rnga de zin zhib dgos/ thod pa bor chog ma zhig dgos/ sha dang rus pa'i ri bo bsnyil thub pa zhig dgos/ khrag dang mchil ma'i rgya mtsho skems nus pa zhig dgos/ myur du byang chub snying po'i sa mthor 'gro ba zhig dgos/ de lta bu zhig e 'ong snyam du dbongs na 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la zhen pa gting nas log pa sgyugs nad can la btso zan byin pa lta bu zhig dgos/ 'dod yon kyi snang ba la lam kha'i ro bzhin du cis kyang dgos med du shes pa zhig dgos/ rnyed bkur dang snyan grags la snying po med pa chu'i chu bur bzhin du shes pa zhig dgos/ sdig grogs kyi skyes bu ni dga' ba 'phel ba'i gnas ma yin pa gcan zan gdug pa'i khrod bzhin du shes pa zhis dkos/ gdams ngag ston pa'i bla ma ma gtogs gzhan zer gyi ngag la mi nyan pa thrun pa 'ur lang ba lha bu zhig dgos/ blo sna dkon mchog la gtod cing bsam rgyu dkon mchog las med pa 372

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rtag tu skyabs 'gro la 'bad pa zhig dgos/ lha chos kyis sems rgyud thul ba phye thug la zo mar btab pa lta bu zhig dgos/ khams bsum gyi sems can thams cad bdag gi bskyed mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas da lta'i pha ma bzhin du shes pa zhig dgos/ pha mar gyur nas kyang phan 'dogs dang gnod speng gi bya ba grangs med pas bdag nges par bskyangs pa yin pas 'gro drug drin mo cher shes pa zhig dgos/ sems can la drin gzo ba'i phyir 'gro don du sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la blo gcig tu 'dun pa bkres pa zas la gdung ba lta bu zhig dgos/ da lta bdag bde ba 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa bzhin du sems can gzhan yang phan pa 'dod la gnod pa mi 'dod par mtshungs pa shes nas rang dang gzhan srung mnyam byed pa zhig dgos/ rang dang gzhan go brjes nas sems can gces par 'dzin pa byang chub sems dpa' spre'u'i rnam thar lha bu zhig dgos/ ci byas pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi yo lang las mi 'da' bar gzhan don mig 'bras ltar srung ba zhig dgos/ gnad chen po bcu gsum dang ldan nas bla na med pa'i byang chub bde bar ma song na ngas khyod bslus par zad do/ /ci ste lus rten 'di la rnam grol mchog gi go 'phang mngon du bgyi bar 'dod cing rang bzhin theg mchog rgyal po'i don la bcos 373

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/min gyi mos gus dang ldan pas shin tu rnal 'byor gyi tshul la thugs dam mdzad na 'di bzhin 'tshal te/ mos gus srog tu bzung / sems bskyed kyis gzhi btings/ /phyi snang ba dang nang shes pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad skye med 'gags med gnas med chen por gtan la phab nas/ dngos gzhi da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa rtog pa'i bsgyur bkod dang bral zhing 'di yin gyi ngos bzung med pa rang stong blo bral chen po rang gsal mkha' mnyam yangs pa/ bde ba'i nyams la ma zhen/ gsal ba'i nyams la ma chags/ mi rtog pa'i ro la ma brkams pa'i cog bzhag rang yan chen por glod tsa na rnam rtog gi 'gyu ba ci ltar shar yang de la bdag rkyen mi sprad/ rbad chod mi bya/ rjes su mi 'brang bar lhod de 'jog /de'i tshe tshogs drug gi yul snang gang snang yang der 'dzin gyi lhad ma zhugs pa gal che/ de'ang las dang po'i skabs skad cig dang por 'di gzugs so/ /'di sgra'o zhes 'dzin shes 'jug mod kyi 'on kyang skad cig gnyis pa la 'dzin pa de nyid chu'i ri mo rang zhig bzhin du shar grol zung 'jug chen por dengs 'gro ba zhig yin/ da dung de lta khu re la dgongs pa gtad na 'od gsal snang bzhi'i lam zab las yang zab rnams phyi nas brgyud ldan bla ma'i man ngag las rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gtam 'di yal bar ma dor 374

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nyams su longs/ tshig 'di yan par ma sgyur snying la chongs/ /don 'di yi ger ma bzhag sems la zungs/ /snyeng gtam de las med do a mo gha/ zhes pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bris pa'o//// pa / /rtsis mda'i gar dbang gi mgo la gnam yig babs pa/kwa ye khyod kyis mngon mtho'i rten bzang ni rnyed nas gda' yi/dud 'gro dang shan thang 'byed ba'i las shig mi byed dam/ /tshe 'di'i bzang shos phal cher ni 'das nas gda' yis/ 'dug chas las kyang 'gro chas 'dam pa'i dus su ma slebs sam/ phan pa'i gdams ngag mang po ni thos nas gda' yi/ da ci zhig bsam nas mdzub mo kha la bcug ste 'dug /rten 'brel da res las lhag pa 'grigs thabs med kyis/ mtshams 'di las thal na ni 'gyod kyang 'phyis so/ /dam chos rang gis bor nas ma byung ba yin gyi/ bsgrub nas ma grub pa ni shes bya'i lugs na med do/ /byas na nyi ma rer yang dam chos mang du 'grub ste/ rang gis ma byas na ni tshe gcig la yang chos spyod sna gcig ji ltar 'grub/ bag chags 'jig rten gyi 'khrul pa la bsags nas/ /yar 'dren chos kyis byed lugs cang yod dam/ /skyid sdug gang byung gi re ltos 'jig rten la bcol nas/ /'chi dus dkon mchog gsum la rang 'byar du 'gro ba ni 376

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/srid dam/ /shes rgyud khyim nas ma byung na/ lus rab tu 'byung lo byas kyang rgyal po kri kri'i glang mjug skar khung la thogs pa'i rmi lam ltar mi 'gro'am/ lar ci ltar byas kyang yar la mi 'drong ba zangs rbab ri sked nas shor ba bzhin du song na/ nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par dkon mchog la shi spar 'thom dang / khong gis cis kyang mi bslu yis/ dkon mchog la shi spar 'tham pa bya ba kha'i 'don 'don mang po la mi zer/ sems dkon mchog gi phyogs su bar mtshams med par drangs pa la byed/ rang gi 'khrul pa rang gis ma brtags shing / rang gi mgo 'don rang gis ma byas na/ /rta na so brgyad pa'i kha lo gzhan sus 'dul/ zhal gdams dgos na/mi yi gru la brten nas ni sogs/ rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces pa de las bzang ba sus thon/ de'i glegs bam snod rkub tu bcug nas gzhan la zhal gdams re ba ci yin/ zhes pa'i gnam yig 'di rag bkram byams pa gling na lhung 'dug zer lo// //ma / /bla ma kun dga' la gtam bya ba/ snying nas 'chi chos shig 'dod na 'jig rten tshe 'di'i snang shes thams cad rtag pa dang brtan pa til 'bru tsam yang med par shes nas/ tshe phyi ma'i 'dug chus kho na la rdog pa gtad de/gong gi dpon/ thad kyi grogs/'gab kyi g.yog thams cad la ngo bsrung dang skyong zhen gyi blo sna 376

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mtha' dag bsnyung la/ tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs gnas bla ma dang /dkon mchog rin po che gsum la skyabs bcol te/ ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa la mi phyed pa'i mos gus kyi srog mkhar tshugs pa zhig dang / dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du lha chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu gzhan don du byang chub kyi sems la mos pa mi gtong ba zhig dang / skyes bu dam pa'i nom thar la lha ba ma gtogs dam pa min pa'i lad mo la skad cig tsam yang mi rgyug pa zhig mdzad na mi bslu ba'i brtul zhugs grub pa lags/ 'jigs med pas so// //pa / /lhag bsam chu gter sbubs nas/ /mdzad bzang pad+mo'i lang tsho//'gog med cir yang snang ba'i/ /'phags mchog de la 'dud do/ /lhag bsam mchog gis bskrun pa'i/ /rnam dkar legs byas med na/ /lha bas lhag pa'i lus rten/ /'di 'dra rnyed pa srid dam/ /lus rten mchog cig thob kyang / /lhag bsam dge ba dkon pas/ 1lhag bsam lan re skyes kyang / /gong 'phel thabs mkhas bsten mdzod/ /lhag bsam rnam dag med na/ /spyod pa rnam dag mi 'byung / /spyod pa rnam dag med na/ /gzhan phan rnam dag 'byung ngam/ /lhag bsam rnam dag med na/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byung ngam/ /byang chub sems mchog med na/ /byang chub bla med 377

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'gum/'thob bam/ /lhag bsam rgyal sras spyi nor/ /rgyal sras lhag bsam las skyes/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa med na/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras mi 'byung / /khams gsum srid pa'i grong na/ /'gro drug sems can dpag med/ /'di ltar lhag bsam skye yul/ /'di la lhag bsam bskyed mdzod/ /lhag bsam mchog dang bral ba'i/ /rang don don gnyer byis pa/ /de dag blo gros nyams rtsal/ /bya nag gshog rtsal 'dra'o/ /'gro kun drin chen pha ma/ /'di la snying rjes drangs pa'i/ /gzhan phan don gnyer chen po/ /de ga lhag bsam lags so/ /rnam dkar bag tsam bsgrub kyang / /blo gros phur khung ma thug /lhag bsam che che mdzod dang / /chung ngu chen por 'gyur ro/ /dge slong lhag bsam rab dkar/ /btags ming don ldan bzhed na/ /dri med lhag pa'i bsam bzang / /yar zla bzhin du spel cig /kha cig na re dal 'byor thob pa la lhag bsam dgos na mir gyur pa la gzhan phan don gnyer dgos pa ha cang thal lo zhe na/ /de ni skabs thob kyi dbang las go dgos te dper na rtogs pa zhes pa spang bya'i rnam rtog dang zab mo'i nyams rtogs gnyis la 'jug kyang skabs so sor go ba len dgos pa bzhin no/ /dge'o// //༄/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul/ /thar 'dod 'gro ba'i mig gcig /don gnyis 'dod dgu sbyin pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas 378

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mkhyen no/ /grangs med bskal par btsal kyang / /rnyed dka' dam chos rin chen/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i dgongs bcud/ /thugs kyi bum par bskyil nas/ /dus dang skal ba ji bzhin/ /don gnyer bu la sgo ba'i/ /drin chen bla ma rje btsun/ /mkhyen no thugs rjes bzung mdzod/ /dus brgya za ma gcig bzhin/ /rgyal bstan lan gcig mjal tshe/ /rnyed dka' don cher shes nas/ /sgrub la gces spras byed cing / /sa rnying bka' brgyud la sogs/ /ris med chos brgyud mtha' dag /sangs rgyas gcig gi bstan 'dzin/ /bstan pa gcig la zhugs pa/ /gus pa'i zhing mchog kho nar/ /yid ches khong nas rnyed de/ /dag snang pad+ma rgyas par/ /rje yis byin gyis rlobs dang / /thog med ba 'khor ba'i 'brog tu/ /rang sems 'khrul bas dub pa/ /'od gsal gnyug ma'i dbyings su/ /ngal bso'i bdud rtsi lho dang / /zab rgyas lam bzang mtha' dag/'od gsal snying po'i ma stegs/ /kun gyi rtse mor son pa'i/ /nges don mchog gi zab lam/ /snang stong phyogs re min par/ /zung 'jug brjod zal chen por/ /gdod nas 'du 'bral med pa'i//rang sems gnyug ma'i de nyid/ /bcos bslad bral ba'i ngang du/ /snang sems spros pa'i rdzun ris/ /chu rlabs mtsho la thim bzhin/ /rang grol phyag rgya chen po/ /'byur med mchog bde'i go 'phang / /da lta nyid du mthong bar/ /mnyam 379

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma med rje btsun bla mas/ /bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs mdzod/ /ma 'ongs skye ba'i phreng bar/ 1bla ma sangs rgyas mjal zhing / /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i btung bas/ /blo stobs rgyas par shog cig /phyag rdzogs sgom lugs/ dag snang sbyang lugs/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs kha kha so sor nga rang nad pa thabs rdug yin phyir 'bri mi thub pas/gsung mi gcog tsam du de lhar bris so// //ra / /nyon dang mtha' grol zhal bdams slong mi/ /zhal gdams nyams len 'dod mkhan yin na/ /shog shar gcig la bris pas mi phan/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung rab blta dgos/ /gsung de blta ba'i nus pa chung rung / /bstan pa yongs rdzobs skyes bu gsum gyi/ /lam du dril ba sngon 'gro'i khrid yig /dran pa nyer bzhag yin pas der ltos/ /blo ldog bzhi nas byang chub sems gnyis/ /sgom pa'i bar kun jeg mchog rgyal po'i/ /rten gzhir bzung nas nyams su len pa/ /pha gcig kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i ring lugs/ /sor rtse tsam gyi gdams ngag kho nas/ /dam pa'i lam srol zla ba ston ba'i/ /'phrul thabs 'di nyid bstan pa'i nyi mas/ /gang shar bzo med lhug par bris so// //ra / /bsod rgyam na re zhal gdams dgos zer/ nga yi kha sgo gdams pas brgyan 'di/ /shes rgyud dul ba'i nyams myong mthus 380

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1min/ /dam chos nyung zad thos pa'i me tog /nga yi sgo gsum sdig dang lhang ba/ /'di gnyis kho nar phyag len byed 'di/ /chos nas de ltar bshad pas ma yin/ /las kyis nongs pa'i rang blo 'dis lan//de phyir rang gi rgyud la brtags tshe/ /gsung rab rin chen gling du slebs nas/ /lag pa stong par rga shi'i grong sgor/ /phyin pa'i ngang tshul bsam nas 'gyod do/ /res 'ga' bskal mang sgra tsam thos dka'i/ /drang srong gsung rab bdud rtsi'i zil thig /cung zad rna ba'i snyim pas thob 'di/ /'bras med min snyam glo ba dga' 'o/ /gang phyir rgyal ba'i rtogs pa'i bstan pa/ /ji bzhin rang gi rgyud la med kyang / /lung gi chos mdzod phyogs tsam rig pas/ /nam zhig bag chags dkar por sad snyam/ /'on kyang dad brtse 'tsho ba dag cing thos pas phongs yang ma ṇi bzlas pas/ /'chi ba dga' tshal 'gro ltar mthong ba'i/ /skye bo'i mdun sar ngo yang tsha 'o/ /tshul 'dis bdag dang bdag 'dra'i spyod tshul/ /dam pa'i mdun sar sna bcad bzhin du/ /dman 'di blo ngan langs la shor ba'i/ /nyes dmigs yin pas gnas 'dir gzob mdzod/ /de phyir khyod kyis yid kyi glang po/ /shugs drags nyes spyod g.yang la 'jug 'di/ /skyo shas nges 'byung lcags kyus gtsag nas/ /gtan bde'i phyogs su kha lo sgyur cig /de lta na yang gtan bde thabs bcas ci yang mi 381

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shes de sgrub rlom pa/ /long ba sbyo 'gros byed dang mtshungs pas/ /dam chos mnyan slad brtson pa ma 'bor/ /chos de logs nas 'tshol dgos min kyi/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par pheg chen/ /mdo sngags kun dang lhag par gsang sngags/ /rgyud sde mtha' dag dgos su bla med/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i lam gnad ma lus/ /gru bzhi lam khyer kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i/ /gsung rab yid bzhin nor bu'i gter kha/ /'di 'drar mjal tshe snying po len dgos/ /kha nas zhal gdams sbul mkhan mang ste/ /bsgo ba'i ngag bzhin byed mkhan mi 'dug /mang po'i chos mtha' tshong dang nag chang / /gyod kyi phyag len kho nas chod song / /da ni 'o mas kha tshig byis pa/ /zho 'khyags 'thung la'ang sun pa skyes nas/ /btang snyoms ngang la sdod par spro yang / /rnga las sgra 'byung dbyug pa'i gzhan dbang / /'dzir ka'i bsne pu bye tī dza'i ngor/ /kha mang khā ta gnyis pa bstan nyis bris/ /dge'o// //ra / /lar dngos gzhi'i lam gyi gzhi rten dang / /gegs sel du sngon 'gro'i chos khrid kyi/ /nyams len la sbyong ba gnad du che/ /der sbyang goms cung zad song ba na/ /lam zab mo'i mthar thug rdzogs pa che/ /blo yid byed bcos ma'i gzeb spengs pa'i/ /gshis ka dag phyogs yan chen po'i ngang / /cog bzhag gi nyams len skyong 382

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ba gces/ /dus de tshe dgra 'dre'i 'tshub lhong dang / /'khor 'phel 'grib longs spyod dar rgud sogs/ /rkyen bzang ngan ji ltar snang ba kun/ /don zang thal rig pa'i rtsal sbyong du/ /'khyer shes na gegs sel gzhan mi dgos//gnad de shes bya ba legs nyes dang //rang skyid sdug gnas skabs ci byung yang / /yid re med dogs med gu yangs ngang / /ngal bsos nas skyid nyal brgyab pas chog /de tshe phog thug bze re med/ /de tshe chags sdang gleng brjod bral/ /de tshe snang ba bde bar shar/ /rang bde gzhan skyid skyid dgu 'dzom/ /de lung bstan mang po'i don bsdus yin/ /pha kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i zhal ta yin/ /bu bstan pa'i nyi ma'i glu dbyangs yin/ /don thugs la bcang na zab par mchis/ /nam mkha' rgya mtshor gsungs pa red////ma / /mgon sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'phrul/ /dus snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rjes 'dzin phyir/ /tha mal gyi gzugs bzung dam chos bstan/ /pha drin chen bla ma spyi bor bzhugs lar 'dab chags blun po ca co che/ /don med kyang las kyis bskos tshul yin/ /de bskyar zlos byed na byis pa'i rtags/ /btang snyoms su zhog mdzod rgan rabs tsho/ /mi bsam med rbongs pa'i sug bris de/ /don bshad rin med kyang rtsed mo tsam/ /der rtsa 'grel gyi tha snyad dgod re bro/ /spyo gtam 'grel na 'chal ba'i rtags/ /bzhon lus 383

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sems rgyas tshe chos la sbyangs/ /chos kha la ma spur rgyud dang sbyar/ /rang btsan sa zin nas 'chad rtsom gyis/ /las gzhan don sgrub pa dam pa'i srol/ /gzhon byis pa'i mi tshe rtsed mos bskyal/ /chos rna bas thos tshad kha nas spur/ /rgan lang tsho song tshe rang sems la /'di 'dzin snyam med pa bdag 'dra'i lugs/ /gru 'di 'dra 'grel dgos zer tsa na/ /khyod bod yul 'phags pa'i zhing skyes kyang / /bag med kyi kun spyod 'di lta bus/ /mgo dkar por slebs ces spyo ba 'dra/ /da tshe mjug dgun nyi'i phyi dro 'dir/ /glu 'di 'dra 'grel ba'i long med kyis/ /tshig brjod pa don ldan 'phags pa'i gsung //don zab cing rgya che gdams pa'i gter/ /mdo rgyud kyi snying po yi ge drug /de ma brjed snying la ri mor bris/ /dbugs ma chad bar du skyor sbyangs gyis/ /blos ma lcogs bar du 'grel pa rgyobs/ /tshe 'di yi rgyab tu phyi ma 'ong / /der skyid po 'dod na ma ṇi thon/ /chos yi ge drug ma'i zhabs rten la/ /las sdig spyod thag pa ma 'dogs ang / /khams gsum gyi 'gro ba ma rgan yin/ /drin che'o snyam na ma ṇi thon/ /lam byams dang snying rjer 'brel ba zhog /tshe phyi mar sgo ma pa'i smon lam thob/ /bod bsil ldan yul 'di 'phags pas bskyangs/ /de'i bka' drin dran na ma ṇi thon/ /tshe sngon nas 'brel bas mgon du thob/ /rang rtse gcig 'jus na slar yang mjal/ /mtho nyi zla ri rtser 384

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'char ba'i dpes/ /skyabs bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu sgoms/ /dma' klung chen rgya mtshor gzhol ba'i dpes/ /rang blo kha dam pa'i chos phyogs drongs/ /sa ri thang dbyar kas bsgyur ba'i dpes/ /rgyud ngan pa 'phabs pa'i thugs rjes grol/ /tshe 'dir bde phyi skyid gtan du 'tsheng / /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa'i bkra shis shog /dbal shul khyo kho'i sngabs rgan dad pas rgyud phyug pa chos 'byung nas/ kho bo gzhon dus rtsed mor bris pa'i glu cal col cig la 'grel pa bris zhes rin po che'i rten bcas bskul ba'i lan du sprang po bstan pa'i nyi mas smras pa dge bar gyur cig/ //ra / /bla ma thub dbang shākya seng ge yi/ /zhabs la sgo gsum gus pas phyag bgyis nas/ /gtan 'dun 'chug med sgrub pa'i man ngas 'di/ /mdor bsdus go sla'i ngag gi phreng bar spel/ /gang zhig theg mchog rigs la gnas pa yi/ /skal bzang skye bo rnams la brtse ba yis/ /theg mchog lam byi rim pa ji snyed cig /kun mkhyen zhal gyi bum pa nas 'ongs pa'i/ /snying po lung bstan brnyes pa'i paṇa chen gyis/ /bkral ba'i rang lugs dri ma med bzung ste/ /rnam par bshad pa'i mdzod chen rnam bdun po/ /gzhung lugs gdams pa'i mthil du 'char 'dod na/ /dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' sems pa nas/ /ji srid rang bzhin theg mchog rgyal po'i bar/ /386
