ngo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'gal med lam gyi phung po gcig nyid du/ /bsgrig pa'i man ngag 'di la goms par mdzod/ /mngon mtho'i phun tshogs rnam pa brgya dag dang / nges par legs pa'i yon tan 'byor pa kun/ /ma tshang med par 'du ba'i ye shes kyi/ /gter de rgyal ba nyag gcig go 'phang yin/ /de phyir go 'phang mchog de skrub pa'i sgo/ /bla med theg pa mchog gi chos tshul du/ /mngon mtho sgrub byed gsung rab kun don dang / /nges legs sgrub pa'i thabs kun tshang bar 'du/ /gang yang 'jig rten phyi ma'i phun tshogs la/ /blo kha cung zad tsam yang ma phyogs rung / /gtan bde zhi ba sgrub pa'i bsnyon ham can/ /de dag byis pa las kyang ches tha shal/ /rang nyid srid pa'i bde 'byor la chags bzhin/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal mtha' dag las sgrol zhes/ /smra ba de dag da dung ci zhig las/ /'gro kun sgrol ba'i ngag don 'tshol bar rigs/ /de slad skyes bu chung dang 'bring po dang / /thun mong lam gyi rim pa la sbyangs nas/ /da gdod pheg mchog thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /rtogs rigs 'dod rnams skye bo mdzangs pa yin/ /shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed na don che ba'i/ /rten de da lta rang gi lag mchis pas/ /'bras med mi bgyi 'chi chos gcig kho nar/ /mi tshe dril ba'i blo sna 'di dang gcig /de yang skye ba da res bya snyam los/ /mi chog long med 'chi ba'i tshul mthong nas/ /skad cig re re'ang mi 386

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1tshe don ldan du/ /bgyid pa'i dge sbyor ci nus byed snyam gnyis/ /rgyu yi dge sbyor de la mang yod kyang / /ston pas che long bsdus pa dge bcu'i khrims/ /yang dag lta bas brgyan pa 'di nyid las/ /brtsams te mkhas par sbyang ba 'di dang gsum/ /dkyus sa ma mthong rta rgyug byed pa bzhin/ /sdig pa'i nyes dmigs ci zhig ltar mthong nas/ /dge la 'dun pa'i rgyu mtshan med min par/ /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal mang du sems dang bzhi/ /skyes bu chung ngu'i lam dang thun mong ba'i/ /sems sbyong yin te 'khor ba sdug bsngal du/ /shes nas thar pa sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro ru/ /mi bsgom mi rung rim pa nges pa lags/ /de nas spid pa'i rtse mo'i 'jig rten bar/ /skad cig 'gyur ba glog gi phreng 'dra dang / /de yang las dang nyon mongs gzhan dbang ba'i/ /'du byed sdug bsngal gtso bor sems pa yis/ /drang ba'i thar 'dod shugs drag rgyun ring du/ /skyes tshe nges 'byung chos sgor zhugs pa ste/ /sdug kun 'gog pa'i go rim sgrub tshul sogs/ /'di las 'phros te zhib tu mkhyen par mdzod/ /nam zhig srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga 'di/ /me 'bar 'khrugs pa'i rlabs ltar mthong ba yi/ /yid 'byung de yi myong ba la dpags nas//skye dgu'i sdug bsngal zhi 'dod bde blag skye/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal mtsho las thar 'dod dang / /de dag sdug bsngal 'phrang las bsgral 387

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i ba gsung 'bum/'dod blo/ /gcig pa min phyir phyi ma 'di skyed dang / /spel ba'i sbad du brtson 'grus brgyud mar sbyang / /de yang rgyu mtshan rnam dag du ma las/ /'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i nges shes dang / /bdag gzhan mnyam brje sgom pa'i sbyor ba las/ /bzod med snying rje chen po 'dren pa'i tshul/ /rgyas par nges don shing rta chen po dang / /rnam bshad bden gnyis shing rtar gsungs pas na/ /klog dang sgom pa'i ngal ba brgya phrag bis/ /theg chen rigs kyi nus pa ci rgyas mdzod/ /snying rje chen po bcos ma min rnyed na/ /de yi shugs kyis rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi/ /sems bskyed zur yang mtshan nyid tshang nus pas/ /blo 'di theg pa mchog gi rtsa bar gsungs/ /sems de bskyed kyang rgyal sras spyod pa yi/ /khur chen rdzogs par nyams su ma blang na/ /dam bca' tsam gyis sangs rgyas mi 'thob pas/ /tshul khrims phung po yongs su rdzogs par blang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kun bsdu na/ /sdom sdud don byed rnam pa gsum yin te/ /de dag dam bzhag yon tan mdzod la sogs/ /bstan bcos rgyas pa rnams su legs par tshol/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i sgo mo grangs med pa/ /shes par dka' phyir mdo sde blta ba dang / /bshes gnyen dam pa ring du bsten dgos par/ /zhi ba lha sogs shing rta che rnams gsungs/ /byang sems spyod la slob tsher ma zad kyi/ /thog mtha' 388

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bar du dge ba'i lam thams cad/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i drin gyis rnyed dgos par/ /nor bzang dpa' bo'i rnam par thar las byung / /de slad bsam dang sbyor bas dge ba'i bshes/ /bsten tshul mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa sogs/ /yid bzhin rin po che yi mdzod 'grel du/ /bka' sprul de dag lam gyi gzhi ma yin/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi mkhas bya'i gnas mang yang / /sgrib pa mtha' dag nges par zhi ba'i sgo/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ye shes tshol ba yi/ /thabs tshul rgyas par slob la snying por 'dzin/ /chos kun rang rang ming tsam zad pa yi/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung sgyu ma bzhin shes nas//gdod nas rang bzhin cha tsam dmigs min pa'i/ /de bzhin nyid kyi bzhugs tshul rjen pa mthong / /rgyal ba'i sher phyin mdo sde mang po ru/ /stong nyid bcu drug de bzhin nyi shu dang / /bdag med gnyis sogs dbye ba mang mdzad pa/ /kun kyang chos nyid tshul gcig 'di las bye/ /ji ltar mi yi skyed tshal stong mthong yang / /lha yi khang bzang bkod pa'i khyad par la/ /sgro 'dog chod pa ma yin de 'dra'i tshul/ /de bzhin nyid la yong ye mi mchi ste/ /rang bzhin med pas tha snyad med pa min/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung rang mtshan gyis yod min/ /yod min med min 'di 'dra 'di kho nar/ /srid dang zhi ba'i chos kun mnyam pa nyid/ /de bzhin nyid mthong gzhan na yod min 389

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/te/ /skye 'gags rtag chad 'gro 'ong mtshan ma sogs/ /spros pa'i mtha' brgyad nye bar zhi ba yi/ /dbyings der kun rtog zhi ba'i brda chad tsam/ /ji srid rten 'brel zab mo'i rnam bzhag 'di/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i rtsal khyad ma sbyang ba/ /de srid myu bzhi skye 'gog gtan tshigs sogs/ /mang du bshad kyang snying po stor bar zad/ / de ltar med na ji ltar yod snyam du/ /the tshom des kyang lta ba ma rnyed na/ /rang bzhin med na chos kun med do zhes/ /log par bzung rnams ji ltar dbu ma pa/ /de slad yon tan mdzod kyi gnas dgu par/ /rten 'brel shes pa'i bsngags pa mang gsungs te/ /da lta'i dus kyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug phal/ /kun mkhyen gzhung gi snying po stor nas 'dug /nges don lta ba'i mthar thug rnyed pa na/ /grogs su bsod nams tshogs chen bde blag tu/ /rdzogs pa'i thabs mkhas gsang sngags rgyud sde las/ /shes par 'dod na dbang skur tshul bzhin nod/ /der ni 'bras bu lam byed rnal 'byor mthus/ /mthar thug gzugs sku sgrub pa'i man ngag dang / /bltas dang dgod sogs bde ba lam byed pas/ /ye shes tshogs chen sgrub pa'i zab gnad kyi/ /myur khyad zer sgros tsam gyis mi tshim par /yid ches rnyed nas de bzhin sgrub nus na/ /ched du bya ba'i go 'phang dus ring mthar/ /mi 'gyang stan thog gcig tu 'grub pa yod/ /390

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i lam/ /zab mo ka dag khregs chod lha ba dang / /rgya chen lhun grub thod rgal goms pa'i mthus/ /phung po 'ja' skur dengs pa'i zab khyad can/ /deng sang lag len byed mkhan mang mod de/ /yin lugs thog tu khel ba nyung mthong bas/ /gzu lum mi bya shing rta che srol 'dir/ /dpang gyur rig 'dzin gzhung du zhun thar chod/ /gdod nas rnam grol rang byung rig pa'i bab/ /rnam par mi rtog 'od gsal gnyug ma 'di/ /rang ngo shes nas ji bzhin nyid bskyang na/ /sems rig myong stobs kyis kyang byed pa 'byung / /'on kyang nyams sbong de 'dra ma skyes par//ngo sprod gnad la zhib tu mkhas bya zhing / /bzhag thabs 'chugs med gcig tu 'dris bya ste/ /bogs 'don gegs sel rnams kyang sgro 'dogs chod/ /khregs chod rtogs pa'i gdengs chen rnyed pa'i tshe/ /'od gsal sgron ma rnam bzhi'i gseng lam nas/ /nang dbyings lhun grub spubs su 'jug pa'i tshul/ /man ngag gnad gsang rig la sla ba yin/ /ji ltar cal col mang du smra ba yi/ /byis rnams mi rgan rnams kyis gtse ba bzhin/ /chos grogs rong tha'i bla ma des bskul nas/ /sprang smyon gang dran rnam rtog gang bab bris/ /dge bas nyam thag ma rgan 'gro drug kun/ /srid mtsho rnam grol zhi ba'i gnas thob shog /phrin yig byis pa'i ca co 'di dag kyang / /bskul 391

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba po yi rna ba gtser gyur cig /ces pa'ang btsun pa gu ru ye shes kyis skyes dang bcas te yi ge'i lam nas bskul ba ltar 'jigs med bstan nyis shar mar bris pa mad lo// //ra / /dge tshogs sa chen yangs ba'i mngal nas 'khrungs/ /sangs rgyas chos tshul nyi ma'i 'od kyis phye/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'dab ma kun nas dkyus ring ba/ /mi yi pad+ma de la mchid 'di gsol/ /bsil ldan ljongs 'di sna tshogs rig gnas kyi/ /rin chen mang pos brgyan pas 'phags yul dang / /bgo skal mnyam de 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i/ /bka' drin bdud rtsi dkar po'i cha shas lags/ /'jig rten mig de'i rnam thar nor bu'i phreng / /mgul bar bzhes nas rgyal bstan bshad sgrub kyi/ /bya bas ngal med ring du brel ba khyod/ /sku khams bde bar bzhugs pas yid rab dga'/ /khyod ni gnyis med gsung pa'i chos la dgyes/ /lung gi sgra tsam smra la'ang gus pas 'dud/ /nyung ngu shes pa'ang gces spras yul du dgongs/ /tshong dpon rin chen rgyus la mkhas pa bzhin/ /de slad shin tu dman zhing nyam chung ba/ /bdag 'dra'ang thub pa'i legs bshad tshig 'ga' tsam/ /spru ba gcig pu'i rgyu mtshan nyer bzung ste/ /gzigs par dgongs shing phrad la don gnyer mdzad/ /'on kyang bdag ni las kyi sha zas gtses/ /sna tshogs nad kyi tshor bas lus 392

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga sems dkrugs/ /'chad la spro med sgrub la mos dang bral/ /nyin mtshan kun tu sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig sems/ /rga bas ngal zhing na bas dub pa'i yid/ /lang long 'du 'dzi'i khur po mi theg phyir/ /mi mang mi 'phrad smra mang mi thos par/ /ri dwags bzhin du bskung nas nyal bar dga'/ /rang gi nus pa ji bzhin chos tshig gi/ /skyes bzang cung zad cig ni yongs 'dzin lor/ /phul ba de lags ma 'ongs dus su yang / /legs bshad mchod sprin stob pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /da res kho bo 'grul rgya bsdam pa dang / /gcig ngo bzung na gzhan ngo bzlog dka' ba'i/ /tshul 'di khyod kyis mi mkhyen mi srid cing / /brtse chen ldan phyir phur tshugs mdzad mi 'tshal/ /lus ni sgur zhing byad bzhin gnyer mas khyab/ /shin tu mi sdug mthong na sgyug bro ba/ /bdag 'dra mthong bas ci bya de las ni/ /'bum 'gyur lhag pa'i man ngag tshig 'ga' gsol/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyis nges par bya ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshad dang sgrub pa ste/ /bshad sgrub med na lung rtogs ci yis 'dzin/ /dam pa'i lam srol 'dzin na de ltar dgongs/ /tshul bzhin ma bsgrubs chos kyis ji ltar grol/ /bsgrub bya ma shes sgrub pa ci la byed/ /bde gshegs chos tshul ma thos mi shes te/ /'jug rim ma nor mdzad na de ltar dgongs/ /thos pas sgrub la bag chags 'jos pa dgos/ /sgrub pas 393

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mang thos snying po lon pa dgos/ /thos bsam sgom gsum rta shig phrug 'dra dgos/ /brtson pa don yod mdzad na de ltar dgongs/ /shes kyang tshim sla mi bya zhib tu sbyang / /rtogs dkar gyur kyang mi zhum yun du bslab/ /mi drag mi dal chu bo'i rgyun bzhin brtson/ /thos pa'i longs spyod gsog na de 'dra dgos/ /mkhas pa'i lugs mang ma 'dzing zhib mor dpyod/ /gang la'ang chags sdang dbang gis ris mi gcod/ /rang lugs ngos bzung nges pa mi 'phrog bya/ /pha chos grub mtha' 'dzin na de 'dra dgos/ /blo sna mi mang 'dun ma gcig thog bzhag /ngang thung mi byed sems khong glod la bsgrub/ /re dogs mi gtsub glang po'i lta stangs bya/ /sgom sgrub snying por mdzad na de 'dra dgos/ /nying 'dzin brtan na 'du 'dzis yid mi 'phrog /snying rje 'byongs na bde sdug rkyen sna theg /mngon shes grub na brtsam pa 'bras bur bcas/ /'khor mang slob tshogs sdud na de 'dra dgos/ /bden la rab gnas skye bos tshad mar 'dzin/ /spyi snyoms che bas kun gyis ma bzhin 'khur/ /sgam zhing zab pas 'khor gyis yong mi brnyas/ /chen po'i go sa skyong na de 'dra dgos/ /bdag la chos med 'jig rten shes pa med/ /'on kyang gnag rdzis rgyal po'i phyugs bgrang ltar/ /bsnyad 'di dam pa'i man ngag la brten phyir/ /thugs la bcang na 'phrod par 'gyur ba snyam/ /de 394

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1skad klong chen brgyud pa'i gral mtha' pa/ /phyi rkyen dbyar gyi dga' bas sems brid cing / /nang rkyen nad kyi zug rngus yid gdungs pa'i/ /ngu ma dgod des dben rir 'bad nas bris/ /deng sang dpyid kyi rlung chen ldang / /dbyar ka 'byung ba'i rten 'brel lags//bdag kyang 'di ltar ca co sgrogs/ /dge legs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel lags/ /ha ha// //ba / /blo gros snang ba 'dum 'jo bas/ /phyin ci log blo'i mun nag che/ /'joms mdzad 'jam mgon nyi zla la/ /btud nas mi rtag tshul bshad bya/ /mal khri'i tha ma zhig la rang 'dug ste/ /bzhin gyi gzi mdangs nyams pa'i gdong pa ni/ /gshin rje'i grong khyer chen por mngon phyogs tsho/ /'chi ba de ring 'ongs zhes sdug bsngal skye/ /bsags pa'i longs spyod mtha' dag kun spangs te/ /nye du mchi ma can gyis mtha' skor zhing / /gtam gyi tha ma smra bar zhugs pa'i tshe/ /nga 'dra'i skal ngan med ces snyam sems byed/ /gling bzhi'i phun tshogs kun la dbang bsgyur kyang / /khab dang sbud pa tsam yang mi dbang bar/ /gcer bu lag pa stong par 'gro ba'i tshe/ /'chi bdag da res slebs ces snying khams g.yo/ /mi tshe gang por gsos gsos bskyangs bskyangs ba'i/ /sgyu lus sgyu ma'i khang pa shul du bzhag /gcig pu sa tshugs med par 'gro tsa na/ /bar do'i 396

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾྾'phrang ring chen por 'o re brgyal/ /pho grung zha chus sgrub la mkhas mod kyang / /'chi tshe blo gdeng thebs pa mi 'dug na/ /'chi bdud zhags pa nag pos btab tsa na/ /'chi ba'i skyes chen bzlog mkhan dka' mo yod/ /'jigs rung dmyal ba'i grong sgo mthong tsa na/ /snying la mya ngan shum shum byed pa'i tshe/ /phyi ma'i grabs shom snga nas ma byas zhes/ /'gyod pa'i me chen 'bar ba'i dus shig 'ong / /rnam shes mi rtag mgron po las dbang song / /sems med ro rgog skam po shul du lus/ /skra sen ri lung mang por 'thor ba'i tshe/ /chos brgyad bsgrub la snying po ci 'dug soms/ /bsags pa'i nor gyis mi bsnyungs 'chi ba'i gnas/ /btsan po g.yul gyis mi bzlog bshin rje'i khrims/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis bcos med skye shi'i 'phrang / /'di las thar thabs lha chos rin po che/ /lha chos lo zlar grabs shom byas byas nas/ /ga ler ga ler bsgrub rgyu mi 'dug ste/ /lha chos sems kyi steng nas 'jog rgyu 'di/ /mnyam med rgyal ba gong ma'i tshul lugs yin/ /'gro 'dug ji ltar byas kyang lha chos bsgrub//spyod lam gang byed dam pa'i chos su dril/ /za nyal 'chag tshad byang chub lam grogs su/ /shes 'di byang chub sems dpa'i ngang tshul yin/ /dge'o// //༄//na mo ma spru shri ye/ /grong ba wa ra ṇa sir sangs rgyas kyis/ /396

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1/bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i thog ma ru/ /'di ni sdug bsngal zhes gsungs de yi phyir/ /rang gi longs spyod cha rgyus shes pa'ang dka'/ /tshe rabs thog ma med nas da bar du/ /rang nyid gar ma skyes shing ci lta bur/ /ma shi tshul de bsam nas mi skyo bar/ /gzhan gyi 'chi ba mthong nas skyo mi rigs/ /da dung tshe bsags nor dang snying brtse'i gnyen/ /thams cad shul du bzhag nas tshe phyi ma'i//lam ring gcig pur blang ste 'gro dgos na/ /yi mug su la byed de su yis byed/ /'chi bas mdun bsu gson la zhen chags shing / /gson po'i 'bab stegs 'chi bas yi nug pa/ /'di 'dra'i dbang gis yang dang yang du ni/ /'chi ba'i byur sdud phung po 'di 'dra 'thob/ /lus la mi chags 'bral bas mi gdung ste//tshul de ma shes rgyud lnga'i 'jig rten du/ /las kyis bsdus shing las kyis kha phral ba'i/ /'gyur ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal sdon mar 'char/ /rlung dmar nang du mar me gzhon nu dang / /snum zad mar me ngang bis rgas pa gnyis/ /'di 'chi tshul min 'di nyid tshul bzhin zhes/ /dbye ba e 'dug bsam blo legs par thongs/ /de ltar dus min glo bur rkyen dbang dang / /na tshod lo mang thal nas shi ba gnyis/ /'di 'dra mi 'tshams 'di 'dra 'jig rten spyi'i/ /dpe khebs yin zhes dbye ba byed rgyu ci/ /'chi 'di sdug bsngal nang nas zil thigs tsam/ /397

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan rje nyi'i gsung 'bum/de 'dra'i sdug bsngal bsam yas mi zad phyir/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho zhes bya ste/ /rgya mtshor nyal nas thigs pas ci zhig 'jigs/ /skrag cig shes na rang re'i thog med kyi/ /skye shi'i gnas 'di hrel gyis sdug bsngal phyir/ /sdug bsngal mthar byed ston pa bla med kyi/ /bstan dang mjal dus ci zin ci thob dgos/ /rang gis ma tshad nam mkhas gar khyab kyi/ /'gro kun drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan te/ /de dag 'di 'dra'i sbug bsngal mtshor byings pa/ /bsam zhing bsam na skyo rgyu mang po 'dug /'on kyang rgyal ba kun gyi thugs gsang mdzod/ /sems can phongs pa skyob pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /rnam dab byang chub sems mchog yid bzhin nor/ /bsgom rgyu yod bzhin mya ngan bya mi dgos/ /sems 'di skyes tshad 'jig rten dmigs bu ste/ /gzhan phyir snying brtse yod na nges par sgoms/ /shes chung nyams myong med pa'i sprang po'i khar/ /zhal gdams re ba mi 'thad de lta na'ang / /gdungs ba yid gso byed pa'i skad cha zhig//dgos zhes srang tshes bskul ngor spyon pas bris/ /dge zhing bkra shis////ra / /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon dang bsod nams rdo rje bgres po khyod/ /sngon bsags bsod nams che bas dal rten thob/ /'phrad dka' rgyal bstan rin chen gling dang phrad/ /da res brgal 398

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nas 'di 'dra rnyed pa dka'/ /khyod kyis ngan song 'gro la phar ltos dang / /drag shos rta dang glang po mchog rnams kyang / /yig drug tshar sa/cig 'don pa'i mthu med phyir/ /da res smra shes don go don yod mdzod/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug mthu stobs bsam yas gter/ /spyan ras gzigs 'dra bod kyi lhar bzhugs kyang / /rjes 'dzin rgyu tshogs rang gis ma bsgrubs pas/ /mgon med nyes spyod rgya mtshor bying ba mang / /grogs khyod sku tshe nyi zla'i mched por shog /'on kyang snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus mthar skyes/ /tshe lo bdun cu'i shul ring rgyab tu bzhag /dgra chen 'chi nam 'ong mi shes kyis/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma mgron khang so nam ltar/ /don chung 'di la rang mgo ma skor bar/ /gtan bde rin chen gling du 'khrid pa'i mgon/ /thugs rje chen po'i zhabs la rtse gcig 'jus/ /lus kyi spre'u bag yod khyim du chug /ngag gi zong ngan ma ṇi'i rgyags su sgyur/ /sems kyi bum pa dge ba'i bdud rtsis khongs/ /gcig pur 'gro tshe mkho ba'i dus shig 'byung / /byang chub sems dang zab mo'i lta ba dang / /rbeg pa'i rgyal po 'od gsal rdzogs chen sogs/ /ji bzhin shes pa'i nyams myong dka' mod kyang / /rlabs chen smon lam thob dang don cher mchis/ /bsod nams dpyid kyi dus su zhing rmo bzhin/ /'phral dang 'phral la 'bras bu mi mthong yang / /grogs med gnyen med 399

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/'jig rten pha rol du/ /ston ka'i lo tog legs bzhin spyad du yod//de phyir snying nas brtse ba'i snyan bskul 'di/ /don med bar snang rlung bzhin ma song bar/ /brjod don thugs kyi ras la tshon 'phos bzhin/ /bzung nas tshe mjug chos kyis 'da' bar mdzod/ /sprang rgan gyis bris pa mad lo////pa //bshad na nyams myong med rung chos rgyus bdog /bshad rgyu chos mthun yin rung nyan mkhan dkon/ /gdams mkhan nyes pa stong gis gang na'ang / /gdams don nyams su blang na skyon yod min/ /dang po dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs zhabs su/ /phan bde'i bsil g.yab 'khor ba'i tshul mthong nas/ /gtsug phud snye ma'i mchod pa sangs rgyas la//phul des mi lus skal pa bzang por byas//'on kyang 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen che rnams kyi/ /spun zla ming don mthun par byed snyam na/ /rnam dag bslab pa'i gzhi lnga rang srog dang / /bsdos nas gces par bzung ba gnad du che/ /dmar ser gos kyi mdangs la rab dga' nas/ /khas len mig 'phang gyen la phyogs na yang / /bag yangs nag chang rol ba'i nyams dga' la/ /bltas nas lag len thur du song ba mang / /dam pa min pas shin tu bsrung dka' dang //dam par gyur pas nan gyis slob dgos pa//bslab pa 'gangs su che ba'i rtags yin pas/ /rang gi rin chen 400

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1chud zos ma byed ang / /ji spid 'tsho'i bar dus mtshams gzhan med pa'i/ /khrims kyi chus srid la dbang thub pa'i sras/ /rtag tu bslab pa'i nor med ma rabs kyi/ /mi dang kun spyod 'dre ba spyon pa yin/ /rin chen me long phyis 'dra'i dga' tshal nang / /yid 'dzin me tog cho lo la rtse zhing / /'chi med bdud rtsi'i khyad par mang spyad nas/ /lhag ma thams cad zad pa'i myang 'das dbyings/ /'jug pa'i phem skas yon tan mtha' dag gi/ /rtsa ba tshul khrims bor nas gdong dmar ma'i/ /khol po rgyab skyar song na ches phangs pas/ /skyid kyis rang sdug ma nyo snying la phur/ /tshul khrims yod na thos nyung blo dman yang / /ting 'dzin shes rab skyed la dka' ba med/ /rtsa ba med la lo med 'bras bu med/ /de slad lam gyi rten 'brel mgo nas sgrigs/ /za bde mkhur bar 'tshams pa'i zan chang dang / /go bde blo dang mthun pa'i tshigs bcad 'di/ /ma 'bor ma brjed yid la nya ra gyis/ /mkho tshe bed chod nges pa'i nor gcig yin/ /sman lha'i ngor/ bstan pa'i nyi mas bris/ dge'o/ /bkra shis// //ra / /tshe 'di'i bya ba mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin/ /'bor ba'i thabs tshul bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /rtsa ba gsum dang rgyu mtshan rnam pa dgu/ /thag bcad gsum gyis 'chi ba bsam byas na/ /zhen 401

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ba log skye ba'i 'byung gnas chen po yin/ /tshe srog mi rtag nges par 'chi ba dang / /yun ring mi sdod myur du 'chi ba dang / /'chi tshe chos min gang gis mi phan zhes/ /yid la bya ba rtsa ba rnam gsum yin/ /'chi bdag bdudaXl bzlog thabs med pa dang / /skyes bu'i tshe la snon pa med pa dang / /gshin rje'i khrims la phyir bzhag med pa gsum/ /nges par 'chi ba'i rgyu mtshan gsum zhes bya/ /tshe yi 'du byed yid brtan med pa dang / /sgyu ma'i lus la snying po med pa dang / /gson rkyen nyung zhing 'chi rkyen mang ba gsum/ /nam 'chi nges pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan yin/ /'chi tshe lus dang gtan bral byed pa dang //nye du 'brel bas phan pa med pa dang / /longs spyod 'byor pa shul du 'jog pa gsum/ /'di snang bsgrub la dgos pa med pa'i rtags//lha chos bsgrub par blo thag bcad pa dang / /myur du dam chos brtson par thag bcad dang / /'chi tshe phan nges chos zhig bsgrub dgos zhes/ /'dun phugs bca' ba thas bcad rnam gsum yin/ /yun ring dus nas srid pa'i grong khyer du/ /chos brgyad bya bar shi sbar 'tham na yang / /phan pa'i snying po rdul tsam mi 'dug na//'di la spar 'tham byed rgyu ci zhig yod/ /de ring mal gyi tha ma la 'dug ste/ /phyi ma'i grong khyer chen por 'gro dgos na/ /khyod la mi 'jibs dpa' gdeng ci zhig yod//bsam blo nang du thong dang go rgyu 'dug / 40 2

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1—bug pa 'dag zhal byas nas kun 'byung sgom/ /thugs dam gcigs su mdzad pa'i rtogs ldan pa/ /thugs rgya che ru song ba'i 'dug chas 'di/ /'chi ba thugs la ma bzhas bka' drin yin/ /lta ba zab mo rtogs rung ma rtogs rung / /banas lugs zab mo mthong rung ma mthong rung / /'chi ba'i 'gro chas kho na 'dun ma'i rtser/ /gtad na dam pa'i lha chos lag na 'dug /'chi chos bsgrub la shom ra mi dgos te/ /'gro zhor 'dug zhor gnas skabs nam yang rung / /bsam pa bzang po gcig las mi 'da' na/ /dam pa'i lha chos legs par bsgrubs zhes bya/ /thugs la zungs shig skal pa can/ /sems la 'chongs shig blo gros bzang / /sprang phrug lhon pa'i smyon gtam 'di/ /ma brjed ma brjed sku tshe ring / /zhes gzhon nu 'jigs med pas bris pa dge'o// //ra / /lag pa dal med lang shor 'jigs med pa/ /las bzang mi mkho dgu mkho'i rtogs ldan des/ /bskul nas ci ka le dang nyo ka tho'i/ /yig ris mi bri zer ba'i dam bca' shor/ /bris na tshong dus ja shog zad pa med/ /bshad na rnam rtog 'char sgo rdzogs dus med/ /byas na rnam g.yeng rtsed mo zin dus med/ /da ni byung rgyal mal du nyal na legs/ /thos kyang thos pa phal cher rtog ge'i gtam/ /bshad kyang 'chad nyan phal cher tshig gi ro/ /bsgom kyang 403

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nyams len phal cher sems kyi bdud/ /thams cad gos med shig med gcer nyal mdzod/ /ma nyan nyan lo thos lo rna ba'i dgra/ /nyan na shes rgyud 'dul ba'i chos gcig nyon/ /ma sems sdug bsam nug bsam stong pa'i 'dang//bsam na nyon mongs spong ba'i thabs shig soms/ /ma sgom sa sgom rdo sgom nyams zhen bdud/ /sgom na zhen med lta ba'i bab cig sgoms/ /ma byed phu byed mdo byed rnam rtog dgra/ /byed na 'dun ma legs pa'i lam zhig byos/ /sgom chen sgom gyi mtho skad zeng (gzengs)ma 'di/ /nyan na 'gram chu ldang ba'i snang lugs shig /yod mod kim pa'i shing thog zos pa bzhin//mya ngan rang mtshang rdol ba'i snang shes skye/ /gnas pa'i dred mong lag gdang sbrel ba yang / /dran rig sa la'i nags 'dabs ma bsnyeg na /'gyu dran 'phar ba rnga nag 'dis slebs tshe/ /'phongs 'go lag pas 'geb rgyu'i sdug la thug /gnyid kyi mi rgan byis pa'i mgo can dang //'phro rgod mon pa 'gro shes a dge sprel/ /gol sgrib khyi mang nang gi ban rgan khyod/ /gegs sel spyod pa'i ber rga ring por zungs/ /g.yo med sems kyi rgya mtsho mer ba 'dir/ /ched 'dzin gnyen po'i dbyug mdung ma mdzad dang / /spang blang rtog pa'i rnyog pa dwangs pa'i khams/ /rtsol skrub med pa'i bsam gtan shugs la 'char/ /lngags skya'i phu dung gyon pa'i dge sbyong khyod/ /404

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ por 1drang srong rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa yin mchi na/ /da ni yon tan dam pa'i rgyal mtshan de/ /ltar snang phyi na mi 'dug nang du tshol/ /gang tshe sems kyi glang bo gnya' rengs po/ /gdul na mi gtsang lus kyi khang pa yang / /grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ste/ /de tshe bdag nyid chen po lag bzang yin/ /zhes pa'ang khang rkub kyi ban rgan ma ṇi pas phul// //ra / /na ma shākya mu na ye/ /phun tshogs zhi ba dam pa'i lding khang nas/ /tshangs dbyangs chos kyi rnga sgra legs bsgrags pas/ /lus can phan bde'i dga' ston la 'bod pa/ /mnyam med skyob pa de yis khyod la srungs/ /dam chos thos kyang rgyud la ma sbyar bas/ /sgo gsum nyes spyod khol por rgas gyur pa/ /bdag 'dras chos gtam 'bul ba mi 'tshal yang / /khyod gsung ma bzlog ne lha'i ma ṇi gsol//'khor ba las kyi ri mo'i grong khyer na/ /lus rten mang ste mngon mtho thob pa nyung / /thob kyang snying po len pa ches nyung bas/ /srid 'di chu ltar 'og tu gzhol ba lags/ /khyod kyis phun tshogs mi yi bde ba brnyes/ /thub pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsis blo mig sad/ /'phags pa'i chos la rab dga' cher 'khrungs pa/ /bsod nams dam pa'i mthu yin stes dbang min/ /de lta mod kyi pad dkar lang tsho yang / /ston ka'i snang bas lhag par rgyas pa bzhin/ /yon tan 406

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/legs tshogs bshes gnyen dam pa'i mthus/ /rgyas par 'gyur gyis dam pa'i mgon la bsten/ /chos tshul gsan cing chos la dga' ba dang / /chos mchod chos kyi rjes su goms mdzad na/ /rin chen chos kyi byin rlabs mi bslu bas/ /sku tshe brgyud mar don chen brnyes par 'gyur/ /rgyal pos skye dgu skyong ba'i thabs tshul yang / /bag yod snying rje lags par sangs rgyas gsungs/ /de dag nyid kyang chos min la med phyir/ /chos la gnas te 'jig rten skyong bar mdzod/ /bden dang dul dang gtong ba'i bsil grib kyis/ /'bangs rnams bkab na skye dgu bskyang 'gyur gyi/ /chos min spyod pas mnga' ris sun phyung na/ /de yis bdag nyid min pa su zhig bskyangs/ /sdig spyod me yis 'dir yang dpal 'byor dang / /grags pa'i dga' tshal yid 'ong kun nyams te/ /slar yang sa 'og me yis gdung 'gyur phyir/ /sa/nyis su bdas kyang de yis bskyang mi 'gyur/ /chab srid rgyas shing mnga' ris bde ba dang / /g.yul gyi nang du rgyal ba rnyed 'gyur dang / /mthu chen lha rnams srung ba byed pa sogs/ /dgos dgu mtha' dag chos las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan bung ba'i gsos/ /yon tan dri bzang rdzogs pa'i legs spyad kyi/ /pad+ma rgyas 'dis snyigs ma'i dgun zlar yang / /blo mig ldan rnams dga' ba skyed par mdzod/ /rgyal 406

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1yang bas mkhas pa bden par smra ba dang / /rmongs pa ngo bstod byas pas mgu 'gyur zhes/ /gsungs phyir bden par smra ba'i me tog 'di/ /mi yi gtso bo khyod la bdag gis 'bul/ /thub rnams chos kyi gdung las bltams pa dang / /lha mi'i rgyal srid chos la brten pa yi//bden pas 'jig rten skyong ba khyod kyi dpal/ /kun dga'i zla ba gsar bar gnas gyur cig /ces pa'ang bod gzhung sa chen po'i gser khrims kyi kha lo 'dzin pa jas ga mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi thugs dam gsal 'debs su/ rdo rong gi sprang 'chal 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas bris te phul ba dge bar gyur cib dge'o// // ba / /na mo gu ru/ /bla ma bsod nams rdo rje'i bka' mchid du/ /snying la phan pa'i gtam zhig bris shig ces/ /bskrul tshig dbyug pas bdag yid brdung mod de/ /rmongs pa'i lce 'di nyes bshad rkyal ba lags/ /'on kyang rig 'dzin bong ma'i bka' lung bi /lad mo shor bas btags pa'i tshig gi rgyud/ /cung zhig mgrin pa'i lam nas grur blang na/ /sgyu ma'i ltad mo ba bzhin deng gzigs shig /'jig rten snang ba bkra ste 'ja' khyim 'dra/ /'ja' khyim rang bzhin med de smig rgyu bzhin/ /smig rgyu ngo bos stong ste nam mkha' 'dra/ /nam mkha' mtshan mar med kyang rtog btags tsam/ /rtog 407

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/btags gdod nas yin mod rtogs pa dkon/ /ma rtogs srid pa'i 'khor lo brgyud cing 'gro/ /'gro drug sdug bsngal rgya mtshor ngang gis 'phyan/ /sdug bsngal lag rtser 'dug kyang bde bar sgom/ /sdug bsngal myong mkhan mang ste bzod mkhan dkon/ /sdug bsngal 'dod mkhan med de bzlog mkhan dkon/ /sdug bsngal bzlog 'dod yod na bzlog thabs 'bad/ /gang byung byung rgyal byas pas ci ste lto/ /thar 'dod tshe 'di sgrub pa ya re cha/ /zhen log tshe 'di gnyer ba ya re cha/ /grub chen 'khrul pas ded pa ya re cha ya cha'i lad mo shor na dgod re bro/ /snying nas 'chi ba dran na 'chi chos gyis/ /phyi ma'i 'gro rgyags bzhed na lha chos rems/ /kha nas 'khrul pa zhig los mi phan gyi/ /rang drin rang la che ba'i chos shig mdzod//blun po'i blun sems mgu ba sba mod de/ /'chi bdag mgo bo bskor rgyu yod dogs med/ /rang sems dpang por thub pa'i lha chos shig /mdzad na 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i thabs shig yod/ /snga dro thar pa 'dod zer ri khrod bzung / /phyi dro gzhan phan yin zer yon bdag tshol//zog po dam par brdzu ba'i chos gzugs tsho'i//rnam thar snying la bcag na a re sdug /khyod kyang snying nas thar pa 'thob bzhed na//tshe 'di'i bya ba btang nas dben ri snyoms/ /gzhan phan snying la bcag nas byang sems sgoms/ /gtan du 'dun ma legs pa'i rtse 408

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mor 'gro/ /dang po 'gro drug snying rje'i yul du gzigs/ /bar du gzhan phan don gnyer lhag bsam 'byong / /tha ma rdzogs byang don gnyer bcos min rnyed/ /de tshe rgyal ba'i sras po'i grangs su tshud/ /sprang po'i sprang 'bod gsan 'os ma lags mod/ /gsan na sprang tshig tshig rtsog (btsog)don zab ma/ /'di 'dra thugs la bzhag kyang phan te mchi/ /ngas ni phan sems kho nas gsol ba lags/ /zhes pa'ang sprang smyon 'jigs med pas so////ra / /zhal gdams zer ba shog tshar chung du la/ /sgog gtam bris pa tsam du go mi rung / /dal 'byor rnyed dka'i khrid nas rdzogs chen bar/ /gang thos gdams pa'i mthil du shes pa gces/ /dang po 'khor ba zer ba'i tshig rkyang la/ /yi mug sgom pa nges 'byung sgrub tshul min/ /sdug bsngal rnam gsum rgyal bas bka' bstsal ltar/ /legs par shes nas mang du sems pa gces/ /de nas gzhan phyir dmyal ba'i me dong du/ /'jug go snyam pa'i tshig skam snying rje min/ /byams brtse'i dmigs rnam ji ltar sgom tshul bcas/ /tshang la ma nor shes nas slob pa gces/ /mthar thug rdo rje'i lam la sbyong snyam na/ /ngo sprod sems 'dzin gcig pus chog pa min/ /dbang thob dam tshig tshul bzhin srung ba yis/ /legs dgu'i rten 'brel rtsa ba tshugs pa gces/ /gnas bde gsal stong 'gyu ba 409

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ngo shes tsam/ /yod kyang rdzogs chen sgom pa'i rnal 'byor min/ /bzhi cha gsum bral ye bab rig pa'i klong / /bsal bzhag bral ba'i skyong tshul shes pa gces/ /tshogs drug snang ba bzo med lhug pa'i ngang / /dran pas zin tsam rjes thob rnal 'byor min/ /snang sems dbyer med rig pas gzer btab ste/ /rba rlabs rgya mtshor grol ba'i man ngag gces/ /skyid na chos kyi drin du lta ba gces/ /sdus na ra mda' chos la bcol ba gces/ /gson na tshe mjug chos su skyel ba gces/ /shi na dam chos rgyags su khyer ba gces/ shi gson skyid sdub gnas skabs ci byung yang / /blo gtad mi 'gyur chos la mdzod cig ces/ /smras 'di thogs med nges legs gnyis kyi ngor/ /bstan pa'i nyi mas nags 'dabs mal nas bkod//// ra / /gang zhig srid pa'i sems can ma lus pa/ /'dul ba'i don slad bdud rtsi'i lam ston pa/ /ston pa zla med zhabs la phyag byas nas/ /phan byed gtam gyi ze ṭa ma 'di 'thor ro/ /sprang po'i byis pa 'jigs med bstan rgyam par/ /dam pa'i grogs kyis zhal gdams bris shig ces/ /bskul tshig ngag gi phreng ba bstsal mod kyi//'di 'dra'i tshul la bdag yid rangs ma gyur/ /don bzhin rtobs nas tshul bzhin chos bstan te/ /gzhan phan spyod la kho bo spro mod kyi/ /ma rtobs rtogs brdzus zob gtam smra ba la/ /bdag gi yid ni kun 410

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ba tu spro ma gyur/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la mos pas zhugs zlog yang / /rgyal bstan 'ag/la med lam gyi cha lag tu/ /rtogs pa med bzhin chos sbong ma gsogs zhes/ /gtam 'di smra la kho bo spro ma lags/ /tshul gnyis gzhung lugs gus pas nyan rlom yang / /rtogs pa'i nyams myong rdul tsam ma thon bzhin/ /thos don ma nor thugs nyams zhog cig ces/ /smra ba'i btam 'dir kho bo spro ba med/ /ston pa'i bstan la legs par phrad gyur kyang / /bstan don snying po rang sems ma btul bzhin/ /thub bstan rin chen sgrub pas skyongs shig ces/ /'di smra ba la kho bo spro ma lags/ /srad bu gcig la'ang zhen pa ma chod par/ /chos brgyad snang ba ro bzhin dor mdzod ces//mig ldan rnams la long bas lam ston bzhin/ /rang gi tshis la rang sems khrel bar zad/ /tshe 'di'i ma la'ang snying rje med bzhin du/ /byang chub sems kyis rang rgyud sbyongs shig ces/ /mdze bos khyung sgrub gzhan la slob pa ltar/ /nga dang nga 'dra'i chos gtam yi re mug /'di dang 'di 'dra'i kun spyod ya nga ba/ /'phabs pa'i lam dang rang rgyud ma 'dres shing / /thos don ma nor sems la ma sbyar te/ /chos dang rang sems tha dad song bas lan/ /de slad khyod kyang de 'drar dgongs mdzad nas/ /log pa'i lam ngan dug ltar thag bsrings te/ /yang dag lam bzang bdud rtsi'i sgor zhugs la/ /dge 411

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba'i bshes kyi gdams ngag don yod mdzod/ /chos pa yin zer chos brdzu'i gzugs mang yang / /'di snang zhen pa rmang nas ma phyung na/ /bcos ma'i chos kyis chos mtha' mi thon pas/ /'chi chos byed na chos brgyad rdog pas non/ /dam pa yin zer dam pa'i zol mang yang / /nang nas rang sems chos kyis ma btul na/ /gzhan gyi mig sngar mdzes pas ci lto ste/ /dam pa bzhed na dam pa'i lam bzang sten/ /mkhas pa yin zer mkhas par rlom mang yang sems 'dul thabs la nan tan ma mkhas na/ /rtog ge rlung spur bshad pas ci bgyi ste/ /mkhas pa bzhed na byas pa'i chos thag chod/ /dpa' bo yin zer ngar skad 'don mang yang / /ma rig 'khrul pa bzlog la ma dpa' na/ /lpags skam 'big la mkhas kyang mi phan gyi/ /dpa' bo bzhed na rga shi'i rtsa ba choms/ /pho grung yin zer shes rlom mang mod kyi/ /tshe rabs gtan gyi 'dug chus ma grub na/ /'khrul bas 'khrul ba sgrub pas ci rung ste/ /pho grung bzhed na 'dun ma gtan legs mdzod/ /grub thob yin lo'i grub rtags 'jog mang yang / /bdag sred ri bo rmang 'gyel ma nus na/ /rdo la rkang rjes bzhag kyang ci mtshar te/ /grub rtags 'jog na bden zhen rtsad nas chod/ /rgyal ba'i sras zhes ming snyan 'chang mang yang / /snying rje chen pos rang sems ma btul na/ /snying rje'i ro mdog 412

zhal kyi gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bstan yang mi phan pas/ /pheg chen bzhed na snying rje chen por slobs/ /rtogs ldan yin zer che blo mang mod de/ /sems kyi gzhi rtsa gting nas ma chod na/ /mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i ming gis mi phan gyis/ /rtogs ldan bzhed na snang ba'i rdzun phug gtibs/ /mdor na rang sems 'dul ba'i thabs kyi mchog /dang po thar 'dod nges 'byung bsam pa bskul/ /bar du gzhan phan byang chub sems gnyis sbyongs/ /tha ma mnyam nyid chos sku'i gtan srid zungs/ /dang po 'chi bas 'jigs nas dge sems bskul/ /bar du 'khor ba'i nyes pas lhag par skrag /tha ma byang chub zhi ba'i yon tan dran/ /nges 'byung yid kyi khams gso sbyin byed yin/ /dang po 'gro drug mar shes yid 'ong bsgrubs/ /bar du sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal dran/ /tha ma bla med byang chub don gnyer bskyed/ /byang chub sems kyi bskul ma 'di yin no/ /dang po dgag bya nges pa'i rmang gzhi bting / /bar du rang bzhin med rtogs mkhar rdzong bzung / /tha ma rten 'brel nges pa'i rgyan bkram ste/ /zab mo bzod pa'i ye shes snying la zhog /de skad phan par smra ba'i gtam gyi cha/ /gang 'di dge ba'i bshes kyi rnam thar can/ /pad+ma bde chen dgongs bzhed skong phyir du/ /sprang thrun 'jigs med ces byas gang dran bris// //pa //na mo gu ru/srid 'dir 'gro ba'i khyad par ji snyed dang //413

zad 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i bsung 'bum/ra ma de yi bde sdus rnam grangs bsam yas pas/ /thams cad rmongs pa ma rig gcig pu las/ /sprul par zad ces gnyis med gsungs pas bstan/ /'phags pa'i gang zag dbye ba rnam mang dang / /de dag yon tan 'byor pa'i khyad par kun/ /rten 'byung shes pa'i blo yi snang ba yis/ /rmongs pa'i mun snyus/ bsal las 'byung bar gsungs/ /de phyir dgra bo'i nang na rmongs pa dang / /de 'dul gnyen po'i nang na shes rab mchog /shes rab bskyed nas rmongs pa 'joms pa las/ /ches lhag dpa' bo'i las gzhan yod ma yin//tshong la sgrim dang shags 'gyed byang ba dang / /rdzun dang g.yo sgyu'i las thabs mkhas pa sogs/ /shes rab ngan pa rmongs pa'i mun khang la/ /rim dgu'i rtsig pas sgon pa btang bar zad/ /'gro ba'i mig gcig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa'i gnad la blo gros mig bsgrubs nas/ /tshul bzhin sems pa'i mig sman rnon po yis/ /legs par sbyangs na chos mis dri med 'byung / /deng sang lta ba shin tu snyigs ma'i dus/ /shes rab ldan pa nyung zhing brgya lam na//yod kyang 'chal ba'i shes rab gol sla bas/ /phul byung zhing sga mthu la brten pa gces/ /thub pa mya ngan 'da' tshe nga 'das nas/ /bstan pa'i mdzod 'di khyod kyis zungs shig ces/ /rgyal sras 'khor gyi dbus su 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /theg mchog chos mdzod 414

ba ba ba ba ma sa sgyu ba sa ba / sgyu ba nga paraskyong ba'i gnyer du bskos/ /de phyir klu sgrub phyogs glang zhi ba lha/ /sangs rgyas bskyang dang zla grags zhi 'tsho sogs/ /'phags bod paṇa grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs snyed/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs las blo mchog dngos grub brnyes/ /'di yi sngon smon thags bskyed byin ༄rlabs las/ /mtshan brjod rgyud chen 'dzam gling bye ba brgyar/ /bklags pas grub pa'i dngos grub gter chen du/ /nyi ltar grags ces dpe med 'tsho yis bshad//bsil ldan ljongs 'dir khyem pa'i tshogs su yang / /rgyud 'di nyi zla lta khur grags che zhing / /kun gyi mgrin pa'i rgyan du 'dzin byed pa/ /bskrub sla'i chos skal yin pa'i rtags su nges/ /sangs rgyas yon tan legs bsngags bstod pa'i mtsho/ /rdo rje'i lam bzang snang byed nyin mo'i mgon/ /zab dang rgya che'i legs bshad za ma tog /bklags pas mchog sbyin rigs sngags rgyal po che/ /'di 'dra klog dang sems pa lha ci smos/ /glegs bam lan re mthong dang mchod pas kyang / /srid pa'i 'byor pa stong gis mi mtshon pa'i/ /nges legs mchog gi skal bzang 'dzad med ster/ /de tshul rgya cher bdag 'dras ga la shes/ /shākya'i gtso bos gsang bdag dpa' bo la//legs par bsungs pa'i phan yon rjes bsngags las//zhib tu mkhyen mdzod mkhyen nas nyams len mdzod//bdag kyang skye ba'i phreng bar bla ma mchog /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhe 6

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhabs pad gus bsten te//bstod pa glur blangs rgyud kyi rnga bo ches//sa gsum rmongs pa'i gnyid 'thug dkrog byed shog /dge slong mdo sngags nas bskul ba ltar sprang ban bstan pa'i nyi mas thang stong rgyal po'i gzhal med khang bya brgya sil snyan len pa'i gnas su shar mar spel ba'o// //༄ //chos kyi dang po tshe 'di'i bde skyid la/ /zhen pa log pa'i blo 'dir thug pas na/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid mi rtag mi brtan par/ /mngon sum mthong 'dis skyo ba skyed la sgoms/ /gnyen dang longs spyod khang khyem sa zhing sogs/ /thams cad bzhag nas gcig pur 'gro ba ni/ /myur du rang gi thog tu'ang 'ong bas na/ /blo gtad thub pa chos las gzhan pa med/ /khri thog dpon dang sprang po dbyug bzung bar/ /thams cad ro skyel don du skyes pa bzhin/ /gcig kyang mi lus phyi ma'i lam 'jug kyang / /skyo shas mi skye rtag 'dzin bdud kyis bslus/ /skyes mtha' 'chi shing 'dus mtha' bral ba 'di/ /thog med dus nas nyams su myong gyur cing / /da dung 'khor ba'i mtha' bar myong dgos pas/ /sems shig yod na thar 'dod cis mi skye/ /'dab chags du bas bdug nas 'phur 'dod bzhin/ /sdug bsngal mang po'i 'byung khungs 'khor ba 'dir/ /skyo nas bsam rgyu chos las med tsa na/ /'di phyi kun tu 'tsheng bas skyid 416

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'go tshugs/ /zhes 'jigs med bstan nyis bris// //ra / /zla bral ston pa dbu yi rgyan du thob/ /bstan pa lung gi phreng ba zhal sgor chags/ /bstan 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs thugs la zhugs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi phrin las gnyer 'chang ba//dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di dang bar do tshe rabs phreng ba kun/ /theg mchog bsten pa'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing / /bka' bzhin sgrub la brtson par byin gyis zlobs/ /'du 'dzi'i nang du g.yeng bas khyer ba'i tshe/ /long med 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /dben pa'i gnas su sprub la gzhol ba'i tshe/ /brtson 'grus mthar skyel nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /sna tshogs chos kyi 'gal rkyen lhags pa'i tshe/ /rkyen snang lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ci byed dam pa'i chos su 'gro ba yis/ /dal rten snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs/ /kun dga'i ngor a zas bris pa dge'o// //ra / /kye lags dzad ni mdzangs pa'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /sku lus gzhon pas thag ring sa mtha' 'khor/ /thugs rig gsal bas mang po mkhyen te mchis/ /brtag dpyad mdzad tshe legs pa gang zhig dgongs/ /tshe gang 'jig rten bya bas brel brel nas/ /zin med ngang la bzhag ste 'gro ba dang / /sgo gsum chos kyi mal du 417

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4 —— sos gdal te/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro gnyis gang la dgyes/ /bya spu bzhin du rlung gis khyer ba dang / /gser thig bzhin du sdod tshugs thub pa gnyis/ /skyid kyi steng nas dam chos byar btub pa/ /su la yod 'dus/ 'dam na gang zhig bzung / /'du 'tsho nang du smra ba lhur len cing / /chags sdang sgom pas rtag tu ngal ba dang / /drang srong gnas su chos kyi bde ba'i ros/ /ngal gso thob dag skyid shos gang du gzigs/ /spyid par ba gang nyid kyi gdan du things/ /sdug por sang gzigs lam kha'i ro bzhin skyur/ /skyid sdug dbye ba zhib mo'i blo yis dpyod/ /bdag ni rgan 'chal bcos gtam smra bar zad/ /sang tshang sprul sku'i gsung ngor bris// //༄/ /rga bas non cing nad kyis nyam thag pa/ /bdag 'dra mthong 'a sa snying po blang rgyu ni/ /rga na 'chi bas gtses pa'i 'khor ba par/ /skyo shas yid 'byung skye las gzhan yod min/ /de phyir lo kyis spun skogs lta bu yi/ /bdag lus mthong la gzas su ma mdzad par/ /de yi snying po lta bu'i skyo shas la/ /goms par bslab nas chos la nan tan mdzod/ /deng sang chags sdang so nam su mkhas la/ /pho skyes mo grung bzang por rtsi na yang / /bdag ltar rga na 'chi bas gtug tsa na/ /dam pa'i chos min cis kyang skyob mi 'gyur/ /ngas kyang lo la dam chos ma bshad min/ /rgyal ba phan 418

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma ma ma mdzad de yis dam chos kyi/ /rtsa ba sdug bsngal sems pa 'dir gsungs pas/ /chos kyi gzhi ma 'di nas tshugs par mdzod/ /'di yang thogs med nges legs gnyis la gdams pa'o// //ra / /gus pas nyon dang zhal gdams don gnyer can/ /gus pa med par gzhung mang thos na yang / /thub pa'i chos la byas sa/zo mi 'byung ste/ /rtog ges dregs pa'i chos dred 'ga' la ltos/ /gus bcas gdams ngag tshig gcig thos na yang / /tshul bzhin bsgrub pas snying po rnyed 'gyur te/ /sngon gyi sems dpa' che rnams yon tan kun/ /chos la gus pa'i rgyu las byung ba yin/ /gus pa de yang phyogs re tsam min par/ /mngon mtho'i chos nas 'od gsal rdzogs pa che'i/ /rgyud sder thug pa'i gdams ngag mtha' dag la/ /sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i gus pa skyed/ /'di na tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bam/ /thun mong thun min lam gyi yul can gyi/ /nan tan srang gi mtho dman 'dra ba phal/ /chos la gus pa phyogs rer song bas nongs/ /de 'dra de yis tshe 'di zad zad du/ /chos la nyams len byed lo bgyis na yang / /bstan pa yongs rdzogs gru bzhi lam me ru/ /rgyud la sbyor ba'i skal ba yod ma yin/ /tshul de bsams nas sngon 'gro dngos gzhi yi/ /lam gyi cha kun rim pa ma nor bar/ /nyams su len la gus pa brtan po ru/ /sgrub 'di zhal gdams 419

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bskrul ba'i lan du gdams/ /maṅga lam// //ra / /'phags mchog lag na ral gri'i zhabs mchod nas/ /thar pa 'dod la gtam gyi skyes shig spro/ /grogs dag dal bas brgyan pa'i lus rten 'di/ /shin tu rnyed dka' u du sba ra 'dra/ /da res phan pa'i chos shig ma mdzad na/ /ngan 'gro'i 'phrang la 'dzeg tshe skrag mo yod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba mang po bsgrubs bsgrubs nas/ /gcer bu lag pa stong par 'chi tsa na/ /gshin rje'i sgra skad snying la brdeg bzhin du/ /phyi ma'i grong khyer chen por 'gro dogs yod/ /da lta ngan 'gro'i sbug bsngal thos gyur kyang / /sems la skad cig tsam yang mi 'jog par/ /rnam g.yeng le lo'i ngang du nyal nyal nas/ /'chi kha brang lag 'thab mo 'byung dogs yod/ /chos brgyad bya ba bsgrub pa'i 'bad rtsol gyis/ /mi tshe gang po yongs su 'das gyur mod/ /lha chos nyin gcig tsam yang mi bsgrub pa'i/ /byed spyod 'di la bsam blo zhib mo thongs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni 'byung bar dka'/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i chos ni 'phrad par dka'/ /'byor pa bcu pa'i lus ni rnyed par dka'/ /da res thod pa 'bor chog byas na legs/ /ston rlom chen po'i gang zag mang mod de/ /khyod la gtan gyi skyabs gnas gzhan zhig med/ /mi bslu tshad ma'i bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /khyed shes blo gtad yul du byas na 120

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1legs/ /'jig rten byis pa'i skye bor gros ma 'dri/ /sdig grogs zog po'i mi la blo ma gtad/ /gcig tu dge ba'i chos la snying ma ring / /rtag tu rang sems dpang por thub pa dgos/ /sngon byon rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar soms/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams thams cad sdom la slobs/ /bag med nyes pa'i spyod la dug ltar 'dzems//sdig grogs skye bo rnams kyis bslus ta re/ /gtam 'di nyams mtshar rtsed mo ma lags te/ /khyod la phan pa'i ngag gis spras pa yin//don 'di sems la phur cig skal bzang dag /ma brjed ma brjed gtam 'di snying la chongs/ /zhes gzhon nu 'jigs med pas so// //ma / /rdzing na med pa yur bar ci zhig 'dren/ /rang gis ma bsgoms gzhan la ci zhig gdams/ /'on kyang lag dal nyi ma ring ba'i gtam/ /cung zad bgyid 'dir rtsed mo'i cho lo mdzod/ /shes mthong mang ba'i rgan nyams yod min yang / /blo nyes ngang la mi tshe song ba'i phyir/ /rang la 'gyod gnas mang du byung ba rnams/ /bshad na khyed kyang bag zon mdzad dam snyam/ /tshul khrims las smon dkar po'i rten 'brel las/ /dal ba rnyed cing bstan dang mjal na yang / /bag med le lo'i ngang la dus dron nas/ /rgas 'di gcig por 'gro tshe skyo ba'i yul/ /dang po bla ma bsten lo mang byas kyang / /bde gshegs chos la gus pa dman pa'i phyir/ /rang rgyud 421

pob 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba chos dang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ma gos chu nang rdo ba bzhin du song / /bar du dam chos nyan lo mang byas kyang / /sprub pa snying por byed 'dod med pa'i phyir/ /rang sems 'dul ba'i bdams ngas ma btsal bar/ /smra mkhas tsam gyi dpal la yid smon byas/ /de nas gdams ngag 'tshol lo mang byas tshe'ang / /chos des rang rgyud 'dul tshul ma shes par/ /zab dgu'i gdams pa gzhan na yod snyam nas/ /yod sar ma bltas med sar btsal bas ngal/ /da lta mdo sngags chos tshul rgya mtsho kun/ /sems rgyud gdul thabs kho nar yid ches kyang / /de la rtse gcig nan tan mi byed par/ /log pa'i yul gyi khol por dus kun 'phyan/ /dam chos ma thos blun rmongs long ba ste/ /thos kyang ma bsam chos dred bsgrub pa'i rgyu/ /'di 'drar 'gyur dogs dam chos mnyan pa dang / /nyan nas sang shes sgrub la brtson par mdzod/ /ne lha'i chos sgrung mdze bo'i khyung sgrub ltar/ /rang blo khrel ba'i chos gtam tshigs bcad 'di/ /dri med 'od zer khyod la me tog gi/ /do shal bzhin du btegs nas bdag bis phul/ /zhes pa sprang rgan bstan pa'i nyi mas bris/ / //ra / /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal bstan lnga brgya tha ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /dam chos dran pa mang ste byed pa dkon/ /theg mchog 'dod pa mang ste shes pa dkon/ /gdams ngag zhu 42 2

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga mkhan mang ste sgrub mkhan nyung / /'on kyang sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i lam gyi gnad/ /dus ngan 'di 'drar thos pa'ang rnyed dka' bas/ /zhi ba'i nags 'dir byang chub sems kyi sgra/ /sgrogs pa'i blo gsal cad la yi rang 'bul//byang chub 'dod pa'i sems la byang chub kyi/ /sems zhes brjod mod byang chub ci yin dang / /de yi yon tan ciyang ma mthong bar/ /byang chub don gnyer tshig tsam zhig tu zad/ /de phyir rgyal ba'i yon tan nyan pa dang / /don de ston pa'i gsung rab blta ba dang / /de yi rjes su lan mang sems byas te/ /dad pa sgo ma 'di sems de'i rtsa ba yin/ /pheg dman byang chub 'dod pas mi g.yo dang / /dka' spyad mtha' yas rnams kyis mi brdzi ba'i/ /byang chub bla med 'dod pa'i snying stobs mthu/ /brtan por skye ba snying rje che la rag /'gro la gces 'dzin koms pa'i blo dang ni/ /de dag sdug bsngal mthong ba'i 'bral 'dod blo/ /zung 'brel sbyangs pas gzhan don khur khyer gyi/ /brtse chen 'byung bar bdag nyid che rnams bzhed/ /de dag sbyong ba'i tshul dang go rim dang //de yi sngon du ji ltar bya ba sogs/ /rgya cher yod kyis brtson pa bskyed mdzod la//tshad ldan mkhas pa'i legs bshad longs la ltos/ /de skad smras 'di khang stong rnga gog bzhin/ /bas mthar kha rog nyal ba'i sprang rgan de/ /rnga gog dbyug pas brdung lhar dbal shul gyi/ /bla mas rna 123

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bar gtser nas gang babs bris// //nga / /lus can phan bde 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ /gnyis med gsung ba'i bstan pa nyag gcig phyir/ /tshul der nyan bshad skrub pa'i bya ba yis/ /lang tsho yol ba 'dun ma'i rtse mo yin/ /khyad par bstan 'di sgrub pa lhur len gyis/ /'phags par gsungs shing thub pas lan mang du/ /sgrub la brtson pa'i yon tan bsngags pa la/ /dgongs nas sgrub pa 'ba' zhig snying por mdzod/ /sa mthor bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras dbang ldan rnams/ /skad cig rer yang zhing mang rdul snyed kyi/ /bde gshegs bstan la bya ba cher mdzad pa/ /de dag rnams kyang sgrub la brtson pa'i mthu/ /de phyir thos pa'i 'o mtsho ni/ /tshul bzhin sems pa'i skya ba yis/ /legs par bsrub nas mngon rtogs kyi/ /mar dkar snying po len par bskrul/ /sarba dza ga tai// //nga / /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnyed dka' dal rten rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /dam chos rnam dag sgrub pa 'dun ma'i rtse/ /gal te de bzhin brtson par ma nus na/ /ya rabs 'jig rten spyod pa'i rjes su zhugs/ /bden zhing brtan la mdzangs shing zhi ba dang //des shing snying brtser ldan pa'i skyes bu ni/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i lam srang la brten nas/ /dam chos 'chi med grong du rim 424

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1gyis 'gro/ /nyes pa sbed cing yon tan zol gyis 'chos/ /gya gyu'i lam du blo gros goms byed cing / /smras pa'i rjes su spyod pa mi 'jug pa/ /de 'dra spong ba bden par gnas zhes bya/ /'jis/ rten dpang rgya gtam dang mna' tho dang / /rgan rabs 'khur dang dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /dan pa'i gnas lnga 'di las mi g.yo ba'i/ /skye bo de dag brtan pa'i yon tan can/ /rang nyid lugs la mkhas shing bya bzhag la/ /mkhas pa gzhan yang legs par bsten byas te/ / bzang po'i lam srol zhib mor dpyod nus pa/ /ma 'dzings ma 'khrugs mdzangs pa'i blo ldan yin/ /rgyan po 'gyed dang bzhad gad shags 'gyed sogs/ /rtag tu sdom pa'i nye bar zhi ba ni/ /zab cing gting dpag dka' ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /'khor gyi dbus na mchog tu brjid par gsungs/ /'jig rten ya rabs spyod pa'i gzhi gcig pu//des shing 'jam pa yin te de yod na/ /skye bo'i glang chen 'grogasaXn bde ba yi/ /yon tan lcags kyus mod la dbang du byed/ /gsod dang 'phrog sogs gzhan la 'tshe ba yi/ /bsam sbyor spangs nas bzod dang gtong ba sogs/ /snying rje'i ngang tshul ldan pa'i kun spyod la/ /gcig tu gzhol ba 'di phyir dge ba yin/ /rang mgo mi thon rogs la ci zhig gdams/ /'on kyang dgos pa yod snyam bris pa min/ /khyod kyis bskul ba'i nan ngo mi bzlog ched/ / 426

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ —thol byung rtog pa'i bya rjes shog bur bkod// //༄/ /rmos kyin dul ba sems kyi zhing sa yin/ /btab kyin skye ba dge ba'i sa bon yin/ /spyad kyin 'phel ba chos kyi lo thog yin/ /so nam mdzod dang je bas je phyug 'ong / /dang po sa rbod rengs pa 'dul thabs gces/ /blo ldos rnam bzhi yin gyis yun du sring / /de nas sa bon ma nor 'debs pa gces/ /byang chub sems sbyong yin gyis srog tu zungs/ /mthun rkyen drod snye zung du 'dzom pa gces/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong yin gyis yang yang bslab/ /zhing mtha' ra ba brtan pos srung ba gces/ /tshul khrims yin gyis zhis ral ma song bya/ /dus dang dus su yur ma yur ba gces/ /bde sdug gtong len yin kyis mang du sgom/ /mdor na sems bskyed yi dam mthil du 'dzin/ /spyod pa rgya mtshos sems bskyed rtsal sbyang 'bad/ /jeg chen gzhung lam yin no lam phran min/ /gsang sngags ba rten yin no lam gzhan min/ /sngon 'gro'i gdams ngag yin no don chung min/ /bla ma mnyes shing dbang bskur rdzogs pa dang / /dam tshig zol med sgrub la brtson pa yis/ /man ngag bzhin du snying po'i don la sbyong / /man ngag med par bsam gtan gzugs med kyi/ /ting 'dzin tsam yang 'grub par mi 'gyur na/ /bsam gyis mi khyab so so rang rig yul/ /pho tshod tsam gyis 'jal ba spyo 'gros yin/ /‘126

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1pa gsang sngags byin rlabs lam zhes yongs su grags/ /rang rgos ma bsgoms dred po kha bshad mkhan/ /bdag 'dras zab zab mang po bshad na yang / /byin rlabs bcud bral tshig gi lbu bar zad/ /de slad brgyud pa rin chen sel med cing // /nyams len byin rlabs rtogs pa'i tsha drod can/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhal gsung bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /'thung la sems kyi zungs su theb nges mdzod/ /gter gyi kha byang lta bu'i tshig rkang ni/ /sems kyi ngo bo rjen par mthong ba dang / /mthong nas cog bzhag gnad kyis skyong ba dang / /gebs sel bogs 'don chig chod byed pa'o/ /de skad 'jigs med dbang drag des bskul nas/ /rdo rgan 'chal bas yid la sang bab bris/ /dge'o// //pa / /lam gyi rtsa ba nges 'byung sems bskyed sgoms/ /rtsa ba med par yal ga ci las skye/ /lam gyi snying po mtha' bral lta ba skyongs/ /snying po med pa'i yal ga ci ru rung / /lam kyi mthar thug 'od gsal rdzogs chen tshol/ /mthar thug ma rnyed ring lam nyi tshe ba/ /'on kyang mthar thug ma rnyed ring lam yod/ /grol lam ma rnyed gong na smin lam yod/ /smin lam bor ba'i grol lam ltar snang ba/ /thun mong bskyur ba'i gseng lam gzugs brnyan tsam/ /de phyir mgo bo med pa'i mjug ma las/ /mjug ma med pa'i mgo bo ba'i ra shes 4 27

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byos/ /de nas rim gyis thog mtha' bar gsum cha/ /yongs rdzogs theg mchog lus bzang rgyas par 'gyur// //nga / /legs tshogs brgya las legs 'ong lha yi tshul/ /skal bzang bsod nams skal bar sa steng 'ongs/ /yid bzhin 'byor bas yid rab 'phrog byed pa/ /gang 'dir gnas pa gang yin de rab dga'/ /bya ba bsnyung zhing bya ltar gsog 'jog bral/ /'du 'dzi'i nang ltar 'du 'god brtsi ba'ang med/ /ci ltar byas kyang ci nas blo bde ba/ /dben pa'i mal du dben gsum sgom rnams bde//zla med zla ba bzhin du gcig pur mjos/ /nor spangs nor dus mi mtshon chog shes gter/ /'dod chung 'dod lha'i mdas kyang mi phig pa/ /bsams shing bsam na bsam gtan spyod rnams bde/ /stobs ldan stobs med lta bur gzhan dbang song / /sna la sna tshogs mtshon btags dgra 'joms pa'i/ /glang chen glang rdzis btul ba'i tshul soms dang / /chen po'i che thob 'di yang snying po chung / /da ni da lta nyid nas blo sna bstung / /su bsam su zer dbang du mi gtong bar/ /rang drin rang chod nges pa'i dam chos zhig /e byed mi byed rang la rag las so////nga / /snying nas byang chub 'dod na 'di 'dra dgos/ /jeg mchog dge ba'i bshes la bsten pa dgos/ /bsten nas gdams 428

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ngag tshul bzhin blang ba dgos/ /gdams don sgrub pa snying por byed pa dgos/ /dgos pa gsum dang ldan na 'tsheng ste mchi/ /bla ma dam pa dod gsal gyi gsung ngor bris// //ra / /kye lags rnam grol bde ba don gnyer na/ /rnam dag thar lam blta ba'i sgron me che/ /thub pa'i legs bshad mang du thos pa gces/ /thos pa'i chos la snying po len byed pa/ /tshul bzhin sems pa'i sbyor ba bsten pa gces/ /yon tan mi nyams gong du 'phel ba'i gzhi/ /dam pa'i mgon la bsten yun ring ba gces/ /gces pa'i gnad la gces spras chen por mdzod/ /blo gsal dam pa dpal dbyangs kyi bzhed pa ltar bris// //ra / /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs chu bo'i rlabs ltar g.yo/ /'khor ba mtshan mo'i nags klong rgyu bar dka'/ /lan cig rnyed pa'i dal rten rin chen 'dir/ /gtan 'dun 'chugs med bsgrub na mi legs sam//don gnyer can gyi ngor bris// //ra / /rgyal bas tshul khrims yon tan gzhi mar gsungs/ /bag med nyes pa kun gyi rten du gsungs/ /de slad khyod kyi bag yod goms mdzad cing / /tshul khrims mig bzhin bsrung la 'bad 'tshal lo/ /tshwa na bha dra'i ngor bris te phul// //ma / /yon tan rten gzhi tshul khrims yin gsungs kyang / /429

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma tshul khrims mi shes lta ba mtho snyam du/ /rten med nam mkhar nyal ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /rmongs pas ngo mtshar byed pa mang po yod/ /de 'dra mang bas ngo mtshar mi che mod/ /tshul khrims nor bu'i phem skas legs btsugs te/ /srid na gnas kyang zhi ba'i lam phyin pa'i/ /skal bzang de dag mkhas pa'i ngo mtshar gnas/ /khyod kyis ngo mtshar snga ma ma mdzad par/ /ngo mtshar byed pa'i lam srang gnyis pa 'dir/ /blo rtse gcig tu dril la bsten mdzad na/ /ngo mtshar yon tan rim gyis rnyed par 'gyur/ /dme ngo mtshar la bris// / /༄/ /gom re bzhin yang yar song na/ /mthon po'i ri rtser bud nas 'gro/ /nyin re bzhin du blo bcos na/ /yon tan tshogs kyis je mthor 'gro/ /thog so stong sga rtser gnas kyang / /lceb na g.yang la ltung bar 'gyur/ /dge sbyor mang po byas snyam yang / / bsam nyes gcig bis thur du 'gro/ /ri gzar ngos kyi rbab rdo ltar/ /yar 'jen 'bad nas bya dgos dang / /thur du 'bad med 'gro ba 'di/ /'khor ba'i sems can spyi yi lugs/ /nor dang bud med 'du 'dzi sogs/ /skyid du bsgom nas sdug 'og 'dzul/ /mar me lang tsho rgyas pa dang / /rtse'o snya ma nas phye leb 'chi/ /gang dang gang la 'khor ba pa/ /dga' ba'i gnas de thur 'gro'i rgyu/ /'byung pos zin rnams yid 'ong yul/ /mthong ba 'gag grir 'chi ba'i ltas/ /430

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1log pa'i yul la goms pa'i sems/ /glod na mi bzang bzung na bzang / /spyon pa g.yang sa nyul ba de/ /mngag na mi legs bkyig na legs/ /'dun ma legs nyes mtha' la ltos/ /gnas skabs legs kyang ltar snang tsam/ /srin mo'i gling gi tshong pa yang 'phral la nyams dga' lta bur gnas/ /re zhig skyid skyid mi 'dra yang / /nam phugs legs pa'i chos de zungs/ /nad med bde ba 'dod pa yis//skyug bro'i sman yang bsten la soms/ /dam pa'i rnam thar rjes su slobs/ /bslabs nas ma lob gcig yod min/ /drang srong gnas pa'i nags khrod kyi/ /ne tso'ang rig byed 'don zhes thos/ /rang blo chos lam ma tshud na/ /phyi tshul bzang yang rtag mi thub/ /sna chad lha yi 'bag lhon pa/ /mdzes mdzes 'dra yang ga la bden/ /chos byed rgyal po'i bla ma ste/ /sdig spyod bud med khol po yin/ /skyid po 'dod na dmyal ba dang / /bde 'gro'i lam sne nor mi rung / /'dod pa'i bde ba khyi la'ang yod/ /chos kyi bde ba 'phags pa'i nor/ /mtho ris bdud rtsi'i zas can lha/ /grong mtha'i rus gong ci la bsdu//rang nyid nyes par spyod mthong yang / /ngo tsha med na cir mi sems/ /de phos 'khrig pa mi sbed pa/ /ngo tsha bral ba'i rnam 'gyur yin/ /ngo tsha bor na bya ba dang / /bya min zhes bya ci yang med/ /khye rgan sna rdzi shor ba la/ /bza' dang bza' min dbye ba ci/ /snyigs dus mi 431

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstanas nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams ngo tsha'i gos/ /bor ba spobs pa mtho bar brtsi/ /tsu ta'i yul du rkang pa gnyis/ /ma tshang gzugs bzang yin par sems/ /ngo tsha yod na rang sems las/ /gzhan du slob dpon btsal mi dgos/ /rta mchog cang shes 'gro ba la/ /lcag tshan brdab nas bskul mi dgos/ /chos kyi srog mkhar tshul khrims te/ /srung thabs ngo tsha shes pa bzang / /khyem na gces pa bu chung ste/ /srung mkhan ma ma bzang mo dgos/ /sangs rgyas gsung rgyun zegs ma yin/ /nyams su len na zhal gdams yin/ /mi len kha mtshar rtsed mo yin/ /gang yang bkra shis dpal 'bar shog/ //ma / /nyer len phung po'i re hrul la/ /sems can rmongs pa skyid snang skyes/ /chos kyis phongs pa'i mru ge yis/ /bde skyid sha phri rus la thug /spyi sems che ba'i mi mchog cig /dka' spyad brgya yis thag ring bgrod/ /kun mkhyen rin chen gling du son/ /'gro mgon shākya'i bla mar grags/ /de ni dam chos 'bru nor gyi/ /pham phab sa la shong dka' ba/ /bsnams nas mi mjed 'dzam gling 'dir/ /ba/dul bya'i tshogs la snyoms par bkyes/ /blang na mang po thob 'gyur te/ /dor na gcig kyang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /de slad dga' ston chen po 'dir/ /ba bo skal yod med sna tshogs byung / /rnam dpyod lag pa ring na bzang / /dad pa'i slong phor che na dga'/ /43 2

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1slong la skyo dub med pa gces/ /'di gsum ldan na phyug po 'ong / /rnam dpyod bslab na skye 'gyur zhing / /dad pa sbyang na 'phel 'gyur te/ /bslab sbyang 'bad pa la gnas pas/ /gsum po'i nang na brtson 'grus gtso/ /gad thog lhun pos sems la gang shar cig bris zer bar a mtshar bris nas phul// //ba / /phun tshogs tshangs dbyangs bdud rtsi'i snang bas/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i gdung ba 'phrog mdzad/ /dpal ldan shākya'i rigs kyi zla ba/ /de yis khyod la dge legs sprul cig /nyon dang shar phyogs bsam sa'i yul gyi/ /dad ldan 'gyur med rdo rje'i ming can//gtad chos re sa gzhan na med kyis/ /blo rtse dam pa'i chos la dril dang / /bslu brid sgyu ma'i rtsed 'jor yengs ltar/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng za zi'i ngang du/ /mi tshe phal cher song nas gda' yis/ /chos shig byed na byed ran 'dug go/ /thog ma med nas skye shi brgyud kyang / /rgyal bstan mjal ba da res tsam yin/ /thengs shis rnyed pa'i dal 'byor rten 'di/ /chud zos song na mi phangs srid dam/ /btsan phyug skyid dar 'dzoms pa'i che dgu/ /kun kyang gcig pur sgren mo lag stong / /dbang med 'jig rten pha rol song ba'i/ /tshul 'di soms la blo sna snyungs dang / /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs kun tu/ /skyid sdug ce 'ong las kyis shes te/ /rang byas las la 433

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstad nyi'i gsung 'bum/mdzub mo bkug tshe/ /mi 'jigs snyam pa'i blo rtse ci 'dug /tshe lhag lug gi mjug ma tsam 'di/ /ji ltar byas kyang phyid nas 'gro ste/ /shul ring 'jig rten phyi mar slebs dus/ /skyid pa'i 'dun ma legs pa dka' 'o/ /dka' 'o snyam pa'i ngang la bsdad na/ /ci yang ma nus ngang du shi yong / /blang dor ji ltar nus bzhin byas na/ /nyin bzhin shes rgyud chos kyis gang yong / /da lta rmongs pa mgo 'phang mtho dus/ /chos byed pas kyang sdig byed brin te/ /nam zhig chos min cis kyang bslu bar/ /thog tu khel ba'i dus shig yong gis/ /dad dang snying stobs dpa' mdzangs rtsal shugs/ /ci yod chos kyi phyogs su sprugs nas/ /chos dang lhan cig bde nas bde bar/ /'gro ba'i mi de rgod po'i yang rtse/ /rgyal dbang bden pa gsung ba de yis/ /chos kun smon lam rtsa ba can du/ /gsungs phyir blo ldog bzhi nas brtsams te/ /'od gsal rdo rje rtse mo'i bar gyi/ /lam bzang mtha' dag tshang la ma nor/ /bo/ rim ma 'khrugs ji bzhin nyid du/ /skye dang gnas dang 'phel ba'i don phyir/ /rnam dag smon lam rgyun du thob dang / /smon lam 'grub pa'i rgyu yi gtso bo/ /tshul khrims nyag gcig yin par gsungs pas/ /tshul khrims kun gyi dang po'i sgor gyur/ /mi dge bcu spong 'bad nas slobs dang / /kun spyod bsdam pa'i lus ngag rnam rig /tshul khrims srung ba'i sgo 434

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga tsam yin kyang / /khrims kyi ngo bo sdom sems brtan pa/ /kho na yin gyis rtsa ba ma 'bor/ /gnyid dang mi lam sad pa'i dus kun/ /'di 'dra'i dge sbyor gtsang mar sres dang / /nam zhig 'chi kha bar do'i tshe yang / /chos kyi bag chags sad nas 'ong gis/ /rang cag chos la 'bad lo byas kyang / /rdo rbab ri rtser skyel ba'i dpe bzhin/ /gyen 'gro dka' zhing bag re'i rkyen gyis/ /dka' tshegs med par thur du ltung bas/ /bsten na mi bslu dkon mchog rnam gsum/ /'di phyi'i blo gtad khong la zhus dang / /zin nas mi 'chor thugs rje'i lcags kyus/ /smon pa'i gnas su drang nas 'gro yis/ /sngon chad bde skyid 'byor ba gang byung / /dkon mchog kho na'i bka' drin yin cing / /da dung yon tan che skye chung 'grub/ /rtsa ba dkon mchog min pa med kyis/ /dus rnams kun tu mchog/ gsum ma brjed/ /gcig chob re lhos khong la bcol nas/ /mi 'gyur dad pa'i gser sbyang maṇ+ḍal/ /g.yel med nyin mtshan rgyun du phul cig /gdams ngag rgyud dang 'byor ba dgos kyi/ /sna kha mang ba'i steng na mi 'dug/gal chen tshig gcig lan dgur bzlas 'di/ /soms la thugs kyi ze'u 'brur chongs mdzod/ /skye zhing skye ba'i phreng ba kun tu/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i gdugs dkar bsil grib/ /bu khyod gtan bde'i ngal 'tsho rnyed par/ /sras bcas rgyal bas byin gyis rlobs 36

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/shig /de skad spo mtho'i nags tshal khrod nas/ /sprang rgan mdo med bstan pa'i nyi mas/ /phan sems zla ba'i mdangs ltar dkar bas/ /bris 'di dge ba'i gsos su gyur cib/ //ra / /pha kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i zhabs rdul mchod/ /dus lan gcig dpyid ka'i nyi ring la/ /grogs la las shog byang re gtad nas/ /'di'i ngos la zhal gdams 'bri dgos zer/ /lar gzhan rgyud gdams pas 'dul mkhan de/ /rang gdams don cung zad sgrub pa dgos/ /don de phyir ne tso chos smra lta'i/ /grogs 'chal ba nga 'drar ma bsnyen ang / /rten mtshan nyid kun lda na bla mas kyang / /yul snod min 'gro ba mi thul bas/ /rang dam pa'i gdul byar byed snyam na/ /rgyud dad brtson blo yis legs par sbyongs/ /lus bla ma'i chos gral mang phyin yang / /sems chos kyi tshos khas ma phog pa/ /'di bang thos rgyud dang sbyar snyam pa'i/ /blo'i 'chos tshul gzhi nas sto ra bas nongs/ /rgyud chos la 'khul du mi btub cing / /chos byas tshad gtan bde'i 'dun ma ru/ /'gror mi ster ltas ngan 'ug pa'i gdong / /dgra chos brgyad 'gong por gdong bzlog thongs/ /sngon smar shod byis pa lo lnga'i gzugs/ /dus deng sang dar yol skra dkar can/ /nga khyod kyis mthong lugs gnyis byung ba'i/ /dpe 'dis kyang rga shi'i 'gyur ba soms/ /tshul de bzhin khyod kyang na 436

zhal gdams phyobs bsdus/ ngo da 1mthor slebs/ /dgra 'chi bdag rgyal po je nyer 'ong / /las byas pa chud zar mi 'gro bas/ /tshe phyi ma'i don la rtog dpyod thongs/ /lam zeg mchog rtsa ba sems bskyed de/ /sems de yi rtsa ba snying rje che/ /blo 'di gnyis yod na gang byas sla/ /chos gces dgu'i snying po ma nor mdzod/ /dgos sangs rgyas theg pa'i rgyal mtshan tog /dpal rdo rje rtse mo'i gsang lam nas/ /grol 'dod na sems de gces spras kyis/ /rten dam tshig sdom pa rnam dag srungs/ /mgon bla ma'i byin brgyud snying dbus su/ /rkyen mos gus drag po'i mtshams sbyor gyis/ /dbang med du 'gugs pa'i gnad shes na/ /lam rdzogs chen rtogs la dka' ba chung / /gshis gdod nas dag pa'i 'od gsal dang / /yum sher phyin zab mo'i nyams myong gnyis/ /thabs cog bzhag 'khyil ba'i man ngag gis/ /sre nus pa rnal 'byor dbang po yin/ /dbyings ka dag bzhon nu bum sku'i klong / //mdangs lhun grub sgron bzhi'i snang cha yis/ /zab rgya che'i dga' ston 'byams klas pa/ /dus rtag tu 'gyed la rtsal sbyong mdzod/ /dbyangs de ska da kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i gsung / /blo dad pa'i bras rir phrad pa las/ /rang nus pa med kyang gzhan dbang gis/ /sgra brnyan du grags pa dge gyuraXcig /smar 'phrang gnyis bar gyi ban+de thos bsam zer ba rang nyid byis par gyur pa'i dusaXkyi grogs pos bskul nas sprang 437

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i kyi gsung 'bum/'chal bstan pa'i nyi mas bris pa mad lo// //ba / /dam pa'i ngang tshul ma smad pa'i/ /mchog sprul zla ba'i gtsug phud can/ /de la byis pa'i khyab 'jug zhig /gtam gyi me tog gsar pas mchod/ /'di na ston chen chos brgyad mkhan/ /chu rdul bzhin du mang mod de/ /de dag rnams kyi gral na khyod/ /nam yang bzhugs par mi mdzad gsol/ /'phags pa'i rnam thar med bzhin du/ /grags skam ri lung brdal gyur kyang / /snying po med pa'i than snye bzhin/ /blang bar bya ba ma lags so/ /'dod lha'i nyag phran mde'u rdo/ /sdig pa'i grogs po bslu thabs che/ /rnam par rtog pa 'brid pa sla/ /de bas thugs ni sgrim por gsol/ /blo gros ri rab ltar brtan zhing / /dgongs pa phyogs mtha'i mtsho bzhin zab/ /de la g.yon can bdud kyi sdes/ /glags skabs rnyed par tsho ba min/ /kun spyod nges pa ma mchis dang / /gtam la yid brtan mi rung dang / /blo rtse du mar g.yo ba la/ /ma rabs grags pa thag mi ring / /sgam zhing dbang po bsdam pa dang //khrel bag smad par ma gyur pa/ /de la ya rabs dam pa'i tshul/ /gan na 'dug pa kho na lags/ /gang na gzhon dang mi gzhon dang / /nor gyis 'byor dang ma 'byor mi/ /kun la thugs ni snyoms mdzad na/ /kun gyis ma ltar bkur bar 'gyur/ /gzur gnas thugs kyis dpyod las gzhan/ /phyogs su 438

zhalas gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1yang lhung ba'i skye bo la/ /thugs ni ha cang rton mdzad na/ /zla ba gza' yis zin ltar 'gyur/ /rnam par rgod cing gsar ngas che/ /shes rab rtsing zhing bab col che/ /de yis snyan pa min pa'i tshig /rin gyis nyos pa 'ba' zhig lags/ /'jig rten gnas la mi chags bzhin/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug ltar ston pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che'i/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i bye brag yin/ /'jig rten spyod la mkhas gyur kyang / /dam pa'i spyod lam ma gzigs pa/ /khyod kyi rnam thar mi 'os kyis/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul mkhyen mdzad gsol/ /srid rtsa rmang nas 'jig pa'i thabs/ /zab mo dpyad gsum dag pa'i lam/ /khyod kyis thos shing dgongs mdzad de/ /chos kyi spyan ldan chen po mdzod/ /yang dang yang du thos pa tshol/ /rtag par rgyun du thos pa sten/ /thabs tshul du mas thos pa skyed/ /thos pas khyod nyid mkhas par byed/ /ji ltar mang du gsan pa bzhin/ /dngos stobs rigs pa gong du spel/ /ji ltar nges shes skyes pa bzhin/ /bsgom pa'i shes rab mthar phyin mdzod/ /rang gi thugs su chud pa'i don/ /zang zing med par gzhan la ston/ /gzhan la dge ba'i chos ston na/ /khyod nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen lags/ /de slad khyod kyis tshul 'di la/ /ci nas dran pa mngon du zhog /don 'di thugs la bstem pa zhig 1thal mo sbyar te gsol ba lags/ /439

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/zhes pa'ang 'jigs med pas so// //pa / /sbyor ba sems skyed dam pa zer rgyu de don rtsar/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod bcos min gyi sems bskyed de yin/ de yang 'di ltar/ rang nyid ma gtogs pa'i sems can yod tshad po thams cad 'khor pa'i ya mtha' thug med nas bzung ste/ da lta'i bar du rang re'i pha dang ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med la/ pha mar gyur nas kyang drin chen pos bskyangs/ zas kyi phud byin/ gos kyi rtses g.yogs/ byams shing brtse bas bsos pa sha stag yin/ de lta bu'i drin chen gyi 'gro ba de dag thams cad zhe 'dod la bde ba 'dod mkhan kho na ma gtogs/rkang lag la tsher ma zug pa tsam gyi sdus bsngal 'dod mkhan med kyi/phal cher mi dge ba'i lam ngan 'ba' zhig la spyod cing / gzhan rnams ngan song gi sdus bsngal kho nas dus 'da' bar 'dug pas 'di rnams snying re rje zhes ma gcig po'i bu sdug bzhin du snying rje chen po la blo bzhag /ga re bdag gis dal 'byor gyi lus rten thob/theb pa chen po'i chos dang mjal ba'i skal bzang 'di lta bu thob dus 'dir sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig thob nges bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo nyan nas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /bsam par bya'o/ /440

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa ni/ shes bya'i chos thams cad rang gi ngos nas grub pa rdul tsam yang med de/ yul la ltos nas yul can gyi shes pa btags/ yul can la brten nas yul zhes phar btags/ de ltar phar btags tshul btags pa yin pa ma gtogs med pas/ btags gzhi de la don dam dpyod byed kyis brtags na rnyed rgyu phra mo yang mi 'dug par thag bcad de/snang ba lam lam po 'di smig rgyu dang mig yol bzhin du rten 'byung gi rang bzhin du thag bcad par bya'o/ /rjes la bsngo ba dam pa ni/ dus gsum du bsags tshar ba dang /bsag par 'gyur ba dang / gsog gin yod pa gang yang rung ste/dge ba'i las la che/ zhig yin tshad po sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob pa'i ched du bsngo byed zer kyang rung / gyur byed zer kyang 'dra ste/ de 'dra'i 'dun pa de la bsngo ba dam pa zer ba yin/ mdor na dam pa gsum ka shes pa ste de la mdzub bu 'dzugs shes dgos/ de ltar dam pa gsum gyis zin na dge ba bsgrub na sgrub tshad po theg pa chen po'i lam yin/ skyes bu chen po'i bsod nams tshad med pa'i 'jug ngo ṭa yin/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi dngos rgyur 'gyur ba yin pas ci nus kyang u ru nu ru shi ru sgu ru 'chug mi nyan pa 441

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med stan nyi'i gsung 'bum/lags/ra / /lags bla ma sangs rgyas su blta lugs mang yang / gtso bor bla mas 'o skol la ston pa'i gsung rab kyi don 'chad pa de bla ma'i thugs la sangs rgyas zhugs pas yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis ma brlab par rgyal pa'i gsung rab 'chad mi nus shing / de tsa na bla ma kho rang sangs rgyas yin rung min rung 'o cab/ la gdams ngag ston pa de rgyal ba nyid du nges pa rnyed nas bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyis sbu rten pa dang lha bab pa bzhin du shes na des chog /gzhan 'u cab gi sems rgyud skal ba ngan pa sngon 'das pa'i rgyal ba khri phrag gis kyang ma thul bar bzhag pa de bla mas chos bshad/gdams ngag gnang ste khyi mir gtong mkhan de drin che/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'jig rten thams cad kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes yin mod kyi/ las ma dag pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snang mi thub pa yin te/ ston pa bzang grogs zhes grags/ bla ma ni ltobs pa'i dus su zan byin pa ltar snyigs ma'i dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa yin pas sku drin che/ gzhan yang /'di yi don ldan 'ga' zhig la/ nga nyid de yi lus gnas te zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus la zhugs nas mchod pa sogs len par mang du bshad pas mos gus bla ma'i rnal 44 2

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1'byor la yi dam du mdzad par rigs so//'jigs med pas so//pa / /na tsha lam du khyer ba la rab 'bring tha gsum ste/ rab na tsha zug gzer drag po de ka bzo bcos su ma song par rang thog tu lhod nas bzhag pas nad kyi ngo bo stong nyid spros bral du shar ba'o//'bring na tsha zug gzer drag po de ka'i thog tu sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon bsdus nas lam du khyer bas nyon mongs pa dang mnyam du chod nas dge sbyor gyi grogs su shar ba'o/ /tha mas na tsha sngon gyi lan chags su shes nas nad la phan pa'i thabs mi byed par zhe sdang gi yul du mi 'dzin pas dkon mchog gi thugs rje ru shes nas sdig sgrib dag pa'o//nga / /rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems zhes bya ba khams sa/sum bde sdug gi/ /sgyu ma sna tshogs bzo ba'i byed po 'di//rtsad gcod med par ltar snang ci mdzes la re ba'i chos byed chos la mgo bo 'khor/ /de phyir rtsad gcod sems la gtang ba'i thabs/ /rtog pa'i rba rlabs zhi bar gnas byas nas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin lhag par mthong ba'i sgo/ /zab cing ngo mtshar bla ma'i ngag las 'byung / /'on kyang sems kyi ko ba mnye tshul dang / /mnyes nas shes rab zab mo'i bzo khyad la/ /'jug pa'i man ngag ji bzhin mi shes par/ /ri bong stag mchong byas pas lhung nyen yod/ /443

ngo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga tshul de bsam nas rang gi rgyud tshod dang / /'tshams pa'i gdams ngag nges par don gnyer na/ /blo ldog rnam bzhi'i sgrom nas 'khor 'das kyi/ /spang blang bslab nas rang sems mel tshe bya/ /yod rung nyer mkho chung ba'i kha dog dbyibs/ /med bzhin 'tshol ba'i sbub/ rus phar zhog la/ /med na thabs chag dbe ba'i dran shes la/bkol du yod bzhin so nam mi chung kyis/ /rang sems gnyug ma rang gis mi shes bzhin/ /sems kyi de nyid gzhan la ji ltar 'chad//shes sla don ldan dge ba'i bskul tshig 'di/ /smar rong sna la'i yul gyi dbe mar gdams/ /'jigs med pas so//nga / /bstan pa'i de nyid legs par shes pa'i mi/ /sto na ka'i dus mjug slebs pa'i sa drod ltar/ /zad pa'i dus 'dir dge tshogs smin min gyi/ /rnam dbye med par lta ba mtho rnyab byed/ /shes mi mang yang nyams len rgyas mi nus/ /sbyangs pa dman yang rang gi tshod mi shes/ /grol lam ma rnyed smin lam skor mgo med/ /rmongs pa'i u tshugs bya bzung lag pa stong / /grub pa'i skyes bu mang pos ches bsngags pa'i/ /man ngag dmar 'jus byas kyang rang rgyud la/ /'khul pa'i tshos mdangs sna gcig ma 'gyur de/ /rten 'brel rtsa ba 'chugs pa'i la yog yin//'khor 'das stong nyid dbyings su rgyas 'debs pa'i/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i de nyid las/ /mthon 444

zhal gdams pyobs bsdus/ pod 1nga po'i go 'phang bsgrod la tshegs med phyir/ /blo sto bas chen po yod na brtson la bsgom/ /med na sdar ma'i dpa' skad ma 'then dang / /thabs mkhas thugs rje che ba'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /chos la sgom rgyus phongs pa mi 'ong gis/ /rang blor 'tshams pa'i dge sbyor rem la gyis/ /'khor ba snying po med kyis zhen log bsgom/ /byin rlabs bslu ba med kyis skyabs 'gror 'bod/ /zab chos rtsod med yin gyis ma ṇi bgrong / /chos kyi nying khu yin gyis sems bskyed sbyongs/ / go ba med na mdo rgyud chos bshad kyang / /gzhung lugs gdams par mi 'char chos dred rgyu/ /nyan shes can la nyin kha'i kha bdal yang / /don ldan snang ba dpe char shar zhes zer/ /de'i phyir bstan pa'i nyi mas thru gtam bris//nga / /'gu log dge 'dun zhal nas/ /gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad dam/ /yang na glu tshig gang bab/ /mdor na sang dran ngab cig /spros zhes shog byang ldeb ma/ /bskur ma'i tshul du byin pa/ /sprang po'i dpyid ka'i nyi ma/ /ring ba'i nam zla 'phul thabs/ /gnang ba bka' drin che zhing / /dran tshad kha nas lab pa'i smra 'dod gtam gyi zhen pa/ /ha cang sems la 'thas pas/ /bshad rgyus phongs pa'i gnas skabs/ /gleng slong gsung gi bdud rtsi/ /ma snyan rgyu zhig med mod/ /skor gcig long skabs med phyir/ /mtha' 446

zad 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma dag bri khom ma byung / /ya gi grub pa'i zhing na/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba/ /gang snang bde stong rol bar/ /rtogs pa'i chang gis myos pa'i/ /nyams rtsal rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs/ /tshigs rkang re re'i khong na/ /zab don rgyud sde'i brjod bya/ /ngo mtshar brgya dang bcas par/ /'char pa'i nyams 'gyur rdzogs pa/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud/ /lhod por grol pa'i shugs kyis/ /'bad med ngang gis 'jo ba'i/ /lo rgyus thos myong yod de/ /rtogs pa nang na med pa'i/ /do ha kha nas 'chad rgyu/ /de 'dra yod thabs med pas/ /nga dang nga 'dra'i spyod yul/ /yin lugs gtan nas mi 'dug /ma gi grong mtha'i thang na/ /stag shar dngul rna can dang / /sman phran g.yu gtsug ldem pa/ /dbyar ka'i me tog lta dur/ /yud tsam zhig tu mdzes pa'i/ /mi rtag la sogs 'gyur ba/ /rtag cing gtsang bar bzung nas/ /sha khrag pags mdangs gsar ba/ /shar nub nam mkha'i ngos su/ /rgyu skar snang ba bzhin tu/ /phan tshun ngom res byed cing / /zhe 'dod glu ru len pa'i/ /nyam dga' byung rgyal skyong ba/ /mthong thos gnyis ka yod de/ /ngur smrig 'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan/ /snal ma ser po'i sked chings/ /'di dag khrel dang ngo tsha/ /'gran pa lta bur bskul ba'i/ /rtags su mngon sum 'dzin bzhin/ /de 'dra smra bar sus nus/ /nges med rgyal khams yul na/ /gdams pa 'di 446

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1bsgom med cing / /nyams len 'di byas med par/ /dngos grub chu 'bur rdol rdol/ /grub rtags thogs rdugs med pa'i/ /grub thob kha min mngar min/ /chib rta g.yu rngog 'jol mo'i/ /rgyab bstad gser sga'i steng na//gar chang ngar ma'i skyem gyis/ /thugs nyams 'ur ba'i ngang das/ /nya ma'i so dkar 'tsho zhing / /byung rgyal mgur du bzhengs pa'i/ /dbyangs bdun nyams kyi 'gyur bas/ /stong sde'i yid kha 'phrogs rung / /kha lce'i sgyu rtsal zhan cing / /thabs mkhas skor mgo mi shes/ /ldem dgongs sna tshogs smra ba'i//dpral ko 'thug po med stabs/ /der yang nged tsho mi mkhas/ /rang gi mthu dang sbyar na/ /da nang zas su ci zos/ /do dgong rtog pa ci shar/ /de dang de sogs bshad na/ /zad pa'i mtha' zhig med de/ /thog med 'khor ba'i dus nas/ /sdug kun snga phyi brgyud ma'i/ /tshul 'di 'khor ba'i grong la/ /skyo shas bskul pa'i grogs su/ /kun mkhyen zhal nas gsungs phyir/ /nyams dga' yin rgyu mi 'dug /khyed rang nyams mtshar bzhed la/ /rang nyams mtshar bos dben pa'i/ /med rabs mug rabs glu 'di/ /dge bar gyur cig swā hā/ /'jigs med pas nyams mtshar du bris// //ra / /bya ba legs nyes rang la yang srid cing nyes zin bcos su med pas gyod brdal ma mang / mtha' ma cir 'gyur mi shes 'phral 47

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/du go ma chod rung/ phugs su bzang byed sus byed mi shes pas pas gzhan la bstod smad dang nga bzang gi kha pho ma snga/ mi'i rgyud tshod tshad kyis mi thig cing 'khon gzhi rang rtsa nas ldang bas gnyen nye ba yin rung kha ma song na lag rgyag pa lta bu'i thag chod dbang che dang /bran tha ma la yang 'bar 'thab drag po/ snying 'dris kyi grogs po la'ang zer chog gi tshar bcad ma mang / mi lam du mi tshud pa'i rgyu gcig gces pa lang shor yin pas gnyen la byams ma thal/dgras bskos thang dang mi mthun pa'i sdug yus dang / mi 'tshams pa'i gnod 'tshe ma byed/ yus can gyi mjug ma nyes can du 'gro zhing / dgra la sdug snying je cher 'gro bas phar bskos kyi mjug ma tshur log /skyid sdug dang dal khom gyi nyams la mi lta bar thog rdzis kyi mngag gzhug dang slong mo ma byed/ 'bangs yin rung zhe la 'jog pa yin/ dpe khrims ngan pa gzhan la ma slob/ la yog rang la 'ong / gtso bor gtam mgo dang gtam rnga 'dzum la zhog la skabs kyi dgos don gnad la phog pa dang ran la mdzes par gtam shod/ kha ngan kyis dgra mi thul zhing yus phar la 'dren rgyur mkho bas dgra la'ang kha 'jam dang sran bzod che ba gyis/ nam phugs shags su che/ snying tshur la gtod na sha tsha phar la ma byas na snying ring du shes nas kha tshur la gyu mkhan med pas drang gtam 448
