zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma ma zang mar shod/ 'on kyang mi la cir 'ong mi shes shing rgyus yod dgra ru song na rang mtshang phyir la 'don pa dang / mi phal cher kha mang bas rang gi rgyus ma 'chad/ mi'i byams pa nam phugs ringaXbs ༷ rang 'dod ma che/ snga 'dris la rang mthong dang / gsar 'grogs che ba'i gnyen bas phyi thag ring ba'i dgra dga' gsung blo gtad mi 'ong bas grogs la gsar ngas ma che/ gsar pa'ang snga ma dang rigs 'drar 'gyur/ spyi mi dgra ru ma len/ 'dod pa can la nor rdzas ma bstan/ slong yang ster nus na ma gtogs rang gi nus pa ma brtags (par)mi thub do bsdo dang mi 'grub las dga' ma mang / spro thung la ku re ma byed/ mi bden pa la shags ma byed/ mi la drin lan mi gsod par lus su ma 'jog bu lon dang 'dra/ gzhan sdug dus snying tshim gtong ba dang ri mgo gang mtho'i nyi ma ma byed/ sdug po rang la'ang yong /rang sdug dus srid cing skyid res gzhan la yang 'ong bas rang skyid pa ngom khyer mi byed/ phar byas la drin che ma 'dren/ sdug yus kyis rang dge mi thon zhing byas pa ngo med du 'gro/ dpa' skad snga bas kheb lhag po med cing / kha 'phang bzang kha pho ma 'don/ kun la rgyus yod/ngan pa che skad 'don3/ gzhan gyis khrel 'ong / dma' na rjes la ma byung yang skyon chung bas yon tan khong du sbos/ kha nas med skad shod/ bsam blo gtang sa rjes na yod pas dpon bcol dus rang 'dod sgyungs/449

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bumagros legs dus tshod zungs/ dbang yod dus pham kha longs/ rgyal kha mig gis de rig ma byed par bden gzhung gtsang po'i mjug ma lta bu zungs/ 'khor mang dus mi rtsis che dgos/ skyid dus mi dang bsnyun dkos/ dran tshad ma smra/ smras tshad thog tu khol/ chad mi btsan na mis tshad ma mi byed/ kha mang na rang gi mdo 'chor/ mi'i gros khyur mi tshud/ mi thams cad dogs zon byed pas snying nye med pas kha sdom/ zas la ngo yod/ dngos po dman pas rtsis cher bsrung rin mi chog gis byin/ phyin chad kyi bsam blo snga nas bshad na bar chad byed pa'i mi mang bas byed ma tshar bar mi go ba gyis/ ma bshad na phas kyang mi go bas bshad dbo/sa pa'i gnad de lhug par shod/ phar la sbyin pa btang na tshur la mi'i 'khor 'du/ ster ba'i sa la rgyun du mi 'gro/ mi'i sna sun nas 'gro/ gros la thag chod ma snga/bcos su yod/bsgyur du btub/ gzab tu btub/ 'di phyin chad kyi bsam blo gsang ba la'ang sbyor/ kha nyung dra ṭa na mis glen pa dang gshis ngan du brtsi zhing kun dang 'brel 'chad/ mang na rgyus lon nas brtsi bzhag chung bas kha gsal gting zab byed/ra / /tshe dpag med la na mo/ /dpal gyi bzang mo ni skyes du 'ga' zhig la 'ong ste/ bzang la brtan cing zab pa dang mdzangs pa rnams kyis rang dbang med par 'dren no/ /rgyud 'jam zhing 450

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1mnyen pa'i bzang bas ni gces pa'i thu bor byed cing / mi chos kyi yon tan mang po'i gzhi 'dzin no/ /de'ang rang gzhan gyi phyogs so so ba dang / mtho dman sogs la bltas pa'i phyogs lhung dang bral bar bskyang na rgyal po sa kun snyom pa'i chos nyid ltar bdag nyid chen po'i che rtags su 'gro/ gzhan gyi legs pa mi bzod pas ni legs pa de ci rang mi 'thob kyi/ yid kyi gdung ba dang / ya rabs kyis dpya ba 'thob/ rgyu mtshan ma brtags par mi khro ste/ khros pa'i 'og tu rigs mi rigs blta ba'i go skabs khro bas 'gog go/ /dgra la'ang 'khrugs pa lta bur mi blang ste/ rang blo'i bde ba bsreg pas dgra la cir yang mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rtsub mor 'byin pa'i ngag ni khā ta'i smra ba ltar brnyas la/ brgya lam na dgos pa can gyi drag po'i ngag ni gzi rno zhing brjid pa yin pas/ 'jam pos ni rtsub mo'ang brgyan par byed do/ /gzhan gyi phun tshogs til mar ltar btsir nas bdag la sbyor ba dang / bdag gi bde ba bgo bsha' mi byed pa'i mi la 'khor mi bsten cing bsten yang dka' ba byed par mi 'gyur te/ 'jig rten ni bde ba 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan gyi byas pa brjed cing brnyas pa ni ya rabs kyi nang na sna rdum ltar snang zhing byas pa 'bras med kyi zhing de su yang mi rmo'o/ /phar byas pa mi bgrang ste/ byas shes la de bgrang mi dgos shing mi shes pa la 46

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga nga nga bgrang yang khyad du gsod/ de 'dra'i ngag des rang gi drin de nyid chus yang yang bsing ba'i chang bzhin nyams par byed pas so/ /grogs kyi bya ba cung zad res srang mda'i mtho dman ltar dga' khro'i rnam 'gyur bstan par mi bya ste/ de de la mi dga' ba brgyud mar spel bas glo ba ring du 'gro ba'i phyir dang / a mra'i tshig gu ltar chung ba'i rang gi de nyid sgrogs pa la mna' 'dor ba'i phyir ro//bya ba legs nyes rang la'ang mchi zhing nyes zin bcos su med pas kyang grogs po'i bya ba nyes pa la tshod mi shes pa'i tshar bcad mi rigs so/ /rang nyid la yid rton cing skyabs su re ba rnams lhag par yang bskyang dgos te/ de gnyis la mi blta ba'i mi la bsam pa nye sa'i gzhi med pa'i phyir ro/ /dgos pa sgrub rgyu min pa'i yo byad la rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas mnog gcig yod snyam pa blo'i 'dzin tshul skyong ba yin cing / ha cang gsog la zhen pa ni rang la de'i dgos pa ci yang mi yong bar sbrang rtsi ltar gzhan gyis spyod pas/'phral dang 'phral du skye bo dga' ba dang / grags pa dang / bsod nams kyi dgos pa la dengs su 'jug par bya'o/ /'gro ba'i bde sdug 'khor lo bskor ba dang 'dra bas 'byor bas dregs pa dang rgud pas zhum pa'i mi brtan pa spang ngo / /mdza' bo phongs dus su 'dor ba dang gzhan phongs bar gyur dus de la dga' nyams ston 462

zhal gdams phyogs bsdus/ pod 1pa sogs kyang mi bya ste/ sdug res rang la'ang 'ong ba'i rigs pa de nyid kyis so/ /gtam la rdzun tshig mang ba dang / bya ba la 'gyur ldog che na bdem pa dang mi 'gyur ba'i tshig dang bya ba smra zhing byed pa na'ang / zla bzugs kyis bslus pa'i ngang ba pad rtsa mthong ba ltar gzhan yid ches par mi 'gyur ro/ /phyug cing mtho ba rnams la bsnyen bskur ches na 'di ni kho bo la dgos pa re'o snyam du brnyas par yang srid la/ de dag gzhan las mgu dka'/ mthun 'jug gi tshul phyogs lhung can de skye bo la mi mdzes pa'ang yin/ phan pa sus byed kyang mi shes pas 'phral gyi mthong lugs dang sbyar nas mtho la 'dud cing dman la brnyas pa'i shing lo rlung bskyod mi mang bar bya/rang gi don 'gangs can mi'i zas ngor 'chor ba dang / skyon yon gyi khog la mi dpyod pas ngo bstod mkhan la shag por rtsi ba sogs col chung gi de nyid bstan pa yin pas dang du mi blang / dam bca' mang ba khur mang po 'khur ba dang 'ching ba mang po'i nang du rkang ba bcug pa yin pas zon bya/ dam bcas nas gzhan du mi 'gyur ba rang nyid tshad mar sgrub pa'i thabs chen por 'gro/gzhan la bstod smad sogs bya ba thams cad ngo lkog stom par byed pa'ang dgos pa de dang 'dra/ su dang gang gi sprus tshad la nyan na nyes dmigs mang po srid pas rang gis legs par dpyad de 463

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rigs pa'i phyogs su zungs thub par bsten te seṅge mche bzang dang / stag dpung bzang lta bu/ 'jigs pa ma byung gong du bzur mkhas pa dang / byung ba'i 'og tu bsran tshugs pa dang / bstod smad dang dgra gnyen sogs kyis yid mi bskyod par sngon gyi las kyis ji ltar 'god pa shes dka' ba la bsams te ri bzhin brtan par gnas pa ni ches brjid pa yin no/ /rkang ba rnyis zin pa'i bya dang / rang rgyus gzhan la shor ba'i mi gnyis skyid pa'i sna thag ma bo la dkri lugs med pas spyod pa zab dgos/ de'ang gsang gtam mdza' bo la'ang sbyin par mi bya ste/ gzhan gyi bsam pa shin tu shog gyur yin pas rang gi snying gtam sbed yul dang / rang nyid gnyis de'i gsang ba mthar thug ston pa'i yul su yin shes par dka' ba dang / gsang tshig byin pa'i mdza' bo ngan pa khro na sprul las kyang 'jigs pa che ba'i phyir ro/ /lkog na 'dug kyang ba/zhan gyi skyon zlo bar mi bya ste/ sgyus/sa pa'i 'dam rdzab dkrugs pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir dang / skyon rang la'ang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /phyin chad kyi blo rtse snga nas mi ston te/ bar chad byed pa'i mi mang bas so/ /ma 'dris pa la rang gi lo rgyus 'chad pa dang / bdag nyid bstod pa dang /mang po'i tshogs dang 'khon gseb dang rtsed mo'i gral la sogs par ha cang rgyu ba dang / 'bangs la kha shags dang rol rtsed 'gyed 464
debs smon 'a4sa rang thi yod par

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ra / /e ma ho/ /rang rig spros bral chos sku kun tu bzang / /lhun grub 'gags med longs sku rdo rje sems/ /zung 'jug sprul pa'i rnam rol dga' rab rje/ /sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs//rdzogs chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'jar dpal bshes//grub gzhis nor gyi bang mdzod shī sing / /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung / /mtshungs bral bla ma rnams la bsol ba 'debs/ //thub bstan nyin mor byed po kun mkhyen rje/ /ris 'dzin yongs kyi spyi rje 'jigs med gling / /dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan bo rnyi'i mtshan/ /rig 'jin bla ma rnams la ba/sol ba 'debs/ /zla med rgyal ba gnyis pa dz+nyā na'i zhabs/ /bka' gter chos kyi mdzod 'dzin phun tshogs 'byung / /lam 'dir mos pa thob pa rat+na'i mtshan/ /drin chen bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mthu nus kyis/ /bdag cag rdo rje rig 'dzin tshom bu yis/ /dbang bzhis rgyud smin sgrib bzhi yongs sbyangs shing // rig 'dzin bzhi thob sku bzhi'i 'bras smin te/ /ye shes bla ma'i sa mchog thob par shog /ces pa'ang tshul ldan gyi dge slong dam chos 'od zer gyi ngor rtags shākya'i sras po'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin la don g.yo sgyu'i nor gyis mngon par 'byor ba/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis so//dge'o////68

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ba ba / /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag 'od dpag med/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i gtso bo'i tshul bstan nas/ /'gro la dngos grub gnyis kyi dpal ster ba/ /bde chen pad+ma ka rar gsol ba 'debs/ /de yi bka' brgyud dri med las 'ongs pa'i/ /smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsis rgyud gang zhing / /skal bzang chos kyi 'byor bas dga' mdzad pa/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mar gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs kun tu theg mchog dbe ba'i bshes/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan rnams kyis rjes 'dzin zhing / /legs dgu'i 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /bya ba rgya chen 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho'i nying khu mthar thug pa/ /rgyal dang de sras rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /zeg mchog stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /gces spras chen pos sgom par byin gyis zlobs//dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi srol/ /dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig mig bzhin srung / /rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor ma nor ba/ /tshul bzhin nyams su longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par 'od gsal rdo rje rtse mo'i lam/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun gyi yul min pa/ /sde gsum rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du/ /rnyed nas sgrub la brtson par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye 'gabs gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis/ /gdal khyab nam mkha' lta bur thag chod nas/ /459

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/stong pa'i dbyings su rig pa'i gzer bcug ste/ /ka dag chos sku sgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhi snang lam du 'khyer ba'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /rig gdangs snang ba lha skur rtsal rdzogs te/ /'od kyi lus la ye shes srog ldan pa/ /lhun grub gzugs sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ thun mong bden bzhi sgom pa'i rnal 'byor nas/ /bla med rdzogs pa chen po'i gsang lam bar/ /tshang la ma nor rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun/ /bzung ste don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa bsod nams ye shes pas rten bcas nan tan bskrul ba'i zhal ngo ma ldog par sprang rgan rang nyid kyis gang dran skad cig la bris pa dge'o// //ra / /mkha' mnyam 'gro la ma ltar rjes brtse yang / /smon lam dbang gis dus mtha'i bod 'bangs la/ /thugs rje lhag par myur bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bka' drin zla med o rgyan chos rje dang / /mchog ba/zigs grub brgya'i gtsug rgyan bi ma la/ /brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /mi phyed mos gus gdung ba'i shugs phyung ste/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mthong grol zhal bzang ston cing byin gyis rlobs/ /dbang 'byor bden tshig gsung zhing byin gyis rlobs/ /ting 'dzin dgongs pa btad de byin gyis rlobs/ /nyid dang rnam dbyer med par byin 460

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nga gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang rnyiḥphu mchog sprul rin po che'i ngor a zas so////nga / /'jigs med grub brgya'i gtsug nor pad+ma 'byung / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyi ma klong chen rje/ /thugs sras brgyud par bcas pa'i byin rlabs rgyun/ /kun 'dus rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /srid bdes mi 'phrog nges 'byung bsam pa yis//bskrul te mchog gsum gtsug gi lhar 'dzin zhing / /gzhan don kho nar byang chub mchog sgrub pa'i/ /bsam sbyor rlabs chen 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par mos gus bla ma'i lam bzang la/ /brten nas dbang gi ye shes gong 'phel te/ /gdal khyab nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /rang sems gnyug ma mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de tshe bcos slad bral ba'i bsam gtan mthus/ /bya rtsol bcos ma'i lta sgom rang sar grol/ /byar med rig pa'i klong du btsan sa zin/ /'khrul ba'i grong khyer stong par byin gyis rlobs/ /gzhi las 'phags pa'i ye shes rlung gi gdangs/ /rtsa mchog me long dwangs pa'i ngos shar ba/ /lhun grub zhing skru'i snang ba bkrag po cher/ /snang bzhi'i lang tsho rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnal 'byor zab mos yul sems kha dog bsgyur/ /gnyid rmi'i bag chags 'od gsal 'khor lor sbyangs/ /skye 'chi bar do'i 'khrul 16

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/snang dra ba kun/ /nyag gcig rtogs pas chod par byin gyis rlobs//'di dang bar dor grol ba ma thob na/ /'chi tshe sangs rgyas sprul bas zhal bstan nas/ /rig 'dzin gnas su bde bar dbugs phyungs te/ /go 'phang mchog la sbyor bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'ang 'jigs med bsam gtan byis nan gyis bskul ba ltar/bstan pa'i nyi mas bris pa dge bar gyur cig///nga / /'jigs zal 'chi med sku can pad+ma 'byung / /jeg mchog bstan pa'i shing rta klong chen pa/ /gangs can phan bde'i nyi ma 'jigs bral gling / /gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis lhun grub shog /shri ban gyi ngor bris// //ma / /skal bzang thar par bgrod pa'i mig gcig pu/ /jeg mchog lam gnad ston pa'i sgron me che/ /rab 'byams rgyal kun phrin las byed po ru/ /rnam 'phrul rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /rang byung pad+ma'i man ngag nor bu'i mdzod/ /las 'phro smon lam dag pas kha bye ste/ /dus mthar rnod ldan 'gro la dbugs 'byin pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun tu bzang po 'jigs med gling pa'i sde'i/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las gnyer 'chang bar/ /rigs kun khyab bdag bla mas byin brlabs pa//dpal ldan skal bzang dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'di 46 2

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /lam bzang sgrub pa'i phyi nang mthun rkyen tshogs/ /ma tshang med par ngang gis 'byor ba dang / /'gal rkyen mtha' dag zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bcos min snying rje che dang byang chub la/ /mi phyed dad pas drangs pa'i sems bskyed kyis/ /rgyal sras spyod mchog zab dang rgya che'i khyod/ /bde blag nyid du 'jal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par rdo rje rtse mo'i gseng lam nas/ /sgrib bral gnyug ma'i dbyings su lhun grub kyi/ /rang snang dkyil 'khor gtso bor byang chub ste/ /'gro la mchog sbyin byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /dad ldan 'di bos kun khyab kyi gsung nan ma lhogs nas/ sprang 'chal rang nyid kyis re dogs med par bris pa mad lo// //ra / /rgyal ba 'od dpag med mgon la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin byis rlobs/ /tshe 'di 'phos ma thag pa ru/ /bde ba can du drang du gsol/ /blo bzang la'o/ / //ba / /'jigs rung 'khor mtshor byings pa'i 'gro ba la/ /dmigs med snying rje'i dbang gyur sprul pa'i gar/ /bstan mdzad legs pa'i lam ston smra ba'i nyi/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /skye ba kun tu mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /'bral med gtsug gi rgyan du 'thob pa dang / /de'i gsung 463

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gdams don ma nor nyams blangs nas/ /gtan bde'i rtsa ba tshugs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbal shul khyo kho'i phyogs nas dad ldan khro rgyal gyi ngor a ba so////ra / /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje phrin las rnams/ /gcig bsdus rje btsun myur ma dpa' mo'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'di phyi bar do kun/ /'jigs dang sdug bsngal tshogs las bskyab tu gsol/ /dge zhing bkra shis// //༄ / /'jigs med theg mchog bstan pa'i nyi ma yis/ /dad brgya'i pad+mo ge sar le zhes phye ba/ /rje btsun bla rme'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i byin rlabs myur 'jug shog /ces bla ma dam pa bsod nams don gsal gyi bka' ltar bris// //ra / /skyabs kud 'dus zhal pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /lung rtogs bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'chang ba/ /bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so skye kun rjes 'dzin shog/ //ra / /'jigs rung srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru/ /thar lam dri med blta ba'i mig gcig po/ /bla ma sangs rgyas de la gsol ba 'debs/ /theg mchog lam bzang rnyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma spyi'i gsol 'debs don gnyer can gyi ngor jis pa 464

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1dge////nga / /'jigs bral zla med ston pa sangs rgyas de la gsol ba 'debs so/ /skye kun sangs rgyas mthong bar byin byis rlobs shig /bstan pa lung dang rtogs pa'i chos mchog de la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dam chos tshul bzhin 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs shig /bstan 'dzin 'jig rten nyi ma dge 'dun de la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dam pa'i rnam thar 'khyod bar byin gyis rlobs shig /'jigs dpal gyi ngag bzhin a zas bris pa dge bar 'gyur cig///nga / /'jigs med gling pa'i bka' brgyud kyi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng mdzad pa'i/ /dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs//gtsang ma'i mi lus rin chen 'dis/ /dmyal ba'i mgo dom mi len shog /lus la bka'i chas gyon nas/ /skya bo'i las ka mi byed shog /mi gcig blo gcig yod pa de/ /sne mang las la mi bkol shog /yong nges 'chi ba mi dran par/ /don med 'dang rgya mi bkram shog /mi dgos bya ba kun bskyur nas//dgos rgyu chos su thag chod shog/dam pa'i chos la phag g.yar nas/ /chos min zol zog mi byed shog /dal dus dge sbyor bskyang ba yis/ /brel tshe rkyen gyis mi 'phrogs shog/khro skyabs shes rab la'o////466

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/༄/ /'jam dpal rjogs ba chen po'i smon lam mi shigs na da'i rol mo zhes bya ba/gzod nas rnam dag mi 'gyur thig le'i sku/ /spros pa'i grwa zur yong ye dmigs min pa/ /snang stong mnyam nyid rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /lhun rdzogs dang po'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig /gnyug ma'i rang bzhin shin tu phra ba'i yid/ /mtshon byed dpe dang brda yi thabs bstan nas/ /rgyal thabs spyi blugs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang / /bla ma'i drin gyis nges par rnyed gyur cig /zhing gi rdul snyed bskal pa ji srid du/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i nges gsang bla na med/ /rdo rje rtse mo 'od gsal snying po'i lam/ /bla ma'i drin gyis tshe 'dir rnyed gyur cig /ye nas lhun grub ma bcos rig pa'i gshis/ /rtsol zhing sgrub med chos sbu 'dus ma byas/ /ye grol gnyug ma khyab gdal chen po'i klong / /bya rtsol spros pa'i 'dzin zhen zhig gyur cig ngo bo stong nyid mtha' bral nam mkha' che/ /ring bzhin ye shes 'od gsal dum pa'i sku/ /thugs rje rol rtsal shar grol sgyu ma'i ngang / /ka dag lta ba'i gdeng chen rnyed gyur cig /ye stong rang stong chos kun rnam 466

gsol 'deb smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1stong pa'i/ /rnam med stong pa blo 'das chen po'i dbyings/ /gnyis snang 'ching ba shugs kyis dgrol nus pa'i/ /rtogs pa'i rtsal chen nang nas rdzogs gyur cig /sna tshogs gzung 'dzin spros pa'i rdzun ris kun/ /zang thal rig pa rgya yan cog bzhag ngang / /gzhi snang gzhi grol chen po'i tshul zhugs pas/ /rang gnas ye shes rang zhal mjal gyur cig /snang ba gtad med klong chen dgongs pa'i spubs/ /a 'thas 'khrul pa'i dmigs gtad kun bshigs nas/ /byar med ngang la ma bcos cog bzhag pas/ /'dzin med rig pa bab la gnas gyur cig /sgom blo'i dran 'dzin nam mkha' mdung bskor bzhin/ /mi sgom 'khrul pa'i kun rtog dbyings su thim/ /sgo ma dang mi sgo ma byis pa'i rtsed mo ltar/ /gtad so'i rdzun phug khong nas rdib gyur cig /phyi ru yid dpyad 'dzin pa'i sems mi spro/ /nang du nyams zhen sgom pa'i ro mi myang / /sgom med rig pa'i ngang du gcer nyal bas/ /'od gsal nyi ma snying la 'char gyur cig /brtan g.yo'i chos kun sgyu ma'i rtsed mo bzhin/ /med bzhin snang ba las kyi 'khor lo can/ /kun byed rig pa'i rnam 'phrul rdzun po cher/ /rtogs nas dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig gyur cig /de ltar rang bzhag nyams myong goms pa'i mthus/ /las rlung dbu ma'i dbyings su 'dus pa las/ /khams gsum ma lus bde stong gcig sga rgyas/ /467

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/'ching ba'i rnal 'byor chen por bdag gyur cig /slar yang sgo yul rlung gi gnad bsnun nas/ /ye shes bzhi sbyor chen po'i lam sbyangs pas/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong pa'i gzugs/ /mi 'gyur bde ba'i nyams brgyar 'bar gyur cig /dag pa dbyings sgron 'od lnga'i lding khang na//rnam par mi rtog rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /mi shigs dwangs ma mchog gi skur smin pa/ /rlum 'khrigs thig le'i ra bar brtan gyur cig /chos nyid mngon sum tshogs kyi lam goms pas/ /sbyor ba'i lam bzhir nyams snang gong du 'phel/ /rig pa tshad phebs bden don mngon sum mthong / /chos zad blo 'das sgom lam rdzogs gyur cig /nam zhig gzhi dbyings thig le chen po'i klong / /gzhi snang lhun grub rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs te/ /phra rab rdul dang bral ba'i ye shes lus/ /'jam dpal dga' ba'i rdo rje mchog 'grub shog /ces pa'ang mdo smad kyi sprang spyon 'jigs med bstan rgyam gyis chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyi shar la bris pa dge zhing bkra shis// // pa / /mthon mthing ral ba'i zur phud rnam pa lnga/ /mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo ru/ /yongs rdzogs 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dpal/ /bdag la ye shes ster ba'i lhar bzhengs shig /mya ngan nyam thag bu chung skyabs med pa/ /gdung ba'i yus kyis ma 468

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1la 'bod pa bzhin/ /mi shes dra ba 'thug pos bcings pa bdag /gdung shugs mchi ma g.yo bas lha khyod 'bod/ /gti nug mun rum 'thug po'i rgyar 'thum zhing / /chos mig rdul dang bral bas rab spangs bdag /rtag tu thugs rje'i gter khyod bsnyen lags na/ /mthong ba'i chos la byin rlabs snang ba stsol/ /skal pa dman la blo gros shin tu dman/ /dman pa las kyang shin tu dman pa bdag /gdung ba'i yid kyis lha khyod rjes dran na/ /thugs rje'i phyag yangs rkyongs shig 'jam pa'i dpal/ /zab mo'i gnas lugs lta ba'i shes rab mig /kun nas ldong ba'i nyam chung byis pa bdag /rtse gcig sems kyis lha khyod bsnyen bgyid na/ /snying la ye shes snang ba 'char du snyol/ /bde gshegs gsung rab drang dang nges pa'i gnad/ /rnam par bye ba'i blo nus bral ba bdag /snying rje'i bdag nyid mchog khyod bsnyen lags kyis/ /spobs pa'i gter chen brgyad kyi sgo 'phar phyes/ /phyin drug sbyong ba'i khyim la mi dbang zhing / /yon tan nor gyis phongs pa'i skal ngan bdag /'phags mchog lag na ral gri'i zhabs mchod na/ /bslab gsum rgyal thabs chen po'i khri la zhog /kun rmongs g.yul gyi 'jigs pas zin gyur cing / /nyon mongs las kyi nyes pas btab pa bdag /lha mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje khyod bsnyen gyis/ /sgrib bral ye shes gzigs pas rtag tu skyongs//469

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/grangs med 'dren pa du mas rab btang zhing / /sems can kun gyi snyigs mar gyur pa bdag /bcom ldan ngag gi dbang phyug bsnyen bkur na/ /rmad byung ye shes sku yi snang ba ston/ /g.yang sa mang po'i lam du rab zhugs shing / /blo gros log par 'phyan pa'i rmongs pa bdag /rje btsun ye shes me long khyod mchod kyis/ /kun tu bzang po'iX'od zer bdag la ston/ /the tshom reg pa rtsub mos ches gzir shing / /bden gnyis rig pa'i gom tshugs 'khyor ba bdag /lha mchog smra ba'i nyi ma khyod sgrub na/ /gzungs spobs sprin gyi 'dzum dkar snying la ston/ /zab rgyas gzhung lugs smra ba'i mthu med cing / /log par smra ba ngan pa'i dbang gyur bdag /'jam mgon snying gi nyi ma khyod mchod na/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi'i snang ba stsol/ /mdor na 'di nas bla med byang chub bar/ /lha mchog chos kyi nyi ma 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mi 'bral snying gi this ler rtag bzhugs te//mi zad ye shes mchog gi dga' ston stsol/ /ces pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med pas lcags sprul zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad la mi phyed pa'i gdung ba drag pos gsol ba btab pa dge legs ye shes mchog stsol zhes bya ba sirnyi ra sna// // ba / /bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun mkhyen rab lha/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig myur mdzad sgrol ma sogs/ /sras bcas rgyal ba 470

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rnams la gus btud nas/ /mkhyen par gsol gyis bdas/ la thugs brtses dgongs/ /bdag 'dra stes dbang legs pas mi lus thob/ /rang dang gzhan gyi bde sdug tshul mang mthong phal cher skyo shas skye ba'i snon mar gyur/ /bsam blo mang du bskor nas gcig steng 'khor/ /da ni skye zhing skye ba'i phreng ba kun/ /'jigs rung sdug bsngal khur pos gnya' mnan nas/ /dam chos byed dbang bral ba'i ngan song du/ /bzod pa ma thob bar du ma 'gro shog /bde 'gror dmyal ba sgrub tu skyes 'dra ba/ /zhe sdang shas che 'dod la brkams pa dang / /las 'bras tshul la yid mi ches pa dang / /sdig spyod dga' ba'i rigs su mi skye shog /skyid la chags shing dbang gis dregs pa dang / /grogs ngan dbang gis bag med dbang du gyur/ /'du 'dzi bsten cing bya ba mang po la/ /chags pa'i rnyi yis zin par ma gyur cig /bkres pas nyen zhing lto phyir rgyu bas ngal/ /gos med gnas med dus kun bag rab grang / /gzhan ngo blta zhing gzhan dbang gis khrid pa/ /sdug phongs dbul po'i nang du mi skye shog /rang don rlung khyer bya ba ngan pas brel/ /gzhan phan mi 'grub rtsod pas 'khor sems bsreg /ltar snang bdud kyis dam chos sad la shor/ /sde dgon gog po'i nang du mi skye shog /mtshan ldan bla ma mgo bo'i thod bzhin 'khur/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab pha 47

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/yi las bzhin slob/ /sgrub la nan tan chu bo'i rgyun bzhin brtson/ /dam pa'i spyod pas tshe lus don yod shog /gong na dpon med rang dbang thob pas bde/ /'og na 'bangs med gcig pur bag yang bde/ /bar na las med sos dal sdod pas bde/ /bde ba gsum gyis mi tshe 'khrol bar shog /de tshe nad med zo mdog bzang zhing rgyas/ /lus yang nyams stobs ldan la lto 'dun chung / /shing shun rtsa ba 'bras bu'i kha zas sogs/ /ngan ngon tsam gyi 'tsho bas chog shes shog /sgra med nags tshal zhi bar lus sbed cing / /mi smra yang dag sdom pas ngag kyang sbas/ /chos tshul zab mo'i phug tu yid sbas te/ /sgo gsum sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas shog /brtul zhugs de yis rgyal rnams dgyes pa bskyed/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba'i lha mang kun dgar byas/ /rang sems chos kyi dga' bas ngal sos nas/ / 'jig rten gsum gyi yon gnas dam par shog /de nas rlabs chen brtson pa'i go cha lhon/ /snying rje'i gzhu thogs 'dus pa'i nang zhugs te/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dgra thabs kyis/ /nyam thag ma rgan 'gro ba'i dpung byed shog /thugs rjes bzigs shig rje btsun mkhyen rab bdag /grub par mdzod cig bdag gi re 'bras 'di/ /da dung tshe rabs phreng bar khyod zhabs la/ /'jus nas smon lam dkar po 'debs par shog///472

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1ma / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /bdag ni skye zhing skye ba'i phreng ba kun//dpal ldan dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing //shugs drag thar 'dod bsam pas nyer drangs pa'i//lha chos brtson pas nyams su len par shog /mtha' yas 'gro la snying rje chen po'i blo//rlung gis bskul ba'i me bzhin 'bar ba dang / /chos nyid zab mo rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis//srid pa rmang nas sgyel ba'i mthu thob shog/gnas skabs bde nas bde ba'i zhing 'gro zhing / /mthar thug bla med byang chub mchog brnyes te/ /dam chos yid bzhin char gyi rgyun bzang pos//'gro kun ma rig gnyid las slong gyur cig /ces pa'ang rig lha'i ngor kun bzang 'jigs med pas so// //nga / /byams brtses 'gro ba ma lus bu bzhin srung / /spyod yul bdud kyi lam las shin tu 'das/ /nus mthu phas kyi rgol bas mi bzlog pa/ /srid gsum bla ma'i zhabs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsil ljongs snod bcud skyob la mtshungs med pa'i/ /thugs dam mi 'gyur mtsho skyes rgyal ba dang / /sman bla spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma yum/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i rtsal shugs phyungs/ /brnag dka' snyigs ma'i gdung ba rtsub mo'i cha/ /nad yams gdon bgegs 'khrugs rtsod dbul phongs sogs/ /mchog gsum byin rlabs bdud rtsis nyer zhi nas/ /bde skyid snang bas sa steng 473

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/khyab par shog /khyad par bdag cag dam chos nyan bshad dang / /rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i gnas skabs kun/ /mi mthun bar chad ming yang mi 'byung zhing / /legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar shog /gzhan gyis byad gtad rbad 'dre'i gnod pa dang //phung dur dam gsum la sogs sri yi rigs/ /rno dbal ye shes ral gris tshar bcad de/ /stong chen dbyings su nye bar zhi gyur cig /dpal ldan nag po chen po lcam dral sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' sdod bstan srung rgya mtshos kyang / /dus rnam kun tu g.yel med srung ba dang //'dod pa'i phrin las yid bzhin sgrub par shog /ces pa'ang mchog sprul rin po che mkhas btsun bzang po'i khyu mchog blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bzhed pa ltar/ /bstan pa'i nyi mas bris te phul ba dge/ //474

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1 yang༄/ /mtsho skyes phrin las rgyas pa'i smon lam bkra shis 'khyil ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na ma shrī pad+ma badz+ra ye/ /pad+ma'i 'byung gnas chen por sor rtog gi/ /ye shes dbang 'byor skye ba'i rol gar gyis/ /rdo rje'i rnam thar 'dzam gling khyab ston pa/ /rnga yab gling pa'i phrin las 'bar gyur cig /grangs med rdo rje 'chang dbang dgongs pa'i mthil/ /'phags yul grub brnyes bye ba'i zhal gyi bcud/ /mi zad byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun 'khyil ba/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /rdo rje'i gsung mchog gnyis med gnyis snang ba'i/ /mkhan slob lo paṇa rgya mtsho'i thugs bskyed mthu/ /bsil ljongs phan bde'i ljon par legs smin pa/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /gsung rab don kun skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ /nyams len gnad kyi gong dur gcig 'dril ba/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i sgrub brgyud ngo mtshar phul/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /zab rgyas theg chen lung rtogs chu bo'i mdzod/ /rmad 476

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/byung rim gnyis lam gyi klu dbang brjid/ /dngos grub rin chen brgya yis yongs gang ba/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /khyad par rgyud sde gzhan gyi man ngag dang / /thun min rdo rje snying po'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'pho chen 'od lus sgrub pa'i shing rta'i srol/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /snying rje'i dbang phyug gdams pa'i brdzur zhugs nas/ /dus babs ji bzhin sna tshogs 'gro 'dul gyi//phrin las bye ba phrag brgya 'jug pa'i gzhi//mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /snying po'i don la mkhas dang man ngag gi/ /drod thob rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phreng ba can/ /rtog ge 'chal ba'i dri mas ma bslad pa//mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /ring brgyud bka' yi chu bo ma nyams shing / /sngon med dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam gnad/ /nye brgyud zab gter nor bu'i mdzod nas thon/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /mdor na byang phyogs 'phags pa'i zhing khams su/ /thub pa'i bstan dang de 'dzin brgyud ma ru/ /'phel bas 'jig rten dge ba'i rten gcig pu/ /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /mkhyen brtse nus pas dri med lugs bzang 'di/ /'dzin skyong spel mdzad skyes du chen po rnams/ /mi nub sku che'i rgyal mtshan rab brtan cing / /mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i ring lugs 476

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1rgyas gyur cig /smon log dam sri'i 'phrul dang rgya 'dre'i g.yul//kla klo'i sbyor ngan la sogs nag phyogs kyi/ /rtsub 'gyur ldang ba'i go skabs gtan bcom ste/ /mtsho skyes ring lugs phyogs mthar rgyas gyur cig /phyi snod 'byung bzhi'i dge mtshan dar babs shing / /skye dgu'i chos srid nyi zla'i snang ba 'bar/ /bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos sa steng kun khyab ste/ /mtsho skyes ring lugs phyogs brgyar 'bar gyur cig /dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /mthu ldan dam can srung ma'i nus mthu yis/ /ris med bod khams bsil ba'i smon lam 'di/ /don yod zhags pa'i mthu ltar 'grub gyur cig /mtsho skyes phrin las rgyas pa'i smon lam bkra shis 'khyel ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di'ang rdo rong gi sbyon pa tshangs pa'i me tog gsar pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas shing rta sa ga'i nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang 'brel bar bris pa bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba'i sgo chen por gyur cig/ //nga / /skyid na bsnyen bkur bya ba'i zhing / /sdug na yus kyis 'bod pa'i yul/ /tshe 'di'i re sa phyi ma'i skyabs/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan ras gzigs/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma gsum/ /mtshan dang rnam 'gyur tha dad kyang / /dgongs klong mdzad pa dbyer med 477

ngo da 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba phyir/ /so sor mi 'dzin gcig tu bsnyu/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs/ /dus rnams kun tu byin gyis rlobs/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob dus su/ /snying po'i lha chos 'grub par shog /tshe thung dgun nya 'dra ba 'di/ /don ldan chos la 'dril bar shog /gdong thug 'chi ba 'byung tsa na/ /chos kyi ra mda' sleb par shob/ /thag ring phyi mar 'gro ba'i tshe/ /chos kyi lam rgyags mang bar shog /tshe 'dir chos kyi sa bon theb/ /phyi ma lo thog legs par shob /gar skyes gang du song na yang / /chos kyi bag chags sad par shog /skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / /blo gtad chos la byed par shog /chos kyi 'jug sgo ma nor ba/ /dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan par shog / chos kyi gzhi ma ma 'chug pa/ /mi 'che'i brtul zhugs brling bar shog /chos kyi srog shing ma yo ba/ /bden pa'i gzhung lam srong bar shog /chos kyi nying khu ma bslad pa/ /byang chub sems gnyis sbyong bar shog /dam chos rgyal po yi ge drug /g.yel med bzlas sgom byed par shog chos bzhin bsgrub la bar chad med/ /mthun rkyen yid bzhin 'dzoms par shog /bla ma lha la dpang ba col nas/ /smon lam chos la btab pa 'di/ /btab sar thebs shing phyir mi ldog /chud zos med par 'grub par shog /dad ldan dgra bla phan dar gyi ngor bstan nyis bris// //478

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1༄༅/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol ston pa bla na med/ /shākya seng ge'i lung rtogs bstan pa'i dbyig /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor 'dzin rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dus kun rjes 'dzin shog /btsun pa tshe brtan kyi ngor smras// //nga / /rdo rje 'chang dbang 'jigs med gling pa'i sde'i/ /bstan pa / re rgyal ma tshon bshad sgrub las gsum gyis/ /'dzin mdzod rtso brgyud bla rmer gsol ba 'debs/ /gtan bde'i rtsa ba tshugs par byin kyis rlobs/ /nag thā dpon po 'jigs pa'i ngor smras pa dge/ //nga / /phyos/sa bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag gi smon lam 'grub pa'i slad du dgongs par gyur cig bdag deng nas bzung ste byang chub kyi bar du phyin ci log gi yul la dga' ba thams cad bral te/ dam pa'i chos dang / khyad par du yang theg pa chen po'i chos la dga' ba mang bar gyur cig chos la dga' ba'i zas kyis nyin mtshan 'da' zhing / bde ba'i dus dang sdug bsngal ba'i dus thams cad du chos kyi dga' ba de las mi g.yo bar gyur cig bdag gi chos kyi dga' ba'i ro de yang phyi phyir dme par dag cing rgya che ba dang /479

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gya nom pa dang / sna tshogs su gnas par 'gyur zhing / skad cig rer yang tshad med pa'i bar du 'phel bar gyur cig de'i mthu las chos mi brjed pa'i dran pa'i me long shin tu gsal zhing dwangs pa dang / ri rab ltar brtan cing mi sgul ba'i dran pa thob par gyur cig /dran pa kun tu srung ba dang / dran pa la rtag 'grus su slob pa dang / shes bzhin gyi dpung dang ldan par gyur te rmi lam na yang chos kyi dran pa mngon du gnas par gyur cig dran pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa la brten nas gang smra ba dang ci byed pa yang rung ste thams cad du ma 'a la pa dang / tshod la babs pa dang dus las mi yol bar 'jug pas skye dgu thams cad kyis bsngags par 'os pa'i gnas su gyur cig /gzhan gyi chos kyi dga' ba dang dran pa la gnod pa byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang 'du 'dzi dang gnyid la dga' ba la sogs pa bar du gcod pa'i chos rnams thams cad kyi thams cad du mi 'byung bar gyur cig /chos kyi dga' ba dang dran pa'i stobs yongs su spyad pa'i phyir sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par bya ba byed cing dge ba'i rtsa ba skrun pa dang / sems can thams cad kyang 'phags pa'i dga' ba zang zing med pa dang dran pa rnam par dag pa la 'god par gyur cig /tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa myur du rdzogs par byas 480

gsol 'debs smon lam phyogs bsdus/ pod 1nas byang chub chen po'i chos kyi dga' ba dang dran pa nyams pa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa la reg par gyur cig /sems rgyud log pa'i yul la mi g.yengs shing / /dus kun chos kyi dga' bas 'tsho ba dang / /dran ldan mkhas pa'i nang na gtsor gyur te/ /don gnyis sgrub la mthu dang ldan par shog /ces dge tshul blo gros dpal bzang gis tshig rtsa bzhag nas rtsom par bskul ba ltar bstan pa'i nyi mas thang stong rgyal po'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o// //481

pod 1bsgogs rjes kyi gtam/de yang mdo khams rol chen bco brgyad las/ rma rol dang /smar rol/ rdo rol/ zla rol sogs su gtso bor chags pa'i lcags mo mgo log pa 'di dag yongs grags ltar na phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i mjug ste bod rab byung bdun pa tshugs ma thag tsam la khams 'gu kho lung nas gnas spo byas te/ da lta'i mgo log pad+ma rdzong gi sa cha gtso bor gyur ba'i rdo 'dzi smar gsum gyi yul gru bdag gir byas nas ring du ma song ba na/ mgo log phag thar gyi sras su kaḥthog bla ma byang chub seng ge'i thugs zin gyi slob bu mkhas shing grub pa'i bdag nyid chen po mgo log bla ma chos 'bum bya ba 'khrungs pas dbu bzung / rim bzhin kar rnying bstan pa'i sgron me karma yongs 'dzin chen po dang / zhwa nag sku phreng bcu ba mchog sprul chos dbyings rdo rje/ bcu gcig pa chen po ye shes rdo rje/ zhwa dmar bdun pa ye shes snying po/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i yang sprul de ma thag pa mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje/ zhe chen rab 'byams lnga ba kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs gangs 1

pod 1 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/can bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag chen por gyur ba dag dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i khyu mchog mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho/ grub pa'i dbang po gtsang ba byams pa chos 'dzin/ smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi nyin byed phyag mdzod byams pa gsung rab/ sman rgyal g.yu thog gnyis pa lha rje stag bla nor bu/lo rgyus spra ba'i dbang po gyi lung sras po sku mched/ rtsod rigs smra ba'i seng chen 'gya ba a lags mdo sngags/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po khra dge slong tshul khrims dar rgyas/ yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros/ bstan pa'i nyin byed a rig dge bshes chen mo/ gsang chen bka' babs shar yod grags pa bzang po/ mdo rgyud smra ba gyang sprul don yod rdo rje/ nges pa don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sku phyogs shing bza' sku phreng / rtsod bral dus babs kyi gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa/ rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhan chen a skong blo bzang rdo rje/ theg mchog smra ba'i bka' babs kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo sogs mkhas dbang nor bu'i phreng ba zam ma chad par yul 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'am dus yun ring por bzhugs te mdzad phrin rgya cher bskyangs pa dang /dgon gnas dang dge 'dun gyi 'dus sde dag smra ma dgos/ khyim pa spra nag pa dag gi khrod du'ang yig tshang lo rgyus gleng ba'i dbe 2

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 1dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsugs thog 'brel yod don bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yig thog nas khul mi dmangs srid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bsnyun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam gsang ba sngags dang 'brel ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' dos dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bsnyun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son ltar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i gnas bab 'og gsung 'bum gcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos gang rgyas shos kyi rmang gzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du 6
